includeSubDomains" always; # HSTS with preload (for submission to browsers' preload lists) add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload" always; # Development/staging environment (shorter duration) add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=300; includeSubDomains" always; X-Content-Type-Options - Prevents MIME Type Sniffing: # Prevents browsers from interpreting files as different MIME types add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always; Referrer-Policy - Controls Referrer Information: # No referrer when protocol security is downgraded add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer-when-downgrade" always; # Strict referrer policy options add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always; add_header Referrer-Policy "same-origin" always; add_header Referrer-Policy "no-referrer" always; # Origin only (no path information) add_header Referrer-Policy "origin" always; X-XSS-Protection - Legacy XSS Protection: # Enable XSS filtering and block page rendering if attack detected add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always; # Note: This header is largely deprecated in favor of CSP # Modern browsers rely on Content-Security-Policy instead Permissions-Policy - Controls Browser Features: # Disable potentially dangerous features add_header Permissions-Policy " camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), speaker=() " always; Nginx excels in microservices environments, routing requests to different services based on URL patterns: location /auth/ { proxy_pass http://auth-service:3001/; } location /users/ { proxy_pass http://user-service:3002/; } location /orders/ { proxy_pass http://order-service:3003/; }

Use Nginx as an API gateway for request routing, authentication, and rate limiting: location /api/v1/ { auth_request /auth; proxy_pass http://api-backend/; } location = /auth { internal; proxy_pass http://auth-service/verify; proxy_pass_request_body off; proxy_set_header Content-Length ""; proxy_set_header X-Original-URI $request_uri; }
Enable the status module for monitoring: location /nginx_status { stub_status on; access_log off; allow 127.0.0.1; deny all; }

Modern e-commerce platforms generate billions of interactions daily, creating vast amounts of unstructured data including product descriptions, user reviews, browsing patterns, and purchase histories. Traditional recommendation systems, while effective, often struggle to understand the nuanced context and semantic relationships within this data. Enter Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) - a revolutionary approach that combines the power of large language models with dynamic information retrieval to create more intelligent, context-aware recommendation systems. This comprehensive series will guide you through building a sophisticated e-commerce recommendation system using RAG technology, covering everything from architectural design to production deployment.
documents.s: Building Intelligent E-commerce Recommendations with RAG: Part 1 - Introduction and Architecture Overview

documents.t: Traditional collaborative filtering and content-based systems analyze patterns and similarities but often miss the subtle nuances of user intent. RAG systems can: Understand natural language queries: "Show me comfortable running shoes for winter marathons" Process complex product relationships: Understanding that "wireless earbuds with noise cancellation" relates to "productivity" and "commuting" Capture seasonal and temporal context: Recommending products based on current trends and seasonal relevance

RAG enables unprecedented personalization by: Dynamic content generation: Creating personalized product descriptions and recommendations Multi-modal understanding: Processing text, images, and user behavior simultaneously Real-time adaptation: Adjusting recommendations based on immediate context and user feedback

Unlike static models, RAG systems continuously improve by: Incorporating fresh data: New products, reviews, and trends are immediately available Learning from interactions: User feedback directly improves future recommendations Adapting to market changes: Seasonal trends, new categories, and emerging products
This 5-part series will take you from concept to production:
RAG fundamentals for e-commerce System architecture and components Technology stack selection Data flow and processing pipeline

The entry point for all recommendation requests, responsible for: interface QueryProcessor { // Parse and understand user intent parseUserQuery(query: string): ParsedQuery; // Extract contextual information extractContext(userId: string, sessionData: SessionContext): UserContext; // Generate search parameters generateSearchParams(query: ParsedQuery, context: UserContext): SearchParams; } interface ParsedQuery { intent: 'browse' | 'search' | 'compare' | 'recommendation'; categories: string[]; filters: ProductFilter[]; sentiment: 'positive' | 'neutral' | 'negative'; urgency: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; } interface UserContext { userId: string; demographics: UserDemographics; purchaseHistory: Purchase[]; browsingBehavior: BrowsingSession[]; preferences: UserPreferences; currentSession: SessionContext; } Key Responsibilities: Natural language query understanding Intent classification and entity extraction Context enrichment with user data Query optimization for downstream components

The core of our RAG system, implementing hybrid search strategies: interface RetrievalEngine { // Semantic search using vector embeddings semanticSearch(query: string, filters: SearchFilters): Promise<Product[]>; // Traditional keyword-based search keywordSearch(query: string, filters: SearchFilters): Promise<Product[]>; // Hybrid search combining both approaches hybridSearch(params: SearchParams): Promise<SearchResult[]>; // Collaborative filtering recommendations collaborativeFilter(userId: string, context: UserContext): Promise<Product[]>; } interface SearchResult { product: Product; relevanceScore: number; searchType: 'semantic' | 'keyword' | 'collaborative'; explanation: string; } Search Strategies: Semantic Search: Vector similarity using embeddings Keyword Search: Traditional full-text search with BM25 Collaborative Filtering: User-based and item-based recommendations Hybrid Ranking: Combining multiple signals for optimal results

Transforms retrieved products into personalized recommendations: interface GenerationEngine { // Generate personalized recommendations generateRecommendations( products: Product[], userContext: UserContext, generationParams: GenerationParams ): Promise<Recommendation[]>; // Create explanations for recommendations generateExplanations( recommendation: Recommendation, userContext: UserContext ): Promise<string>; // Generate product comparisons generateComparison( products: Product[], comparisonCriteria: string[] ): Promise<ProductComparison>; } interface Recommendation { product: Product; score: number; reasoning: string; personalizationFactors: PersonalizationFactor[]; confidence: number; } interface PersonalizationFactor { type: 'purchase_history' | 'browsing_behavior' | 'demographics' | 'seasonal'; weight: number; explanation: string; }

Database Best For Pros Cons Pinecone Production scale Managed service, excellent performance Cost, vendor lock-in Weaviate Complex schemas GraphQL API, multi-modal support Learning curve Qdrant Self-hosted Open source, Rust performance Operational overhead Chroma Development Easy setup, Python native Limited production features Recommendation: Start with Qdrant for development and Pinecone for production.

Model Best For Pros Cons OpenAI GPT-4 High-quality generation Excellent reasoning, API ease Cost, latency Anthropic Claude Safety-focused Strong reasoning, less hallucination Rate limits Local Models Privacy/cost Data control, no API costs Infrastructure complexity Azure OpenAI Enterprise Enterprise features, compliance Microsoft ecosystem Recommendation: OpenAI GPT-4 for prototyping, Local models for production scale.

interface EmbeddingService { generateProductEmbedding(product: Product): Promise<number[]>; generateQueryEmbedding(query: string): Promise<number[]>; generateUserEmbedding(userContext: UserContext): Promise<number[]>; } // Popular embedding models const EMBEDDING_MODELS = { 'text-embedding-ada-002': { dimensions: 1536, cost: 'low', quality: 'high', provider: 'openai' }, 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2': { dimensions: 384, cost: 'free', quality: 'medium', provider: 'sentence-transformers' }, 'text-embedding-3-large': { dimensions: 3072, cost: 'medium', quality: 'highest', provider: 'openai' } };

interface BatchProcessor { // Daily product catalog updates processProductUpdates(): Promise<void>; // Weekly user behavior analysis updateUserProfiles(): Promise<void>; // Monthly model retraining retrainModels(): Promise<void>; // Real-time event processing processUserEvent(event: UserEvent): Promise<void>; } interface UserEvent { userId: string; eventType: 'view' | 'click' | 'purchase' | 'cart_add' | 'search'; productId?: string; searchQuery?: string; timestamp: Date; metadata: Record<string, any>; }

class PerformanceOptimizer { async optimizeRetrieval(query: SearchParams): Promise<SearchResult[]> { // Parallel search strategies const [semanticResults, keywordResults, collaborativeResults] = await Promise.all([ this.semanticSearch(query), this.keywordSearch(query), this.collaborativeFilter(query.userId) ]); // Fast result merging return this.mergeResults(semanticResults, keywordResults, collaborativeResults); } async cacheStrategy(userId: string, query: string): Promise<Recommendation[]> { const cacheKey = `recommendations:${userId}:${hash(query)}`; // Check cache first const cached = await this.cache.get(cacheKey); if (cached && !this.isStale(cached)) { return cached; } // Generate fresh recommendations const recommendations = await this.generateRecommendations(userId, query); // Cache with appropriate TTL await this.cache.set(cacheKey, recommendations, this.getTTL(query)); return recommendations; } }

interface ScalabilityConfig { // Horizontal scaling parameters maxConcurrentRequests: number; vectorDBShards: number; embeddingBatchSize: number; // Performance thresholds maxLatency: number; // milliseconds minThroughput: number; // requests per second // Resource limits maxMemoryUsage: number; // MB maxCPUUsage: number; // percentage } class AutoScaler { async scaleBasedOnLoad(metrics: SystemMetrics): Promise<void> { if (metrics.avgLatency > this.config.maxLatency) { await this.scaleOutVectorDB(); await this.increaseEmbeddingWorkers(); } if (metrics.throughput < this.config.minThroughput) { await this.optimizeQueryRouting(); await this.warmupCaches(); } } }

interface CostOptimizer { selectOptimalModel(query: QueryComplexity): ModelConfig; calculateCostBenefit(model: ModelConfig, expectedQuality: number): number; optimizeEmbeddingBatching(products: Product[]): BatchConfig; } enum QueryComplexity { SIMPLE = 'simple', // Basic keyword search - use smaller models MEDIUM = 'medium', // Semantic search - balanced models COMPLEX = 'complex' // Complex reasoning - premium models } const MODEL_COSTS = { 'gpt-4': { input: 0.03, output: 0.06 }, // per 1K tokens 'gpt-3.5-turbo': { input: 0.001, output: 0.002 }, 'local-llama': { input: 0, output: 0, infrastructure: 500 } // monthly };

class CacheManager { private readonly cacheLayers = { // L1: In-memory cache for hot data memory: new Map<string, CacheEntry>(), // L2: Redis for session data redis: new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL), // L3: Database for persistent data database: new Database() }; async get(key: string): Promise<any> { // Check L1 cache first if (this.cacheLayers.memory.has(key)) { return this.cacheLayers.memory.get(key).value; } // Check L2 cache const redisValue = await this.cacheLayers.redis.get(key); if (redisValue) { // Promote to L1 this.cacheLayers.memory.set(key, { value: JSON.parse(redisValue), timestamp: Date.now() }); return JSON.parse(redisValue); } // Fallback to database return await this.cacheLayers.database.get(key); } }

interface BusinessMetrics { // Revenue impact recommendationRevenue: number; averageOrderValue: number; conversionRate: number; // User engagement clickThroughRate: number; timeOnSite: number; returnCustomerRate: number; // System performance recommendationAccuracy: number; systemLatency: number; userSatisfactionScore: number; } class MetricsCollector { async trackRecommendationPerformance( recommendationId: string, userAction: UserAction ): Promise<void> { const metrics = { recommendationId, userId: userAction.userId, action: userAction.type, timestamp: new Date(), productId: userAction.productId, revenue: userAction.revenue || 0 }; await this.metricsDatabase.insert('recommendation_events', metrics); await this.updateRealTimeMetrics(metrics); } async calculateROI(timeframe: TimeFrame): Promise<ROIMetrics> { const costs = await this.calculateSystemCosts(timeframe); const revenue = await this.calculateRecommendationRevenue(timeframe); return { roi: (revenue - costs) / costs, totalRevenue: revenue, totalCosts: costs, timeframe }; } }

Welcome back to our comprehensive series on building RAG-powered e-commerce recommendation systems! In Part 1, we explored the architecture and core concepts. Now, we'll get hands-on with the foundation of any RAG system: building robust data pipelines and generating high-quality vector embeddings that capture the semantic essence of products and user behavior. Vector embeddings are the secret sauce that enables our recommendation system to understand the relationships between products, users, and their preferences at a semantic level. Let's dive into building a production-ready data processing pipeline that transforms raw e-commerce data into meaningful vector representations.

Inventory and availability stock_quantity: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, description="Available stock") is_available: bool = Field(default=True, description="Product availability") # Temporal data created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow) updated_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow) # # processors/product_processor.py import pandas as pd import numpy as np from typing import List, Dict, Tuple import re from collections import Counter import logging from models.product import Product, ProductReview logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) class ProductDataProcessor: def __init__(self): self.stop_words = self._load_stop_words() self.category_keywords = self._load_category_keywords() def clean_product_data(self, products_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame: """Clean and standardize product data""" logger.info(f"Cleaning {len(products_df)} products") # Remove duplicates products_df = products_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['id']) # Standardize text fields products_df['title'] = products_df['title'].apply(self._clean_text) products_df['description'] = products_df['description'].apply(self._clean_text) # Normalize prices products_df['price'] = pd.to_numeric(products_df['price'], errors='coerce') products_df = products_df.dropna(subset=['price']) # Fill missing values products_df['description'] = products_df['description'].fillna('') products_df['brand'] = products_df['brand'].fillna('Unknown') products_df['rating'] = products_df['rating'].fillna(0.0) products_df['review_count'] = products_df['review_count'].fillna(0) # Calculate derived features products_df['title_length'] = products_df['title'].str.len() products_df['description_length'] = products_df['description'].str.len() products_df['price_category'] = pd.cut( products_df['price'], bins=[0, 25, 100, 500, np.inf], labels=['budget', 'mid-range', 'premium', 'luxury'] ) logger.info(f"Cleaned data: {len(products_df)} products remaining") return products_df def extract_product_features(self, product: Product) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Extract meaningful features from product data""" features = { # Basic features 'title': product.title, 'description': product.description, 'category': product.category.value, 'subcategory': product.subcategory or '', 'brand': product.brand or '', # Numeric features 'price': product.price, 'rating': product.rating or 0.0, 'review_count': product.review_count, 'popularity_score': product.popularity_score, # Text processing 'combined_text': self._create_combined_text(product), 'keywords': product.keywords, 'search_terms': product.search_terms, # Categorical features 'price_range': self._categorize_price(product.price), 'rating_tier': self._categorize_rating(product.rating or 0.0), 'popularity_tier': self._categorize_popularity(product.popularity_score), # Availability features 'is_available': product.is_available, 'stock_level': self._categorize_stock(product.stock_quantity), } # Add attribute-based features features.update(self._process_attributes(product.attributes)) return features def _clean_text(self, text: str) -> str: """Clean and normalize text data""" if pd.isna(text) or not isinstance(text, str): return "" # Convert to lowercase text = text.lower() # Remove special characters but keep alphanumeric and spaces text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', ' ', text) # Remove extra whitespaces text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text).strip() return text def _create_combined_text(self, product: Product) -> str: """Create combined text for embedding generation""" components = [ product.title, product.description, product.brand or '', product.category.value, product.subcategory or '', ' '.join(product.keywords), ' '.join(product.search_terms) ] # Filter out empty components components = [comp for comp in components if comp and comp.strip()] return ' '.join(components) def _categorize_price(self, price: float) -> str: """Categorize price into ranges""" if price < 25: return 'budget' elif price < 100: return 'mid-range' elif price < 500: return 'premium' else: return 'luxury' def _categorize_rating(self, rating: float) -> str: """Categorize rating into tiers""" if rating >= 4.5: return 'excellent' elif rating >= 4.0: return 'very_good' elif rating >= 3.5: return 'good' elif rating >= 3.0: return 'average' else: return 'poor' def _categorize_popularity(self, score: float) -> str: """Categorize popularity score""" if score >= 0.8: return 'viral' elif score >= 0.6: return 'popular' elif score >= 0.4: return 'moderate' elif score >= 0.2: return 'low' else: return 'niche' def _categorize_stock(self, quantity: int) -> str: """Categorize stock levels""" if quantity == 0: return 'out_of_stock' elif quantity < 10: return 'low_stock' elif quantity < 100: return 'medium_stock' else: return 'high_stock' def _process_attributes(self, attributes: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, str]: """Process product attributes into features""" processed = {} for key, value in attributes.items(): # Normalize key clean_key = f"attr_{re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '_', key.lower())}" # Convert value to string representation if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)): clean_value = ', '.join(str(v) for v in value) else: clean_value = str(value) processed[clean_key] = self._clean_text(clean_value) return processed def _load_stop_words(self) -> set: """Load stop words for text processing""" # Basic stop words - in production, use NLTK or spaCy return { 'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'or', 'but', 'in', 'on', 'at', 'to', 'for', 'of', 'with', 'by', 'from', 'up', 'about', 'into', 'through', 'during' } def _load_category_keywords(self) -> Dict[str, List[str]]: """Load category-specific keywords""" return { 'electronics': ['smartphone', 'laptop', 'tablet', 'tv', 'camera', 'headphones'], 'clothing': ['shirt', 'pants', 'dress', 'shoes', 'jacket', 'accessories'], 'home_garden': ['furniture', 'decor', 'kitchen', 'garden', 'tools', 'appliances'], 'books': ['novel', 'textbook', 'magazine', 'ebook', 'audiobook', 'reference'], 'sports': ['equipment', 'apparel', 'fitness', 'outdoor', 'team', 'individual'], 'beauty': ['skincare', 'makeup', 'hair', 'fragrance', 'tools', 'accessories'] }

interactions_df['timestamp'].dt.hour interactions_df['day_of_week'] = interactions_df['timestamp'].dt.dayofweek interactions_df['is_weekend'] = interactions_df['day_of_week'].isin([5, 6]) # Calculate interaction weights interactions_df['interaction_weight'] = interactions_df['interaction_type'].map( lambda x: self.interaction_weights.get(InteractionType(x), 1.0) ) # Add session-based features interactions_df = self._add_session_features(interactions_df) return interactions_df def create_user_profiles(self, users_df: pd.DataFrame, interactions_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Dict]: """Create comprehensive user profiles from interaction data""" user_profiles = {} for user_id in users_df['id'].unique(): user_interactions = interactions_df[interactions_df['user_id'] == user_id] profile = { 'user_id': user_id, 'behavioral_features': self._extract_behavioral_features(user_interactions), 'preference_features': self._extract_preference_features(user_interactions), 'temporal_features': self._extract_temporal_features(user_interactions), 'engagement_features': self._extract_engagement_features(user_interactions), } user_profiles[user_id] = profile logger.info(f"Created profiles for {len(user_profiles)} users") return user_profiles def _add_session_features(self, interactions_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame: """Add session-based features to interactions""" # Sort by user and timestamp interactions_df = interactions_df.sort_values(['user_id', 'timestamp']) # Calculate time since previous interaction interactions_df['time_since_prev'] = interactions_df.groupby('user_id')['timestamp'].diff() interactions_df['time_since_prev_seconds'] = interactions_df['time_since_prev'].dt.total_seconds() # Identify session boundaries (gap > 30 interactions_df def _extract_behavioral_features(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]: """Extract behavioral patterns from user interactions""" if len(user_interactions) == 0: len(user_interactions) for interaction_type in InteractionType: ratio = interaction_counts.get(interaction_type.value, 0) / total_interactions features[f'{interaction_type.value}_ratio'] = ratio # Purchase behavior purchases = user_interactions[user_interactions['interaction_type'] == InteractionType.PURCHASE.value] features['purchase_frequency'] = len(purchases) features['avg_time_to_purchase'] = self._calculate_avg_time_to_purchase(user_interactions) # Browsing behavior views = user_interactions[user_interactions['interaction_type'] == InteractionType.VIEW.value] features['avg_session_length'] = user_interactions.groupby('session_id').size().mean() features['avg_products_per_session'] = user_interactions.groupby('session_id')['product_id'].nunique().mean() # Engagement depth features['bounce_rate'] = self._calculate_bounce_rate(user_interactions) features['repeat_visit_rate'] = self._calculate_repeat_visit_rate(user_interactions) return features def _extract_preference_features(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Extract user preferences from interaction patterns""" if len(user_interactions) == 0: return {} # This would typically join with product data to get categories, brands, etc. # For now, we'll create placeholder logic features = { 'preferred_categories': [], 'preferred_brands': [], 'price_sensitivity': 0.5, 'quality_preference': 0.5, } # Calculate preferences based on weighted interactions weighted_interactions = user_interactions.copy() weighted_interactions['weight'] = weighted_interactions['interaction_type'].map( lambda x: self.interaction_weights.get(InteractionType(x), 1.0) ) # In a real implementation, you'd join with product data here # features['preferred_categories'] = self._get_top_categories(weighted_interactions) # features['preferred_brands'] = self._get_top_brands(weighted_interactions) return features def _extract_temporal_features(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]: """Extract temporal behavior patterns""" if len(user_interactions) == 0: return {} features = {} # Time-based patterns hour_distribution = user_interactions['hour'].value_counts(normalize=True) features['peak_hour'] = hour_distribution.idxmax() features['activity_variance'] = hour_distribution.var() # Day-of-week patterns dow_distribution = user_interactions['day_of_week'].value_counts(normalize=True) features['weekend_activity_ratio'] = user_interactions['is_weekend'].mean() # Recency and frequency features['days_since_last_interaction'] = ( datetime.utcnow() - user_interactions['timestamp'].max() ).days features['interaction_frequency'] = len(user_interactions) / max( (user_interactions['timestamp'].max() - user_interactions['timestamp'].min()).days, 1 ) return features def _extract_engagement_features(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]: """Extract user engagement metrics""" if len(user_interactions) == 0: return {} features = {} # Session-based metrics session_stats = user_interactions.groupby('session_id').agg({ 'timestamp': ['min', 'max'], 'product_id': 'nunique', 'interaction_type': 'count' }).reset_index() # Calculate session durations session_stats['duration'] = ( session_stats[('timestamp', 'max')] - session_stats[('timestamp', 'min')] ).dt.total_seconds() features['avg_session_duration'] = session_stats['duration'].mean() features['total_sessions'] = len(session_stats) features['avg_actions_per_session'] = session_stats[('interaction_type', 'count')].mean() # Conversion metrics sessions_with_purchase = user_interactions[ user_interactions['interaction_type'] == InteractionType.PURCHASE.value ]['session_id'].nunique() features['session_conversion_rate'] = sessions_with_purchase / len(session_stats) if len(session_stats) > 0 else 0 return features def _calculate_avg_time_to_purchase(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> float: """Calculate average time from first interaction to purchase""" purchases = user_interactions[user_interactions['interaction_type'] == InteractionType.PURCHASE.value] if len(purchases) == 0: return 0.0 times_to_purchase = [] for _, purchase in purchases.iterrows(): session_interactions = user_interactions[ user_interactions['session_id'] == purchase['session_id'] ].sort_values('timestamp') first_interaction = session_interactions.iloc[0]['timestamp'] time_to_purchase = (purchase['timestamp'] - first_interaction).total_seconds() times_to_purchase.append(time_to_purchase) return np.mean(times_to_purchase) if times_to_purchase else 0.0 def _calculate_bounce_rate(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> float: """Calculate bounce rate (single-interaction sessions)""" session_sizes = user_interactions.groupby('session_id').size() single_interaction_sessions = (session_sizes == 1).sum() return single_interaction_sessions / len(session_sizes) if len(session_sizes) > 0 else 0 def _calculate_repeat_visit_rate(self, user_interactions: pd.DataFrame) -> float: """Calculate repeat visit rate""" unique_days = user_interactions['timestamp'].dt.date.nunique() total_days = ( user_interactions['timestamp'].max() - user_interactions['timestamp'].min() ).days + 1 return unique_days / total_days if total_days > 0 else 0 def _get_default_behavioral_features(self) -> Dict[str, float]: """Return default behavioral features for users with no interactions""" features = {} for interaction_type in InteractionType: features[f'{interaction_type.value}_ratio'] = 0.0 features.update({ 'purchase_frequency': 0.0, 'avg_time_to_purchase': 0.0, 'avg_session_length': 0.0, 'avg_products_per_session': 0.0, 'bounce_rate': 1.0, 'repeat_visit_rate': 0.0, }) return features

Now let's implement the core embedding generation system: # embeddings/embedding_generator.py import numpy as np import torch from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Union import logging from abc import ABC, abstractmethod import asyncio import aiohttp import openai from tqdm import tqdm logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) class BaseEmbeddingGenerator(ABC): """Abstract base class for embedding generators""" @abstractmethod async def generate_embeddings(self, texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray: pass @abstractmethod def get_embedding_dimension(self) -> int: pass class SentenceTransformerEmbedding(BaseEmbeddingGenerator): """Local sentence transformer embedding generator""" def __init__(self, model_name: str = "all-MiniLM-L6-v2"): self.model_name = model_name self.model = SentenceTransformer(model_name) self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu") self.model.to(self.device) logger.info(f"Loaded SentenceTransformer model: {model_name}") async def generate_embeddings(self, texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray: """Generate embeddings for a list of texts""" if not texts: return np.array([]) # Process in batches to manage memory batch_size = 32 all_embeddings = [] for i in tqdm(range(0, len(texts), batch_size), desc="Generating embeddings"): batch = texts[i:i + batch_size] embeddings = self.model.encode( batch, convert_to_numpy=True, show_progress_bar=False, batch_size=batch_size ) all_embeddings.append(embeddings) return np.vstack(all_embeddings) def get_embedding_dimension(self) -> int: return self.model.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() class OpenAIEmbedding(BaseEmbeddingGenerator): """OpenAI API embedding generator""" def __init__(self, model_name: str = "text-embedding-ada-002", api_key: Optional[str] = None): self.model_name = model_name openai.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") self.dimensions = { "text-embedding-ada-002": 1536, "text-embedding-3-small": 1536, "text-embedding-3-large": 3072, } logger.info(f"Initialized OpenAI embedding model: {model_name}") async def generate_embeddings(self, texts: List[str]) -> np.ndarray: """Generate embeddings using OpenAI API""" if not texts: return np.array([]) # OpenAI API has rate limits, so we batch requests batch_size = 100 # OpenAI recommends up to 2048 texts per request all_embeddings = [] for i in tqdm(range(0, len(texts), batch_size), desc="Generating OpenAI embeddings"): batch = texts[i:i + batch_size] try: response = await openai.Embedding.acreate( model=self.model_name, input=batch ) batch_embeddings = [data.embedding for data in response.data] all_embeddings.extend(batch_embeddings) # Rate limiting await asyncio.sleep(0.1) except Exception as e: logger.error(f"Error generating embeddings for batch {i}: {e}") # Fill with zeros for failed batches zero_embedding = [0.0] * self.get_embedding_dimension() all_embeddings.extend([zero_embedding] * len(batch)) return np.array(all_embeddings) def get_embedding_dimension(self) -> int: return self.dimensions.get(self.model_name, 1536) class ProductEmbeddingGenerator: """Specialized embedding generator for products""" def __init__(self, embedding_generator: BaseEmbeddingGenerator): self.embedding_generator = embedding_generator self.dimension = embedding_generator.get_embedding_dimension() async def generate_product_embeddings(self, products: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]: """Generate embeddings for products""" logger.info(f"Generating embeddings for {len(products)} products") # Prepare texts for embedding product_texts = [] product_ids = [] for product in products: text = self._create_product_text(product) product_texts.append(text) product_ids.append(product['id']) # Generate embeddings embeddings = await self.embedding_generator.generate_embeddings(product_texts) # Create mapping product_embeddings = {} for product_id, embedding in zip(product_ids, embeddings): product_embeddings[product_id] = embedding logger.info(f"Generated embeddings for {len(product_embeddings)} products") return product_embeddings def _create_product_text(self, product: Dict[str, Any]) -> str: """Create text representation of product for embedding""" components = [] # Title (highest weight) if product.get('title'): components.append(f"Title: {product['title']}") # Category and subcategory if product.get('category'): components.append(f"Category: {product['category']}") if product.get('subcategory'): components.append(f"Subcategory: {product['subcategory']}") # Brand if product.get('brand'): components.append(f"Brand: {product['brand']}") # Description if product.get('description'): # Truncate very long descriptions description = product['description'][:500] components.append(f"Description: {description}") # Price range if product.get('price_range'): components.append(f"Price range: {product['price_range']}") # Keywords and tags if product.get('keywords'): components.append(f"Keywords: {', '.join(product['keywords'])}") # Attributes for key, value in product.get('attributes', {}).items(): if isinstance(value, (str, int, float)): components.append(f"{key}: {value}") return ' '.join(components) class UserEmbeddingGenerator: """Specialized embedding generator for users""" def __init__(self, embedding_generator: BaseEmbeddingGenerator): self.embedding_generator = embedding_generator self.dimension = embedding_generator.get_embedding_dimension() async def generate_user_embeddings(self, user_profiles: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]: """Generate embeddings for user profiles""" logger.info(f"Generating embeddings for {len(user_profiles)} users") # Prepare texts for embedding user_texts = [] user_ids = [] for user_id, profile in user_profiles.items(): text = self._create_user_text(profile) user_texts.append(text) user_ids.append(user_id) # Generate embeddings embeddings = await self.embedding_generator.generate_embeddings(user_texts) # Create mapping user_embeddings = {} for user_id, embedding in zip(user_ids, embeddings): user_embeddings[user_id] = embedding logger.info(f"Generated embeddings for {len(user_embeddings)} users") return user_embeddings def _create_user_text(self, profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> str: """Create text representation of user profile for embedding""" components = [] # Behavioral features behavioral = profile.get('behavioral_features', {}) if behavioral: high_interactions = [k.replace('_ratio', '') for k, v in behavioral.items() if k.endswith('_ratio') and v > 0.1] if high_interactions: components.append(f"Frequently: {', '.join(high_interactions)}") # Preferences preferences = profile.get('preference_features', {}) if preferences.get('preferred_categories'): components.append(f"Prefers categories: {', '.join(preferences['preferred_categories'])}") if preferences.get('preferred_brands'): components.append(f"Prefers brands: {', '.join(preferences['preferred_brands'])}") # Engagement level engagement = profile.get('engagement_features', {}) if engagement.get('session_conversion_rate', 0) > 0.1: components.append("High converter") elif engagement.get('avg_session_duration', 0) > 300: # 5 minutes components.append("Engaged browser") # Temporal patterns temporal = profile.get('temporal_features', {}) if temporal.get('weekend_activity_ratio', 0) > 0.6: components.append("Weekend shopper") if not components: components.append("New user") return ' '.join(components) class QueryEmbeddingGenerator: """Generate embeddings for search queries""" def __init__(self, embedding_generator: BaseEmbeddingGenerator): self.embedding_generator = embedding_generator async def generate_query_embedding(self, query: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> np.ndarray: """Generate embedding for a search query with optional context""" # Enhance query with context enhanced_query = self._enhance_query_with_context(query, context) # Generate embedding embeddings = await self.embedding_generator.generate_embeddings([enhanced_query]) return embeddings[0] def _enhance_query_with_context(self, query: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str: """Enhance query with contextual information""" if not context: return query enhancements = [query] # Add user preferences if context.get('preferred_categories'): enhancements.append(f"Categories: {', '.join(context['preferred_categories'])}") # Add price context if context.get('price_range'): enhancements.append(f"Price range: {context['price_range']}") # Add temporal context if context.get('season'): enhancements.append(f"Season: {context['season']}") return ' '.join(enhancements)

# validation/embedding_validator.py import numpy as np from typing import List, Dict, Tuple, Any from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity from sklearn.decomposition import PCA from sklearn.cluster import KMeans import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import seaborn as sns from collections import defaultdict import logging logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) class EmbeddingQualityValidator: """Validate the quality of generated embeddings""" def __init__(self): self.similarity_threshold = 0.7 self.diversity_threshold = 0.3 def validate_product_embeddings( self, product_embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray], products: List[Dict[str, Any]] ) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Comprehensive validation of product embeddings""" logger.info("Validating product embeddings...") results = { 'total_products': len(product_embeddings), 'embedding_dimension': len(next(iter(product_embeddings.values()))), 'quality_metrics': {}, 'recommendations': [] } # Create product lookup product_lookup = {p['id']: p for p in products} # Test semantic similarity similarity_results = self._test_semantic_similarity(product_embeddings, product_lookup) results['quality_metrics']['semantic_similarity'] = similarity_results # Test category clustering clustering_results = self._test_category_clustering(product_embeddings, product_lookup) results['quality_metrics']['category_clustering'] = clustering_results # Test embedding diversity diversity_results = self._test_embedding_diversity(product_embeddings) results['quality_metrics']['diversity'] = diversity_results # Generate recommendations results['recommendations'] = self._generate_quality_recommendations(results['quality_metrics']) logger.info(f"Validation complete. Overall quality score: {self._calculate_overall_score(results['quality_metrics']):.3f}") return results def _test_semantic_similarity( self, embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray], products: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] ) -> Dict[str, float]: """Test if semantically similar products have similar embeddings""" # Sample products for testing (to avoid O(n²) computation) sample_size = min(100, len(embeddings)) sampled_ids = list(embeddings.keys())[:sample_size] similarity_scores = [] for i, product_id_1 in enumerate(sampled_ids): for product_id_2 in sampled_ids[i+1:]: # Calculate embedding similarity emb_sim = cosine_similarity( embeddings[product_id_1].reshape(1, -1), embeddings[product_id_2].reshape(1, -1) )[0, 0] # Calculate semantic similarity (based on category, brand, etc.) semantic_sim = self._calculate_semantic_similarity( products[product_id_1], products[product_id_2] ) similarity_scores.append({ 'embedding_similarity': emb_sim, 'semantic_similarity': semantic_sim }) # Calculate correlation emb_sims = [s['embedding_similarity'] for s in similarity_scores] sem_sims = [s['semantic_similarity'] for s in similarity_scores] correlation = np.corrcoef(emb_sims, sem_sims)[0, 1] return { 'correlation': correlation, 'avg_embedding_similarity': np.mean(emb_sims), 'avg_semantic_similarity': np.mean(sem_sims), 'sample_size': len(similarity_scores) } def _test_category_clustering( self, embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray], products: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] ) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Test if products from same category cluster together""" # Group by category category_embeddings = defaultdict(list) category_products = defaultdict(list) for product_id, embedding in embeddings.items(): if product_id in products: category = products[product_id].get('category', 'unknown') category_embeddings[category].append(embedding) category_products[category].append(product_id) # Calculate intra-category similarity intra_similarities = {} for category, embs in category_embeddings.items(): if len(embs) > 1: emb_matrix = np.array(embs) sim_matrix = cosine_similarity(emb_matrix) # Average similarity excluding diagonal mask = ~np.eye(sim_matrix.shape[0], dtype=bool) avg_similarity = sim_matrix[mask].mean() intra_similarities[category] = avg_similarity # Calculate inter-category similarity categories = list(category_embeddings.keys()) inter_similarities = [] for i, cat1 in enumerate(categories): for cat2 in categories[i+1:]: if len(category_embeddings[cat1]) > 0 and len(category_embeddings[cat2]) > 0: # Calculate average similarity between categories emb1 = np.mean(category_embeddings[cat1], axis=0) emb2 = np.mean(category_embeddings[cat2], axis=0) sim = cosine_similarity(emb1.reshape(1, -1), emb2.reshape(1, -1))[0, 0] inter_similarities.append(sim) return { 'intra_category_similarity': np.mean(list(intra_similarities.values())), 'inter_category_similarity': np.mean(inter_similarities), 'separation_score': np.mean(list(intra_similarities.values())) - np.mean(inter_similarities), 'categories_analyzed': len(category_embeddings) } def _test_embedding_diversity(self, embeddings: Dict[str, np.ndarray]) -> Dict[str, float]: """Test diversity of embeddings to avoid mode collapse""" embedding_matrix = np.array(list(embeddings.values())) # Calculate pairwise similarities similarity_matrix = cosine_similarity(embedding_matrix) # Remove diagonal (self-similarity) mask = ~np.eye(similarity_matrix.shape[0], dtype=bool) similarities = similarity_matrix[mask] # Calculate diversity metrics avg_similarity = similarities.mean() similarity_std = similarities.std() # PCA to check dimensionality usage pca = PCA() pca.fit(embedding_matrix) explained_variance_ratio = pca.explained_variance_ratio_ # Calculate effective dimensionality (95% variance) cumsum_variance = np.cumsum(explained_variance_ratio) effective_dims = np.argmax(cumsum_variance >= 0.95) + 1 return { 'average_similarity': avg_similarity, 'similarity_std': similarity_std, 'effective_dimensions': effective_dims, 'total_dimensions': embedding_matrix.shape[1], 'dimension_usage_ratio': effective_dims / embedding_matrix.shape[1] } def _calculate_semantic_similarity(self, product1: Dict[str, Any], product2: Dict[str, Any]) -> float: """Calculate semantic similarity between two products""" similarity = 0.0 # Category similarity (highest weight) if product1.get('category') == product2.get('category'): similarity += 0.4 # Subcategory similarity if product1.get('subcategory') == product2.get('subcategory'): similarity += 0.2 # Brand similarity if product1.get('brand') == product2.get('brand'): similarity += 0.2 # Price range similarity if product1.get('price_range') == product2.get('price_range'): similarity += 0.1 # Title similarity (simple word overlap) title1_words = set(product1.get('title', '').lower().split()) title2_words = set(product2.get('title', '').lower().split()) if title1_words and title2_words: word_overlap = len(title1_words & title2_words) / len(title1_words | title2_words) similarity += 0.1 * word_overlap return similarity def _calculate_overall_score(self, metrics: Dict[str, Any]) -> float: """Calculate overall quality score""" scores = [] # Semantic similarity correlation (should be positive) if 'semantic_similarity' in metrics: correlation = metrics['semantic_similarity'].get('correlation', 0) scores.append(max(0, correlation)) # Category clustering separation if 'category_clustering' in metrics: separation = metrics['category_clustering'].get('separation_score', 0) scores.append(max(0, min(1, separation))) # Diversity (should not be too high or too low) if 'diversity' in metrics: avg_sim = metrics['diversity'].get('average_similarity', 0.5) # Optimal similarity around 0.3-0.5 diversity_score = 1 - abs(avg_sim - 0.4) / 0.4 scores.append(max(0, diversity_score)) return np.mean(scores) if scores else 0.0 def _generate_quality_recommendations(self, metrics: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]: """Generate recommendations based on quality metrics""" recommendations = [] # Check semantic similarity if 'semantic_similarity' in metrics: correlation = metrics['semantic_similarity'].get('correlation', 0) if correlation < 0.3: recommendations.append( "Low semantic similarity correlation. Consider improving text preprocessing " "or using a more powerful embedding model." ) # Check category clustering if 'category_clustering' in metrics: separation = metrics['category_clustering'].get('separation_score', 0) if separation < 0.1: recommendations.append( "Poor category separation. Consider adding category information to " "product text or using category-specific embeddings." ) # Check diversity if 'diversity' in metrics: avg_sim = metrics['diversity'].get('average_similarity', 0.5) if avg_sim > 0.8: recommendations.append( "Embeddings are too similar (mode collapse). Consider using a different " "embedding model or improving text diversity." ) elif avg_sim < 0.1: recommendations.append( "Embeddings are too diverse. Consider improving text preprocessing " "or using a more consistent embedding approach." ) if not recommendations: recommendations.append("Embedding quality looks good!") return recommendations
