This guide provides step-by-step instructions for achieving the architecture maturity requirement: "Application architecture foundation is defined and documented".

The application architecture foundation establishes the complete structural foundation of your application, including layers, frameworks, key mechanisms, and design patterns. This is a Maturity Level 1 - PREPARATION (Sprint 0) requirement that must be completed before development begins.

By the end of this implementation, you should have: ✅ Complete architecture documentation with visual diagrams ✅ Defined application layers and their responsibilities ✅ Documented frameworks and technology choices ✅ Established key mechanisms (logging, error handling, security) ✅ Architecture review sessions completed with stakeholders ✅ Implementation guidelines for development teams

Step 1.1: Stakeholder Requirements Gathering​ Duration: 2-3 days Participants: Technical leads, business stakeholders, architects Actions: Business Requirements Analysis # Create requirements documentation mkdir -p docs/architecture/requirements touch docs/architecture/requirements/business-requirements.md touch docs/architecture/requirements/functional-requirements.md touch docs/architecture/requirements/non-functional-requirements.md Technology Constraints Assessment Document existing technology stack constraints Identify integration requirements with legacy systems Define performance and scalability requirements Security and compliance requirements Resource and Timeline Constraints Team size and skill assessment Budget constraints Delivery timeline requirements Infrastructure availability Step 1.2: Technology Stack Selection​ Duration: 1-2 days Participants: Technical architects, senior developers Actions: Framework Selection Documentation # docs/architecture/technology-stack.md ## Frontend Framework - **Choice**: Next.js 14+ with App Router - **Rationale**: SSR/SSG capabilities, excellent performance, strong ecosystem - **Alternatives Considered**: React SPA, Nuxt.js, Angular ## Backend Framework - **Choice**: NestJS 15+ - **Rationale**: TypeScript-first, modular architecture, enterprise-ready - **Alternatives Considered**: Express.js, Fastify, Koa.js ## Database - **Choice**: PostgreSQL with TypeORM - **Rationale**: ACID compliance, complex queries, strong typing - **Alternatives Considered**: MongoDB, MySQL, Prisma Create Technology Decision Matrix // docs/architecture/technology-decisions.ts export interface TechnologyDecision { category: string; chosen: string; alternatives: string[]; rationale: string; tradeoffs: string[]; reviewDate: Date; } export const technologyDecisions: TechnologyDecision[] = [ { category: 'Frontend Framework', chosen: 'Next.js 14+', alternatives: ['React SPA', 'Angular', 'Vue.js'], rationale: 'SSR capabilities, performance, ecosystem', tradeoffs: ['Learning curve', 'Vendor lock-in'], reviewDate: new Date('2024-01-15'), }, ];

Step 2.1: Create Architecture Diagrams​ Duration: 3-4 days Tools: Draw.io, Lucidchart, or Mermaid Actions: System Context Diagram (C4 Level 1) graph TB User[End Users] System[E-commerce Platform] Payment[Payment Gateway] Email[Email Service] Analytics[Analytics Service] User --> System System --> Payment System --> Email System --> Analytics Container Diagram (C4 Level 2) graph TB subgraph "E-commerce Platform" Web[Next.js Web App] API[NestJS API Gateway] UserService[User Service] ProductService[Product Service] OrderService[Order Service] DB[(PostgreSQL)] Cache[(Redis)] end Web --> API API --> UserService API --> ProductService API --> OrderService UserService --> DB ProductService --> DB OrderService --> DB API --> Cache Component Diagram (C4 Level 3) // docs/architecture/diagrams/component-diagram.md ## Frontend Components (Next.js) ### Application Structure src/ ├── app/ # App Router pages ├── components/ # Reusable UI components │ ├── atoms/ # Basic UI elements │ ├── molecules/ # Component combinations │ ├── organisms/ # Complex UI sections │ └── templates/ # Page layouts ├── lib/ # Utilities and configurations ├── hooks/ # Custom React hooks └── types/ # TypeScript definitions ## Backend Components (NestJS) ### Service Architecture src/ ├── modules/ # Feature modules │ ├── user/ # User management │ ├── product/ # Product catalog │ ├── order/ # Order processing │ └── auth/ # Authentication ├── common/ # Shared components │ ├── guards/ # Security guards │ ├── interceptors/ # Request/response interceptors │ ├── filters/ # Exception filters │ └── decorators/ # Custom decorators └── config/ # Configuration management Step 2.2: Define Application Layers​ Duration: 2-3 days Actions: Layer Definition Documentation # docs/architecture/application-layers.md ## Frontend Layers (Next.js) ### 1. Presentation Layer - **Responsibility**: User interface and user interaction - **Components**: Pages, components, forms, layouts - **Technologies**: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion ### 2. Application Layer - **Responsibility**: Application logic and state management - **Components**: Custom hooks, context providers, utilities - **Technologies**: React Context, Zustand, React Query ### 3. Infrastructure Layer - **Responsibility**: External service integration - **Components**: API clients, authentication, storage - **Technologies**: Axios, NextAuth, LocalStorage ## Backend Layers (NestJS) ### 1. Presentation Layer (Controllers) - **Responsibility**: HTTP request handling and response formatting - **Components**: Controllers, DTOs, validation pipes - **Technologies**: NestJS controllers, class-validator ### 2. Application Layer (Services) - **Responsibility**: Business logic orchestration - **Components**: Application services, use cases - **Technologies**: NestJS services, dependency injection ### 3. Domain Layer - **Responsibility**: Core business rules and entities - **Components**: Entities, domain services, value objects - **Technologies**: TypeORM entities, domain models ### 4. Infrastructure Layer - **Responsibility**: External integrations and persistence - **Components**: Repositories, external services, databases - **Technologies**: TypeORM repositories, HTTP clients Layer Implementation Guidelines // docs/architecture/layer-guidelines.ts export interface LayerGuidelines { layer: string; responsibilities: string[]; dependencies: string[]; prohibitions: string[]; examples: string[]; } export const layerGuidelines: LayerGuidelines[] = [ { layer: 'Presentation', responsibilities: [ 'Handle HTTP requests/responses', 'Input validation and sanitization', 'Authentication and authorization checks', 'Response formatting and error handling', ], dependencies: ['Application Layer only'], prohibitions: ['Direct database access', 'Business logic implementation', 'Direct external service calls'], examples: ['UserController', 'ProductController', 'AuthController'], }, ]; Step 2.3: Document Key Mechanisms​ Duration: 2-3 days Actions: Logging Mechanism // docs/architecture/mechanisms/logging.md ## Logging Strategy ### Implementation ```typescript // Backend Logging (NestJS) import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; @Injectable() export class LoggingService { private readonly logger = new Logger(LoggingService.name); logRequest(req: Request, correlationId: string) { this.logger.log({ message: 'HTTP Request', method: req.method, url: req.url, correlationId, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); } logError(error: Error, context: string, correlationId: string) { this.logger.error({ message: error.message, stack: error.stack, context, correlationId, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }); } } // Frontend Logging (Next.js) export class ClientLogger { static log(level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error', message: string, data?: any) { const logEntry = { level, message, data, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), userAgent: navigator.userAgent, url: window.location.href }; // Send to logging service this.sendToServer(logEntry); } } Error Handling Mechanism // docs/architecture/mechanisms/error-handling.md ## Error Handling Strategy ### Global Error Filter (NestJS) ```typescript @Catch() export class GlobalExceptionFilter implements ExceptionFilter { catch(exception: unknown, host: ArgumentsHost) { const ctx = host.switchToHttp(); This guide provides comprehensive backup and recovery strategies for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications, ensuring business continuity and data protection in production environments.

A robust backup and recovery strategy is essential for maintaining data integrity, ensuring business continuity, and meeting compliance requirements. This guide covers database backups, application state recovery, disaster recovery planning, and automated recovery procedures.

// src/backup/database-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { exec } from 'child_process'; import { promisify } from 'util'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; import * as AWS from 'aws-sdk'; const execAsync = promisify(exec); export interface BackupMetadata { id: string; timestamp: Date; type: 'full' | 'incremental' | 'differential'; size: number; duration: number; location: string; checksum: string; status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'partial'; } @Injectable() export class DatabaseBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(DatabaseBackupService.name); private readonly s3: AWS.S3; private readonly backupDir: string; constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) { this.s3 = new AWS.S3({ region: this.configService.get('AWS_REGION'), accessKeyId: this.configService.get('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'), secretAccessKey: this.configService.get('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'), }); this.backupDir = this.configService.get('BACKUP_DIRECTORY', '/tmp/backups'); } // Full backup every day at 2 AM @Cron('0 2 * * *') async createFullBackup(): Promise<BackupMetadata> { const startTime = Date.now(); const backupId = `full_${Date.now()}`; this.logger.log('Starting full database backup'); try { // Create backup directory if it doesn't exist await fs.mkdir(this.backupDir, { recursive: true }); const filename = `${backupId}.sql`; const filepath = path.join(this.backupDir, filename); // Create PostgreSQL dump const dumpCommand = this.buildPgDumpCommand(filepath, 'full'); await execAsync(dumpCommand); // Compress the backup const compressedPath = `${filepath}.gz`; await execAsync(`gzip ${filepath}`); // Calculate file size and checksum const stats = await fs.stat(compressedPath); const checksum = await this.calculateChecksum(compressedPath); // Upload to S3 await this.uploadToS3(compressedPath, `backups/full/${filename}.gz`); // Clean up local file await fs.unlink(compressedPath); const duration = Date.now() - startTime; const metadata: BackupMetadata = { id: backupId, timestamp: new Date(), type: 'full', size: stats.size, duration, location: `s3://backups/full/${filename}.gz`, checksum, status: 'success', }; await this.saveBackupMetadata(metadata); this.logger.log(`Full backup completed successfully: ${backupId}`); return metadata; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Full backup failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } // Incremental backup every hour @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_HOUR) async createIncrementalBackup(): Promise<BackupMetadata> { const startTime = Date.now(); const backupId = `incremental_${Date.now()}`; this.logger.log('Starting incremental backup'); try { // Get the last backup timestamp const lastBackup = await this.getLastBackupTimestamp(); // Create WAL-E backup or transaction log backup const filename = `${backupId}.wal`; const filepath = path.join(this.backupDir, filename); // Archive WAL files since last backup await this.archiveWALFiles(lastBackup, filepath); // Compress and upload const compressedPath = `${filepath}.gz`; await execAsync(`gzip ${filepath}`); const stats = await fs.stat(compressedPath); const checksum = await this.calculateChecksum(compressedPath); await this.uploadToS3(compressedPath, `backups/incremental/${filename}.gz`); await fs.unlink(compressedPath); const duration = Date.now() - startTime; const metadata: BackupMetadata = { id: backupId, timestamp: new Date(), type: 'incremental', size: stats.size, duration, location: `s3://backups/incremental/${filename}.gz`, checksum, status: 'success', }; await this.saveBackupMetadata(metadata); this.logger.log(`Incremental backup completed: ${backupId}`); return metadata; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Incremental backup failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } async restoreFromBackup( backupId: string, targetDatabase?: string, ): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Starting database restore from backup: ${backupId}`); try { const metadata = await this.getBackupMetadata(backupId); if (!metadata) { throw new Error(`Backup not found: ${backupId}`); } // Download backup from S3 const localPath = await this.downloadFromS3(metadata.location); // Verify checksum const downloadedChecksum = await this.calculateChecksum(localPath); if (downloadedChecksum !== metadata.checksum) { throw new Error('Backup file corrupted - checksum mismatch'); } // Decompress if needed const decompressedPath = localPath.replace('.gz', ''); if (localPath.endsWith('.gz')) { await execAsync(`gunzip ${localPath}`); } // Create target database if specified const dbName = targetDatabase || this.configService.get('DB_NAME'); if (targetDatabase) { await this.createDatabase(targetDatabase); } // Restore the backup const restoreCommand = this.buildPgRestoreCommand(decompressedPath, dbName); await execAsync(restoreCommand); // Clean up await fs.unlink(decompressedPath); this.logger.log(`Database restore completed successfully: ${backupId}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Database restore failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } private buildPgDumpCommand(filepath: string, type: 'full' | 'schema-only'): string { const host = this.configService.get('DB_HOST'); const port = this.configService.get('DB_PORT'); const username = this.configService.get('DB_USERNAME'); const database = this.configService.get('DB_NAME'); let command = `pg_dump -h ${host} -p ${port} -U ${username} -d ${database}`; if (type === 'schema-only') { command += ' --schema-only'; } else { command += ' --verbose --no-owner --no-acl'; } command += ` > ${filepath}`; return `PGPASSWORD=${this.configService.get('DB_PASSWORD')} ${command}`; } private buildPgRestoreCommand(filepath: string, database: string): string { const host = this.configService.get('DB_HOST'); const port = this.configService.get('DB_PORT'); const username = this.configService.get('DB_USERNAME'); const command = `psql -h ${host} -p ${port} -U ${username} -d ${database} < ${filepath}`; return `PGPASSWORD=${this.configService.get('DB_PASSWORD')} ${command}`; } private async uploadToS3(localPath: string, s3Key: string): Promise<void> { const fileContent = await fs.readFile(localPath); await this.s3.upload({ Bucket: this.configService.get('BACKUP_S3_BUCKET'), Key: s3Key, Body: fileContent, StorageClass: 'STANDARD_IA', // Infrequent Access for cost optimization ServerSideEncryption: 'AES256', }).promise(); } private async downloadFromS3(s3Location: string): Promise<string> { const [, , bucket, ...keyParts] = s3Location.split('/'); const key = keyParts.join('/'); const response = await this.s3.getObject({ Bucket: bucket, Key: key, }).promise(); const localPath = path.join(this.backupDir, path.basename(key)); await fs.writeFile(localPath, response.Body as Buffer); return localPath; } private async calculateChecksum(filepath: string): Promise<string> { const { stdout } = await execAsync(`sha256sum ${filepath}`); return stdout.split(' ')[0]; } private async saveBackupMetadata(metadata: BackupMetadata): Promise<void> { // Save to database or metadata store // Implementation depends on your metadata storage strategy } private async getBackupMetadata(backupId: string): Promise<BackupMetadata | null> { // Retrieve from database or metadata store // Implementation depends on your metadata storage strategy return null; } private async getLastBackupTimestamp(): Promise<Date> { // Get timestamp of last backup for incremental backups return new Date(Date.now() - 3600000); // Default to 1 hour ago } private async archiveWALFiles(since: Date, outputPath: string): Promise<void> { // Archive PostgreSQL WAL files for incremental backup // This would typically use WAL-E or similar tool } private async createDatabase(name: string): Promise<void> { const command = this.buildCreateDatabaseCommand(name); await execAsync(command); } private buildCreateDatabaseCommand(database: string): string { const host = this.configService.get('DB_HOST'); const port = this.configService.get('DB_PORT'); const username = this.configService.get('DB_USERNAME'); const command = `createdb -h ${host} -p ${port} -U ${username} ${database}`; return `PGPASSWORD=${this.configService.get('DB_PASSWORD')} ${command}`; } }

// src/backup/redis-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import Redis from 'ioredis'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; @Injectable() export class RedisBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RedisBackupService.name); private readonly redis: Redis; private readonly backupDir: string; constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) { this.redis = new Redis({ host: this.configService.get('REDIS_HOST'), port: this.configService.get('REDIS_PORT'), password: this.configService.get('REDIS_PASSWORD'), }); this.backupDir = this.configService.get('REDIS_BACKUP_DIR', '/tmp/redis-backups'); } // Redis backup every 6 hours @Cron('0 */6 * * *') async createRedisBackup(): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Starting Redis backup'); try { await fs.mkdir(this.backupDir, { recursive: true }); const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/:/g, '-'); const filename = `redis-backup-${timestamp}.rdb`; const filepath = path.join(this.backupDir, filename); // Trigger BGSAVE for point-in-time backup await this.redis.bgsave(); // Wait for background save to complete await this.waitForBgsaveCompletion(); // Copy the RDB file const rdbPath = await this.getRdbPath(); await fs.copyFile(rdbPath, filepath); // Compress and upload to S3 await this.compressAndUpload(filepath, `redis-backups/${filename}`); this.logger.log(`Redis backup completed: ${filename}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Redis backup failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } private async waitForBgsaveCompletion(): Promise<void> { let isRunning = true; while (isRunning) { const result = await this.redis.lastsave(); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); const newResult = await this.redis.lastsave(); isRunning = result === newResult; } } private async getRdbPath(): Promise<string> { const info = await this.redis.config('GET', 'dir'); const dbfilename = await this.redis.config('GET', 'dbfilename'); return path.join(info[1], dbfilename[1]); } private async compressAndUpload(filepath: string, s3Key: string): Promise<void> { // Implementation similar to database backup service } }

version: string; configuration: Record<string, any>; activeConnections: number; queueStates: Record<string, any>; cacheStates: Record<string, any>; metrics: Record<string, number>; } @Injectable() export class StateSnapshotService { private readonly logger = new Logger(StateSnapshotService.name); // src/disaster-recovery/recovery-orchestrator.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; export interface DisasterRecoveryPlan { id: string; name: string; priority: 'critical' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'; rto: number; // Recovery Time Objective in minutes rpo: number; // Recovery Point Objective in minutes steps: RecoveryStep[]; } export interface RecoveryStep { id: string; name: string; type: 'database' | 'application' | 'infrastructure' | 'validation'; command: string; timeout: number; dependencies: string[]; rollbackCommand?: string; } @Injectable() export class RecoveryOrchestratorService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RecoveryOrchestratorService.name); constructor( private readonly configService: ConfigService, private readonly databaseBackupService: DatabaseBackupService, private readonly stateSnapshotService: StateSnapshotService, ) {} async executeDisasterRecovery( planId: string, targetEnvironment: string, ): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Starting disaster recovery: ${planId} -> ${targetEnvironment}`); try { const plan = await this.getRecoveryPlan(planId); if (!plan) { throw new Error(`Recovery plan not found: ${planId}`); } // Validate prerequisites await this.validatePrerequisites(plan, targetEnvironment); // Execute recovery steps const results = await this.executeRecoverySteps(plan.steps); // Validate recovery await this.validateRecovery(plan, targetEnvironment); this.logger.log(`Disaster recovery completed successfully: ${planId}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Disaster recovery failed: ${error.message}`); await this.executeRollback(planId); throw error; } } private async getRecoveryPlan(planId: string): Promise<DisasterRecoveryPlan | null> { // Load recovery plan from configuration or database const plans: Record<string, DisasterRecoveryPlan> = { 'database-corruption': { id: 'database-corruption', name: 'Database Corruption Recovery', priority: 'critical', rto: 30, // 30 minutes rpo: 60, // 1 hour data loss acceptable steps: [ { id: 'stop-services', name: 'Stop Application Services', type: 'application', command: 'kubectl scale deployment --replicas=0', timeout: 300, dependencies: [], }, { id: 'restore-database', name: 'Restore Database from Backup', type: 'database', command: 'restore-latest-backup', timeout: 1800, dependencies: ['stop-services'], }, { id: 'start-services', name: 'Start Application Services', type: 'application', command: 'kubectl scale deployment --replicas=3', timeout: 600, dependencies: ['restore-database'], }, { id: 'validate-health', name: 'Validate Application Health', type: 'validation', command: 'health-check', timeout: 300, dependencies: ['start-services'], }, ], }, }; return plans[planId] || null; } private async validatePrerequisites( plan: DisasterRecoveryPlan, targetEnvironment: string, ): Promise<void> { // Check if target environment is available // Verify backup availability // Check resource availability // Validate access permissions } private async executeRecoverySteps(steps: RecoveryStep[]): Promise<void> { const completed = new Set<string>(); const failed = new Set<string>(); while (completed.size < steps.length && failed.size === 0) { for (const step of steps) { if (completed.has(step.id) || failed.has(step.id)) { continue; } // Check if all dependencies are completed const dependenciesCompleted = step.dependencies.every(dep => completed.has(dep)); if (!dependenciesCompleted) { continue; } try { this.logger.log(`Executing recovery step: ${step.name}`); await this.executeStep(step); completed.add(step.id); this.logger.log(`Recovery step completed: ${step.name}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Recovery step failed: ${step.name}`, error); failed.add(step.id); throw error; } } // Prevent infinite loop if (completed.size === 0 && failed.size === 0) { throw new Error('No recovery steps can be executed - check dependencies'); } } } private async executeStep(step: RecoveryStep): Promise<void> { switch (step.type) { case 'database': if (step.command === 'restore-latest-backup') { const latestBackup = await this.getLatestBackup(); await this.databaseBackupService.restoreFromBackup(latestBackup.id); } break; case 'application': await this.executeCommand(step.command, step.timeout); break; case 'infrastructure': await this.executeInfrastructureCommand(step.command, step.timeout); break; case 'validation': await this.executeValidation(step.command, step.timeout); break; } } private async executeCommand(command: string, timeout: number): Promise<void> { // Execute shell command with timeout } private async executeInfrastructureCommand(command: string, timeout: number): Promise<void> { // Execute infrastructure commands (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.) } private async executeValidation(command: string, timeout: number): Promise<void> { // Execute validation commands (health checks, data integrity checks, etc.) } private async validateRecovery( plan: DisasterRecoveryPlan, targetEnvironment: string, ): Promise<void> { // Perform comprehensive validation // Check application health // Verify data integrity // Test critical functionality } private async executeRollback(planId: string): Promise<void> { // Execute rollback procedures if recovery fails } private async getLatestBackup(): Promise<BackupMetadata> { // Get the most recent successful backup throw new Error('Method not implemented'); } }

// scripts/backup-static-assets.ts import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; import { S3 } from 'aws-sdk'; import { createHash } from 'crypto'; interface AssetManifest { version: string; timestamp: string; assets: AssetInfo[]; } interface AssetInfo { path: string; hash: string; size: number; mimeType: string; } class StaticAssetBackup { private s3: S3; private bucketName: string; constructor() { this.s3 = new S3({ region: process.env.AWS_REGION, accessKeyId: process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, secretAccessKey: process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, }); this.bucketName = process.env.BACKUP_BUCKET!; } async backupStaticAssets(buildDir: string): Promise<void> { console.log('Starting static asset backup...'); try { // Generate asset manifest const manifest = await this.generateAssetManifest(buildDir); // Upload assets to S3 await this.uploadAssets(buildDir, manifest); // Upload manifest await this.uploadManifest(manifest); console.log('Static asset backup completed successfully'); } catch (error) { console.error('Static asset backup failed:', error); throw error; } } private async generateAssetManifest(buildDir: string): Promise<AssetManifest> { const assets: AssetInfo[] = []; const traverseDirectory = async (dir: string, relativePath = ''): Promise<void> => { const items = await fs.readdir(dir); for (const item of items) { const fullPath = path.join(dir, item); const stats = await fs.stat(fullPath); if (stats.isDirectory()) { await traverseDirectory(fullPath, path.join(relativePath, item)); } else { const content = await fs.readFile(fullPath); const hash = createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex'); assets.push({ path: path.join(relativePath, item), hash, size: stats.size, mimeType: this.getMimeType(item), }); } } }; await traverseDirectory(buildDir); return { version: process.env.npm_package_version || '1.0.0', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), assets, }; } private async uploadAssets(buildDir: string, manifest: AssetManifest): Promise<void> { for (const asset of manifest.assets) { const localPath = path.join(buildDir, asset.path); const s3Key = `static-assets/${manifest.version}/${asset.path}`; const content = await fs.readFile(localPath); await this.s3.upload({ Bucket: this.bucketName, Key: s3Key, Body: content, ContentType: asset.mimeType, CacheControl: 'public, max-age=31536000', // 1 year Metadata: { originalHash: asset.hash, originalSize: asset.size.toString(), }, }).promise(); console.log(`Uploaded: ${asset.path}`); } } private async uploadManifest(manifest: AssetManifest): Promise<void> { const manifestKey = `static-assets/${manifest.version}/manifest.json`; await this.s3.upload({ Bucket: this.bucketName, Key: manifestKey, Body: JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2), ContentType: 'application/json', }).promise(); console.log('Manifest uploaded successfully'); } private getMimeType(filename: string): string { const ext = path.extname(filename).toLowerCase(); const mimeTypes: Record<string, string> = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.json': 'application/json', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.gif': 'image/gif', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff': 'font/woff', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.ttf': 'font/ttf', '.eot': 'application/vnd.ms-fontobject', }; return mimeTypes[ext] || 'application/octet-stream'; } } // Usage in package.json scripts: // "backup:assets": "ts-node scripts/backup-static-assets.ts"

// src/monitoring/backup-monitoring.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; @Injectable() export class BackupMonitoringService { private readonly logger = new Logger(BackupMonitoringService.name); constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {} // Monitor backup health every 15 minutes @Cron('*/15 * * * *') async monitorBackupHealth(): Promise<void> { try { // Check recent backup completion const recentBackups = await this.getRecentBackups(24); // Last 24 hours if (recentBackups.length === 0) { await this.sendAlert('No backups completed in the last 24 hours', 'critical'); return; } // Check backup sizes const avgSize = this.calculateAverageSize(recentBackups); const latestBackup = recentBackups[0]; if (latestBackup.size < avgSize * 0.5) { await this.sendAlert( `Latest backup size is significantly smaller than average: ${latestBackup.size} vs ${avgSize}`, 'warning' ); } // Check backup integrity const integrityChecks = await this.performIntegrityChecks(recentBackups.slice(0, 3)); const failedChecks = integrityChecks.filter(check => !check.valid); if (failedChecks.length > 0) { await this.sendAlert( `Backup integrity check failed for: ${failedChecks.map(c => c.backupId).join(', ')}`, 'critical' ); } // Check storage space const storageUsage = await this.checkStorageUsage(); if (storageUsage.percentage > 85) { await this.sendAlert( `Backup storage usage is high: ${storageUsage.percentage}%`, 'warning' ); } this.logger.log('Backup health monitoring completed successfully'); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Backup health monitoring failed', error); } } private async getRecentBackups(hours: number): Promise<BackupMetadata[]> { // Implementation to get recent backups return []; } private calculateAverageSize(backups: BackupMetadata[]): number { if (backups.length === 0) return 0; return backups.reduce((sum, backup) => sum + backup.size, 0) / backups.length; } private async performIntegrityChecks(backups: BackupMetadata[]): Promise<Array<{ backupId: string; valid: boolean }>> { // Implementation to check backup integrity return []; } private async checkStorageUsage(): Promise<{ used: number; total: number; percentage: number }> { // Implementation to check storage usage return { used: 0, total: 0, percentage: 0 }; } private async sendAlert(message: string, severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical'): Promise<void> { // Implementation to send alerts (email, Slack, PagerDuty, etc.) this.logger.warn(`BACKUP ALERT [${severity.toUpperCase()}]: ${message}`); } }

This guide provides comprehensive setup and usage instructions for code quality tools in NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend projects.

Code quality tools are essential for maintaining consistent, secure, and maintainable code across a microservices architecture. This guide covers automated code style verification, quality analysis, and integration with development workflows.

ESLint provides automated code style verification and catches potential bugs and anti-patterns. # .github/workflows/quality.yml name: Code Quality on: pull_request: branches: [main, develop] push: branches: [main, develop] jobs: quality: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 - name: Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '20' cache: 'npm' - name: Install dependencies run: npm ci - name: Type checking run: npm run type-check - name: Lint checking run: npm run lint:check - name: Format checking run: npm run format:check - name: Security audit run: npm audit --audit-level high - name: Run tests with coverage run: npm run test:coverage - name: SonarQube Scan uses: sonarqube-quality-gate-action@master env: SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }} SONAR_HOST_URL: ${{ secrets.SONAR_HOST_URL }} - name: Upload coverage to Codecov uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3 with: file: ./coverage/lcov.info flags: unittests name: codecov-umbrella

// scripts/quality-gate.ts import { execSync } from 'child_process'; import { readFileSync } from 'fs'; interface QualityMetrics { coverage: number; duplicatedLines: number; maintainabilityRating: string; reliabilityRating: string; securityRating: string; } class QualityGate { private readonly thresholds = { coverage: 80, duplicatedLines: 3, maintainabilityRating: 'A', reliabilityRating: 'A', securityRating: 'A', }; async checkQuality(): Promise<void> { console.log('🔍 Running quality gate checks...'); // Check test coverage await this.checkCoverage(); // Check linting await this.checkLinting(); // Check formatting await this.checkFormatting(); // Check type safety await this.checkTypes(); // Check security vulnerabilities await this.checkSecurity(); console.log('✅ All quality gate checks passed!'); } private async checkCoverage(): Promise<void> { try { execSync('npm run test:coverage', { stdio: 'inherit' }); const coverageData = JSON.parse( readFileSync('coverage/coverage-summary.json', 'utf8') ); const totalCoverage = coverageData.total.lines.pct; if (totalCoverage < this.thresholds.coverage) { throw new Error( `Coverage ${totalCoverage}% is below threshold ${this.thresholds.coverage}%` ); } console.log(`✅ Coverage: ${totalCoverage}%`); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Coverage check failed:', error.message); process.exit(1); } } private async checkLinting(): Promise<void> { try { execSync('npm run lint:check', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Linting passed'); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Linting failed'); process.exit(1); } } private async checkFormatting(): Promise<void> { try { execSync('npm run format:check', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Formatting passed'); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Formatting failed'); process.exit(1); } } private async checkTypes(): Promise<void> { try { execSync('npm run type-check', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Type checking passed'); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Type checking failed'); process.exit(1); } } private async checkSecurity(): Promise<void> { try { execSync('npm audit --audit-level high', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('✅ Security audit passed'); } catch (error) { console.error('❌ Security audit failed'); process.exit(1); } } } // Run quality gate const qualityGate = new QualityGate(); qualityGate.checkQuality().catch(console.error);

// src/monitoring/quality-metrics.service.ts import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { HttpService } from '@nestjs/axios'; @Injectable() export class QualityMetricsService { constructor(private readonly httpService: HttpService) {} @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_DAY_AT_MIDNIGHT) async collectQualityMetrics(): Promise<void> { const metrics = await this.getSonarQubeMetrics(); const coverage = await this.getCoverageMetrics(); await this.sendMetricsToMonitoring({ ...metrics, ...coverage, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), }); } private async getSonarQubeMetrics(): Promise<any> { const response = await this.httpService .get(`${process.env.SONAR_HOST_URL}/api/measures/component`, { params: { component: process.env.SONAR_PROJECT_KEY, metricKeys: 'coverage,duplicated_lines_density,sqale_rating,reliability_rating,security_rating', }, headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SONAR_TOKEN}`, }, }) .toPromise(); return response.data; } private async getCoverageMetrics(): Promise<any> { // Read coverage data from file system // Implementation depends on your coverage tool return {}; } private async sendMetricsToMonitoring(metrics: any): Promise<void> { // Send to your monitoring system (Prometheus, DataDog, etc.) console.log('Quality metrics collected:', metrics); } }

Controller Implementation​ // user.controller.ts import { Controller, Get, Post, Put, Delete, Body, Param, Query, UseGuards, UsePipes, ValidationPipe, HttpStatus, HttpCode } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ApiTags, ApiOperation, ApiResponse, ApiBearerAuth } from '@nestjs/swagger'; import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard'; import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard'; import { Roles } from '../auth/decorators/roles.decorator'; import { UserRole } from '../auth/enums/user-role.enum'; import { UserService } from './user.service'; import { CreateUserDto } from './dto/create-user.dto'; import { UpdateUserDto } from './dto/update-user.dto'; import { UserListQueryDto } from './dto/user-list-query.dto'; import { User } from './entities/user.entity'; @ApiTags('users') @Controller('users') @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard) @ApiBearerAuth() export class UserController { constructor(private readonly userService: UserService) {} @Post() @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN) @UsePipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true })) @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED) @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Create a new user' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 201, description: 'User created successfully', type: User }) @ApiResponse({ status: 400, description: 'Invalid input data' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: 'Insufficient permissions' }) async createUser(@Body() createUserDto: CreateUserDto): Promise<User> { return this.userService.create(createUserDto); } @Get() @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.MANAGER) @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get list of users' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'Users retrieved successfully', type: [User] }) async getUsers(@Query() query: UserListQueryDto): Promise<User[]> { return this.userService.findAll(query); } @Get(':id') @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Get user by ID' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'User found', type: User }) @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'User not found' }) async getUserById(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<User> { return this.userService.findById(id); } @Put(':id') @UsePipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true })) @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Update user' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 200, description: 'User updated successfully', type: User }) @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'User not found' }) async updateUser( @Param('id') id: string, @Body() updateUserDto: UpdateUserDto, ): Promise<User> { return this.userService.update(id, updateUserDto); } @Delete(':id') @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN) @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT) @ApiOperation({ summary: 'Delete user' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 204, description: 'User deleted successfully' }) @ApiResponse({ status: 404, description: 'User not found' }) async deleteUser(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<void> { await this.userService.delete(id); } } Service Implementation​ // user.service.ts import { Injectable, NotFoundException, ConflictException, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { Repository } from 'typeorm'; import { User } from './entities/user.entity'; import { CreateUserDto } from './dto/create-user.dto'; import { UpdateUserDto } from './dto/update-user.dto'; import { UserListQueryDto } from './dto/user-list-query.dto'; import { HashService } from '../common/services/hash.service'; import { EmailService } from '../email/email.service'; @Injectable() export class UserService { private readonly logger = new Logger(UserService.name); constructor( @InjectRepository(User) private readonly userRepository: Repository<User>, private readonly hashService: HashService, private readonly emailService: EmailService, ) {} async create(createUserDto: CreateUserDto): Promise<User> { this.logger.log(`Creating user with email: ${createUserDto.email}`); // Check if user already exists const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { email: createUserDto.email }, }); if (existingUser) { throw new ConflictException('User with this email already exists'); } // Hash password const hashedPassword = await this.hashService.hash(createUserDto.password); // Create user entity const user = this.userRepository.create({ ...createUserDto, password: hashedPassword, }); // Save user const savedUser = await this.userRepository.save(user); // Send welcome email await this.emailService.sendWelcomeEmail(savedUser.email, savedUser.firstName); this.logger.log(`User created successfully with ID: ${savedUser.id}`); return savedUser; } async findAll(query: UserListQueryDto): Promise<User[]> { const { page = 1, limit = 10, search, role } = query; const queryBuilder = this.userRepository.createQueryBuilder('user'); if (search) { queryBuilder.andWhere( '(user.firstName ILIKE :search OR user.lastName ILIKE :search OR user.email ILIKE :search)', { search: `%${search}%` }, ); } if (role) { queryBuilder.andWhere('user.role = :role', { role }); } const users = await queryBuilder .skip((page - 1) * limit) .take(limit) .orderBy('user.createdAt', 'DESC') .getMany(); return users; } async findById(id: string): Promise<User> { const user = await this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } }); if (!user) { throw new NotFoundException(`User with ID ${id} not found`); } return user; } async update(id: string, updateUserDto: UpdateUserDto): Promise<User> { const user = await this.findById(id); // Hash password if provided if (updateUserDto.password) { updateUserDto.password = await this.hashService.hash(updateUserDto.password); } Object.assign(user, updateUserDto); return this.userRepository.save(user); } async delete(id: string): Promise<void> { const user = await this.findById(id); await this.userRepository.remove(user); this.logger.log(`User with ID ${id} deleted successfully`); } } DTO Implementation​ // create-user.dto.ts import { IsEmail, IsString, IsEnum, IsOptional, MinLength, MaxLength, Matches, IsPhoneNumber } from 'class-validator'; @ApiProperty({ description: 'User last name', example: 'Doe', minLength: 2, maxLength: 50 }) @IsString() @MinLength(2) @MaxLength(50) lastName: string; @ApiProperty({ description: 'User email address', example: 'john.doe@example.com' }) @IsEmail() email: string; @ApiProperty({ description: 'User password', example: 'StrongP@ssw0rd', minLength: 8 }) @IsString() @MinLength(8) @Matches( /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&]/, { message: 'Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, number and special character' } ) password: string; This guide provides step-by-step instructions for special development scenarios commonly encountered when building NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontends.

Special development use cases require specific tools, configurations, and procedures that go beyond standard development workflows. This guide covers environment setup, custom tooling, debugging procedures, and troubleshooting for complex scenarios.

Setting up multiple NestJS services and Next.js applications locally with proper service discovery and communication. Prerequisites​ Docker and Docker Compose installed Node.js 18+ and pnpm/npm Git and development tools configured Setup Steps​ Clone and Setup Services # Clone the monorepo git clone <repository-url> cd <project-name> # Install dependencies for all services pnpm install # Start infrastructure services docker-compose up -d postgres redis rabbitmq Configure Service Discovery // shared/config/services.config.ts export const ServiceConfig = { userService: { host: process.env.USER_SERVICE_HOST || 'localhost', port: process.env.USER_SERVICE_PORT || 3001, }, orderService: { host: process.env.ORDER_SERVICE_HOST || 'localhost', port: process.env.ORDER_SERVICE_PORT || 3002, }, gateway: { host: process.env.GATEWAY_HOST || 'localhost', port: process.env.GATEWAY_PORT || 3000, } }; Environment Variable Configuration # .env.local (for local development) DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/microservices_db" REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6379" RABBITMQ_URL="amqp://localhost:5672" # Service-specific variables USER_SERVICE_PORT=3001 ORDER_SERVICE_PORT=3002 GATEWAY_PORT=3000 # JWT secrets JWT_SECRET="your-dev-jwt-secret" JWT_REFRESH_SECRET="your-dev-refresh-secret"

'up' : 'down', })), }, }; } } Message Queue Debugging​ // src/messaging/rabbitmq-debug.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { RabbitMQModule, AmqpConnection } from '@golevelup/nestjs-rabbitmq'; @Injectable() export class RabbitMQDebugService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RabbitMQDebugService.name); constructor(private readonly amqpConnection: AmqpConnection) {} async debugQueue(queueName: string) { try { const channel = this.amqpConnection.channel; const queueInfo = await channel.checkQueue(queueName); this.logger.log(`Queue ${queueName} info:`, { messageCount: queueInfo.messageCount, consumerCount: queueInfo.consumerCount, }); return queueInfo; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to check queue ${queueName}:`, error); throw error; } } async purgeQueue(queueName: string) { try { const channel = this.amqpConnection.channel; await channel.purgeQueue(queueName); this.logger.log(`Purged queue ${queueName}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to purge queue ${queueName}:`, error); throw error; } } }

This guide provides comprehensive input validation strategies for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications to ensure data integrity and security.

Input validation is a critical security and data integrity practice that must be implemented at multiple layers of the application. This guide covers client-side validation for user experience, server-side validation for security, and database constraints for data integrity.

@IsOptional() @IsPhoneNumber(null, { message: 'Please provide a valid phone number' }) phoneNumber?: string; @IsOptional() @IsDate() @Type(() => Date) @Transform(({ value }) => value && new Date(value)) dateOfBirth?: Date; @IsEnum(UserRole, { message: 'Role must be one of: admin, user, moderator' }) role: UserRole; @IsOptional() @ValidateNested() @Type(() => AddressDto) address?: AddressDto; @IsOptional() @IsString({ each: true }) @ArrayMinSize(0) @ArrayMaxSize(10) @Transform(({ value }) => value?.map((tag: string) => tag.trim().toLowerCase())) tags?: string[]; // src/validators/custom-validators.ts import { registerDecorator, ValidationOptions, ValidationArguments } from 'class-validator'; // Unique email validator export function IsUniqueEmail(validationOptions?: ValidationOptions) { return function (object: Object, propertyName: string) { registerDecorator({ name: 'isUniqueEmail', target: object.constructor, propertyName: propertyName, options: validationOptions, validator: { async validate(value: any, args: ValidationArguments) { const userService = Container.get(UserService); const existingUser = await userService.findByEmail(value); return !existingUser; }, defaultMessage(args: ValidationArguments) { return `Email ${args.value} is already taken`; }, }, }); }; } // Strong password validator export function IsStrongPassword(validationOptions?: ValidationOptions) { return function (object: Object, propertyName: string) { registerDecorator({ name: 'isStrongPassword', target: object.constructor, propertyName: propertyName, options: validationOptions, validator: { validate(value: any, args: ValidationArguments) { if (typeof value !== 'string') return false; const hasMinLength = value.length >= 8; const hasUpperCase = /[A-Z]/.test(value); const hasLowerCase = /[a-z]/.test(value); const hasNumbers = /\d/.test(value); const hasSpecialChar = /[@$!%*?&]/.test(value); const hasNoSequence = !/(.)\1{2,}/.test(value); // No 3+ consecutive same chars return hasMinLength && hasUpperCase && hasLowerCase && hasNumbers && hasSpecialChar && hasNoSequence; }, defaultMessage(args: ValidationArguments) { return 'Password must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, special character, and no repetitive sequences'; }, }, }); }; } // File type validator export function IsValidFileType(allowedTypes: string[], validationOptions?: ValidationOptions) { return function (object: Object, propertyName: string) { registerDecorator({ name: 'isValidFileType', target: object.constructor, propertyName: propertyName, constraints: [allowedTypes], options: validationOptions, validator: { validate(value: any, args: ValidationArguments) { if (!value || !value.mimetype) return false; const [allowedTypes] = args.constraints; return allowedTypes.includes(value.mimetype); }, defaultMessage(args: ValidationArguments) { const [allowedTypes] = args.constraints; return `File type must be one of: ${allowedTypes.join(', ')}`; }, }, }); }; }

// src/validation/validation.service.ts @Injectable() export class ValidationService { private readonly logger = new Logger(ValidationService.name); // Sanitize input to prevent XSS sanitizeInput(input: string): string { return input .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '') // Remove script tags .replace(/javascript:/gi, '') // Remove javascript: protocol .replace(/on\w+="[^"]*"/gi, '') // Remove event handlers .trim(); } // Validate business rules async validateBusinessRules(dto: any, context: string): Promise<ValidationResult> { const errors: string[] = []; switch (context) { case 'user-creation': await this.validateUserCreationRules(dto, errors); break; case 'order-creation': await this.validateOrderCreationRules(dto, errors); break; default: this.logger.warn(`Unknown validation context: ${context}`); } return { isValid: errors.length === 0, errors, }; } private async validateUserCreationRules(dto: CreateUserDto, errors: string[]): Promise<void> { // Age validation if (dto.dateOfBirth) { const age = this.calculateAge(dto.dateOfBirth); if (age < 13) { errors.push('User must be at least 13 years old'); } } // Email domain validation const emailDomain = dto.email.split('@')[1]; const blockedDomains = await this.getBlockedEmailDomains(); if (blockedDomains.includes(emailDomain)) { errors.push('Email domain is not allowed'); } // Password history check if (dto.password) { const passwordHistory = await this.getUserPasswordHistory(dto.email); const isPasswordReused = await this.checkPasswordReuse(dto.password, passwordHistory); if (isPasswordReused) { errors.push('Password has been used recently, please choose a different password'); } } } // Rate limiting validation async validateRateLimit(identifier: string, action: string): Promise<boolean> { const key = `rate_limit:${action}:${identifier}`; const current = await this.redisService.get(key); const limits = { 'user-creation': { count: 5, window: 3600 }, // 5 attempts per hour 'password-reset': { count: 3, window: 1800 }, // 3 attempts per 30 minutes 'login': { count: 10, window: 900 }, // 10 attempts per 15 minutes }; const limit = limits[action]; if (!limit) return true; if (current >= limit.count) { return false; } await this.redisService.incr(key, limit.window); return true; } }

// src/middleware/validation.middleware.ts @Injectable() export class ValidationMiddleware implements NestMiddleware { constructor(private readonly validationService: ValidationService) {} use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) { // Sanitize query parameters if (req.query) { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(req.query)) { if (typeof value === 'string') { req.query[key] = this.validationService.sanitizeInput(value); } } } // Sanitize body parameters if (req.body && typeof req.body === 'object') { this.sanitizeObject(req.body); } // Validate content type for POST/PUT requests if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method)) { const contentType = req.headers['content-type']; if (!contentType || !contentType.includes('application/json')) { return res.status(400).json({ statusCode: 400, message: 'Content-Type must be application/json', error: 'Bad Request', }); } } // Check payload size const contentLength = parseInt(req.headers['content-length'] || '0'); if (contentLength > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { // 10MB limit return res.status(413).json({ statusCode: 413, message: 'Payload too large', error: 'Payload Too Large', }); } next(); } private sanitizeObject(obj: any): void { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) { if (typeof value === 'string') { obj[key] = this.validationService.sanitizeInput(value); } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) { this.sanitizeObject(value); } } } }

Defense in Depth: Validate at multiple layers Fail Securely: Default to rejection when validation fails Clear Error Messages: Provide helpful feedback to users Performance: Validate efficiently without blocking Consistency: Use consistent validation patterns

Server-Side Priority: Never rely solely on client-side validation Sanitization: Clean inputs before validation Business Rules: Separate technical from business validation Rate Limiting: Prevent abuse through validation endpoints Logging: Log validation failures for security monitoring

// src/integrations/http/http-client.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { HttpService } from '@nestjs/axios'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Observable, throwError, of } from 'rxjs'; import { retry, catchError, timeout, map } from 'rxjs/operators'; import { AxiosResponse, AxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios'; export interface HttpClientOptions { baseURL: string; timeout: number; retries: number; retryDelay: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; auth?: { type: 'bearer' | 'basic' | 'apikey'; token?: string; username?: string; password?: string; apiKey?: string; apiKeyHeader?: string; }; } @Injectable() export class HttpClientService { private readonly logger = new Logger(HttpClientService.name); constructor( private readonly httpService: HttpService, private readonly configService: ConfigService, ) {} createClient(options: HttpClientOptions) { const config: AxiosRequestConfig = { baseURL: options.baseURL, timeout: options.timeout, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'MyApp/1.0.0', ...options.headers, }, }; // Configure authentication if (options.auth) { switch (options.auth.type) { case 'bearer': config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${options.auth.token}`; break; case 'basic': const basicAuth = Buffer.from( `${options.auth.username}:${options.auth.password}` ).toString('base64'); config.headers.Authorization = `Basic ${basicAuth}`; break; case 'apikey': const headerName = options.auth.apiKeyHeader || 'X-API-Key'; config.headers[headerName] = options.auth.apiKey; break; } } return { get: <T>(url: string, config?: AxiosRequestConfig) => this.makeRequest<T>('get', url, undefined, { ...config, ...options }), post: <T>(url: string, data?: any, config?: AxiosRequestConfig) => this.makeRequest<T>('post', url, data, { ...config, ...options }), put: <T>(url: string, data?: any, config?: AxiosRequestConfig) => this.makeRequest<T>('put', url, data, { ...config, ...options }), delete: <T>(url: string, config?: AxiosRequestConfig) => this.makeRequest<T>('delete', url, undefined, { ...config, ...options }), }; } private makeRequest<T>( method: 'get' | 'post' | 'put' | 'delete', url: string, data?: any, options?: HttpClientOptions & AxiosRequestConfig, ): Observable<T> { const startTime = Date.now(); let request: Observable<AxiosResponse<T>>; switch (method) { case 'get': request = this.httpService.get<T>(url, options); break; case 'post': request = this.httpService.post<T>(url, data, options); break; case 'put': request = this.httpService.put<T>(url, data, options); break; case 'delete': request = this.httpService.delete<T>(url, options); break; } return request.pipe( timeout(options?.timeout || 30000), retry({ count: options?.retries || 3, delay: (error, retryCount) => { const delay = options?.retryDelay || 1000; this.logger.warn( `Request failed, retrying (${retryCount}/${options?.retries || 3}) after ${delay}ms`, { url, method, error: error.message } ); return of(null).pipe(timeout(delay * retryCount)); }, }), map(response => { const duration = Date.now() - startTime; this.logger.log( `Request completed: ${method.toUpperCase()} ${url} (${response.status}) in ${duration}ms` ); return response.data; }), catchError(error => { const duration = Date.now() - startTime; this.logger.error( `Request failed: ${method.toUpperCase()} ${url} after ${duration}ms`, error.response?.data || error.message ); return throwError(() => error); }), ); } }

// src/integrations/circuit-breaker/circuit-breaker.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Observable, throwError, of } from 'rxjs'; import { catchError, tap } from 'rxjs/operators'; export enum CircuitState { CLOSED = 'CLOSED', OPEN = 'OPEN', HALF_OPEN = 'HALF_OPEN', } export interface CircuitBreakerOptions { failureThreshold: number; recoveryTimeout: number; monitoringPeriod: number; fallbackEnabled: boolean; } interface CircuitBreakerMetrics { failures: number; successes: number; lastFailureTime: number; state: CircuitState; } @Injectable() export class CircuitBreakerService { private readonly logger = new Logger(CircuitBreakerService.name); private readonly circuits = new Map<string, CircuitBreakerMetrics>(); createCircuit( name: string, options: CircuitBreakerOptions, ): <T>(operation: () => Observable<T>, fallback?: () => Observable<T>) => Observable<T> { if (!this.circuits.has(name)) { this.circuits.set(name, { failures: 0, successes: 0, lastFailureTime: 0, state: CircuitState.CLOSED, }); } return <T>( operation: () => Observable<T>, fallback?: () => Observable<T>, ): Observable<T> => { const circuit = this.circuits.get(name)!; // Check if circuit should transition from OPEN to HALF_OPEN if ( circuit.state === CircuitState.OPEN && Date.now() - circuit.lastFailureTime > options.recoveryTimeout ) { circuit.state = CircuitState.HALF_OPEN; this.logger.log(`Circuit breaker ${name} transitioning to HALF_OPEN`); } // Reject if circuit is OPEN if (circuit.state === CircuitState.OPEN) { this.logger.warn(`Circuit breaker ${name} is OPEN, rejecting request`); if (fallback && options.fallbackEnabled) { return fallback(); } return throwError(() => new Error(`Circuit breaker ${name} is OPEN`)); } return operation().pipe( tap(() => { // Record success circuit.successes++; if (circuit.state === CircuitState.HALF_OPEN) { circuit.state = CircuitState.CLOSED; circuit.failures = 0; this.logger.log(`Circuit breaker ${name} recovered to CLOSED`); } }), catchError(error => { // Record failure circuit.failures++; circuit.lastFailureTime = Date.now(); // Check if we should open the circuit if (circuit.failures >= options.failureThreshold) { circuit.state = CircuitState.OPEN; this.logger.error( `Circuit breaker ${name} opened after ${circuit.failures} failures` ); } // Use fallback if available and enabled if (fallback && options.fallbackEnabled) { return fallback(); } return throwError(() => error); }), ); }; } getCircuitStatus(name: string): CircuitBreakerMetrics | null { return this.circuits.get(name) || null; } resetCircuit(name: string): void { const circuit = this.circuits.get(name); if (circuit) { circuit.failures = 0; circuit.successes = 0; circuit.state = CircuitState.CLOSED; circuit.lastFailureTime = 0; this.logger.log(`Circuit breaker ${name} manually reset`); } } }

// src/integrations/payment/stripe-payment.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Observable, from, of } from 'rxjs'; import { map, catchError } from 'rxjs/operators'; import Stripe from 'stripe'; export interface PaymentIntent { id: string; amount: number; currency: string; status: string; clientSecret: string; } export interface CreatePaymentIntentDto { amount: number; currency: string; customerId?: string; metadata?: Record<string, string>; } @Injectable() export class StripePaymentService { private readonly logger = new Logger(StripePaymentService.name); private readonly stripe: Stripe; private readonly circuit: ReturnType<CircuitBreakerService['createCircuit']>; constructor( private readonly configService: ConfigService, private readonly circuitBreaker: CircuitBreakerService, private readonly httpClient: HttpClientService, ) { this.stripe = new Stripe( this.configService.get<string>('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY')!, { apiVersion: '2023-10-16', timeout: 30000, maxNetworkRetries: 3, } ); // Configure circuit breaker for Stripe API this.circuit = this.circuitBreaker.createCircuit('stripe-api', { failureThreshold: 5, recoveryTimeout: 30000, // 30 seconds monitoringPeriod: 60000, // 1 minute fallbackEnabled: true, }); } createPaymentIntent(data: CreatePaymentIntentDto): Observable<PaymentIntent> { const operation = () => from( this.stripe.paymentIntents.create({ amount: data.amount, currency: data.currency, customer: data.customerId, metadata: data.metadata, automatic_payment_methods: { enabled: true, }, }) ).pipe( map(intent => ({ id: intent.id, amount: intent.amount, currency: intent.currency, status: intent.status, clientSecret: intent.client_secret!, })) ); const fallback = () => { this.logger.warn('Stripe service unavailable, using fallback payment processor'); // Implement fallback to secondary payment processor return this.createPaymentIntentFallback(data); }; return this.circuit(operation, fallback); } confirmPaymentIntent(paymentIntentId: string): Observable<PaymentIntent> { const operation = () => from( this.stripe.paymentIntents.confirm(paymentIntentId) ).pipe( map(intent => ({ id: intent.id, amount: intent.amount, currency: intent.currency, status: intent.status, clientSecret: intent.client_secret!, })) ); return this.circuit(operation); } private createPaymentIntentFallback(data: CreatePaymentIntentDto): Observable<PaymentIntent> { // Implement fallback payment processor (e.g., PayPal, Square) return of({ id: `fallback_${Date.now()}`, amount: data.amount, currency: data.currency, status: 'requires_payment_method', clientSecret: 'fallback_client_secret', }); } // Webhook handling for Stripe events handleWebhook(payload: string, signature: string): Observable<void> { const operation = () => { try { const event = this.stripe.webhooks.constructEvent( payload, signature, this.configService.get<string>('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET')! ); return from(this.processWebhookEvent(event)); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Webhook signature verification failed', error); throw error; } }; return this.circuit(operation); } private async processWebhookEvent(event: Stripe.Event): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Processing Stripe webhook event: ${event.type}`); switch (event.type) { case 'payment_intent.succeeded': await this.handlePaymentSuccess(event.data.object as Stripe.PaymentIntent); break; case 'payment_intent.payment_failed': await this.handlePaymentFailure(event.data.object as Stripe.PaymentIntent); break; default: this.logger.log(`Unhandled event type: ${event.type}`); } } private async handlePaymentSuccess(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent): Promise<void> { // Update order status, send confirmation email, etc. this.logger.log(`Payment succeeded for intent: ${paymentIntent.id}`); } private async handlePaymentFailure(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent): Promise<void> { // Handle payment failure, notify user, etc. this.logger.error(`Payment failed for intent: ${paymentIntent.id}`); } }

// src/integrations/rate-limit/rate-limit.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Redis } from 'ioredis'; export interface RateLimitOptions { windowMs: number; maxRequests: number; keyGenerator?: (context: any) => string; } export interface RateLimitResult { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; resetTime: number; } @Injectable() export class RateLimitService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RateLimitService.name); constructor(private readonly redis: Redis) {} async checkRateLimit( key: string, options: RateLimitOptions, ): Promise<RateLimitResult> { const now = Date.now(); const window = Math.floor(now / options.windowMs); const redisKey = `rate_limit:${key}:${window}`; try { const current = await this.redis.incr(redisKey); if (current === 1) { // Set expiration for the first request in this window await this.redis.expire(redisKey, Math.ceil(options.windowMs / 1000)); } const allowed = current <= options.maxRequests; const remaining = Math.max(0, options.maxRequests - current); const resetTime = (window + 1) * options.windowMs; if (!allowed) { this.logger.warn(`Rate limit exceeded for key: ${key}`); } return { allowed, remaining, resetTime, }; } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Rate limit check failed', error); // Fail open - allow request if Redis is unavailable return { allowed: true, remaining: options.maxRequests, resetTime: now + options.windowMs, }; } } async resetRateLimit(key: string): Promise<void> { try { const pattern = `rate_limit:${key}:*`; const keys = await this.redis.keys(pattern); if (keys.length > 0) { await this.redis.del(...keys); this.logger.log(`Rate limit reset for key: ${key}`); } } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Rate limit reset failed', error); } } }

// hooks/use-api-client.ts import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'; import { useAuth } from './use-auth'; interface ApiClientOptions { baseURL: string; timeout?: number; retries?: number; } interface ApiResponse<T> { data: T | null; error: string | null; loading: boolean; } export const useApiClient = (options: ApiClientOptions) => { const { token } = useAuth(); const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController>(); const createRequest = useCallback( async <T>( endpoint: string, config: RequestInit = {} ): Promise<T> => { // Cancel previous request if (abortControllerRef.current) { abortControllerRef.current.abort(); } abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController(); const url = `${options.baseURL}${endpoint}`; const timeout = options.timeout || 30000; const requestConfig: RequestInit = { ...config, signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token && { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }), ...config.headers, }, }; // Add timeout const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => { abortControllerRef.current?.abort(); }, timeout); try { const response = await fetch(url, requestConfig); clearTimeout(timeoutId); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`); } const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type'); if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) { return await response.json(); } return await response.text() as unknown as T; } catch (error) { clearTimeout(timeoutId); if (error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError') { throw new Error('Request timeout'); } throw error; } }, [options.baseURL, options.timeout, token] ); const useRequest = <T>( endpoint: string, config: RequestInit = {} ): [ApiResponse<T>, () => Promise<void>] => { const [response, setResponse] = useState<ApiResponse<T>>({ data: null, error: null, loading: false, }); const execute = useCallback(async () => { setResponse(prev => ({ ...prev, loading: true, error: null })); try { const data = await createRequest<T>(endpoint, config); setResponse({ data, error: null, loading: false }); } catch (error) { const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'; setResponse({ data: null, error: errorMessage, loading: false }); } }, [endpoint, config]); return [response, execute]; }; return { get: <T>(endpoint: string) => createRequest<T>(endpoint, { method: 'GET' }), post: <T>(endpoint: string, data?: any) => createRequest<T>(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: data ? // src/interceptors/performance.interceptor.ts import { Injectable, NestInterceptor, ExecutionContext, CallHandler, Logger, } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Observable } from 'rxjs'; import { tap, catchError } from 'rxjs/operators'; import { Request, Response } from 'express'; import { PerformanceService } from '../monitoring/performance.service'; @Injectable() export class PerformanceInterceptor implements NestInterceptor { private readonly logger = new Logger(PerformanceInterceptor.name); constructor(private readonly performanceService: PerformanceService) {} intercept(context: ExecutionContext, next: CallHandler): Observable<any> { const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<Request>(); const response = context.switchToHttp().getResponse<Response>(); const startTime = Date.now(); const startMemory = process.memoryUsage(); const startCpuUsage = process.cpuUsage(); // Extract route information const method = request.method; const route = request.route?.path || request.url; const userAgent = request.headers['user-agent']; const requestId = request.headers['x-request-id'] as string; return next.handle().pipe( tap(() => { this.recordPerformanceMetrics( method, route, response.statusCode, startTime, startMemory, startCpuUsage, userAgent, requestId, ); }), catchError((error) => { this.recordPerformanceMetrics( method, route, response.statusCode || 500, startTime, startMemory, startCpuUsage, userAgent, requestId, error, ); throw error; }), ); } private recordPerformanceMetrics( method: string, route: string, statusCode: number, startTime: number, startMemory: NodeJS.MemoryUsage, startCpuUsage: NodeJS.CpuUsage, userAgent: string, requestId: string, error?: Error, ): void { const endTime = Date.now(); const duration = endTime - startTime; const endMemory = process.memoryUsage(); const endCpuUsage = process.cpuUsage(startCpuUsage); const performanceData = { method, route, statusCode, duration, memoryUsage: { heapUsed: endMemory.heapUsed - startMemory.heapUsed, heapTotal: endMemory.heapTotal - startMemory.heapTotal, external: endMemory.external - startMemory.external, rss: endMemory.rss - startMemory.rss, }, cpuUsage: { user: endCpuUsage.user, system: endCpuUsage.system, }, userAgent, requestId, timestamp: new Date(startTime).toISOString(), error: error?.message, }; // Record metrics this.performanceService.recordRequestPerformance(performanceData); // Log slow requests if (duration > 1000) { this.logger.warn(`Slow request detected: ${method} ${route} - ${duration}ms`, { requestId, performanceData, }); } // Log high memory usage if (performanceData.memoryUsage.heapUsed > 50 * 1024 * 1024) { // 50MB this.logger.warn(`High memory usage detected: ${method} ${route}`, { requestId, memoryUsage: performanceData.memoryUsage, }); } } }

} private setupQueryLogging(): void { // Override the query method to add performance tracking const originalQuery = this.dataSource.query.bind(this.dataSource); this.dataSource.query = async (query: string, parameters?: any[]): Promise<any> => { const startTime = performance.now(); }, {} as Record<string, number>); return { slowQueries: slowQueries.slice(-10), // Last 10 slow queries averageDuration, totalQueries: this.queryPerformanceData.length, queryPatterns, }; } private async getExecutionPlan(query: string, parameters?: any[]): Promise<any> { try { const explainQuery = `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) ${query}`; return relevantLines.slice(0, 3).join('\n'); } }

// src/monitoring/profiling.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import * as v8 from 'v8'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; } } private initializeEventLoopMonitoring(): void { if (typeof require !== 'undefined') { try { const { monitorEventLoopDelay } = require('perf_hooks'); this.eventLoopMonitor = monitorEventLoopDelay({ resolution: 20 }); this.eventLoopMonitor.enable(); } catch (error) { this.logger.warn('Event loop monitoring not available', error); } } } private async checkForMemoryLeaks(currentProfile: ProfileData): Promise<void> { if (this.profileDataHistory.length < 10) return; for (let i = 1; i < memoryGrowth.length; i++) { if (memoryGrowth[i] > memoryGrowth[i - 1]) { consecutiveIncreases++; } else { consecutiveIncreases = 0; } } if (consecutiveIncreases >= 8) { // 8 consecutive increases this.logger.warn('Potential memory leak detected', { currentHeapUsed: currentProfile.memoryUsage.heapUsed, memoryGrowthPattern: memoryGrowth, }); // Trigger heap snapshot for analysis await this.createHeapSnapshot(); } // Check for high memory usage const heapUsedMB = currentProfile.memoryUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024; if (heapUsedMB > 512) { // Alert if heap usage exceeds 512MB this.logger.warn(`High memory usage detected: ${heapUsedMB.toFixed(2)}MB`, { memoryUsage: currentProfile.memoryUsage, heapStatistics: currentProfile.heapStatistics, }); // 30 seconds in microseconds if (cpuUsagePercent > 80) { this.logger.warn(`High CPU usage detected: ${cpuUsagePercent.toFixed(2)}%`, { cpuUsage: currentProfile.cpuUsage, }); } // Check event loop delay if (currentProfile.eventLoopDelay && currentProfile.eventLoopDelay > 100) { this.logger.warn(`High event loop delay detected: ${currentProfile.eventLoopDelay}ms`); heapSnapshot.pipe(writeStream); this.logger.log(`Heap snapshot created: ${filename}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to create heap snapshot', error); } } async getProfileReport(): Promise<{ current: ProfileData; averages: { memoryUsage: number; cpuUsagePercent: number; eventLoopDelay: number; }; trends: { memoryTrend: 'increasing' | 'decreasing' | 'stable'; cpuTrend: 'increasing' | 'decreasing' | 'stable'; }; }> { const current = this.profileDataHistory[this.profileDataHistory.length - 1]; if (!current) { throw new Error('No profile data available'); } const recentProfiles = this.profileDataHistory.slice(-20); // Last 20 samples const averageMemory = recentProfiles.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.memoryUsage.heapUsed, 0) / recentProfiles.length; const averageCpuPercent = recentProfiles.reduce((sum, p) => { const totalCpu = p.cpuUsage.user + p.cpuUsage.system; return sum + (totalCpu / 30000000) * 100; }, 0) / recentProfiles.length; const averageEventLoopDelay = recentProfiles.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.eventLoopDelay || 0), 0) / recentProfiles.length; // Calculate trends const memoryTrend = this.calculateTrend(recentProfiles.map(p => p.memoryUsage.heapUsed));
