} { const poorMetrics = this.metrics.filter(m => m.rating === 'poor'); const issueGroups = this.metrics.reduce((groups, metric) => { if (metric.rating === 'poor') { const key = metric.name; if (!groups[key]) { groups[key] = { name: key, count: 0, totalValue: 0 }; } groups[key].count++; groups[key].totalValue += metric.value; } return groups; }, {} as Record<string, { name: string; count: number; totalValue: number }>); const topIssues = Object.values(issueGroups) .map(group => ({ name: group.name, count: group.count, avgValue: group.totalValue / group.count, })) .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count) .slice(0, 5); const loadTimeMetrics = this.metrics.filter(m => m.name === 'LCP' || m.name === 'FCP'); const averageLoadTime = loadTimeMetrics.length > 0 ? loadTimeMetrics.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.value, 0) / loadTimeMetrics.length : 0; return { totalMetrics: this.metrics.length, poorPerformanceCount: poorMetrics.length, averageLoadTime, topIssues, }; } } export const clientPerformanceTracker = new ClientPerformanceTracker();

// hooks/use-performance-monitoring.ts import { useEffect } from 'react'; import { useRouter } from 'next/router'; import { clientPerformanceTracker } from '../lib/performance/client-performance'; export const usePerformanceMonitoring = (userId?: string) => { const router = useRouter(); useEffect(() => { if (userId) { clientPerformanceTracker.setUserId(userId); } // Track route changes const handleRouteChangeStart = (url: string) => { const startTime = performance.now(); const handleRouteChangeComplete = () => { const loadTime = performance.now() - startTime; clientPerformanceTracker.trackCustomMetric('route_change_duration', loadTime, { route: url, }); router.events.off('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChangeComplete); }; router.events.on('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteChangeComplete); }; router.events.on('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChangeStart); return () => { router.events.off('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChangeStart); }; }, [router, userId]); // Manual performance tracking functions const trackCustomMetric = (name: string, value: number, metadata?: Record<string, any>) => { clientPerformanceTracker.trackCustomMetric(name, value, metadata); }; const trackUserAction = (action: string, component: string, duration?: number) => { clientPerformanceTracker.trackCustomMetric('user_action', duration || 1, { action, component, url: window.location.pathname, }); }; const trackApiCall = (endpoint: string, method: string, duration: number, status: number) => { clientPerformanceTracker.trackCustomMetric('api_call_duration', duration, { endpoint, method, status, }); }; return { trackCustomMetric, trackUserAction, trackApiCall, getPerformanceSummary: () => clientPerformanceTracker.getPerformanceSummary(), }; };

// scripts/performance-tests.ts import puppeteer from 'puppeteer'; import lighthouse from 'lighthouse'; interface PerformanceTestResult { url: string; timestamp: Date; metrics: { firstContentfulPaint: number; largestContentfulPaint: number; firstInputDelay: number; cumulativeLayoutShift: number; speedIndex: number; timeToInteractive: number; }; scores: { performance: number; accessibility: number; bestPractices: number; seo: number; }; opportunities: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description: string; score: number; }>; } class PerformanceTester { private browser?: puppeteer.Browser; async initialize(): Promise<void> { this.browser = await puppeteer.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox'], }); } async runPerformanceTest(url: string): Promise<PerformanceTestResult> { if (!this.browser) { await this.initialize(); } const page = await this.browser!.newPage(); try { // Configure page for performance testing await page.setCacheEnabled(false); await page.setViewport({ width: 1920, height: 1080 }); // Run Lighthouse audit const { lhr } = await lighthouse(url, { port: new URL(this.browser!.wsEndpoint()).port, onlyCategories: ['performance', 'accessibility', 'best-practices', 'seo'], settings: { preset: 'desktop', }, }); const metrics = lhr.audits; return { url, timestamp: new Date(), metrics: { firstContentfulPaint: metrics['first-contentful-paint'].numericValue || 0, largestContentfulPaint: metrics['largest-contentful-paint'].numericValue || 0, firstInputDelay: metrics['max-potential-fid'].numericValue || 0, cumulativeLayoutShift: metrics['cumulative-layout-shift'].numericValue || 0, speedIndex: metrics['speed-index'].numericValue || 0, timeToInteractive: metrics['interactive'].numericValue || 0, }, scores: { performance: (lhr.categories.performance?.score || 0) * 100, accessibility: (lhr.categories.accessibility?.score || 0) * 100, bestPractices: (lhr.categories['best-practices']?.score || 0) * 100, seo: (lhr.categories.seo?.score || 0) * 100, }, opportunities: Object.values(lhr.audits) .filter(audit => audit.scoreDisplayMode === 'numeric' && audit.score !== null && audit.score < 0.9) .map(audit => ({ id: audit.id, title: audit.title, description: audit.description, score: audit.score || 0, })) .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score), }; } finally { await page.close(); } } async runLoadTest(url: string, concurrency: number = 10, duration: number = 60): Promise<{ averageResponseTime: number; requestsPerSecond: number; errorRate: number; p95ResponseTime: number; }> { const results: Array<{ duration: number; success: boolean }> = []; const startTime = Date.now(); const endTime = startTime + (duration * 1000); const runRequest = async (): Promise<void> => { while (Date.now() < endTime) { const requestStart = Date.now(); try { const page = await this.browser!.newPage(); await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' }); await page.close(); results.push({ duration: Date.now() - requestStart, success: true, }); } catch (error) { results.push({ duration: Date.now() - requestStart, success: false, }); } } }; // Run concurrent requests const promises = Array(concurrency).fill(null).map(() => runRequest()); await Promise.all(promises); // Calculate metrics const successfulResults = results.filter(r => r.success); const totalDuration = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000; const averageResponseTime = successfulResults.length > 0 ? successfulResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.duration, 0) / successfulResults.length : 0; const requestsPerSecond = results.length / totalDuration; const errorRate = (results.length - successfulResults.length) / results.length; const sortedDurations = successfulResults.map(r => r.duration).sort((a, b) => a - b); const p95Index = Math.floor(sortedDurations.length * 0.95); const p95ResponseTime = sortedDurations[p95Index] || 0; return { averageResponseTime, requestsPerSecond, errorRate, p95ResponseTime, }; } async close(): Promise<void> { if (this.browser) { await this.browser.close(); } } } // Usage example export async function runPerformanceTestSuite(): Promise<void> { const tester = new PerformanceTester(); const urls = [ 'https://app.example.com', 'https://app.example.com/dashboard', 'https://app.example.com/profile', ]; try { for (const url of urls) { console.log(`Testing ${url}...`); // Performance audit const performanceResult = await tester.runPerformanceTest(url); console.log(`Performance Score: ${performanceResult.scores.performance}`); console.log(`LCP: ${performanceResult.metrics.largestContentfulPaint}ms`); // Load test const loadResult = await tester.runLoadTest(url, 5, 30); console.log(`Average Response Time: ${loadResult.averageResponseTime}ms`); console.log(`Requests/sec: ${loadResult.requestsPerSecond}`); // Report issues if (performanceResult.opportunities.length > 0) { console.log('Performance Opportunities:'); performanceResult.opportunities.slice(0, 3).forEach(opp => { console.log(`- ${opp.title} (Score: ${opp.score})`); }); } } } finally { await tester.close(); } }

# monitoring/rules/performance.yml groups: - name: application-performance rules: - alert: HighResponseTime expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 2 for: 5m labels: severity: warning annotations: summary: "High application response time" description: "95th percentile response time is {{ $value }}s for {{ $labels.service }}" - alert: HighErrorRate expr: rate(http_requests_total{status_code=~"5.."}[5m]) / rate(http_requests_total[5m]) > 0.05 for: 2m labels: severity: critical annotations: summary: "High error rate detected" description: "Error rate is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for {{ $labels.service }}" - alert: SlowDatabaseQueries expr: avg(query_duration_seconds) > 1 for: 3m labels: severity: warning annotations: summary: "Slow database queries detected" description: "Average query duration is {{ $value }}s" - alert: MemoryLeakDetected expr: increase(process_resident_memory_bytes[1h]) > 100000000 for: 15m labels: severity: critical annotations: summary: "Potential memory leak detected" description: "Memory usage increased by {{ $value | humanizeBytes }} in the last hour" - alert: HighCPUUsage expr: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total[5m]) > 0.8 for: 10m labels: severity: warning annotations: summary: "High CPU usage detected" description: "CPU usage is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for {{ $labels.service }}"

This guide provides comprehensive automated deployment strategies for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications using GitOps, container orchestration, blue-green deployments, and progressive delivery techniques.

Automated deployment ensures consistent, reliable, and efficient software delivery across environments. This guide covers containerization, Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and advanced deployment strategies for microservices and microfrontend architectures.

name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' cache: 'pnpm' cache-dependency-path: ${{ matrix.service }}/pnpm-lock.yaml - name: Install dependencies run: | cd ${{ matrix.service }} pnpm install --frozen-lockfile - name: Run tests run: | cd ${{ matrix.service }} pnpm run test pnpm run test:e2e - name: Upload coverage uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3 with: file: ${{ matrix.service }}/coverage/lcov.info flags: ${{ matrix.service }} build: needs: test runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' strategy: matrix: service: [api-gateway, user-service, product-service, frontend] outputs: image-tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }} image-digest: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }} steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup Docker Buildx uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3 - name: Log in to Container Registry uses: docker/login-action@v3 with: registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }} username: ${{ github.actor }} password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: Extract metadata id: meta uses: docker/metadata-action@v5 with: images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/${{ matrix.service }} tags: | type=ref,event=branch type=ref,event=pr type=sha,prefix={{branch}}- type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}} - name: Build and push Docker image id: build uses: docker/build-push-action@v5 with: context: ${{ matrix.service }} file: ${{ matrix.service }}/Dockerfile push: true tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }} labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }} cache-from: type=gha cache-to: type=gha,mode=max platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64 - name: Generate SBOM uses: anchore/sbom-action@v0 with: image: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }} format: spdx-json output-file: ${{ matrix.service }}-sbom.spdx.json - name: Upload SBOM uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3 with: name: ${{ matrix.service }}-sbom path: ${{ matrix.service }}-sbom.spdx.json security-scan: needs: build runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: service: [api-gateway, user-service, product-service, frontend] steps: - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master with: image-ref: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/${{ matrix.service }}:latest format: 'sarif' output: 'trivy-results.sarif' - name: Upload Trivy scan results uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2 with: sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif' deploy-staging: needs: [build, security-scan] runs-on: ubuntu-latest environment: staging if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' steps: - name: Commit and push changes run: | cd gitops git config user.name "github-actions[bot]" git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" git add . git commit -m "Update staging deployment to ${{ github.sha }}" git push deploy-production: needs: deploy-staging runs-on: ubuntu-latest environment: production if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' steps: - # scripts/blue-green-deploy.sh #!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail SERVICE_NAME=$1 NEW_VERSION=$2 NAMESPACE=${3:-default} echo "Starting blue-green deployment for $SERVICE_NAME:$NEW_VERSION" # Deploy green version kubectl apply -f - <<EOF apiVersion: apps/v1 kind: Deployment metadata: name: ${SERVICE_NAME}-green namespace: $NAMESPACE spec: replicas: 3 selector: matchLabels: app: $SERVICE_NAME version: green template: metadata: labels: app: $SERVICE_NAME version: green spec: containers: - name: $SERVICE_NAME image: $SERVICE_NAME:$NEW_VERSION ports: - containerPort: 3000 livenessProbe: httpGet: path: /health port: 3000 initialDelaySeconds: 30 readinessProbe: httpGet: path: /health/ready port: 3000 initialDelaySeconds: 5 EOF # Wait for green deployment to be ready echo "Waiting for green deployment to be ready..." kubectl rollout status deployment/${SERVICE_NAME}-green -n $NAMESPACE --timeout=300s # Run health checks echo "Running health checks on green deployment..." GREEN_POD=$(kubectl get pods -n $NAMESPACE -l app=$SERVICE_NAME,version=green -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') kubectl exec -n $NAMESPACE $GREEN_POD -- curl -f http://localhost:3000/health # Switch traffic to green echo "Switching traffic to green deployment..." kubectl patch service $SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"green"}}}' # Wait for traffic switch sleep 30 # Run post-deployment tests echo "Running post-deployment tests..." ./scripts/run-smoke-tests.sh $SERVICE_NAME $NAMESPACE if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "Deployment successful. Cleaning up blue deployment..." kubectl delete deployment ${SERVICE_NAME}-blue -n $NAMESPACE --ignore-not-found=true # Rename green to blue for next deployment kubectl patch deployment ${SERVICE_NAME}-green -n $NAMESPACE -p '{"metadata":{"name":"'${SERVICE_NAME}'-blue"}}' kubectl patch deployment ${SERVICE_NAME}-blue -n $NAMESPACE -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"matchLabels":{"version":"blue"}},"template":{"metadata":{"labels":{"version":"blue"}}}}}' kubectl patch service $SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"blue"}}}' echo "Blue-green deployment completed successfully!" else echo "Deployment failed. Rolling back to blue deployment..." kubectl patch service $SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"blue"}}}' kubectl delete deployment ${SERVICE_NAME}-green -n $NAMESPACE exit 1 fi

#!/bin/bash # scripts/auto-rollback.sh set -euo pipefail SERVICE_NAME=$1 NAMESPACE=${2:-default} THRESHOLD_ERROR_RATE=${3:-5} # 5% error rate threshold THRESHOLD_RESPONSE_TIME=${4:-1000} # 1000ms response time threshold echo "Monitoring $SERVICE_NAME for automatic rollback conditions..." # Function to get current error rate get_error_rate() { kubectl exec -n monitoring deployment/prometheus -- \ promtool query instant \ 'rate(http_requests_total{service="'$SERVICE_NAME'",status=~"5.."}[5m]) / rate(http_requests_total{service="'$SERVICE_NAME'"}[5m]) * 100' \ | grep -o '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*' || echo "0" } # Function to get current response time get_response_time() { kubectl exec -n monitoring deployment/prometheus -- \ promtool query instant \ 'histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="'$SERVICE_NAME'"}[5m])) * 1000' \ | grep -o '[0-9]*\.[0-9]*' || echo "0" } # Function to perform rollback perform_rollback() { echo "ALERT: Performing automatic rollback for $SERVICE_NAME" # Get previous revision PREVIOUS_REVISION=$(kubectl rollout history deployment/$SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE | tail -2 | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') # Rollback to previous revision kubectl rollout undo deployment/$SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE --to-revision=$PREVIOUS_REVISION # Wait for rollback to complete kubectl rollout status deployment/$SERVICE_NAME -n $NAMESPACE --timeout=300s # Send notification curl -X POST $SLACK_WEBHOOK -H 'Content-type: application/json' \ --data '{"text":"🚨 Automatic rollback performed for '$SERVICE_NAME' due to high error rate or response time"}' echo "Rollback completed for $SERVICE_NAME" } # Monitor for 10 minutes END_TIME=$((SECONDS + 600)) while [ $SECONDS -lt $END_TIME ]; do ERROR_RATE=$(get_error_rate) RESPONSE_TIME=$(get_response_time) echo "Current metrics - Error Rate: ${ERROR_RATE}%, Response Time: ${RESPONSE_TIME}ms" # Check if rollback conditions are met if (( $(echo "$ERROR_RATE > $THRESHOLD_ERROR_RATE" | bc -l) )) || \ (( $(echo "$RESPONSE_TIME > $THRESHOLD_RESPONSE_TIME" | bc -l) )); then perform_rollback exit 0 fi sleep 30 done echo "Monitoring completed. No rollback required for $SERVICE_NAME"

// src/health/health.controller.ts import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common'; import { HealthCheckService, HealthCheck, TypeOrmHealthIndicator, MemoryHealthIndicator, DiskHealthIndicator, } from '@nestjs/terminus'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { RedisHealthIndicator } from './redis-health.indicator'; import { ExternalServiceHealthIndicator } from './external-service-health.indicator'; @Controller('health') export class HealthController { constructor( private health: HealthCheckService, private db: TypeOrmHealthIndicator, private memory: MemoryHealthIndicator, private disk: DiskHealthIndicator, private redis: RedisHealthIndicator, private externalService: ExternalServiceHealthIndicator, private configService: ConfigService, ) {} @Get() @HealthCheck() check() { return this.health.check([ // Database health () => this.db.pingCheck('database'), // Redis health () => this.redis.pingCheck('redis'), // Memory health (less than 150MB) () => this.memory.checkHeap('memory_heap', 150 * 1024 * 1024), () => this.memory.checkRSS('memory_rss', 150 * 1024 * 1024), // Disk health (less than 80% usage) () => this.disk.checkStorage('storage', { threshold: 0.8, path: '/' }), // External service health () => this.externalService.pingCheck('external_api', { url: this.configService.get('EXTERNAL_API_URL'), timeout: 5000, }), ]); } @Get('ready') @HealthCheck() readiness() { return this.health.check([ () => this.db.pingCheck('database'), () => this.redis.pingCheck('redis'), ]); } @Get('live') @HealthCheck() liveness() { return this.health.check([ () => this.memory.checkHeap('memory_heap', 200 * 1024 * 1024), ]); } }

This guide provides comprehensive configuration management strategies for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications, covering environment-specific configurations, secrets management, feature flags, and dynamic configuration updates.

Configuration management ensures consistent, secure, and maintainable application settings across different environments. This guide covers centralized configuration, environment isolation, secrets handling, and configuration validation for microservices and microfrontend architectures.

// src/config/app.config.ts import { registerAs } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Transform } from 'class-transformer'; import { IsString, IsNumber, IsBoolean, IsEnum, ValidateNested } from 'class-validator'; export enum Environment { Development = 'development', Test = 'test', Staging = 'staging', Production = 'production', } export class CorsConfig { @IsString({ each: true }) origins: string[]; @IsBoolean() credentials: boolean; @IsString({ each: true }) methods: string[]; } export class AppConfiguration { @IsEnum(Environment) nodeEnv: Environment; @IsNumber() @Transform(({ value }) => parseInt(value, 10)) port: number; @IsString() appName: string; @IsString() appVersion: string; @ValidateNested() cors: CorsConfig; @IsBoolean() @Transform(({ value }) => value === 'true') metricsEnabled: boolean; @IsString() logLevel: string; @IsString() timeZone: string; } export const AppConfig = registerAs('app', (): AppConfiguration => ({ nodeEnv: process.env.NODE_ENV as Environment, port: parseInt(process.env.PORT || '3000', 10), appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'microservice', appVersion: process.env.APP_VERSION || '1.0.0', cors: { origins: process.env.CORS_ORIGINS?.split(',') || ['http://localhost:3000'], credentials: process.env.CORS_CREDENTIALS === 'true', methods: process.env.CORS_METHODS?.split(',') || ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE'], }, metricsEnabled: process.env.METRICS_ENABLED !== 'false', logLevel: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info', timeZone: process.env.TZ || 'UTC', }));

// src/config/dynamic-config.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { EventEmitter2 } from '@nestjs/event-emitter'; import { Interval } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import axios from 'axios'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; export interface ConfigChangeEvent { key: string; oldValue: any; newValue: any; timestamp: Date; } @Injectable() export class DynamicConfigService implements OnModuleInit { private readonly logger = new Logger(DynamicConfigService.name); private configCache = new Map<string, any>(); private lastUpdateTime = new Date(); constructor( private readonly configService: ConfigService, private readonly eventEmitter: EventEmitter2, ) {} async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> { await this.loadInitialConfig(); this.startConfigRefresh(); } private async loadInitialConfig(): Promise<void> { try { // Load from environment variables this.loadEnvironmentConfig(); // Load from remote config service if available const remoteConfigUrl = this.configService.get('REMOTE_CONFIG_URL'); if (remoteConfigUrl) { await this.loadRemoteConfig(remoteConfigUrl); } // Load from local config files await this.loadFileConfig(); this.logger.log('Initial configuration loaded successfully'); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to load initial configuration', error); } } private loadEnvironmentConfig(): void { const envVars = process.env; for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(envVars)) { if (key.startsWith('APP_CONFIG_')) { const configKey = key.replace('APP_CONFIG_', '').toLowerCase(); this.setConfig(configKey, this.parseConfigValue(value)); } } } private async loadRemoteConfig(url: string): Promise<void> { try { const response = await axios.get(url, { timeout: 5000, headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.configService.get('REMOTE_CONFIG_TOKEN')}`, }, }); if (response.data && typeof response.data === 'object') { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(response.data)) { this.setConfig(key, value); } this.logger.log('Remote configuration loaded successfully'); } } catch (error) { this.logger.warn('Failed to load remote configuration', error.message); } } private async loadFileConfig(): Promise<void> { try { const configDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'config'); const environment = this.configService.get('NODE_ENV', 'development'); const configFile = path.join(configDir, `${environment}.json`); try { const configContent = await fs.readFile(configFile, 'utf-8'); const config = JSON.parse(configContent); for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(config)) { this.setConfig(key, value); } this.logger.log(`File configuration loaded from ${configFile}`); } catch (fileError) { this.logger.debug(`No configuration file found at ${configFile}`); } } catch (error) { this.logger.warn('Failed to load file configuration', error); } } @Interval(60000) // Refresh every minute private async startConfigRefresh(): Promise<void> { try { const remoteConfigUrl = this.configService.get('REMOTE_CONFIG_URL'); if (remoteConfigUrl) { await this.refreshRemoteConfig(remoteConfigUrl); } } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to refresh configuration', error); } } private async refreshRemoteConfig(url: string): Promise<void> { try { const response = await axios.get(url, { timeout: 5000, headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.configService.get('REMOTE_CONFIG_TOKEN')}`, 'If-Modified-Since': this.lastUpdateTime.toISOString(), }, }); if (response.status === 200 && response.data) { const changes: ConfigChangeEvent[] = []; for (const [key, newValue] of Object.entries(response.data)) { const oldValue = this.configCache.get(key); if (JSON.stringify(oldValue) !== JSON.stringify(newValue)) { changes.push({ key, oldValue, newValue, timestamp: new Date(), }); this.setConfig(key, newValue); } } if (changes.length > 0) { this.logger.log(`Configuration updated: ${changes.length} changes`); for (const change of changes) { this.eventEmitter.emit('config.changed', change); } } this.lastUpdateTime = new Date(); } } catch (error) { if (error.response?.status !== 304) { // 304 = Not Modified this.logger.warn('Failed to refresh remote configuration', error.message); } } } private setConfig(key: string, value: any): void { this.configCache.set(key, value); } get<T = any>(key: string, defaultValue?: T): T { return this.configCache.get(key) ?? defaultValue; } has(key: string): boolean { return this.configCache.has(key); } getAll(): Record<string, any> { return Object.fromEntries(this.configCache.entries()); } private parseConfigValue(value: string | undefined): any { if (!value) return undefined; // Try to parse as JSON try { return JSON.parse(value); } catch { // Return as string if not valid JSON return value; } } async reloadConfig(): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Manually reloading configuration...'); await this.loadInitialConfig(); } // Configuration validation validateConfig<T>(schema: any, config: T): { isValid: boolean; errors: string[] } { const { error } = schema.validate(config, { abortEarly: false }); if (error) { return { isValid: false, errors: error.details.map((detail: any) => detail.message), }; } return { isValid: true, errors: [] }; } }

// lib/config/environment.ts import { z } from 'zod'; // Client-side configuration schema (publicly available) const clientConfigSchema = z.object({ APP_NAME: z.string().default('Microservice App'), APP_VERSION: z.string().default('1.0.0'), API_BASE_URL: z.string().url(), ENVIRONMENT: z.enum(['development', 'staging', 'production']).default('development'), FEATURE_FLAGS: z.object({ enableNewUI: z.boolean().default(false), enableAnalytics: z.boolean().default(true), enableExperimentalFeatures: z.boolean().default(false), }), SENTRY_DSN: z.string().optional(), GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID: z.string().optional(), }); // Server-side configuration schema (includes secrets) const serverConfigSchema = clientConfigSchema.extend({ DATABASE_URL: z.string(), REDIS_URL: z.string(), JWT_SECRET: z.string(), API_SECRET_KEY: z.string(), NEXTAUTH_SECRET: z.string(), NEXTAUTH_URL: z.string().url(), }); export type ClientConfig = z.infer<typeof clientConfigSchema>; export type ServerConfig = z.infer<typeof serverConfigSchema>; class ConfigManager { private clientConfig: ClientConfig | null = null; private serverConfig: ServerConfig | null = null; getClientConfig(): ClientConfig { if (!this.clientConfig) { this.clientConfig = this.loadClientConfig(); } return this.clientConfig; } getServerConfig(): ServerConfig { if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { throw new Error('Server configuration cannot be accessed on the client side'); } if (!this.serverConfig) { this.serverConfig = this.loadServerConfig(); } return this.serverConfig; } private loadClientConfig(): ClientConfig { const config = { APP_NAME: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME, APP_VERSION: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, API_BASE_URL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL!, ENVIRONMENT: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENVIRONMENT, FEATURE_FLAGS: { enableNewUI: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_NEW_UI === 'true', enableAnalytics: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_ANALYTICS !== 'false', enableExperimentalFeatures: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FEATURE_EXPERIMENTAL === 'true', }, SENTRY_DSN: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN, GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID, }; const result = clientConfigSchema.safeParse(config); if (!result.success) { console.error('Client configuration validation failed:', result.error.format()); throw new Error('Invalid client configuration'); } return result.data; } private loadServerConfig(): ServerConfig { const config = { ...this.getClientConfig(), DATABASE_URL: process.env.DATABASE_URL!, REDIS_URL: process.env.REDIS_URL!, JWT_SECRET: process.env.JWT_SECRET!, API_SECRET_KEY: process.env.API_SECRET_KEY!, NEXTAUTH_SECRET: process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET!, NEXTAUTH_URL: process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL!, }; const result = serverConfigSchema.safeParse(config); if (!result.success) { console.error('Server configuration validation failed:', result.error.format()); throw new Error('Invalid server configuration'); } return result.data; } // Reload configuration (useful for hot reloading in development) reload(): void { this.clientConfig = null; this.serverConfig = null; } // Get specific configuration value with type safety get<K extends keyof ClientConfig>(key: K): ClientConfig[K]; get<K extends keyof ServerConfig>(key: K, serverOnly: true): ServerConfig[K]; get<K extends keyof ClientConfig | keyof ServerConfig>( key: K, serverOnly = false ): any { if (serverOnly) { return this.getServerConfig()[key as keyof ServerConfig]; } return this.getClientConfig()[key as keyof ClientConfig]; } } export const configManager = new ConfigManager(); // Convenience functions export const getClientConfig = () => configManager.getClientConfig(); export const getServerConfig = () => configManager.getServerConfig(); // Type-safe configuration getters export const getConfig = <K extends keyof ClientConfig>(key: K) => configManager.get(key); export const getServerOnlyConfig = <K extends keyof ServerConfig>(key: K) => configManager.get(key, true);

// components/providers/config-provider.tsx import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { ClientConfig, getClientConfig } from '../../lib/config/environment'; interface ConfigContextType { config: ClientConfig; isLoading: boolean; error: Error | null; refresh: () => Promise<void>; } const ConfigContext = createContext<ConfigContextType | undefined>(undefined); export const useConfig = () => { const context = useContext(ConfigContext); if (!context) { throw new Error('useConfig must be used within ConfigProvider'); } return context; }; interface ConfigProviderProps { children: React.ReactNode; initialConfig?: ClientConfig; } export const ConfigProvider: React.FC<ConfigProviderProps> = ({ children, initialConfig }) => { const [config, setConfig] = useState<ClientConfig>(() => initialConfig || getClientConfig() ); const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null); const refresh = async () => { setIsLoading(true); setError(null); try { // Fetch runtime configuration from API const response = await fetch('/api/config'); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Failed to fetch config: ${response.statusText}`); } const runtimeConfig = await response.json(); // Merge with build-time configuration const mergedConfig = { ...config, ...runtimeConfig, FEATURE_FLAGS: { ...config.FEATURE_FLAGS, ...runtimeConfig.FEATURE_FLAGS, }, }; setConfig(mergedConfig); } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error('Unknown error')); console.error('Failed to refresh configuration:', err); } finally { setIsLoading(false); } }; useEffect(() => { // Refresh configuration periodically const interval = setInterval(() => { refresh(); }, 5 * 60 * 1000); // Every 5 minutes return () => clearInterval(interval); }, []); const value: ConfigContextType = { config, isLoading, error, refresh, }; return ( <ConfigContext.Provider value={value}> {children} </ConfigContext.Provider> ); };

// src/config/vault.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import axios, { AxiosInstance } from 'axios'; export interface VaultSecret { data: Record<string, any>; metadata: { created_time: string; version: number; }; } @Injectable() export class VaultService implements OnModuleInit { private readonly logger = new Logger(VaultService.name); private client: AxiosInstance; private token: string | null = null; private secrets = new Map<string, any>(); constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) { const vaultUrl = this.configService.get('VAULT_URL'); this.client = axios.create({ baseURL: vaultUrl, timeout: 10000, }); } async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> { try { await this.authenticate(); await this.loadSecrets(); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to initialize Vault service', error); } } private async authenticate(): Promise<void> { const authMethod = this.configService.get('VAULT_AUTH_METHOD', 'token'); switch (authMethod) { case 'token': await this.authenticateWithToken(); break; case 'kubernetes': await this.authenticateWithKubernetes(); break; case 'app-role': await this.authenticateWithAppRole(); break; default: throw new Error(`Unsupported Vault auth method: ${authMethod}`); } } private async authenticateWithToken(): Promise<void> { this.token = this.configService.get('VAULT_TOKEN'); if (!this.token) { throw new Error('Vault token not provided'); } this.client.defaults.headers.common['X-Vault-Token'] = this.token; // Verify token const response = await this.client.get('/v1/auth/token/lookup-self'); this.logger.log('Successfully authenticated with Vault using token'); } private async authenticateWithKubernetes(): Promise<void> { const jwt = await this.getServiceAccountToken(); const role = this.configService.get('VAULT_K8S_ROLE'); const response = await this.client.post('/v1/auth/kubernetes/login', { role, jwt, }); this.token = response.data.auth.client_token; this.client.defaults.headers.common['X-Vault-Token'] = this.token; this.logger.log('Successfully authenticated with Vault using Kubernetes auth'); } private async authenticateWithAppRole(): Promise<void> { const roleId = this.configService.get('VAULT_ROLE_ID'); const secretId = this.configService.get('VAULT_SECRET_ID'); const response = await this.client.post('/v1/auth/approle/login', { role_id: roleId, secret_id: secretId, }); this.token = response.data.auth.client_token; this.client.defaults.headers.common['X-Vault-Token'] = this.token; this.logger.log('Successfully authenticated with Vault using AppRole'); } private async getServiceAccountToken(): Promise<string> { const fs = await import('fs/promises'); const tokenPath = '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token'; return fs.readFile(tokenPath, 'utf8'); } private async loadSecrets(): Promise<void> { const secretPaths = this.configService.get<string[]>('VAULT_SECRET_PATHS', []); for (const path of secretPaths) { try { const secret = await this.getSecret(path); this.secrets.set(path, secret); this.logger.log(`Loaded secret from ${path}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to load secret from ${path}`, error); } } } async getSecret(path: string): Promise<VaultSecret> { try { const response = await this.client.get(`/v1/secret/data/${path}`); return response.data.data; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to get secret from ${path}`, error); throw error; } } async setSecret(path: string, data: Record<string, any>): Promise<void> { try { await this.client.post(`/v1/secret/data/${path}`, { data }); this.secrets.set(path, { data }); this.logger.log(`Set secret at ${path}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to set secret at ${path}`, error); throw error; } } getCachedSecret(path: string): any { return this.secrets.get(path)?.data; } async refreshSecrets(): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Refreshing all secrets...'); await this.loadSecrets(); } // Periodic secret refresh async startSecretRefresh(intervalMs = 300000): Promise<void> { // 5 minutes setInterval(async () => { try { await this.refreshSecrets(); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to refresh secrets', error); // src/migration/migration.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common'; import { DataSource } from 'typeorm'; import { InjectDataSource } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; export interface MigrationInfo { id: number; timestamp: number; name: string; executedAt: Date; executionTime: number; } export interface MigrationPlan { pending: MigrationInfo[]; executed: MigrationInfo[]; canRollback: boolean; rollbackTarget?: MigrationInfo; } @Injectable() export class MigrationService implements OnModuleInit { private readonly logger = new Logger(MigrationService.name); constructor( @InjectDataSource() private readonly dataSource: DataSource, private readonly configService: ConfigService, ) {} async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> { if (this.configService.get('AUTO_RUN_MIGRATIONS') === 'true') { await this.runPendingMigrations(); } } async getMigrationPlan(): Promise<MigrationPlan> { const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner(); try { // Get executed migrations const executedMigrations = await queryRunner.query(` SELECT id, timestamp, name, "executedAt", "executionTime" FROM migrations_history ORDER BY timestamp ASC `); // Get all available migrations const allMigrations = this.dataSource.migrations.map(migration => ({ id: 0, // Will be set when executed timestamp: parseInt(migration.name.split('-')[0]), name: migration.name, executedAt: null, executionTime: 0, })); // Determine pending migrations const executedTimestamps = new Set(executedMigrations.map(m => m.timestamp)); const pendingMigrations = allMigrations.filter( m => !executedTimestamps.has(m.timestamp) ); return { pending: pendingMigrations, executed: executedMigrations, canRollback: executedMigrations.length > 0, rollbackTarget: executedMigrations[executedMigrations.length - 1], }; } finally { await queryRunner.release(); } } async runPendingMigrations(dryRun = false): Promise<{ success: boolean; migrationsRun: string[]; errors: string[]; executionTime: number; }> { const startTime = Date.now(); const migrationsRun: string[] = []; const errors: string[] = []; try { const plan = await this.getMigrationPlan(); if (plan.pending.length === 0) { this.logger.log('No pending migrations to run'); return { success: true, migrationsRun: [], errors: [], executionTime: Date.now() - startTime, }; } this.logger.log(`Found ${plan.pending.length} pending migrations`); if (dryRun) { this.logger.log('DRY RUN: Would execute the following migrations:'); plan.pending.forEach(migration => { this.logger.log(`- ${migration.name}`); }); return { success: true, migrationsRun: plan.pending.map(m => m.name), errors: [], executionTime: Date.now() - startTime, }; } // Create backup before migration await this.createBackup(`pre-migration-${Date.now()}`); // Run migrations await this.dataSource.runMigrations({ transaction: 'each', // Run each migration in its own transaction }); // Validate migrations const postPlan = await this.getMigrationPlan(); if (postPlan.pending.length > 0) { throw new Error(`${postPlan.pending.length} migrations still pending after execution`); } plan.pending.forEach(migration => { migrationsRun.push(migration.name); this.logger.log(`Successfully executed migration: ${migration.name}`); }); return { success: true, migrationsRun, errors, executionTime: Date.now() - startTime, }; } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Migration failed', error); errors.push(error.message); // Attempt to rollback on failure try { await this.rollbackLastMigration(); this.logger.log('Rollback completed successfully'); } catch (rollbackError) { this.logger.error('Rollback failed', rollbackError); errors.push(`Rollback failed: ${rollbackError.message}`); } return { success: false, migrationsRun, errors, executionTime: Date.now() - startTime, }; } } async rollbackLastMigration(): Promise<void> { try { await this.dataSource.undoLastMigration({ transaction: 'each', }); this.logger.log('Last migration rolled back successfully'); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to rollback last migration', error); throw error; } } async rollbackToMigration(targetMigrationName: string): Promise<void> { const plan = await this.getMigrationPlan(); const targetMigration = plan.executed.find(m => m.name === targetMigrationName); if (!targetMigration) { throw new Error(`Migration ${targetMigrationName} not found in executed migrations`); } // Create backup before rollback await this.createBackup(`pre-rollback-${Date.now()}`); // Rollback migrations one by one until target const migrationsToRollback = plan.executed .filter(m => m.timestamp > targetMigration.timestamp) .reverse(); // Rollback in reverse order for (const migration of migrationsToRollback) { try { await this.dataSource.undoLastMigration({ transaction: 'each', }); this.logger.log(`Rolled back migration: ${migration.name}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to rollback migration: ${migration.name}`, error); throw error; } } } async createBackup(backupName: string): Promise<void> { const dbConfig = { host: this.configService.get('DATABASE_HOST'), port: this.configService.get('DATABASE_PORT'), database: this.configService.get('DATABASE_NAME'), username: this.configService.get('DATABASE_USERNAME'), password: this.configService.get('DATABASE_PASSWORD'), }; const backupPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'backups', `${backupName}.sql`); // Ensure backup directory exists await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(backupPath), { recursive: true }); // Create pg_dump command const pgDumpCommand = [ 'pg_dump', `--host=${dbConfig.host}`, `--port=${dbConfig.port}`, `--username=${dbConfig.username}`, '--no-password', '--verbose', '--clean', '--if-exists', '--create', '--format=custom', `--file=${backupPath}`, dbConfig.database, ].join(' '); // Set PGPASSWORD environment variable process.env.PGPASSWORD = dbConfig.password; try { const { exec } = await import('child_process'); const { promisify } = await import('util'); const execAsync = promisify(exec); await execAsync(pgDumpCommand); this.logger.log(`Database backup created: ${backupPath}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to create database backup', error); throw error; } finally { delete process.env.PGPASSWORD; } } async validateMigration(migrationName: string): Promise<{ isValid: boolean; issues: string[]; }> { const issues: string[] = []; try { // Read migration file const migrationPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src/migrations', `${migrationName}.ts`); const migrationContent = await fs.readFile(migrationPath, 'utf-8'); // Check for common migration issues const commonIssues = [ { pattern: /DROP TABLE/gi, message: 'DROP TABLE operations can cause data loss', }, { pattern: /ALTER TABLE.*DROP COLUMN/gi, message: 'DROP COLUMN operations can cause data loss', }, { pattern: /ALTER TABLE.*RENAME COLUMN/gi, message: 'RENAME COLUMN may require application changes', }, { pattern: /CREATE UNIQUE INDEX/gi, message: 'Creating unique indexes on existing data may fail', }, { pattern: /ALTER TABLE.*ADD CONSTRAINT.*NOT NULL/gi, message: 'Adding NOT NULL constraints to existing columns may fail', }, ]; commonIssues.forEach(({ pattern, message }) => { if (pattern.test(migrationContent)) { issues.push(message); } }); // Check for transaction handling if (!migrationContent.includes('transaction')) { issues.push('Migration should be wrapped in a transaction'); } // Check for rollback method if (!migrationContent.includes('down(')) { issues.push('Migration should include a down() method for rollback'); } return { isValid: issues.length === 0, issues, }; } catch (error) { return { isValid: false, issues: [`Failed to validate migration: ${error.message}`], }; } } async generateMigrationReport(): Promise<{ totalMigrations: number; executedMigrations: number; pendingMigrations: number; lastMigration: MigrationInfo | null; migrationHistory: MigrationInfo[]; averageExecutionTime: number; }> { const plan = await this.getMigrationPlan(); const averageExecutionTime = plan.executed.length > 0 ? plan.executed.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.executionTime, 0) / plan.executed.length : 0; return { totalMigrations: plan.executed.length + plan.pending.length, executedMigrations: plan.executed.length, pendingMigrations: plan.pending.length, lastMigration: plan.executed[plan.executed.length - 1] || null, migrationHistory: plan.executed, averageExecutionTime, }; } }

public async up(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { // Step 1: Add column with default value await queryRunner.addColumn('users', new Column({ name: 'status', type: 'varchar', length: '20', default: "'active'", isNullable: false, })); // Step 2: Update existing records (if needed) await queryRunner.query(` UPDATE users SET status = 'active' WHERE status IS NULL OR status = '' `); // Step 3: Add index for performance await queryRunner.createIndex('users', new Index('IDX_users_status', ['status'])); } public async down(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { await queryRunner.dropIndex('users', 'IDX_users_status'); await queryRunner.dropColumn('users', 'status'); } } // Example: Zero-downtime table restructuring export class RestructureProductsTable1641081600000 implements MigrationInterface { name = 'RestructureProductsTable1641081600000'; public async up(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { // Create new table structure await queryRunner.createTable(new Table({ name: 'products_new', columns: [ { name: 'id', type: 'uuid', isPrimary: true, generationStrategy: 'uuid', default: 'gen_random_uuid()', }, { name: 'name', type: 'varchar', length: '255', isNullable: false, }, { name: 'description', type: 'text', isNullable: true, }, { name: 'price', type: 'decimal', precision: 10, scale: 2, isNullable: false, }, { name: 'category_id', type: 'uuid', isNullable: false, }, { name: 'created_at', type: 'timestamp', default: 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP', }, { name: 'updated_at', type: 'timestamp', default: 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP', }, ], })); // Copy data from old table to new table await queryRunner.query(` INSERT INTO products_new (id, name, description, price, category_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, name, description, price::decimal(10,2), category_id, created_at, updated_at FROM products `); // Create indexes on new table await queryRunner.createIndex('products_new', new Index('IDX_products_new_category', ['category_id'])); await queryRunner.createIndex('products_new', new Index('IDX_products_new_name', ['name'])); // Atomic table swap (requires coordination with application deployment) await queryRunner.query('BEGIN'); try { await queryRunner.renameTable('products', 'products_old'); await queryRunner.renameTable('products_new', 'products'); await queryRunner.query('COMMIT'); } catch (error) { await queryRunner.query('ROLLBACK'); throw error; } } public async down(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { // Rollback table swap await queryRunner.query('BEGIN'); try { await queryRunner.renameTable('products', 'products_new'); await queryRunner.renameTable('products_old', 'products'); await queryRunner.query('COMMIT'); } catch (error) { await queryRunner.query('ROLLBACK'); throw error; } // Clean up await queryRunner.dropTable('products_new'); } } // Example: Data migration with batch processing export class MigrateUserPreferences1641168000000 implements MigrationInterface { name = 'MigrateUserPreferences1641168000000'; public async up(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { // Create new preferences table await queryRunner.createTable(new Table({ name: 'user_preferences', columns: [ { name: 'id', type: 'uuid', isPrimary: true, generationStrategy: 'uuid', default: 'gen_random_uuid()', }, { name: 'user_id', type: 'uuid', isNullable: false, }, { name: 'preference_key', type: 'varchar', length: '100', isNullable: false, }, { name: 'preference_value', type: 'jsonb', isNullable: true, }, { name: 'created_at', type: 'timestamp', default: 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP', }, ], })); // Migrate data in batches to avoid memory issues const batchSize = 1000; let offset = 0; let hasMoreData = true; while (hasMoreData) { const users = await queryRunner.query(` SELECT id, settings FROM users WHERE settings IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 `, [batchSize, offset]); if (users.length === 0) { hasMoreData = false; break; } // Transform and insert preferences for (const user of users) { const settings = JSON.parse(user.settings || '{}'); for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(settings)) { await queryRunner.query(` INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, preference_key, preference_value) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) `, [user.id, key, JSON.stringify(value)]); } } offset += batchSize; // Log progress console.log(`Migrated preferences for ${offset} users`); } // Create indexes await queryRunner.createIndex('user_preferences', new Index('IDX_user_preferences_user_key', ['user_id', 'preference_key'], { isUnique: true }) ); } public async down(queryRunner: QueryRunner): Promise<void> { await queryRunner.dropTable('user_preferences'); } }

#!/bin/bash # scripts/migrate-database.sh set -euo pipefail ENVIRONMENT=${1:-development} DRY_RUN=${2:-false} BACKUP_ENABLED=${3:-true} echo "Starting database migration for environment: $ENVIRONMENT" # Load environment-specific configuration case $ENVIRONMENT in "development") DB_HOST=$DEV_DB_HOST DB_NAME=$DEV_DB_NAME DB_USER=$DEV_DB_USER DB_PASS=$DEV_DB_PASS ;; "staging") DB_HOST=$STAGING_DB_HOST DB_NAME=$STAGING_DB_NAME DB_USER=$STAGING_DB_USER DB_PASS=$STAGING_DB_PASS ;; "production") DB_HOST=$PROD_DB_HOST DB_NAME=$PROD_DB_NAME DB_USER=$PROD_DB_USER DB_PASS=$PROD_DB_PASS ;; *) echo "Unknown environment: $ENVIRONMENT" exit 1 ;; esac # Set database connection export DATABASE_HOST=$DB_HOST export DATABASE_NAME=$DB_NAME export DATABASE_USERNAME=$DB_USER export DATABASE_PASSWORD=$DB_PASS # Function to run migration with monitoring run_migration() { local start_time=$(date +%s) echo "Checking migration plan..." npm run migration:plan if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "true" ]; then echo "Running dry-run migration..." npm run migration:run -- --dry-run return 0 fi if [ "$BACKUP_ENABLED" = "true" ]; then echo "Creating pre-migration backup..." npm run migration:backup fi echo "Running database migrations..." npm run migration:run local end_time=$(date +%s) local duration=$((end_time - start_time)) echo "Migration completed in ${duration} seconds" # Validate migration echo "Validating migration..." npm run migration:validate # Generate migration report npm run migration:report > "migration-report-${ENVIRONMENT}-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).json" } # Function to handle migration failure handle_failure() { echo "Migration failed. Checking if rollback is needed..." if [ "$ENVIRONMENT" = "production" ]; then echo "Production migration failed. Manual intervention required." echo "Please check logs and consider manual rollback." exit 1 else echo "Attempting automatic rollback..." npm run migration:rollback exit 1 fi } # Trap errors and handle failure trap handle_failure ERR # Pre-migration checks echo "Running pre-migration checks..." # Check database connectivity npm run migration:check-connection || { echo "Database connection failed" exit 1 } # Check migration files npm run migration:validate-files || { echo "Migration file validation failed" exit 1 } # Check for pending migrations PENDING_MIGRATIONS=$(npm run migration:pending --silent | wc -l) if [ "$PENDING_MIGRATIONS" -eq 0 ]; then echo "No pending migrations found" exit 0 fi echo "Found $PENDING_MIGRATIONS pending migrations" # Production-specific checks if [ "$ENVIRONMENT" = "production" ]; then echo "Production environment detected. Running additional checks..." # Check for destructive operations npm run migration:check-destructive || { echo "Destructive operations detected in migrations" echo "Please review migrations manually" exit 1 } # Require explicit confirmation for production if [ -z "${MIGRATION_CONFIRMED:-}" ]; then echo "Production migration requires explicit confirmation" echo "Set MIGRATION_CONFIRMED=true to proceed" exit 1 fi fi # Run migration run_migration echo "Migration pipeline completed successfully"

// src/migration/migration-metrics.service.ts import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'; import { PrometheusService } from '../monitoring/prometheus.service'; import { Counter, Histogram, Gauge } from 'prom-client'; @Injectable() export class MigrationMetricsService { private readonly migrationCounter: Counter<string>; private readonly migrationDuration: Histogram<string>; private readonly pendingMigrations: Gauge<string>; private readonly migrationErrors: Counter<string>; constructor(private readonly prometheusService: PrometheusService) { this.migrationCounter = new Counter({ name: 'database_migrations_total', help: 'Total number of database migrations executed', labelNames: ['status', 'migration_name'], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.migrationDuration = new Histogram({ name: 'database_migration_duration_seconds', help: 'Duration of database migration execution', labelNames: ['migration_name'], buckets: [1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 300, 600], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.pendingMigrations = new Gauge({ name: 'database_pending_migrations', help: 'Number of pending database migrations', registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.migrationErrors = new Counter({ name: 'database_migration_errors_total', help: 'Total number of database migration errors', labelNames: ['migration_name', 'error_type'], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); } recordMigrationSuccess(migrationName: string, duration: number): void { this.migrationCounter.inc({ status: 'success', migration_name: migrationName }); this.migrationDuration.observe({ migration_name: migrationName }, duration); } recordMigrationFailure(migrationName: string, errorType: string): void { this.migrationCounter.inc({ status: 'failure', migration_name: migrationName }); this.migrationErrors.inc({ migration_name: migrationName, error_type: errorType }); } updatePendingMigrations(count: number): void { this.pendingMigrations.set(count); } }

// scripts/deploy.ts import { execSync } from 'child_process'; import * as fs from 'fs'; import * as yaml from 'js-yaml'; interface DeploymentConfig { environment: string; namespace: string; imageTag: string; replicas: number; resources: { requests: { cpu: string; memory: string }; limits: { cpu: string; memory: string }; }; } class DeploymentOrchestrator { private config: DeploymentConfig; constructor(environment: string) { this.config = this.loadConfig(environment); } async deploy(): Promise<void> { console.log(`Starting deployment to ${this.config.environment}`); try { // Pre-deployment checks await this.preDeploymentChecks(); // Build and push image await this.buildAndPushImage(); // Deploy to Kubernetes await this.deployToKubernetes(); // Post-deployment verification await this.postDeploymentVerification(); console.log('Deployment completed successfully'); } catch (error) { console.error('Deployment failed:', error); await this.rollback(); throw error; } } private loadConfig(environment: string): DeploymentConfig { const configPath = `./deploy/config/${environment}.json`; return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8')); } private async preDeploymentChecks(): Promise<void> { console.log('Running pre-deployment checks...'); // Check cluster connectivity try { execSync('kubectl cluster-info', { stdio: 'pipe' }); } catch (error) { throw new Error('Cannot connect to Kubernetes cluster'); } // Check namespace exists try { execSync(`kubectl get namespace ${this.config.namespace}`, { stdio: 'pipe' }); } catch (error) { console.log(`Creating namespace ${this.config.namespace}`); execSync(`kubectl create namespace ${this.config.namespace}`); } // Validate configuration this.validateConfiguration(); console.log('Pre-deployment checks completed'); } private validateConfiguration(): void { const requiredFields = ['environment', 'namespace', 'imageTag', 'replicas']; for (const field of requiredFields) { if (!this.config[field]) { throw new Error(`Missing required configuration: ${field}`); } } if (this.config.replicas < 1) { throw new Error('Replicas must be at least 1'); } } private async buildAndPushImage(): Promise<void> { console.log('Building and pushing Docker image...'); const imageName = `myregistry/user-service:${this.config.imageTag}`; // Build image execSync(`docker build -t ${imageName} .`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); // Security scan try { execSync(`docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock aquasec/trivy image ${imageName}`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (error) { console.warn('Security scan failed, but continuing deployment'); } // Push image execSync(`docker push ${imageName}`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Image built and pushed successfully'); } private async deployToKubernetes(): Promise<void> { console.log('Deploying to Kubernetes...'); // Generate deployment manifest const manifest = this.generateDeploymentManifest(); fs.writeFileSync('./deploy/generated-manifest.yaml', manifest); // Apply manifest execSync(`kubectl apply -f ./deploy/generated-manifest.yaml`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); // Wait for rollout to complete execSync(`kubectl rollout status deployment/user-service -n ${this.config.namespace} --timeout=600s`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Kubernetes deployment completed'); } private generateDeploymentManifest(): string { const deployment = { apiVersion: 'apps/v1', kind: 'Deployment', metadata: { name: 'user-service', namespace: this.config.namespace, labels: { app: 'user-service', version: this.config.imageTag, environment: this.config.environment, }, }, spec: { replicas: this.config.replicas, strategy: { type: 'RollingUpdate', rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0, }, }, selector: { matchLabels: { app: 'user-service', }, }, template: { metadata: { labels: { app: 'user-service', version: this.config.imageTag, }, }, spec: { containers: [ { name: 'user-service', image: `myregistry/user-service:${this.config.imageTag}`, ports: [{ containerPort: 3000 }], resources: this.config.resources, livenessProbe: { httpGet: { path: '/health', port: 3000, }, initialDelaySeconds: 30, periodSeconds: 30, }, readinessProbe: { httpGet: { path: '/health/ready', port: 3000, }, initialDelaySeconds: 5, periodSeconds: 10, }, }, ], }, }, }, }; return yaml.dump(deployment); } private async postDeploymentVerification(): Promise<void> { console.log('Running post-deployment verification...'); // Wait for pods to be ready await this.waitForPodsReady(); // Run health checks await this.runHealthChecks(); // Run smoke tests await this.runSmokeTests(); console.log('Post-deployment verification completed'); } private async waitForPodsReady(): Promise<void> { console.log('Waiting for pods to be ready...'); let retries = 30; while (retries > 0) { try { const output = execSync( `kubectl get pods -n ${this.config.namespace} -l app=user-service -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.phase}'`, { encoding: 'utf8' } ); const phases = output.trim().split(' '); if (phases.every(phase => phase === 'Running')) { console.log('All pods are running'); return; } } catch (error) { console.warn('Error checking pod status:', error.message); } retries--; await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10000)); // Wait 10 seconds } throw new Error('Pods did not become ready within timeout'); } private async runHealthChecks(): Promise<void> { console.log('Running health checks...'); try { // Port-forward to service for health check const portForwardProcess = execSync( `kubectl port-forward -n ${this.config.namespace} service/user-service 8080:80 &`, { stdio: 'pipe' } ); // Wait a moment for port-forward to establish await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000)); // Make health check request const response = await fetch('http://localhost:8080/health'); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Health check failed: ${response.status}`); } console.log('Health checks passed'); } catch (error) { throw new Error(`Health check failed: ${error.message}`); } } private async runSmokeTests(): Promise<void> { console.log('Running smoke tests...'); try { // Run smoke test suite execSync('npm run test:smoke', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Smoke tests passed'); } catch (error) { throw new Error(`Smoke tests failed: ${error.message}`); } } private async rollback(): Promise<void> { console.log('Rolling back deployment...'); try { execSync(`kubectl rollout undo deployment/user-service -n ${this.config.namespace}`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Rollback completed'); } catch (error) { console.error('Rollback failed:', error.message); } } } // Usage const deployer = new DeploymentOrchestrator(process.argv[2] || 'staging'); deployer.deploy().catch(error => { console.error('Deployment failed:', error); process.exit(1); });

// scripts/blue-green-deploy.ts interface BlueGreenConfig { blueNamespace: string; greenNamespace: string; serviceNamespace: string; healthCheckUrl: string; trafficShiftDelay: number; } class BlueGreenDeployment { private config: BlueGreenConfig; constructor(config: BlueGreenConfig) { this.config = config; } async deploy(newVersion: string): Promise<void> { console.log(`Starting blue-green deployment for version ${newVersion}`); try { // Determine current and target environments const currentEnv = await this.getCurrentEnvironment(); const targetEnv = currentEnv === 'blue' ? 'green' : 'blue'; const targetNamespace = targetEnv === 'blue' ? this.config.blueNamespace : this.config.greenNamespace; console.log(`Current environment: ${currentEnv}, Target environment: ${targetEnv}`); // Deploy to target environment await this.deployToEnvironment(targetNamespace, newVersion); // Run health checks await this.validateDeployment(targetNamespace); // Switch traffic await this.switchTraffic(targetEnv); // Verify traffic switch await this.verifyTrafficSwitch(); // Cleanup old environment await this.cleanupOldEnvironment(currentEnv === 'blue' ? this.config.blueNamespace : this.config.greenNamespace); console.log('Blue-green deployment completed successfully'); } catch (error) { console.error('Blue-green deployment failed:', error); throw error; } } private async getCurrentEnvironment(): Promise<'blue' | 'green'> { try { const serviceOutput = execSync( `kubectl get service user-service -n ${this.config.serviceNamespace} -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector.environment}'`, { encoding: 'utf8' } ); return serviceOutput.trim() as 'blue' | 'green'; } catch (error) { // Default to blue if service doesn't exist return 'blue'; } } private async deployToEnvironment(namespace: string, version: string): Promise<void> { console.log(`Deploying version ${version} to ${namespace}`); const deployment = this.generateDeploymentManifest(namespace, version); fs.writeFileSync(`./deploy/${namespace}-manifest.yaml`, deployment); execSync(`kubectl apply -f ./deploy/${namespace}-manifest.yaml`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync(`kubectl rollout status deployment/user-service -n ${namespace} --timeout=600s`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); } private async validateDeployment(namespace: string): Promise<void> { console.log(`Validating deployment in ${namespace}`); // Port-forward and run health checks const portForwardProcess = spawn('kubectl', [ 'port-forward', '-n', namespace, 'service/user-service', '8080:80' ]); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000)); try { const response = await fetch('http://localhost:8080/health'); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Health check failed: ${response.status}`); } // Run additional validation tests await this.runValidationTests(); console.log(`Deployment validation successful for ${namespace}`); } finally { portForwardProcess.kill(); } } private async switchTraffic(targetEnv: 'blue' | 'green'): Promise<void> { console.log(`Switching traffic to ${targetEnv} environment`); const serviceManifest = this.generateServiceManifest(targetEnv); fs.writeFileSync('./deploy/service-switch.yaml', serviceManifest); execSync('kubectl apply -f ./deploy/service-switch.yaml', { stdio: 'inherit' }); // Wait for DNS propagation await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, this.config.trafficShiftDelay)); } private async verifyTrafficSwitch(): Promise<void> { console.log('Verifying traffic switch...'); let retries = 5; while (retries > 0) { try { const response = await fetch(this.config.healthCheckUrl); if (response.ok) { console.log('Traffic switch verified successfully'); return; } } catch (error) { console.warn(`Traffic verification attempt failed: ${error.message}`); } retries--; await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 10000)); } throw new Error('Traffic switch verification failed'); } private generateServiceManifest(targetEnv: 'blue' | 'green'): string { const service = { apiVersion: 'v1', kind: 'Service', metadata: { name: 'user-service', namespace: this.config.serviceNamespace, }, spec: { type: 'ClusterIP', ports: [ { port: 80, targetPort: 3000, protocol: 'TCP', }, ], selector: { app: 'user-service', environment: targetEnv, }, }, }; return yaml.dump(service); } }

name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' cache: 'npm' cache-dependency-path: ${{ matrix.service }}/package-lock.json - name: Install dependencies run: | cd ${{ matrix.service }} npm ci - // src/promotion/promotion-gate.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { HttpService } from '@nestjs/axios'; import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs'; export interface PromotionGate { name: string; required: boolean; timeout: number; validator: () => Promise<PromotionGateResult>; } export interface PromotionGateResult { passed: boolean; message: string; details?: any; } export interface PromotionRequest { sourceEnvironment: string; targetEnvironment: string; version: string; services: string[]; skipOptionalGates?: boolean; } @Injectable() export class PromotionGateService { private readonly logger = new Logger(PromotionGateService.name); constructor(private readonly httpService: HttpService) {} async validatePromotion(request: PromotionRequest): Promise<{ approved: boolean; gates: Array<PromotionGateResult & { name: string; required: boolean }>; message: string; }> { this.logger.log(`Validating promotion from ${request.sourceEnvironment} to ${request.targetEnvironment}`); const gates = this.getPromotionGates(request.targetEnvironment); const results = []; let allRequiredPassed = true; for (const gate of gates) { try { this.logger.debug(`Running gate: ${gate.name}`); const result = await Promise.race([ gate.validator(), this.createTimeoutPromise(gate.timeout, gate.name), ]); results.push({ name: gate.name, required: gate.required, ...result, }); if (gate.required && !result.passed) { allRequiredPassed = false; } this.logger.debug(`Gate ${gate.name}: ${result.passed ? 'PASSED' : 'FAILED'} - ${result.message}`); } catch (error) { const errorResult = { name: gate.name, required: gate.required, passed: false, message: `Gate execution failed: ${error.message}`, details: error, }; results.push(errorResult); if (gate.required) { allRequiredPassed = false; } this.logger.error(`Gate ${gate.name} execution failed`, error); } } const approved = allRequiredPassed || request.skipOptionalGates === true; const message = approved ? 'All required promotion gates passed' : 'One or more required promotion gates failed'; return { approved, gates: results, message, }; } private getPromotionGates(targetEnvironment: string): PromotionGate[] { const commonGates: PromotionGate[] = [ { name: 'health-check', required: true, timeout: 30000, validator: () => this.validateHealthCheck(), }, { name: 'database-migrations', required: true, timeout: 60000, validator: () => this.validateDatabaseMigrations(), }, { name: 'security-scan', required: true, timeout: 120000, validator: () => this.validateSecurityScan(), }, ]; const environmentSpecificGates: Record<string, PromotionGate[]> = { staging: [ { name: 'integration-tests', required: true, timeout: 300000, validator: () => this.validateIntegrationTests(), }, { name: 'performance-baseline', required: false, timeout: 180000, validator: () => this.validatePerformanceBaseline(), }, ], production: [ { name: 'staging-validation', required: true, timeout: 60000, validator: () => this.validateStagingEnvironment(), }, { name: 'performance-tests', required: true, timeout: 600000, validator: () => this.validatePerformanceTests(), }, { name: 'backup-verification', required: true, timeout: 120000, validator: () => this.validateBackupStatus(), }, { name: 'manual-approval', required: true, timeout: 3600000, // 1 hour validator: () => this.validateManualApproval(), }, ], }; return [ ...commonGates, ...(environmentSpecificGates[targetEnvironment] || []), ]; } private async createTimeoutPromise(timeout: number, gateName: string): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { return new Promise((_, reject) => { setTimeout(() => { reject(new Error(`Gate ${gateName} timed out after ${timeout}ms`)); }, timeout); }); } private async validateHealthCheck(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/health', { timeout: 5000 }) ); if (response.status === 200) { return { passed: true, message: 'Health check passed', details: response.data, }; } else { return { passed: false, message: `Health check failed with status ${response.status}`, details: response.data, }; } } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Health check endpoint unreachable', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateDatabaseMigrations(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { // Check if there are pending migrations const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/migrations/status') ); const { pending, errors } = response.data; if (errors && errors.length > 0) { return { passed: false, message: 'Database migration errors detected', details: errors, }; } if (pending && pending.length > 0) { return { passed: false, message: `${pending.length} pending migrations found`, details: pending, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'All database migrations are up to date', }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify database migration status', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateSecurityScan(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/security/scan-status') ); const { vulnerabilities, lastScan } = response.data; const highSeverityVulns = vulnerabilities.filter(v => v.severity === 'high' || v.severity === 'critical'); if (highSeverityVulns.length > 0) { return { passed: false, message: `${highSeverityVulns.length} high/critical vulnerabilities found`, details: highSeverityVulns, }; } // Check if scan is recent (within last 24 hours) const scanAge = Date.now() - new Date(lastScan).getTime(); const maxAge = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours if (scanAge > maxAge) { return { passed: false, message: 'Security scan is outdated', details: { lastScan, ageHours: scanAge / (60 * 60 * 1000) }, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Security scan passed with no critical vulnerabilities', details: { vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities.length, lastScan }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify security scan status', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateIntegrationTests(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/tests/integration/latest') ); const { status, passRate, duration, failedTests } = response.data; if (status !== 'passed') { return { passed: false, message: `Integration tests failed with status: ${status}`, details: failedTests, }; } if (passRate < 95) { return { passed: false, message: `Integration test pass rate below threshold: ${passRate}%`, details: { passRate, failedTests }, }; } return { passed: true, message: `Integration tests passed with ${passRate}% success rate`, details: { passRate, duration }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify integration test status', details: error.message, }; } } private async validatePerformanceBaseline(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/performance/baseline') ); const { currentMetrics, baseline, deviation } = response.data; const thresholds = { responseTime: 20, // 20% increase allowed throughput: -10, // 10% decrease allowed errorRate: 50, // 50% increase allowed }; const violations = []; for (const [metric, threshold] of Object.entries(thresholds)) { if (deviation[metric] > threshold) { violations.push({ metric, deviation: deviation[metric], threshold, current: currentMetrics[metric], baseline: baseline[metric], }); } } if (violations.length > 0) { return { passed: false, message: 'Performance metrics deviated beyond acceptable thresholds', details: violations, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Performance metrics within acceptable range', details: { currentMetrics, baseline, deviation }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify performance baseline', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateStagingEnvironment(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/staging/validation') ); const { uptime, errorRate, responseTime, lastDeployment } = response.data; // Check if staging has been stable for at least 2 hours const deploymentAge = Date.now() - new Date(lastDeployment).getTime(); const minStabilityTime = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 2 hours if (deploymentAge < minStabilityTime) { return { passed: false, message: 'Staging environment needs more stability time', details: { deploymentAge: deploymentAge / (60 * 60 * 1000), required: 2 }, }; } if (errorRate > 1) { return { passed: false, message: `Staging error rate too high: ${errorRate}%`, details: { errorRate, threshold: 1 }, }; } if (responseTime > 2000) { return { passed: false, message: `Staging response time too high: ${responseTime}ms`, details: { responseTime, threshold: 2000 }, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Staging environment validation passed', details: { uptime, errorRate, responseTime, lastDeployment }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to validate staging environment', details: error.message, }; } } private async validatePerformanceTests(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/performance/tests/latest') ); const { status, metrics, thresholds } = response.data; if (status !== 'passed') { return { passed: false, message: `Performance tests failed with status: ${status}`, details: metrics, }; } const violations = []; for (const [metric, value] of Object.entries(metrics)) { const threshold = thresholds[metric]; if (threshold && value > threshold) { violations.push({ metric, value, threshold }); } } if (violations.length > 0) { return { passed: false, message: 'Performance tests exceeded thresholds', details: violations, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Performance tests passed all thresholds', details: metrics, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify performance test results', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateBackupStatus(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/backup/status') ); const { lastBackup, status, size } = response.data; // Check if backup is recent (within last 24 hours) const backupAge = Date.now() - new Date(lastBackup).getTime(); const maxAge = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours if (backupAge > maxAge) { return { passed: false, message: 'No recent backup found', details: { lastBackup, ageHours: backupAge / (60 * 60 * 1000) }, }; } if (status !== 'completed') { return { passed: false, message: `Backup status is ${status}, not completed`, details: { status, lastBackup }, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Recent backup verified', details: { lastBackup, status, size }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify backup status', details: error.message, }; } } private async validateManualApproval(): Promise<PromotionGateResult> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/admin/approvals/production/latest') ); const { approved, approver, timestamp, comments } = response.data; if (!approved) { return { passed: false, message: 'Manual approval required for production deployment', details: { status: 'pending' }, }; } // Check if approval is recent (within last 4 hours) const approvalAge = Date.now() - new Date(timestamp).getTime(); const maxAge = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 4 hours if (approvalAge > maxAge) { return { passed: false, message: 'Manual approval is outdated', details: { timestamp, ageHours: approvalAge / (60 * 60 * 1000) }, }; } return { passed: true, message: 'Manual approval verified', details: { approver, timestamp, comments }, }; } catch (error) { return { passed: false, message: 'Unable to verify manual approval status', details: error.message, }; } } }
