// src/monitoring/prometheus.service.ts import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'; import { register, Counter, Histogram, Gauge } from 'prom-client'; @Injectable() export class PrometheusService { private readonly httpRequestsTotal = new Counter({ name: 'http_requests_total', help: 'Total number of HTTP requests', labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status_code'], registers: [register], }); private readonly httpRequestDuration = new Histogram({ name: 'http_request_duration_seconds', help: 'Duration of HTTP requests in seconds', labelNames: ['method', 'route'], buckets: [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 3, 5, 7, 10], registers: [register], }); private readonly databaseConnectionsActive = new Gauge({ name: 'database_connections_active', help: 'Number of active database connections', registers: [register], }); private readonly redisConnectionsActive = new Gauge({ name: 'redis_connections_active', help: 'Number of active Redis connections', registers: [register], }); private readonly businessMetrics = { usersRegistered: new Counter({ name: 'users_registered_total', help: 'Total number of user registrations', labelNames: ['source'], registers: [register], }), ordersCreated: new Counter({ name: 'orders_created_total', help: 'Total number of orders created', labelNames: ['status'], registers: [register], }), paymentProcessed: new Counter({ name: 'payments_processed_total', help: 'Total number of payments processed', labelNames: ['status', 'provider'], registers: [register], }), activeUsers: new Gauge({ name: 'active_users_current', help: 'Current number of active users', registers: [register], }), }; recordHttpRequest(method: string, route: string, statusCode: number, duration: number): void { this.httpRequestsTotal.inc({ method, route, status_code: statusCode.toString() }); this.httpRequestDuration.observe({ method, route }, duration); } updateDatabaseConnections(count: number): void { this.databaseConnectionsActive.set(count); } updateRedisConnections(count: number): void { this.redisConnectionsActive.set(count); } recordUserRegistration(source: string): void { this.businessMetrics.usersRegistered.inc({ source }); } recordOrderCreation(status: string): void { this.businessMetrics.ordersCreated.inc({ status }); } recordPayment(status: string, provider: string): void { this.businessMetrics.paymentProcessed.inc({ status, provider }); } updateActiveUsers(count: number): void { this.businessMetrics.activeUsers.set(count); } getMetrics(): string { return register.metrics(); } }

// src/middleware/monitoring.middleware.ts import { Injectable, NestMiddleware } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; import { PrometheusService } from '../monitoring/prometheus.service'; @Injectable() export class MonitoringMiddleware implements NestMiddleware { constructor(private readonly prometheusService: PrometheusService) {} use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void { const startTime = Date.now(); res.on('finish', () => { const duration = (Date.now() - startTime) / 1000; const route = req.route?.path || req.path; this.prometheusService.recordHttpRequest( req.method, route, res.statusCode, duration ); }); next(); } }

// lib/monitoring/client-metrics.ts interface PerformanceMetric { name: string; value: number; labels?: Record<string, string>; } class ClientMetrics { private metrics: PerformanceMetric[] = []; // Core Web Vitals recordCLS(value: number, route: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'web_vitals_cls', value, labels: { route, metric: 'cls' }, }); } recordFID(value: number, route: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'web_vitals_fid', value, labels: { route, metric: 'fid' }, }); } recordLCP(value: number, route: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'web_vitals_lcp', value, labels: { route, metric: 'lcp' }, }); } recordFCP(value: number, route: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'web_vitals_fcp', value, labels: { route, metric: 'fcp' }, }); } recordTTFB(value: number, route: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'web_vitals_ttfb', value, labels: { route, metric: 'ttfb' }, }); } // Custom Business Metrics recordUserInteraction(action: string, component: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'user_interactions_total', value: 1, labels: { action, component }, }); } recordAPICall(endpoint: string, status: number, duration: number): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'api_calls_total', value: 1, labels: { endpoint, status: status.toString() }, }); this.metrics.push({ name: 'api_call_duration_seconds', value: duration / 1000, labels: { endpoint }, }); } recordPageView(route: string, loadTime: number): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'page_views_total', value: 1, labels: { route }, }); this.metrics.push({ name: 'page_load_time_seconds', value: loadTime / 1000, labels: { route }, }); } recordError(type: string, message: string, component?: string): void { this.metrics.push({ name: 'client_errors_total', value: 1, labels: { type, component: component || 'unknown' }, }); } // Send metrics to backend async sendMetrics(): Promise<void> { if (this.metrics.length === 0) return; try { await fetch('/api/metrics', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ metrics: this.metrics }), }); this.metrics = []; // Clear after sending } catch (error) { console.error('Failed to send metrics:', error); } } // Automatic metric collection collectWebVitals(): void { if (typeof window === 'undefined') return; // Collect Core Web Vitals import('web-vitals').then(({ getCLS, getFID, getFCP, getLCP, getTTFB }) => { const route = window.location.pathname; getCLS((metric) => this.recordCLS(metric.value, route)); getFID((metric) => this.recordFID(metric.value, route)); getFCP((metric) => this.recordFCP(metric.value, route)); getLCP((metric) => this.recordLCP(metric.value, route)); getTTFB((metric) => this.recordTTFB(metric.value, route)); }); // Page load metrics window.addEventListener('load', () => { const loadTime = performance.timing.loadEventEnd - performance.timing.navigationStart; this.recordPageView(window.location.pathname, loadTime); }); // Unhandled errors window.addEventListener('error', (event) => { this.recordError('javascript', event.error?.message || 'Unknown error', event.filename); }); // Unhandled promise rejections window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) => { this.recordError('promise', event.reason?.message || 'Unhandled promise rejection'); }); // Send metrics periodically setInterval(() => this.sendMetrics(), 30000); // Every 30 seconds } } export const clientMetrics = new ClientMetrics();

// hooks/use-monitoring.ts import { useEffect } from 'react'; import { useRouter } from 'next/router'; import { clientMetrics } from '../lib/monitoring/client-metrics'; export const useMonitoring = () => { const router = useRouter(); useEffect(() => { // Initialize monitoring clientMetrics.collectWebVitals(); // Track route changes const handleRouteChange = (url: string) => { const startTime = Date.now(); const handleRouteComplete = () => { const loadTime = Date.now() - startTime; clientMetrics.recordPageView(url, loadTime); router.events.off('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteComplete); }; router.events.on('routeChangeComplete', handleRouteComplete); }; router.events.on('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChange); return () => { router.events.off('routeChangeStart', handleRouteChange); }; }, [router]); const trackUserInteraction = (action: string, component: string) => { clientMetrics.recordUserInteraction(action, component); }; const trackAPICall = (endpoint: string, status: number, duration: number) => { clientMetrics.recordAPICall(endpoint, status, duration); }; const trackError = (type: string, message: string, component?: string) => { clientMetrics.recordError(type, message, component); }; return { trackUserInteraction, trackAPICall, trackError, }; };

// src/monitoring/database-monitor.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { DataSource } from 'typeorm'; import { PrometheusService } from './prometheus.service'; @Injectable() export class DatabaseMonitorService { private readonly logger = new Logger(DatabaseMonitorService.name); constructor( private readonly dataSource: DataSource, private readonly prometheus: PrometheusService, ) {} @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_30_SECONDS) async monitorDatabasePerformance(): Promise<void> { try { // Monitor active connections const connectionCount = await this.getActiveConnections(); this.prometheus.updateDatabaseConnections(connectionCount); // Monitor slow queries const slowQueries = await this.getSlowQueries(); this.logSlowQueries(slowQueries); // Monitor database size const dbSize = await this.getDatabaseSize(); this.prometheus.updateDatabaseSize(dbSize); // Monitor table sizes const tableSizes = await this.getTableSizes(); this.updateTableSizeMetrics(tableSizes); } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Database monitoring failed', error); } } private async getActiveConnections(): Promise<number> { const result = await this.dataSource.query(` SELECT count(*) as connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' `); return parseInt(result[0].connections); } private async getSlowQueries(): Promise<any[]> { return this.dataSource.query(` SELECT query, mean_exec_time, calls FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE mean_exec_time > 1000 ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10 `); } private async getDatabaseSize(): Promise<number> { const result = await this.dataSource.query(` SELECT pg_database_size(current_database()) as size `); return parseInt(result[0].size); } private async getTableSizes(): Promise<Array<{table: string, size: number}>> { return this.dataSource.query(` SELECT schemaname, tablename as table, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename)) as size, pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) as size_bytes FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(schemaname||'.'||tablename) DESC `); } private logSlowQueries(queries: any[]): void { queries.forEach(query => { this.logger.warn(`Slow query detected: ${query.query.substring(0, 100)}... (${query.mean_exec_time}ms avg, ${query.calls} calls)`); }); } private updateTableSizeMetrics(tableSizes: Array<{table: string, size_bytes: number}>): void { // Update Prometheus metrics for table sizes // Implementation depends on your specific metrics setup } }

This guide provides comprehensive performance testing strategies for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications, covering load testing, stress testing, performance benchmarking, and automated performance validation in CI/CD pipelines.

Performance testing ensures applications meet performance requirements under various load conditions. This guide covers different types of performance testing, automation strategies, and performance optimization techniques for microservices and microfrontend architectures.

// tests/performance/load-test.js import http from 'k6/http'; import { check, sleep } from 'k6'; import { Rate, Trend, Counter } from 'k6/metrics'; // Custom metrics const errorRate = new Rate('error_rate'); const responseTimeP95 = new Trend('response_time_p95'); const successfulRequests = new Counter('successful_requests'); const failedRequests = new Counter('failed_requests'); // Test configuration export const options = { stages: [ { duration: '2m', target: 10 }, // Ramp up to 10 users { duration: '5m', target: 10 }, // Stay at 10 users { duration: '2m', target: 20 }, // Ramp up to 20 users { duration: '5m', target: 20 }, // Stay at 20 users { duration: '2m', target: 50 }, // Ramp up to 50 users { duration: '5m', target: 50 }, // Stay at 50 users { duration: '2m', target: 0 }, // Ramp down to 0 users ], thresholds: { http_req_duration: ['p(95)<2000'], // 95% of requests must be below 2s http_req_failed: ['rate<0.01'], // Error rate must be below 1% error_rate: ['rate<0.01'], // Custom error rate response_time_p95: ['p(95)<2000'], // Custom P95 response time }, }; // Test data const testUsers = [ { email: 'user1@example.com', password: 'password123' }, { email: 'user2@example.com', password: 'password123' }, { email: 'user3@example.com', password: 'password123' }, ]; const baseUrl = __ENV.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3001'; // Authentication helper function authenticate() { const user = testUsers[Math.floor(Math.random() * testUsers.length)]; const loginResponse = http.post(`${baseUrl}/auth/login`, { email: user.email, password: user.password, }, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, }); const loginSuccess = check(loginResponse, { 'login status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'login response has token': (r) => r.json('access_token') !== undefined, }); if (loginSuccess) { successfulRequests.add(1); return loginResponse.json('access_token'); } else { failedRequests.add(1); errorRate.add(1); return null; } } // Main test scenario export default function () { // Authentication const token = authenticate(); if (!token) { return; } const headers = { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }; // Test user profile endpoint const profileResponse = http.get(`${baseUrl}/users/profile`, { headers }); const profileCheck = check(profileResponse, { 'profile status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'profile response time < 500ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 500, 'profile has user data': (r) => r.json('id') !== undefined, }); if (profileCheck) { successfulRequests.add(1); responseTimeP95.add(profileResponse.timings.duration); } else { failedRequests.add(1); errorRate.add(1); } // Test product listing endpoint const productsResponse = http.get(`${baseUrl}/products?page=1&limit=20`, { headers }); check(productsResponse, { 'products status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'products response time < 1000ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 1000, 'products has data': (r) => r.json('data') !== undefined, }); // Test product creation const newProduct = { name: `Test Product ${Math.random()}`, description: 'Test product description', price: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000) + 10, categoryId: '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000', }; const createResponse = http.post(`${baseUrl}/products`, JSON.stringify(newProduct), { headers }); const createCheck = check(createResponse, { 'product creation status is 201': (r) => r.status === 201, 'product creation response time < 1500ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 1500, 'created product has id': (r) => r.json('id') !== undefined, }); if (createCheck) { const productId = createResponse.json('id'); // Test product update const updateData = { name: `Updated ${newProduct.name}` }; const updateResponse = http.put(`${baseUrl}/products/${productId}`, JSON.stringify(updateData), { headers }); check(updateResponse, { 'product update status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'product update response time < 1000ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 1000, }); // Test product deletion const deleteResponse = http.del(`${baseUrl}/products/${productId}`, null, { headers }); check(deleteResponse, { 'product deletion status is 204': (r) => r.status === 204, 'product deletion response time < 500ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 500, }); } sleep(1); // Wait 1 second between iterations } // Setup function (runs once before the test) export function setup() { console.log('Starting performance test setup...'); // Health check const healthResponse = http.get(`${baseUrl}/health`); if (healthResponse.status !== 200) { throw new Error('Service is not healthy'); } console.log('Service health check passed'); return { timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }; } // Teardown function (runs once after the test) export function teardown(data) { console.log(`Performance test completed at ${new Date().toISOString()}`); console.log(`Test started at ${data.timestamp}`); }

// tests/performance/stress-test.js import http from 'k6/http'; import { check, sleep } from 'k6'; import { Rate, Trend } from 'k6/metrics'; const errorRate = new Rate('error_rate'); const responseTime = new Trend('response_time'); export const options = { stages: [ { duration: '1m', target: 50 }, // Ramp up to 50 users { duration: '3m', target: 100 }, // Ramp up to 100 users { duration: '3m', target: 200 }, // Ramp up to 200 users { duration: '3m', target: 300 }, // Ramp up to 300 users (stress point) { duration: '5m', target: 300 }, // Stay at 300 users { duration: '3m', target: 400 }, // Push to 400 users (breaking point) { duration: '5m', target: 400 }, // Stay at 400 users { duration: '2m', target: 0 }, // Ramp down ], thresholds: { http_req_duration: ['p(95)<5000'], // Allow higher response times during stress http_req_failed: ['rate<0.05'], // Allow higher error rate during stress error_rate: ['rate<0.05'], }, }; const baseUrl = __ENV.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3001'; export default function () { const response = http.get(`${baseUrl}/products?page=1&limit=50`); const success = check(response, { 'status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'response time < 5000ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 5000, }); if (!success) { errorRate.add(1); } responseTime.add(response.timings.duration); sleep(Math.random() * 2 + 1); // Random sleep between 1-3 seconds }

// tests/performance/spike-test.js import http from 'k6/http'; import { check, sleep } from 'k6'; export const options = { stages: [ { duration: '2m', target: 10 }, // Normal load { duration: '30s', target: 100 }, // Spike to 100 users { duration: '1m', target: 100 }, // Stay at spike { duration: '30s', target: 10 }, // Return to normal { duration: '2m', target: 10 }, // Normal load { duration: '30s', target: 200 }, // Larger spike { duration: '1m', target: 200 }, // Stay at larger spike { duration: '30s', target: 10 }, // Return to normal { duration: '2m', target: 10 }, // Normal load ], thresholds: { http_req_duration: ['p(95)<3000'], http_req_failed: ['rate<0.02'], }, }; const baseUrl = __ENV.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3001'; export default function () { const responses = http.batch([ ['GET', `${baseUrl}/products`], ['GET', `${baseUrl}/categories`], ['GET', `${baseUrl}/health`], ]); for (let i = 0; i < responses.length; i++) { check(responses[i], { 'status is 200': (r) => r.status === 200, 'response time < 3000ms': (r) => r.timings.duration < 3000, }); } sleep(1); }

// tests/performance/lighthouse-performance.ts import lighthouse from 'lighthouse'; import * as chromeLauncher from 'chrome-launcher'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; interface PerformanceMetrics { url: string; timestamp: Date; scores: { performance: number; accessibility: number; bestPractices: number; seo: number; }; metrics: { firstContentfulPaint: number; largestContentfulPaint: number; firstInputDelay: number; cumulativeLayoutShift: number; speedIndex: number; timeToInteractive: number; }; opportunities: Array<{ id: string; title: string; score: number; details: any; }>; } class LighthousePerformanceTester { private chrome?: chromeLauncher.LaunchedChrome; async initialize(): Promise<void> { this.chrome = await chromeLauncher.launch({ chromeFlags: ['--headless', '--disable-gpu', '--no-sandbox'], }); } async runPerformanceTest(url: string): Promise<PerformanceMetrics> { if (!this.chrome) { await this.initialize(); } const options = { logLevel: 'info' as const, output: 'json' as const, onlyCategories: ['performance', 'accessibility', 'best-practices', 'seo'], port: this.chrome!.port, settings: { preset: 'desktop', throttlingMethod: 'simulate', throttling: { rttMs: 40, throughputKbps: 10240, cpuSlowdownMultiplier: 1, }, }, }; const result = await lighthouse(url, options); const lhr = result!.lhr; return { url, timestamp: new Date(), scores: { performance: Math.round((lhr.categories.performance?.score || 0) * 100), accessibility: Math.round((lhr.categories.accessibility?.score || 0) * 100), bestPractices: Math.round((lhr.categories['best-practices']?.score || 0) * 100), seo: Math.round((lhr.categories.seo?.score || 0) * 100), }, metrics: { firstContentfulPaint: lhr.audits['first-contentful-paint']?.numericValue || 0, largestContentfulPaint: lhr.audits['largest-contentful-paint']?.numericValue || 0, firstInputDelay: lhr.audits['max-potential-fid']?.numericValue || 0, cumulativeLayoutShift: lhr.audits['cumulative-layout-shift']?.numericValue || 0, speedIndex: lhr.audits['speed-index']?.numericValue || 0, timeToInteractive: lhr.audits['interactive']?.numericValue || 0, }, opportunities: Object.values(lhr.audits) .filter(audit => audit.scoreDisplayMode === 'numeric' && audit.score !== null && audit.score < 0.9) .map(audit => ({ id: audit.id, title: audit.title, score: audit.score || 0, details: audit.details, })) .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score), }; } async runPageSpeedTest(urls: string[]): Promise<PerformanceMetrics[]> { const results: PerformanceMetrics[] = []; for (const url of urls) { console.log(`Testing ${url}...`); try { const metrics = await this.runPerformanceTest(url); results.push(metrics); // Log key metrics console.log(`Performance Score: ${metrics.scores.performance}`); console.log(`LCP: ${metrics.metrics.largestContentfulPaint}ms`); console.log(`FID: ${metrics.metrics.firstInputDelay}ms`); console.log(`CLS: ${metrics.metrics.cumulativeLayoutShift}`); // Wait between tests await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)); } catch (error) { console.error(`Failed to test ${url}:`, error); } } return results; } async generateReport(results: PerformanceMetrics[], outputPath: string): Promise<void> { const report = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), summary: { totalPages: results.length, averagePerformanceScore: results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.scores.performance, 0) / results.length, averageAccessibilityScore: results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.scores.accessibility, 0) / results.length, pagesBelow90Performance: results.filter(r => r.scores.performance < 90).length, slowestPage: results.reduce((slowest, current) => current.metrics.largestContentfulPaint > slowest.metrics.largestContentfulPaint ? current : slowest ), }, details: results, recommendations: this.generateRecommendations(results), }; await fs.writeFile(outputPath, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)); console.log(`Performance report saved to ${outputPath}`); } private generateRecommendations(results: PerformanceMetrics[]): string[] { const recommendations: string[] = []; // Analyze common issues const commonOpportunities = new Map<string, number>(); results.forEach(result => { result.opportunities.forEach(opp => { commonOpportunities.set(opp.id, (commonOpportunities.get(opp.id) || 0) + 1); }); }); // Generate recommendations based on frequency const sortedOpportunities = Array.from(commonOpportunities.entries()) .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]) .slice(0, 5); sortedOpportunities.forEach(([opportunityId, count]) => { const percentage = Math.round((count / results.length) * 100); recommendations.push(`${opportunityId} affects ${percentage}% of tested pages`); }); return recommendations; } async cleanup(): Promise<void> { if (this.chrome) { await this.chrome.kill(); } } } // Usage example export async function runLighthouseTests(): Promise<void> { const tester = new LighthousePerformanceTester(); const urls = [ 'http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:3000/products', 'http://localhost:3000/profile', 'http://localhost:3000/dashboard', ]; try { const results = await tester.runPageSpeedTest(urls); await tester.generateReport(results, 'lighthouse-report.json'); // Check performance thresholds const failedPages = results.filter(r => r.scores.performance < 90); if (failedPages.length > 0) { console.error(`${failedPages.length} pages failed performance threshold`); process.exit(1); } } finally { await tester.cleanup(); } }

// tests/performance/playwright-performance.ts import { test, expect, Page } from '@playwright/test'; interface PerformanceMetrics { navigation: number; firstContentfulPaint: number; largestContentfulPaint: number; domContentLoaded: number; loadComplete: number; resources: Array<{ name: string; duration: number; size: number; }>; } async function collectPerformanceMetrics(page: Page): Promise<PerformanceMetrics> { const performanceData = await page.evaluate(() => { const navigation = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming; const paintEntries = performance.getEntriesByType('paint'); const resourceEntries = performance.getEntriesByType('resource') as PerformanceResourceTiming[]; const fcp = paintEntries.find(entry => entry.name === 'first-contentful-paint')?.startTime || 0; const lcp = paintEntries.find(entry => entry.name === 'largest-contentful-paint')?.startTime || 0; return { navigation: navigation.loadEventEnd - navigation.navigationStart, firstContentfulPaint: fcp, largestContentfulPaint: lcp, domContentLoaded: navigation.domContentLoadedEventEnd - navigation.navigationStart, loadComplete: navigation.loadEventEnd - navigation.navigationStart, resources: resourceEntries.map(resource => ({ name: resource.name, duration: resource.responseEnd - resource.requestStart, size: resource.transferSize || 0, })), }; }); return performanceData; } test.describe('Frontend Performance Tests', () => { test('Home page should load within performance budget', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('http://localhost:3000'); const metrics = await collectPerformanceMetrics(page); // Performance assertions expect(metrics.navigation).toBeLessThan(3000); // 3 seconds max expect(metrics.firstContentfulPaint).toBeLessThan(1500); // 1.5 seconds max expect(metrics.domContentLoaded).toBeLessThan(2000); // 2 seconds max console.log('Performance Metrics:', metrics); }); test('Product listing should handle large datasets efficiently', async ({ page }) => { // Navigate to products page await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/products'); // Wait for products to load await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="product-list"]'); const metrics = await collectPerformanceMetrics(page); // Check that rendering large lists doesn't block UI expect(metrics.navigation).toBeLessThan(4000); // Test scrolling performance const scrollStart = Date.now(); await page.evaluate(() => { window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight); }); const scrollDuration = Date.now() - scrollStart; expect(scrollDuration).toBeLessThan(100); // Smooth scrolling }); test('Form submission should be responsive', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/login'); // Measure form interaction performance const interactionStart = Date.now(); await page.fill('[data-testid="email-input"]', 'test@example.com'); await page.fill('[data-testid="password-input"]', 'password123'); const fillDuration = Date.now() - interactionStart; expect(fillDuration).toBeLessThan(500); // Responsive input // Measure form submission const submitStart = Date.now(); await page.click('[data-testid="submit-button"]'); // Wait for navigation or response await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard'); const submitDuration = Date.now() - submitStart; expect(submitDuration).toBeLessThan(2000); // Quick submission }); test('Bundle size should be within limits', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('http://localhost:3000'); const metrics = await collectPerformanceMetrics(page); // Check JavaScript bundle size const jsResources = metrics.resources.filter(r => r.name.includes('.js')); const totalJSSize = jsResources.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.size, 0); expect(totalJSSize).toBeLessThan(1024 * 1024); // 1MB max for JS // Check CSS bundle size const cssResources = metrics.resources.filter(r => r.name.includes('.css')); const totalCSSSize = cssResources.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.size, 0); expect(totalCSSSize).toBeLessThan(256 * 1024); // 256KB max for CSS }); });

// tests/performance/database-performance.ts import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing'; import { DataSource } from 'typeorm'; import { Performance } from 'perf_hooks'; interface DatabaseMetrics { operationType: string; duration: number; rowsAffected: number; connectionCount: number; timestamp: Date; } class DatabasePerformanceTester { private dataSource: DataSource; private metrics: DatabaseMetrics[] = []; constructor(dataSource: DataSource) { this.dataSource = dataSource; } async testConnectionPool(): Promise<void> { console.log('Testing database connection pool...'); const promises: Promise<any>[] = []; const startTime = performance.now(); // Simulate concurrent connections for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) { promises.push(this.performDatabaseOperation('SELECT 1')); } await Promise.all(promises); const duration = performance.now() - startTime; console.log(`50 concurrent connections completed in ${duration}ms`); if (duration > 5000) { throw new Error('Connection pool performance degraded'); } } async testQueryPerformance(): Promise<void> { console.log('Testing query performance...'); // Test simple SELECT await this.performDatabaseOperation('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users', 'count_users'); // Test complex JOIN await this.performDatabaseOperation(` SELECT u.id, u.name, p.title, c.name as category FROM users u LEFT JOIN products p ON u.id = p.created_by LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE u.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT 100 `, 'complex_join'); // Test aggregation await this.performDatabaseOperation(` SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM products WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date DESC `, 'aggregation'); // Analyze results this.metrics.forEach(metric => { console.log(`${metric.operationType}: ${metric.duration}ms`); if (metric.duration > 1000) { console.warn(`Slow query detected: ${metric.operationType}`); } }); } async testInsertPerformance(): Promise<void> { console.log('Testing bulk insert performance...'); const batchSizes = [100, 500, 1000, 2000]; for (const batchSize of batchSizes) { const startTime = performance.now(); // Generate test data const testData = Array.from({ length: batchSize }, (_, i) => ({ name: `Test Product ${i}`, description: `Description for test product ${i}`, price: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000) + 10, category_id: '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000', })); // Bulk insert await this.dataSource.query(` INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, category_id) VALUES ${testData.map(() => '(?, ?, ?, ?)').join(', ')} `, testData.flatMap(item => [item.name, item.description, item.price, item.category_id])); const duration = performance.now() - startTime; console.log(`Batch insert ${batchSize} records: ${duration}ms (${(batchSize / (duration / 1000)).toFixed(0)} records/sec)`); // Clean up test data await this.dataSource.query('DELETE FROM products WHERE name LIKE ?', ['Test Product %']); } } async testUpdatePerformance(): Promise<void> { console.log('Testing update performance...'); // Create test data const testProductIds: string[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) { const result = await this.dataSource.query(` INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, category_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id `, [`Test Product ${i}`, `Description ${i}`, 100, '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000']); testProductIds.push(result[0].id); } // Test single record updates const singleUpdateStart = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { await this.dataSource.query('UPDATE products SET price = ? WHERE id = ?', [200, testProductIds[i]]); } const singleUpdateDuration = performance.now() - singleUpdateStart; console.log(`100 single updates: ${singleUpdateDuration}ms`); // Test bulk update const bulkUpdateStart = performance.now(); await this.dataSource.query(` UPDATE products SET price = 300 WHERE id IN (${testProductIds.slice(100, 200).map(() => '?').join(', ')}) `, testProductIds.slice(100, 200)); const bulkUpdateDuration = performance.now() - bulkUpdateStart; console.log(`100 bulk update: ${bulkUpdateDuration}ms`); // Clean up await this.dataSource.query(` DELETE FROM products WHERE id IN (${testProductIds.map(() => '?').join(', ')}) `, testProductIds); } private async performDatabaseOperation(query: string, operationType = 'generic'): Promise<void> { const startTime = performance.now(); const connectionsBefore = await this.getConnectionCount(); try { const result = await this.dataSource.query(query); const duration = performance.now() - startTime; const connectionsAfter = await this.getConnectionCount(); this.metrics.push({ operationType, duration, rowsAffected: Array.isArray(result) ? result.length : 1, connectionCount: connectionsAfter, timestamp: new Date(), }); } catch (error) { console.error(`Database operation failed: ${operationType}`, error); throw error; } } private async getConnectionCount(): Promise<number> { try { const result = await this.dataSource.query(` SELECT count(*) as count FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' `); return parseInt(result[0].count); } catch { return 0; } } generateReport(): any { const report = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), totalOperations: this.metrics.length, averageDuration: this.metrics.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.duration, 0) / this.metrics.length, slowestOperation: this.metrics.reduce((slowest, current) => current.duration > slowest.duration ? current : slowest ), operationBreakdown: this.metrics.reduce((breakdown, metric) => { if (!breakdown[metric.operationType]) { breakdown[metric.operationType] = { count: 0, totalDuration: 0, averageDuration: 0, }; } breakdown[metric.operationType].count++; breakdown[metric.operationType].totalDuration += metric.duration; breakdown[metric.operationType].averageDuration = breakdown[metric.operationType].totalDuration / breakdown[metric.operationType].count; return breakdown; }, {} as any), }; return report; } } // Usage in tests describe('Database Performance', () => { let tester: DatabasePerformanceTester; let dataSource: DataSource; beforeAll(async () => { // Setup test database connection dataSource = new DataSource({ type: 'postgres', host: process.env.TEST_DB_HOST, port: parseInt(process.env.TEST_DB_PORT || '5432'), username: process.env.TEST_DB_USER, password: process.env.TEST_DB_PASS, database: process.env.TEST_DB_NAME, synchronize: true, entities: ['src/**/*.entity.ts'], }); await dataSource.initialize(); tester = new DatabasePerformanceTester(dataSource); }); afterAll(async () => { await dataSource.destroy(); }); test('Connection pool performance', async () => { await tester.testConnectionPool(); }); test('Query performance', async () => { await tester.testQueryPerformance(); }); test('Insert performance', async () => { await tester.testInsertPerformance(); }); test('Update performance', async () => { await tester.testUpdatePerformance(); }); test('Generate performance report', () => { const report = tester.generateReport(); console.log('Database Performance Report:', JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)); // Assert performance thresholds expect(report.averageDuration).toBeLessThan(500); // 500ms average expect(report.slowestOperation.duration).toBeLessThan(2000); // 2s max }); });

# .github/workflows/performance-tests.yml name: Performance Tests on: schedule: - cron: '0 2 * * *' # Daily at 2 AM workflow_dispatch: inputs: test_type: description: 'Type of performance test' required: true default: 'load' type: choice options: - load - stress - spike - endurance jobs: performance-tests: runs-on: ubuntu-latest services: postgres: image: postgres:15 env: POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres POSTGRES_DB: testdb options: >- --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 redis: image: redis:7 options: >- --health-cmd "redis-cli ping" --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5 steps: - name: Checkout uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: '18' cache: 'npm' - name: Install dependencies run: npm ci - name: Build application run: npm run build - name: Start application run: | npm run start:prod & sleep 30 # Wait for application to start env: DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/testdb REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379 - name: Wait for application to be ready run: | timeout 60 bash -c 'until curl -f http://localhost:3000/health; do sleep 2; done' - name: Install K6 run: | sudo gpg -k sudo gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv-keys C5AD17C747E3415A3642D57D77C6C491D6AC1D69 echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install k6 - name: Run load tests if: ${{ github.event.inputs.test_type == 'load' || github.event.inputs.test_type == '' }} run: k6 run tests/performance/load-test.js env: BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000 - name: Run stress tests if: ${{ github.event.inputs.test_type == 'stress' }} run: k6 run tests/performance/stress-test.js env: BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000 - name: Run spike tests if: ${{ github.event.inputs.test_type == 'spike' }} run: k6 run tests/performance/spike-test.js env: BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000 - name: Run frontend performance tests run: npm run test:performance:frontend - name: Run database performance tests run: npm run test:performance:database env: TEST_DB_HOST: localhost TEST_DB_PORT: 5432 TEST_DB_USER: postgres TEST_DB_PASS: postgres TEST_DB_NAME: testdb - name: Generate performance report run: | node scripts/generate-performance-report.js env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: Upload performance results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3 with: name: performance-results path: | performance-report.json lighthouse-report.json k6-results.json - name: Comment PR with results if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' uses: actions/github-script@v6 with: script: | const fs = require('fs'); const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('performance-report.json', 'utf8')); const comment = ` ## 📊 Performance Test Results **Load Test Summary:** - Average Response Time: ${report.averageResponseTime}ms - 95th Percentile: ${report.p95ResponseTime}ms - Error Rate: ${report.errorRate}% - Requests/Second: ${report.requestsPerSecond} **Frontend Performance:** - Performance Score: ${report.lighthouseScore}/100 - Largest Contentful Paint: ${report.lcp}ms - First Input Delay: ${report.fid}ms ${report.hasRegressions ? '⚠️ Performance regressions detected!' : '✅ All performance thresholds met'} `; github.rest.issues.createComment({ issue_number: context.issue.number, owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, body: comment }); - name: Fail if performance thresholds not met run: | if [ -f performance-failures.txt ]; then echo "Performance thresholds not met:" cat performance-failures.txt exit 1 fi

// src/monitoring/performance-monitoring.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Interval } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { PrometheusService } from './prometheus.service'; import { Histogram, Counter, Gauge } from 'prom-client'; @Injectable() export class PerformanceMonitoringService { private readonly logger = new Logger(PerformanceMonitoringService.name); private readonly responseTimeHistogram: Histogram<string>; private readonly throughputCounter: Counter<string>; private readonly activeUsersGauge: Gauge<string>; private readonly errorRateCounter: Counter<string>; constructor(private readonly prometheusService: PrometheusService) { this.responseTimeHistogram = new Histogram({ name: 'http_request_duration_seconds', help: 'Duration of HTTP requests in seconds', labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status_code'], buckets: [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1, 3, 5, 7, 10], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.throughputCounter = new Counter({ name: 'http_requests_total', help: 'Total number of HTTP requests', labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status_code'], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.activeUsersGauge = new Gauge({ name: 'active_users_total', help: 'Number of active users', registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); this.errorRateCounter = new Counter({ name: 'http_request_errors_total', help: 'Total number of HTTP request errors', labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'error_type'], registers: [this.prometheusService.getRegistry()], }); } recordRequestMetrics( method: string, route: string, statusCode: number, duration: number ): void { this.responseTimeHistogram .labels(method, route, statusCode.toString()) .observe(duration / 1000); // Convert to seconds this.throughputCounter .labels(method, route, statusCode.toString()) .inc(); if (statusCode >= 400) { this.errorRateCounter .labels(method, route, statusCode >= 500 ? 'server_error' : 'client_error') .inc(); } } @Interval(60000) // Every minute async collectSystemMetrics(): Promise<void> { try { // Collect active users (example implementation) const activeUsers = await this.getActiveUsersCount(); this.activeUsersGauge.set(activeUsers); // Additional metrics collection can be added here } catch (error) { this.logger.error('Failed to collect system metrics', error); } } private async getActiveUsersCount(): Promise<number> { // Implementation would depend on your authentication system // This is a placeholder return Math.floor(Math.random() * 100); } }

Application Performance Monitoring - Real-time performance monitoring Infrastructure Monitoring - System-level performance metrics CI/CD Pipeline - Integration with deployment pipeline This performance testing guide should be regularly updated to incorporate new testing tools and methodologies.

This guide provides step-by-step instructions for implementing comprehensive backup and restore strategies for development, staging, and testing environments in your NestJS/Next.js application ecosystem.
documents.s: Pre-Production Environments Backup/Restore Strategy Implementation Guide

documents.t: Pre-production environments require specialized backup and restore strategies that balance data protection with development agility. Unlike production, these environments need frequent refreshes, test data management, and rapid environment provisioning capabilities.

By the end of this implementation, you should have: ✅ Automated backup systems for all pre-production environments ✅ Environment refresh capabilities for consistent testing ✅ Test data management and privacy compliance ✅ Rapid environment provisioning from backups ✅ Data synchronization between environments ✅ Monitoring and alerting for backup health

Environment Purpose Backup Frequency Retention Restore Time Development Daily development work Daily 7 days < 30 minutes Integration Feature integration testing Twice daily 14 days < 20 minutes Staging Production-like testing Hourly 30 days < 15 minutes UAT User acceptance testing Daily 21 days < 25 minutes Demo Client demonstrations Weekly 60 days < 45 minutes

Step 1.1: Environment Assessment and Requirements​ Duration: 1-2 days Participants: DevOps engineers, developers, QA team Actions: Document Current Environment State # Create environment inventory mkdir -p docs/backup-strategy/pre-production touch docs/backup-strategy/pre-production/environment-inventory.md touch docs/backup-strategy/pre-production/data-classification.md touch docs/backup-strategy/pre-production/compliance-requirements.md Environment Data Classification # docs/backup-strategy/pre-production/data-classification.md ## Data Categories in Pre-Production ### Sensitive Data (PII/PHI) - **Production Mirror**: Real user data (masked/anonymized) - **Synthetic Data**: Generated test data resembling production - **Compliance**: GDPR, HIPAA, SOX requirements ### Application Data - **Configuration**: Environment-specific settings - **Application State**: User sessions, cache data - **File Uploads**: Test documents, images, media files ### System Data - **Database Schemas**: Table structures, indexes, constraints - **Application Code**: Deployed versions and configurations - **Infrastructure Config**: Kubernetes manifests, Terraform state Define Recovery Time and Point Objectives // docs/backup-strategy/pre-production/rto-rpo-requirements.ts export interface EnvironmentSLA { environment: string; rto: string; // Recovery Time Objective rpo: string; // Recovery Point Objective availability: string; dataSensitivity: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'; } export const preProductionSLAs: EnvironmentSLA[] = [ { environment: 'development', rto: '30 minutes', rpo: '24 hours', availability: '95%', dataSensitivity: 'low', }, { environment: 'staging', rto: '15 minutes', rpo: '1 hour', availability: '99%', dataSensitivity: 'medium', }, { environment: 'uat', rto: '25 minutes', rpo: '4 hours', availability: '97%', dataSensitivity: 'medium', }, ]; Step 1.2: Backup Infrastructure Design​ Duration: 2-3 days Actions: GCP Backup Infrastructure Setup # infrastructure/backup/gcp-backup-resources.yaml apiVersion: v1 kind: ConfigMap metadata: name: backup-config namespace: backup-system data: backup-schedule: | environments: development: database: schedule: "0 2 * * *" # Daily at 2 AM retention: "7d" files: schedule: "0 3 * * *" # Daily at 3 AM retention: "7d" staging: database: schedule: "0 */1 * * *" # Hourly retention: "30d" files: schedule: "0 */2 * * *" # Every 2 hours retention: "30d" uat: database: schedule: "0 */6 * * *" # Every 6 hours retention: "21d" files: schedule: "0 */8 * * *" # Every 8 hours retention: "21d" --- apiVersion: batch/v1 kind: CronJob metadata: name: pre-prod-backup-scheduler namespace: backup-system spec: schedule: '*/5 * * * *' # Check every 5 minutes jobTemplate: spec: template: spec: containers: - name: backup-coordinator image: gcr.io/project-id/backup-coordinator:latest env: - name: BACKUP_CONFIG valueFrom: configMapKeyRef: name: backup-config key: backup-schedule restartPolicy: OnFailure Backup Storage Strategy # infrastructure/backup/storage.tf # Cloud Storage buckets for different backup types resource "google_storage_bucket" "pre_prod_database_backups" { name = "${var.project_id}-pre-prod-db-backups" location = var.region lifecycle_rule { condition { age = 30 } action { type = "Delete" } } versioning { enabled = true } uniform_bucket_level_access = true } resource "google_storage_bucket" "pre_prod_file_backups" { name = "${var.project_id}-pre-prod-file-backups" location = var.region lifecycle_rule { condition { age = 14 } action { type = "SetStorageClass" storage_class = "COLDLINE" } } lifecycle_rule { condition { age = 90 } action { type = "Delete" } } } # Cloud SQL backup configuration resource "google_sql_database_instance" "staging_db" { name = "staging-database" database_version = "POSTGRES_14" region = var.region settings { tier = "db-f1-micro" backup_configuration { enabled = true start_time = "02:00" point_in_time_recovery_enabled = true backup_retention_settings { retained_backups = 30 retention_unit = "COUNT" } } maintenance_window { day = 7 hour = 3 update_track = "stable" } } }

Step 2.1: Automated Database Backups​ Duration: 3-4 days Actions: Database Backup Service Implementation // src/backup/pre-production-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { Repository, DataSource } from 'typeorm'; import { Storage } from '@google-cloud/storage'; import { exec } from 'child_process'; import { promisify } from 'util'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; import * as zlib from 'zlib'; const execAsync = promisify(exec); export interface BackupJob { id: string; environment: string; type: 'database' | 'files' | 'full'; status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed'; startTime: Date; endTime?: Date; size?: number; location?: string; metadata?: Record<string, any>; } @Injectable() export class PreProductionBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(PreProductionBackupService.name); private readonly storage = new Storage(); constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService, private readonly dataSource: DataSource) {} @Cron('0 2 * * *') // Daily at 2 AM async performDevelopmentBackup(): Promise<void> { await this.performEnvironmentBackup('development'); } @Cron('0 */1 * * *') // Hourly async performStagingBackup(): Promise<void> { await this.performEnvironmentBackup('staging'); } @Cron('0 */6 * * *') // Every 6 hours async performUATBackup(): Promise<void> { await this.performEnvironmentBackup('uat'); } async performEnvironmentBackup(environment: string): Promise<BackupJob> { const job: BackupJob = { id: `backup-${environment}-${Date.now()}`, environment, type: 'full', status: 'pending', startTime: new Date(), }; try { this.logger.log(`Starting backup for ${environment} environment`); job.status = 'running'; // 1. Create database backup const dbBackupPath = await this.createDatabaseBackup(environment, job.id); // 2. Create file system backup const fileBackupPath = await this.createFileSystemBackup(environment, job.id); // 3. Upload to cloud storage const cloudLocation = await this.uploadBackupToCloud(environment, job.id, [dbBackupPath, fileBackupPath]); // 4. Clean up local files await this.cleanupLocalBackups([dbBackupPath, fileBackupPath]); // 5. Update job status job.status = 'completed'; job.endTime = new Date(); job.location = cloudLocation; this.logger.log(`Backup completed for ${environment}: ${cloudLocation}`); // 6. Send notification await this.sendBackupNotification(job); return job; } catch (error) { job.status = 'failed'; job.endTime = new Date(); this.logger.error(`Backup failed for ${environment}:`, error.stack); await this.sendBackupNotification(job, error); throw error; } } private async createDatabaseBackup(environment: string, jobId: string): Promise<string> { const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-'); const filename = `${environment}-db-backup-${timestamp}.sql`; const backupPath = path.join('/tmp', filename); const dbConfig = this.configService.get(`database.${environment}`); // Create compressed database dump const pgDumpCommand = [ 'pg_dump', `--host=${dbConfig.host}`, `--port=${dbConfig.port}`, `--username=${dbConfig.username}`, `--dbname=${dbConfig.database}`, '--format=custom', '--compress=9', '--no-owner', '--no-privileges', `--file=${backupPath}`, ].join(' '); this.logger.log(`Creating database backup: ${filename}`); try { await execAsync(pgDumpCommand, { env: { ...process.env, PGPASSWORD: dbConfig.password }, }); const stats = await fs.stat(backupPath); this.logger.log(`Database backup created: ${filename} (${stats.size} bytes)`); return backupPath; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Database backup failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } private async createFileSystemBackup(environment: string, jobId: string): Promise<string> { const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-'); const filename = `${environment}-files-backup-${timestamp}.tar.gz`; const backupPath = path.join('/tmp', filename); const dataDirectory = this.configService.get(`storage.${environment}.dataPath`); if (!dataDirectory) { this.logger.warn(`No data directory configured for ${environment}, skipping file backup`); return null; } const tarCommand = [ 'tar', '-czf', backupPath, '-C', path.dirname(dataDirectory), path.basename(dataDirectory), ].join(' '); try { this.logger.log(`Creating file system backup: ${filename}`); await execAsync(tarCommand); const stats = await fs.stat(backupPath); this.logger.log(`File system backup created: ${filename} (${stats.size} bytes)`); return backupPath; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`File system backup failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } private async uploadBackupToCloud(environment: string, jobId: string, backupPaths: string[]): Promise<string> { const bucketName = this.configService.get('backup.storage.bucket'); const bucket = this.storage.bucket(bucketName); const uploadPromises = backupPaths .filter((path) => path !== null) .map(async (localPath) => { const filename = path.basename(localPath); const cloudPath = `pre-production/${environment}/${jobId}/${filename}`; const file = bucket.file(cloudPath); this.logger.log(`Uploading ${filename} to ${cloudPath}`); await bucket.upload(localPath, { destination: cloudPath, metadata: { metadata: { environment, jobId, timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), type: filename.includes('db-backup') ? 'database' : 'files', }, }, }); return cloudPath; }); const uploadedPaths = await Promise.all(uploadPromises); return `gs://${bucketName}/pre-production/${environment}/${jobId}/`; } private async cleanupLocalBackups(backupPaths: string[]): Promise<void> { const cleanupPromises = backupPaths .filter((path) => path !== null) .map(async (backupPath) => { try { await fs.unlink(backupPath); this.logger.log(`Cleaned up local backup: ${backupPath}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.warn(`Failed to cleanup local backup ${backupPath}:`, error.message); } }); await Promise.all(cleanupPromises); } private async sendBackupNotification(job: BackupJob, error?: Error): Promise<void> { const webhookUrl = this.configService.get('notifications.slack.webhookUrl'); if (!webhookUrl) return; const color = job.status === 'completed' ? 'good' : 'danger'; const message = { attachments: [ { color, title: `Pre-Production Backup ${job.status === 'completed' ? 'Completed' : 'Failed'}`, fields: [ { title: 'Environment', value: job.environment, short: true }, { title: 'Job ID', value: job.id, short: true }, { title: 'Duration', value: this.formatDuration(job.startTime, job.endTime), short: true }, { title: 'Status', value: job.status, short: true }, ], ...(error && { text: `Error: ${error.message}` }), ...(job.location && { text: `Backup location: ${job.location}` }), }, ], }; try { const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(message), }); if (!response.ok) { throw new Error(`Slack notification failed: ${response.statusText}`); } } catch (notificationError) { this.logger.error('Failed to send backup notification:', notificationError.message); } } private formatDuration(start: Date, end?: Date): string { if (!end) return 'In progress'; const durationMs = end.getTime() - start.getTime(); const minutes = Math.floor(durationMs / 60000); const seconds = Math.floor((durationMs % 60000) / 1000); return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`; } } Step 2.2: Environment Refresh and Data Synchronization​ Duration: 2-3 days Actions: Environment Refresh Service // src/backup/environment-refresh.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Storage } from '@google-cloud/storage'; import { exec } from 'child_process'; import { promisify } from 'util'; import * as fs from 'fs/promises'; import * as path from 'path'; const execAsync = promisify(exec); export interface RefreshJob { id: string; sourceEnvironment: string; targetEnvironment: string; type: 'full' | 'data-only' | 'schema-only'; status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed'; startTime: Date; endTime?: Date; options?: { maskSensitiveData?: boolean; preserveUsers?: boolean; preserveConfigs?: boolean; }; } @Injectable() export class EnvironmentRefreshService { private readonly logger = new Logger(EnvironmentRefreshService.name); private readonly storage = new Storage(); constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {} async refreshEnvironmentFromProduction( targetEnvironment: string, options: RefreshJob['options'] = {}, ): Promise<RefreshJob> { const job: RefreshJob = { id: `refresh-${targetEnvironment}-${Date.now()}`, sourceEnvironment: 'production', targetEnvironment, type: 'full', status: 'pending', startTime: new Date(), options, }; try { this.logger.log(`Starting environment refresh: production -> ${targetEnvironment}`); job.status = 'running'; // 1. Create fresh production backup const prodBackupPath = await this.createProductionSnapshot(); // 2. Download and prepare backup for target environment const processedBackupPath = await this.processBackupForEnvironment(prodBackupPath, targetEnvironment, options); // 3. Stop target environment services await this.stopEnvironmentServices(targetEnvironment); // 4. Restore database await this.restoreDatabase(targetEnvironment, processedBackupPath); // 5. Restore file system await this.restoreFileSystem(targetEnvironment, processedBackupPath); // 6. Update environment-specific configurations await this.updateEnvironmentConfigurations(targetEnvironment); // 7. Start services and verify await this.startEnvironmentServices(targetEnvironment); await this.verifyEnvironmentHealth(targetEnvironment); job.status = 'completed'; job.endTime = new Date(); this.logger.log(`Environment refresh completed: ${job.id}`); await this.sendRefreshNotification(job); return job; } catch (error) { job.status = 'failed'; job.endTime = new Date(); this.logger.error(`Environment refresh failed:`, error.stack); await this.sendRefreshNotification(job, error); throw error; } } async refreshEnvironmentFromBackup( targetEnvironment: string, backupId: string, options: RefreshJob['options'] = {}, ): Promise<RefreshJob> { const job: RefreshJob = { id: `restore-${targetEnvironment}-${Date.now()}`, sourceEnvironment: 'backup', targetEnvironment, type: 'full', status: 'pending', startTime: new Date(), options, }; try { this.logger.log(`Starting environment restore: ${backupId} -> ${targetEnvironment}`); job.status = 'running'; // 1. Download backup from cloud storage const backupPath = await this.downloadBackup(backupId, targetEnvironment); // 2. Stop target environment services await this.stopEnvironmentServices(targetEnvironment); // 3. Restore from backup await this.restoreFromBackup(targetEnvironment, backupPath); // 4. Start services and verify await this.startEnvironmentServices(targetEnvironment); await this.verifyEnvironmentHealth(targetEnvironment); job.status = 'completed'; job.endTime = new Date(); this.logger.log(`Environment restore completed: ${job.id}`); await this.sendRefreshNotification(job); return job; } catch (error) { job.status = 'failed'; job.endTime = new Date(); this.logger.error(`Environment restore failed:`, error.stack); await this.sendRefreshNotification(job, error); throw error; } } private async processBackupForEnvironment( backupPath: string, targetEnvironment: string, options: RefreshJob['options'], ): Promise<string> { const processedPath = `${backupPath}.processed`; if (options.maskSensitiveData) { await this.maskSensitiveData(backupPath, processedPath); } else { await fs.copyFile(backupPath, processedPath); } if (options.preserveUsers) { await this.preserveEnvironmentUsers(processedPath, targetEnvironment); } if (options.preserveConfigs) { await this.preserveEnvironmentConfigs(processedPath, targetEnvironment); } return processedPath; } private async maskSensitiveData(sourcePath: string, targetPath: string): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Masking sensitive data in backup'); // Create a temporary SQL file with data masking commands const maskingScript = ` -- Mask email addresses UPDATE users SET email = CONCAT('user_', id, '@example.com'); -- Mask phone numbers UPDATE users SET phone = CONCAT('555-0', LPAD(id::text, 3, '0')); -- Mask names UPDATE users SET first_name = CONCAT('User', id), last_name = CONCAT('Test', id); -- Mask addresses UPDATE addresses SET street = CONCAT(id, ' Test Street'), city = 'Test City', postal_code = '12345'; -- Remove sensitive logs DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'; -- Reset passwords to a default test value UPDATE users SET password_hash = '$2b$10$test.hash.for.development.environment'; `; const maskingScriptPath = '/tmp/masking-script.sql'; await fs.writeFile(maskingScriptPath, maskingScript); // Apply masking to the backup const dbConfig = this.configService.get('database.production'); const maskCommand = [ 'pg_restore', '--clean', '--if-exists', '--no-owner', '--no-privileges', '--single-transaction', `--host=${dbConfig.host}`, `--port=${dbConfig.port}`, `--username=${dbConfig.username}`, `--dbname=temp_masking_db`, sourcePath, '&&', 'psql', `--host=${dbConfig.host}`, `--port=${dbConfig.port}`, `--username=${dbConfig.username}`, `--dbname=temp_masking_db`, '--file', maskingScriptPath, '&&', 'pg_dump', `--host=${dbConfig.host}`, `--port=${dbConfig.port}`, `--username=${dbConfig.username}`, `--dbname=temp_masking_db`, '--format=custom', '--no-owner', '--no-privileges', `--file=${targetPath}`, ].join(' '); await execAsync(maskCommand, { env: { ...process.env, PGPASSWORD: dbConfig.password }, }); // Cleanup await fs.unlink(maskingScriptPath); } private async stopEnvironmentServices(environment: string): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Stopping services for ${environment} environment`); const namespace = `${environment}-namespace`; const stopCommand = `kubectl scale deployment --all --replicas=0 -n ${namespace}`; try { await execAsync(stopCommand); // Wait for pods to terminate const waitCommand = `kubectl wait --for=delete pod --all -n ${namespace} --timeout=300s`; await execAsync(waitCommand); this.logger.log(`Services stopped for ${environment}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to stop services for ${environment}:`, error.message); throw error; } } private async startEnvironmentServices(environment: string): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Starting services for ${environment} environment`); const namespace = `${environment}-namespace`; const startCommand = `kubectl scale deployment --all --replicas=1 -n ${namespace}`; try { await execAsync(startCommand); // Wait for pods to be ready const waitCommand = `kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod --all -n ${namespace} --timeout=600s`; await execAsync(waitCommand); this.logger.log(`Services started for ${environment}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to start services for ${environment}:`, error.message); throw error; } } private async verifyEnvironmentHealth(environment: string): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Verifying health for ${environment} environment`); const healthCheckUrl = this.configService.get(`environments.${environment}.healthCheckUrl`); if (!healthCheckUrl) { this.logger.warn(`No health check URL configured for ${environment}`); return; } let attempts = 0; const maxAttempts = 10; const delay = 30000; // 30 seconds while (attempts < maxAttempts) { try { const response = await fetch(healthCheckUrl); if (response.ok) { this.logger.log(`Environment ${environment} is healthy`); return; } this.logger.warn(`Health check failed for ${environment}: ${response.status}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.warn(`Health check attempt ${attempts + 1} failed:`, error.message); } attempts++; if (attempts < maxAttempts) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay)); } } throw new Error(`Environment ${environment} failed health checks after ${maxAttempts} attempts`); } private async sendRefreshNotification(job: RefreshJob, error?: Error): Promise<void> { // Implementation similar to backup notifications // Send Slack/Teams notification about refresh status } }

Step 3.1: Test Data Generation and Management​ Duration: 2-3 days Actions: Test Data Generator Service // src/backup/test-data-generator.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { faker } from '@faker-js/faker'; import { DataSource } from 'typeorm'; export interface TestDataConfig { environment: string; userCount: number; productCount: number; orderCount: number; preserveExistingData: boolean; useRealisticData: boolean; } @Injectable() export class TestDataGeneratorService { private readonly logger = new Logger(TestDataGeneratorService.name); constructor(private readonly dataSource: DataSource) {} async generateTestData(config: TestDataConfig): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Generating test data for ${config.environment}`); const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner(); await queryRunner.connect(); await queryRunner.startTransaction(); try { if (!config.preserveExistingData) { await this.clearExistingData(queryRunner); import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Storage } from '@google-cloud/storage'; export interface BackupHealthReport { environment: string; lastBackupTime: Date; backupStatus: 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'critical'; backupSize: number; retentionCompliance: boolean; issues: string[]; } @Injectable() export class BackupMonitoringService { private readonly logger = new Logger(BackupMonitoringService.name); private readonly storage = new Storage(); constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {} @Cron('0 */4 * * *') // Every 4 hours async monitorBackupHealth(): Promise<void> { const environments = ['development', 'staging', 'uat']; for (const environment of environments) { try { const report = await this.generateHealthReport(environment); await this.processHealthReport(report); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Health check failed for ${environment}:`, error.stack); } } } private async generateHealthReport(environment: string): Promise<BackupHealthReport> { const bucketName = this.configService.get('backup.storage.bucket'); const bucket = this.storage.bucket(bucketName); const [files] = await bucket.getFiles({ prefix: `pre-production/${environment}/`, maxResults: 100, }); if (files.length === 0) { return { environment, lastBackupTime: new Date(0), backupStatus: 'critical', backupSize: 0, retentionCompliance: false, issues: ['No backups found'], }; } // Sort by creation time, newest first files.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.metadata.timeCreated).getTime() - new Date(a.metadata.timeCreated).getTime()); const latestBackup = files[0]; const lastBackupTime = new Date(latestBackup.metadata.timeCreated); const backupAge = Date.now() - lastBackupTime.getTime(); const expectedInterval = this.getExpectedBackupInterval(environment); const issues: string[] = []; // Check backup freshness if (backupAge > expectedInterval * 2) { issues.push(`Backup is ${Math.round(backupAge / 3600000)} hours old`); } // Check retention compliance const retentionDays = this.getRetentionDays(environment); const oldBackups = files.filter((file) => { const fileAge = Date.now() - new Date(file.metadata.timeCreated).getTime(); return fileAge > retentionDays * 24 * 3600 * 1000; }); if (oldBackups.length > 0) { issues.push(`${oldBackups.length} backups exceed retention policy`); } const backupStatus = issues.length === 0 ? 'healthy' : issues.length === 1 ? 'warning' : 'critical'; return { environment, lastBackupTime, backupStatus, backupSize: latestBackup.metadata.size, retentionCompliance: oldBackups.length === 0, issues, }; } private async processHealthReport(report: BackupHealthReport): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Backup health report for ${report.environment}: ${report.backupStatus}`); if (report.backupStatus !== 'healthy') { await this.sendHealthAlert(report); } // Store metrics for monitoring dashboard await this.storeHealthMetrics(report); } }

// src/scaling/auto-scaling.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { EventEmitter2 } from '@nestjs/event-emitter'; import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { HttpService } from '@nestjs/axios'; import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs'; export interface ScalingMetrics { timestamp: Date; cpu: { current: number; average: number; target: number; }; memory: { current: number; average: number; target: number; }; requests: { perSecond: number; average: number; target: number; }; responseTime: { current: number; p95: number; target: number; }; queueDepth: { current: number; average: number; target: number; }; errorRate: { current: number; average: number; threshold: number; }; connections: { active: number; average: number; limit: number; }; } export interface ScalingDecision { action: 'scale-up' | 'scale-down' | 'no-action'; type: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'; currentInstances: number; targetInstances: number; reason: string; confidence: number; estimatedDuration: number; costImpact: number; } export interface ScalingPolicy { name: string; service: string; enabled: boolean; minInstances: number; maxInstances: number; targetCpuUtilization: number; targetMemoryUtilization: number; targetRequestsPerSecond: number; targetResponseTime: number; scaleUpCooldown: number; scaleDownCooldown: number; scaleUpPolicy: { threshold: number; periodSeconds: number; step: number; }; scaleDownPolicy: { threshold: number; periodSeconds: number; step: number; }; predictiveScaling: { enabled: boolean; lookAheadMinutes: number; confidenceThreshold: number; }; } @Injectable() export class AutoScalingService { private readonly logger = new Logger(AutoScalingService.name); private scalingPolicies: Map<string, ScalingPolicy> = new Map(); private lastScalingAction: Map<string, Date> = new Map(); private metricsHistory: Map<string, ScalingMetrics[]> = new Map(); constructor( private readonly eventEmitter: EventEmitter2, private readonly httpService: HttpService ) { this.initializeScalingPolicies(); } private initializeScalingPolicies(): void { const policies: ScalingPolicy[] = [ { name: 'api-gateway-scaling', service: 'api-gateway', enabled: true, minInstances: 2, maxInstances: 20, targetCpuUtilization: 70, targetMemoryUtilization: 80, targetRequestsPerSecond: 100, targetResponseTime: 200, scaleUpCooldown: 300, // 5 minutes scaleDownCooldown: 600, // 10 minutes scaleUpPolicy: { threshold: 80, periodSeconds: 60, step: 2, }, scaleDownPolicy: { threshold: 50, periodSeconds: 300, step: 1, }, predictiveScaling: { enabled: true, lookAheadMinutes: 30, confidenceThreshold: 0.8, }, }, { name: 'user-service-scaling', service: 'user-service', enabled: true, minInstances: 1, maxInstances: 10, targetCpuUtilization: 65, targetMemoryUtilization: 75, targetRequestsPerSecond: 50, targetResponseTime: 150, scaleUpCooldown: 180, scaleDownCooldown: 480, scaleUpPolicy: { threshold: 75, periodSeconds: 60, step: 1, }, scaleDownPolicy: { threshold: 40, periodSeconds: 300, step: 1, }, predictiveScaling: { enabled: false, lookAheadMinutes: 15, confidenceThreshold: 0.7, }, }, { name: 'product-service-scaling', service: 'product-service', enabled: true, minInstances: 2, maxInstances: 15, targetCpuUtilization: 60, targetMemoryUtilization: 70, targetRequestsPerSecond: 75, targetResponseTime: 180, scaleUpCooldown: 240, scaleDownCooldown: 540, scaleUpPolicy: { threshold: 70, periodSeconds: 90, step: 2, }, scaleDownPolicy: { threshold: 35, periodSeconds: 360, step: 1, }, predictiveScaling: { enabled: true, lookAheadMinutes: 45, confidenceThreshold: 0.75, }, }, ]; policies.forEach(policy => { this.scalingPolicies.set(policy.service, policy); }); this.logger.log(`Initialized ${policies.length} scaling policies`); } @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_30_SECONDS) async evaluateScaling(): Promise<void> { this.logger.debug('Evaluating auto-scaling decisions'); for (const [serviceName, policy] of this.scalingPolicies) { if (!policy.enabled) continue; try { const metrics = await this.collectServiceMetrics(serviceName); this.updateMetricsHistory(serviceName, metrics); const decision = await this.makeScalingDecision(serviceName, policy, metrics); if (decision.action !== 'no-action') { this.logger.log( `Scaling decision for ${serviceName}: ${decision.action} from ${decision.currentInstances} to ${decision.targetInstances} (${decision.reason})` ); await this.executeScalingDecision(serviceName, decision); } } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to evaluate scaling for ${serviceName}`, error); } } } private async collectServiceMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics> { try { // Collect metrics from Prometheus/monitoring system const [cpuMetrics, memoryMetrics, requestMetrics, responseTimeMetrics, queueMetrics] = await Promise.all([ this.getCpuMetrics(serviceName), this.getMemoryMetrics(serviceName), this.getRequestMetrics(serviceName), this.getResponseTimeMetrics(serviceName), this.getQueueMetrics(serviceName), ]); const metrics: ScalingMetrics = { timestamp: new Date(), cpu: cpuMetrics, memory: memoryMetrics, requests: requestMetrics, responseTime: responseTimeMetrics, queueDepth: queueMetrics, errorRate: await this.getErrorRateMetrics(serviceName), connections: await this.getConnectionMetrics(serviceName), }; return metrics; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to collect metrics for ${serviceName}`, error); throw error; } } private async getCpuMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['cpu']> { // Query Prometheus for CPU metrics const query = `avg(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="${serviceName}"}[5m])) * 100`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { current: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'cpu', 300), // 5 minutes target: this.scalingPolicies.get(serviceName)?.targetCpuUtilization || 70, }; } private async getMemoryMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['memory']> { const query = `avg(container_memory_usage_bytes{container="${serviceName}"} / container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{container="${serviceName}"}) * 100`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { current: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'memory', 300), target: this.scalingPolicies.get(serviceName)?.targetMemoryUtilization || 80, }; } private async getRequestMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['requests']> { const query = `sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="${serviceName}"}[1m]))`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { perSecond: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'requests', 300), target: this.scalingPolicies.get(serviceName)?.targetRequestsPerSecond || 100, }; } private async getResponseTimeMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['responseTime']> { const currentQuery = `avg(http_request_duration_seconds{service="${serviceName}"}) * 1000`; const p95Query = `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="${serviceName}"}[5m])) * 1000`; const [currentResult, p95Result] = await Promise.all([ this.queryPrometheus(currentQuery), this.queryPrometheus(p95Query), ]); return { current: parseFloat(currentResult.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), p95: parseFloat(p95Result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), target: this.scalingPolicies.get(serviceName)?.targetResponseTime || 200, }; } private async getQueueMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['queueDepth']> { const query = `avg(queue_depth{service="${serviceName}"})`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { current: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'queue', 300), target: 30, // Default queue depth target }; } private async getErrorRateMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['errorRate']> { const query = `(sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="${serviceName}",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="${serviceName}"}[5m]))) * 100`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { current: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'error_rate', 300), threshold: 5, // 5% error rate threshold }; } private async getConnectionMetrics(serviceName: string): Promise<ScalingMetrics['connections']> { const query = `avg(active_connections{service="${serviceName}"})`; const result = await this.queryPrometheus(query); return { active: parseFloat(result.data.result[0]?.value[1] || '0'), average: await this.getAverageMetric(serviceName, 'connections', 300), limit: 1000, // Default connection limit }; } private async queryPrometheus(query: string): Promise<any> { try { const response = await firstValueFrom( this.httpService.get('/api/v1/query', { params: { query }, baseURL: process.env.PROMETHEUS_URL || 'http://prometheus:9090', }) ); return response.data; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Prometheus query failed: ${query}`, error); throw error; } } private async getAverageMetric(serviceName: string, metricType: string, periodSeconds: number): Promise<number> { const history = this.metricsHistory.get(serviceName) || []; const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - periodSeconds * 1000); const recentMetrics = history.filter(m => m.timestamp >= cutoff); if (recentMetrics.length === 0) return 0; const sum = recentMetrics.reduce((acc, m) => { switch (metricType) { case 'cpu': return acc + m.cpu.current; case 'memory': return acc + m.memory.current; case 'requests': return acc + m.requests.perSecond; case 'queue': return acc + m.queueDepth.current; case 'error_rate': return acc + m.errorRate.current; case 'connections': return acc + m.connections.active; default: return acc; } }, 0); return sum / recentMetrics.length; } private updateMetricsHistory(serviceName: string, metrics: ScalingMetrics): void { const history = this.metricsHistory.get(serviceName) || []; history.push(metrics); // Keep only last hour of metrics const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 3600 * 1000); const filteredHistory = history.filter(m => m.timestamp >= cutoff); this.metricsHistory.set(serviceName, filteredHistory); } private async makeScalingDecision( serviceName: string, policy: ScalingPolicy, metrics: ScalingMetrics ): Promise<ScalingDecision> { const currentInstances = await this.getCurrentInstanceCount(serviceName); // Check cooldown periods const lastAction = this.lastScalingAction.get(serviceName); if (lastAction) { const timeSinceLastAction = Date.now() - lastAction.getTime(); const cooldownPeriod = policy.scaleUpCooldown * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds if (timeSinceLastAction < cooldownPeriod) { return { action: 'no-action', type: 'horizontal', currentInstances, targetInstances: currentInstances, reason: 'Cooldown period active', confidence: 1.0, estimatedDuration: 0, costImpact: 0, }; This guide establishes comprehensive architecture roadmap planning and management processes for NestJS microservices and Next.js microfrontend applications, covering strategic technical planning, milestone tracking, technology evolution, and alignment with business objectives through systematic roadmap development and execution.

Architecture roadmap management ensures that technical development aligns with business goals through systematic planning, milestone tracking, and continuous adaptation. This process involves strategic technology planning, resource allocation, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication to deliver value-driven technical outcomes.
