} export interface UpdateUserRequest { name?: string; email?: string; } // src/services/user.service.ts import { User, CreateUserRequest, UpdateUserRequest } from '../models/user.model'; import { UserRepository } from '../repositories/user.repository'; import { hashPassword, validateEmail } from '../utils/auth.utils'; import { ValidationError, NotFoundError } from '../utils/errors'; export class UserService { constructor(private userRepository: UserRepository) {} async createUser(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<User> { // Validate input if (!validateEmail(userData.email)) { throw new ValidationError('Invalid email format'); } // Check if user already exists const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findByEmail(userData.email); if (existingUser) { throw new ValidationError('User with this email already exists'); } // Hash password const hashedPassword = await hashPassword(userData.password); // Create user const user = await this.userRepository.create({ ...userData, password: hashedPassword, }); return user; } async getUserById(id: string): Promise<User> { const user = await this.userRepository.findById(id); if (!user) { throw new NotFoundError(`User with id ${id} not found`); } return user; } async updateUser(id: string, updateData: UpdateUserRequest): Promise<User> { const user = await this.getUserById(id); if (updateData.email && updateData.email !== user.email) { if (!validateEmail(updateData.email)) { throw new ValidationError('Invalid email format'); } const existingUser = await this.userRepository.findByEmail(updateData.email); if (existingUser && existingUser.id !== id) { throw new ValidationError('Email already in use'); } } return this.userRepository.update(id, updateData); } async deleteUser(id: string): Promise<void> { const user = await this.getUserById(id); await this.userRepository.delete(id); } } // src/controllers/user.controller.ts import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; import { UserService } from '../services/user.service'; import { CreateUserRequest, UpdateUserRequest } from '../models/user.model'; import { logger } from '../utils/logger'; export class UserController { constructor(private userService: UserService) {} createUser = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { try { const userData: CreateUserRequest = req.body; const user = await this.userService.createUser(userData); logger.info('User created successfully', { userId: user.id }); res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, createdAt: user.createdAt, }, }); } catch (error) { next(error); } }; getUser = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { try { const { id } = req.params; const user = await this.userService.getUserById(id); res.json({ success: true, data: { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, createdAt: user.createdAt, updatedAt: user.updatedAt, }, }); } catch (error) { next(error); } }; updateUser = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { try { const { id } = req.params; const updateData: UpdateUserRequest = req.body; const user = await this.userService.updateUser(id, updateData); logger.info('User updated successfully', { userId: id }); res.json({ success: true, data: { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name, updatedAt: user.updatedAt, }, }); } catch (error) { next(error); } }; deleteUser = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { try { const { id } = req.params; await this.userService.deleteUser(id); logger.info('User deleted successfully', { userId: id }); res.status(204).send(); } catch (error) { next(error); } }; }

// src/utils/errors.ts export abstract class AppError extends Error { abstract statusCode: number; abstract type: string; constructor(message: string, public context?: Record<string, any>) { super(message); this.name = this.constructor.name; Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor); } } export class ValidationError extends AppError { statusCode = 400; type = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'; } export class NotFoundError extends AppError { statusCode = 404; type = 'NOT_FOUND'; } export class UnauthorizedError extends AppError { statusCode = 401; type = 'UNAUTHORIZED'; } export class ForbiddenError extends AppError { statusCode = 403; type = 'FORBIDDEN'; } export class ConflictError extends AppError { statusCode = 409; type = 'CONFLICT'; } export class InternalServerError extends AppError { statusCode = 500; type = 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR'; }

// src/middleware/error.middleware.ts import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; import { AppError } from '../utils/errors'; import { logger } from '../utils/logger'; export function errorHandler( error: Error, req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction ) { logger.error('Error occurred:', { message: error.message, stack: error.stack, url: req.url, method: req.method, userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'), ip: req.ip, }); // Handle known application errors if (error instanceof AppError) { return res.status(error.statusCode).json({ success: false, error: { type: error.type, message: error.message, ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && { context: error.context }), }, }); } // Handle validation errors from libraries like Joi, Yup if (error.name === 'ValidationError') { return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { type: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Invalid input data', details: error.message, }, }); } // Handle MongoDB duplicate key errors if (error.name === 'MongoError' && (error as any).code === 11000) { return res.status(409).json({ success: false, error: { type: 'DUPLICATE_KEY', message: 'Resource already exists', }, }); } // Default to 500 server error res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { type: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', message: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'Internal server error' : error.message, }, }); } // 404 handler export function notFoundHandler(req: Request, res: Response) { res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { type: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Route ${req.originalUrl} not found`, }, }); }

// src/app.ts process.on('uncaughtException', (error: Error) => { logger.error('Uncaught Exception:', error); process.exit(1); }); process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason: any, promise: Promise<any>) => { logger.error('Unhandled Rejection at:', promise, 'reason:', reason); process.exit(1); }); // Graceful shutdown process.on('SIGTERM', () => { logger.info('SIGTERM received, shutting down gracefully'); server.close(() => { logger.info('Process terminated'); process.exit(0); }); });

// ❌ Bad - Not handling errors properly async function fetchUserData(userId: string) { const user = await userService.getUserById(userId); const orders = await orderService.getOrdersByUserId(userId); return { user, orders }; } // ✅ Good - Proper error handling async function fetchUserData(userId: string): Promise<{ user: User; orders: Order[] }> { try { const [user, orders] = await Promise.all([ userService.getUserById(userId), orderService.getOrdersByUserId(userId), ]); return { user, orders }; } catch (error) { logger.error('Failed to fetch user data', { userId, error }); throw new InternalServerError('Failed to fetch user data'); } }

// Parallel execution with Promise.all async function fetchUserProfile(userId: string) { try { const [user, profile, preferences] = await Promise.all([ userService.getUserById(userId), profileService.getProfileByUserId(userId), preferencesService.getPreferences(userId), ]); return { user, profile, preferences }; } catch (error) { // If any promise fails, all fail throw error; } } // Sequential execution with fallbacks async function fetchUserWithFallback(userId: string) { try { // Try primary data source return await primaryUserService.getUserById(userId); } catch (primaryError) { logger.warn('Primary service failed, trying backup', { userId, error: primaryError }); try { // Fallback to secondary data source return await backupUserService.getUserById(userId); } catch (backupError) { logger.error('Both services failed', { userId, primaryError, backupError }); throw new InternalServerError('User service unavailable'); } } } // Promise.allSettled for partial failures async function fetchMultipleUsers(userIds: string[]) { const results = await Promise.allSettled( userIds.map(id => userService.getUserById(id)) ); const users: User[] = []; const errors: string[] = []; results.forEach((result, index) => { if (result.status === 'fulfilled') { users.push(result.value); } else { errors.push(`Failed to fetch user ${userIds[index]}: ${result.reason.message}`); } }); return { users, errors }; }

// src/utils/rate-limiter.ts import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; interface RateLimitOptions { windowMs: number; max: number; message?: string; } const store = new Map<string, { count: number; resetTime: number }>(); export function rateLimit(options: RateLimitOptions) { return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { const key = req.ip || 'unknown'; const now = Date.now(); let record = store.get(key); if (!record || now > record.resetTime) { record = { count: 1, resetTime: now + options.windowMs, }; store.set(key, record); return next(); } if (record.count >= options.max) { return res.status(429).json({ success: false, error: { type: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', message: options.message || 'Too many requests', }, }); } record.count++; next(); }; } // Usage app.use('/api', rateLimit({ windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes max: 100, // Limit each IP to 100 requests per windowMs message: 'Too many requests from this IP', }));

// src/middleware/validation.middleware.ts import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; import Joi from 'joi'; import { ValidationError } from '../utils/errors'; export function validate(schema: Joi.ObjectSchema) { return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { const { error, value } = schema.validate(req.body, { abortEarly: false, stripUnknown: true, }); if (error) { const details = error.details.map(detail => ({ field: detail.path.join('.'), message: detail.message, })); throw new ValidationError('Validation failed', { details }); } req.body = value; next(); }; } // Validation schemas export const createUserSchema = Joi.object({ email: Joi.string().email().required(), name: Joi.string().min(2).max(50).required(), password: Joi.string().min(8).pattern(/^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&]/).required(), age: Joi.number().integer().min(18).max(120).optional(), }); export const updateUserSchema = Joi.object({ email: Joi.string().email().optional(), name: Joi.string().min(2).max(50).optional(), age: Joi.number().integer().min(18).max(120).optional(), });

// src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken'; import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'; import { UnauthorizedError, ForbiddenError } from '../utils/errors'; interface AuthenticatedRequest extends Request { user?: { id: string; email: string; role: string; }; } export function authenticate(req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) { const token = req.headers.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', ''); if (!token) { throw new UnauthorizedError('Access token required'); } try { const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET!) as any; req.user = decoded; next(); } catch (error) { throw new UnauthorizedError('Invalid or expired token'); } } export function authorize(roles: string[]) { return (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => { if (!req.user) { throw new UnauthorizedError('Authentication required'); } if (!roles.includes(req.user.role)) { throw new ForbiddenError('Insufficient permissions'); } next(); }; } // Usage router.get('/admin/users', authenticate, authorize(['admin']), userController.getAllUsers);

// src/utils/sanitization.ts import DOMPurify from 'isomorphic-dompurify'; import validator from 'validator'; export function sanitizeHtml(input: string): string { return DOMPurify.sanitize(input); } export function sanitizeEmail(email: string): string { return validator.normalizeEmail(email) || ''; } export function escapeHtml(unsafe: string): string { return validator.escape(unsafe); } export function sanitizeInput(input: any): any { if (typeof input === 'string') { return validator.escape(input.trim()); } if (Array.isArray(input)) { return input.map(sanitizeInput); } if (typeof input === 'object' && input !== null) { const sanitized: any = {}; for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) { sanitized[key] = sanitizeInput(value); } return sanitized; } return input; }

// src/utils/cache.ts import NodeCache from 'node-cache'; import Redis from 'ioredis'; class CacheService { private memoryCache: NodeCache; private redisClient: Redis; constructor() { this.memoryCache = new NodeCache({ stdTTL: 600, // 10 minutes default TTL checkperiod: 120 // Check for expired keys every 2 minutes }); this.redisClient = new Redis({ host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost', port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379'), retryDelayOnFailover: 100, maxRetriesPerRequest: 3, }); } async get<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> { // Try memory cache first const memoryResult = this.memoryCache.get<T>(key); if (memoryResult !== undefined) { return memoryResult; } // Fallback to Redis try { const redisResult = await this.redisClient.get(key); if (redisResult) { const parsed = JSON.parse(redisResult); // Store in memory cache for faster access this.memoryCache.set(key, parsed, 300); // 5 minutes in memory return parsed; } } catch (error) { logger.warn('Redis cache error:', error); } return null; } async set<T>(key: string, value: T, ttl?: number): Promise<void> { // Store in memory cache this.memoryCache.set(key, value, ttl); // Store in Redis try { const serialized = JSON.stringify(value); if (ttl) { await this.redisClient.setex(key, ttl, serialized); } else { await this.redisClient.set(key, serialized); } } catch (error) { logger.warn('Redis cache set error:', error); } } async del(key: string): Promise<void> { this.memoryCache.del(key); try { await this.redisClient.del(key); } catch (error) { logger.warn('Redis cache delete error:', error); } } async flush(): Promise<void> { this.memoryCache.flushAll(); try { await this.redisClient.flushall(); } catch (error) { logger.warn('Redis cache flush error:', error); } } } export const cache = new CacheService(); // Caching decorator export function cacheable(ttl: number = 600) { return function (target: any, propertyName: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) { const method = descriptor.value; descriptor.value = async function (...args: any[]) { const cacheKey = `${target.constructor.name}:${propertyName}:${JSON.stringify(args)}`; const cached = await cache.get(cacheKey); if (cached !== null) { return cached; } const result = await method.apply(this, args); await cache.set(cacheKey, result, ttl); return result; }; return descriptor; }; }

// src/repositories/user.repository.ts import { User, CreateUserRequest, UpdateUserRequest } from '../models/user.model'; import { cache } from '../utils/cache'; export class UserRepository { @cacheable(300) // Cache for 5 minutes async findById(id: string): Promise<User | null> { // First check cache const cacheKey = `user:${id}`; const cached = await cache.get<User>(cacheKey); if (cached) { return cached; } const user = await this.db.collection('users').findOne({ _id: id }); if (user) { await cache.set(cacheKey, user, 300); } return user; } async create(userData: CreateUserRequest): Promise<User> { const user = await this.db.collection('users').insertOne({ ...userData, createdAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(), }); // Cache the new user await cache.set(`user:${user.insertedId}`, user, 300); return user; } async update(id: string, updateData: UpdateUserRequest): Promise<User> { const user = await this.db.collection('users').findOneAndUpdate( { _id: id }, { $set: { ...updateData, updatedAt: new Date() } }, { returnDocument: 'after' } ); // Update cache if (user.value) { await cache.set(`user:${id}`, user.value, 300); } return user.value!; } async delete(id: string): Promise<void> { await this.db.collection('users').deleteOne({ _id: id }); // Remove from cache await cache.del(`user:${id}`); } }

// src/utils/logger.ts import winston from 'winston'; const logFormat = winston.format.combine( winston.format.timestamp(), winston.format.errors({ stack: true }), winston.format.json() ); export const logger = winston.createLogger({ level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info', format: logFormat, defaultMeta: { service: process.env.SERVICE_NAME || 'api', version: process.env.APP_VERSION || '1.0.0', }, transports: [ new winston.transports.Console({ format: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? winston.format.combine( winston.format.colorize(), winston.format.simple() ) : logFormat, }), // File transport for production ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? [ new winston.transports.File({ filename: 'logs/error.log', level: 'error', }), new winston.transports.File({ filename: 'logs/combined.log', }), ] : []), ], }); // Request logging middleware export function requestLogger(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) { const start = Date.now(); res.on('finish', () => { const duration = Date.now() - start; logger.info('HTTP Request', { method: req.method, url: req.url, statusCode: res.statusCode, duration, userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'), ip: req.ip, }); }); next(); }

// src/routes/health.routes.ts import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express'; import { cache } from '../utils/cache'; import { database } from '../config/database'; const router = Router(); router.get('/health', async (req: Request, res: Response) => { const healthcheck = { uptime: process.uptime(), message: 'OK', timestamp: Date.now(), checks: { database: await checkDatabase(), cache: await checkCache(), memory: checkMemory(), }, }; const isHealthy = Object.values(healthcheck.checks).every(check => check.status === 'ok'); res.status(isHealthy ? 200 : 503).json(healthcheck); }); async function checkDatabase() { try { await database.ping(); return { status: 'ok', message: 'Database connection is healthy' }; } catch (error) { return { status: 'error', message: 'Database connection failed' }; } } async function checkCache() { try { await cache.set('health-check', 'ok', 10); const result = await cache.get('health-check'); return result === 'ok' ? { status: 'ok', message: 'Cache is working' } : { status: 'error', message: 'Cache read/write failed' }; } catch (error) { return { status: 'error', message: 'Cache connection failed' }; } } function checkMemory() { const memUsage = process.memoryUsage(); const memoryUsageMB = { rss: Math.round(memUsage.rss / 1024 / 1024), heapTotal: Math.round(memUsage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024), heapUsed: Math.round(memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024), external: Math.round(memUsage.external / 1024 / 1024), }; return { status: memoryUsageMB.heapUsed < 512 ? 'ok' : 'warning', usage: memoryUsageMB, }; } export { router as healthRoutes };

Try to use JSX shorthand for passing boolean variables. Let's say you want to control the title visibility of a Navbar component. Bad: return ( <Navbar showTitle={true} /> ); Good: return( <Navbar showTitle /> ) ↥ back to top

Let's say you want to show a particular user's details based on role. Bad: const { role } = user; if(role === ADMIN) { return <AdminUser /> }else{ return <NormalUser /> } Good: const { role } = user; return role === ADMIN ? <AdminUser /> : <NormalUser /> ↥ back to top

Object literals can help make our code more readable. Let's say you want to show three types of users based on their role. You can't use ternary because the number of options is greater than two. Bad: const {role} = user switch(role){ case ADMIN: return <AdminUser /> case EMPLOYEE: return <EmployeeUser /> case USER: return <NormalUser /> } Good: const {role} = user const components = { ADMIN: AdminUser, EMPLOYEE: EmployeeUser, USER: NormalUser }; const Component = components[role]; return <Componenent />; ↥ back to top

Always use Fragment over Div. It keeps the code clean and is also beneficial for performance because one less node is created in the virtual DOM. Bad: return (
) Good: return ( <> ) ↥ back to top

Don't define a function inside render. Try to keep the logic inside render to an absolute minimum. Bad: return ( <button onClick={() => dispatch(ACTION_TO_SEND_DATA)}> // NOTICE HERE This is a bad example </button> ) Good: const submitData = () => dispatch(ACTION_TO_SEND_DATA) return ( <button onClick={submitData}> This is a good example </button> ) ↥ back to top

React.PureComponent and Memo can significantly improve the performance of your application. They help us to avoid unnecessary rendering. Bad: import React, { useState } from "react"; export const TestMemo = () => { const [userName, setUserName] = useState("faisal"); const [count, setCount] = useState(0); const increment = () => setCount((count) => count + 1); return ( <> ); }; const ChildrenComponent =({ userName }) => { console.log("rendered", userName); return
{userName}
; }; Although the child component should render only once because the value of count has nothing to do with the ChildComponent. But, it renders each time you click on the button. Output Let's edit the ChildrenComponent to this: Good: import React ,{useState} from "react"; const ChildrenComponent = React.memo(({userName}) => { console.log('rendered') return
{userName}
}) Now no matter how many times you click on the button, it will render only when necessary. ↥ back to top

Good: const bodyStyle = { height: "10px" } return
↥ back to top

Move any JS code out of JSX if that doesn't serve any purpose of rendering or UI functionality. Bad: return (
    {posts.map((post) => (
  • { console.log(event.target, 'clicked!'); // <- THIS IS BAD }} key={post.id}>{post.title}
    • ))}
); Good: const onClickHandler = (event) => { console.log(event.target, 'clicked!'); } return (
    {posts.map((post) => (
  • {post.title}
    • ))}
); ↥ back to top

Use template literals to build large strings. Avoid using string concatenation. It's nice and clean. Bad: const userDetails = user.name + "'s profession is" + user.proffession return (
{userDetails}
) Good: const userDetails = `${user.name}'s profession is ${user.proffession}` return (
{userDetails}
) ↥ back to top

Always try to import things in a certain order. It improves code readability. Bad: import React from 'react'; import ErrorImg from '../../assets/images/error.png'; import styled from 'styled-components/native'; import colors from '../../styles/colors'; import { PropTypes } from 'prop-types'; Good: The rule of thumb is to keep the import order like this: Built-in External Internal So the example above becomes: import React from 'react'; import { PropTypes } from 'prop-types'; import styled from 'styled-components/native'; import ErrorImg from '../../assets/images/error.png'; import colors from '../../styles/colors'; ↥ back to top

Use the JavaScript feature of implicit return to write beautiful code. Let's say your function does a simple calculation and returns the result. Bad: const add = (a, b) => { return a + b; } Good: const add = (a, b) => a + b; ↥ back to top

Always use PascalCase for components and camelCase for instances. Bad: import reservationCard from './ReservationCard'; const ReservationItem = <ReservationCard />; Good: import ReservationCard from './ReservationCard'; const reservationItem = <ReservationCard />; ↥ back to top

Do not use DOM component prop names for passing props between components because others might not expect these names. Bad: <MyComponent style="dark" /> <MyComponent className="dark" /> Good: <MyComponent variant="fancy" /> ↥ back to top
Use double quotes for JSX attributes and single quotes for all other JS. Bad: <Foo bar='bar' /> <Foo style={{ left: "20px" }} /> Good: <Foo bar="bar" /> <Foo style={{ left: '20px' }} /> ↥ back to top

Always use camelCase for prop names or PascalCase if the prop value is a React component. Bad: <Component UserName="hello" phone_number={12345678} /> Good: <MyComponent userName="hello" phoneNumber={12345678} Component={SomeComponent} /> ↥ back to top

If your component spans more than one line, always wrap it in parentheses. Bad: return <MyComponent variant="long"> <MyChild /> </MyComponent>; Good: return ( <MyComponent variant="long"> <MyChild /> </MyComponent> ); ↥ back to top

If your component doesn't have any children, then use self-closing tags. It improves readability. Bad: <SomeComponent variant="stuff"></SomeComponent> Good: <SomeComponent variant="stuff" /> ↥ back to top
Do not use underscores in any internal React method. Bad: const _onClickHandler = () => { // do stuff } Good: const onClickHandler = () => { // do stuff } ↥ back to top

Always include an alt prop in your tags. And do not use picture or image in your alt property because the screenreaders already announce img elements as images. No need to include that. Bad: Good: ↥ back to top

True!

: null }; Good: // Recommended: short-circuit evaluation const sampleComponent = () => { return isTrue &&

// src/hooks/useApi.ts import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'; interface UseApiOptions<T> { initialData?: T; onSuccess?: (data: T) => void; onError?: (error: Error) => void; dependencies?: any[]; } interface UseApiReturn<T> { data: T | null; loading: boolean; error: Error | null; refetch: () => Promise<void>; reset: () => void; } export function useApi<T>(apiFunction: () => Promise<T>, options: UseApiOptions<T> = {}): UseApiReturn<T> { const { initialData = null, onSuccess, onError, dependencies = [] } = options; const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(initialData); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null); const mountedRef = useRef(true); const fetchData = useCallback(async () => { if (!mountedRef.current) return; setLoading(true); setError(null); try { const result = await apiFunction(); if (mountedRef.current) { setData(result); onSuccess?.(result); } } catch (err) { if (mountedRef.current) { const error = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error('Unknown error'); setError(error); onError?.(error); } } finally { if (mountedRef.current) { setLoading(false); } } }, [apiFunction, onSuccess, onError]); const reset = useCallback(() => { setData(initialData); setError(null); setLoading(false); }, [initialData]); useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, dependencies); useEffect(() => { return () => { mountedRef.current = false; }; }, []); return { data, loading, error, refetch: fetchData, reset, }; } // src/hooks/useLocalStorage.ts import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'; export function useLocalStorage<T>( key: string, initialValue: T, ): [T, (value: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void, () => void] { const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState<T>(() => { try { const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key); return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue; } catch (error) { console.error(`Error reading localStorage key "${key}":`, error); return initialValue; } }); const setValue = useCallback( (value: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => { try { const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value; setStoredValue(valueToStore); window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore)); } catch (error) { console.error(`Error setting localStorage key "${key}":`, error); } }, [key, storedValue], ); const removeValue = useCallback(() => { try { window.localStorage.removeItem(key); setStoredValue(initialValue); } catch (error) { console.error(`Error removing localStorage key "${key}":`, error); } }, [key, initialValue]); useEffect(() => { const handleStorageChange = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === key && e.newValue) { try { setStoredValue(JSON.parse(e.newValue)); } catch (error) { console.error(`Error parsing localStorage value for key "${key}":`, error); } } }; window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange); return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange); }, [key]); return [storedValue, setValue, removeValue]; } // src/hooks/useDebounce.ts import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T { const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value); useEffect(() => { const handler = setTimeout(() => { setDebouncedValue(value); }, delay); return () => { clearTimeout(handler); }; }, [value, delay]); return debouncedValue; }

{ ...item, quantity: item.quantity + 1 } : item, ); } else { newItems = [...state.items, { ...action.payload, quantity: 1 }]; } return { ...state, items: newItems, total: calculateTotal(newItems), itemCount: calculateItemCount(newItems), }; } case 'REMOVE_ITEM': { const newItems = state.items.filter((item) => item.id !== action.payload.id); return { ...state, items: newItems, total: calculateTotal(newItems), itemCount: calculateItemCount(newItems), }; } case 'UPDATE_QUANTITY': { const newItems = state.items .map((item) => item.id === action.payload.id ? { ...item, quantity: Math.max(0, action.payload.quantity) } : item, ) .filter((item) => item.quantity > 0); return { ...state, items: newItems, total: calculateTotal(newItems), itemCount: calculateItemCount(newItems), }; } case 'CLEAR_CART': return { items: [], total: 0, itemCount: 0, }; case 'SET_CART': { return { ...state, items: action.payload, total: calculateTotal(action.payload), itemCount: calculateItemCount(action.payload), }; } default: return state; } }; const calculateTotal = (items: CartItem[]): number => { return items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.price * item.quantity, 0); }; const calculateItemCount = (items: CartItem[]): number => { return items.reduce((count, item) => count + item.quantity, 0); }; export const useShoppingCart = () => { const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(cartReducer, { items: [], total: 0, itemCount: 0, }); const addItem = useCallback((item: Omit<CartItem, 'quantity'>) => { dispatch({ type: 'ADD_ITEM', payload: item }); }, []); const removeItem = useCallback((id: string) => { dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_ITEM', payload: { id } }); }, []); const updateQuantity = useCallback((id: string, quantity: number) => { dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_QUANTITY', payload: { id, quantity } }); }, []); const clearCart = useCallback(() => { dispatch({ type: 'CLEAR_CART' }); }, []); const isItemInCart = useCallback( (id: string): boolean => { return state.items.some((item) => item.id === id); }, [state.items], ); const getItemQuantity = useCallback( (id: string): number => { const item = state.items.find((item) => item.id === id); return item?.quantity || 0; }, [state.items], ); const cartSummary = useMemo( () => ({ subtotal: state.total, tax: state.total * 0.08, // 8% tax shipping: state.total > 50 ? 0 : 10, // Free shipping over $50 total: state.total + state.total * 0.08 + (state.total > 50 ? 0 : 10), }), [state.total], ); return { ...state, addItem, removeItem, updateQuantity, clearCart, isItemInCart, getItemQuantity, cartSummary, }; };

Comprehensive TypeScript development guidelines for building type-safe, maintainable applications.
Type Safety Principles Interface Design Advanced Types Generic Programming Error Handling Performance Optimization

// tsconfig.json { "compilerOptions": { "strict": true, "noImplicitAny": true, "noImplicitReturns": true, "noUnusedLocals": true, "noUnusedParameters": true, "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true, "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true } }

// ❌ Bad - Implicit any function processUser(user) { return user.name.toUpperCase(); } // ✅ Good - Explicit types interface User { id: string; name: string; email: string; age: number; isActive: boolean; } function processUser(user: User): string { return user.name.toUpperCase(); }

// ❌ Bad function fetchData(): any { return fetch('/api/data').then(res => res.json()); } // ✅ Good interface ApiResponse<T> { data: T; status: number; message: string; } async function fetchData<T>(): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> { const response = await fetch('/api/data'); return response.json() as ApiResponse<T>; } // Usage with specific type interface UserData { users: User[]; total: number; } const userData = await fetchData<UserData>();

// ❌ Bad - Vague interface interface Data { stuff: any; things: object; } // ✅ Good - Clear and specific interface UserProfile { readonly id: string; personalInfo: { firstName: string; lastName: string; email: string; dateOfBirth?: Date; }; preferences: { theme: 'light' | 'dark'; notifications: boolean; language: string; }; metadata: { createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date; version: number; }; }

interface CreateUserRequest { // Required fields firstName: string; lastName: string; email: string; // Optional fields age?: number; phoneNumber?: string; preferences?: UserPreferences; } interface UpdateUserRequest { // ID is required for updates id: string; // All other fields are optional for partial updates firstName?: string; lastName?: string; email?: string; age?: number; }

interface BaseEntity { id: string; createdAt: Date; updatedAt: Date; } interface User extends BaseEntity { name: string; email: string; role: UserRole; } interface AdminUser extends User { permissions: Permission[]; lastLoginAt?: Date; } // Interface composition interface UserWithProfile extends User { profile: UserProfile; }

type Status = 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected'; type Theme = 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto'; interface Task { id: string; title: string; status: Status; priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; } // Discriminated unions interface LoadingState { type: 'loading'; } interface SuccessState { type: 'success'; data: User[]; } interface ErrorState { type: 'error'; error: string; } type AsyncState = LoadingState | SuccessState | ErrorState; function handleState(state: AsyncState) { switch (state.type) { case 'loading': return 'Loading...'; case 'success': return `Loaded ${state.data.length} users`; case 'error': return `Error: ${state.error}`; default: // TypeScript ensures exhaustive checking const _exhaustive: never = state; return _exhaustive; } }

// Make all properties optional type Partial<T> = { [P in keyof T]?: T[P]; }; // Make all properties required type Required<T> = { [P in keyof T]-?: T[P]; }; // Pick specific properties type UserSummary = Pick<User, 'id' | 'name' | 'email'>; // Omit specific properties type CreateUserData = Omit<User, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>; // Custom mapped types type Nullable<T> = { [P in keyof T]: T[P] | null; }; type StringKeys<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] extends string ? K : never; }[keyof T]; // Usage type UserStringKeys = StringKeys<User>; // 'name' | 'email'

// Basic conditional type type NonNullable<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T; // More complex conditional type type ApiResponse<T> = T extends string ? { message: T } : T extends number ? { code: T } : { data: T }; // Infer keyword type ReturnType<T> = T extends (...args: any[]) => infer R ? R : any; // Utility conditional types type Flatten<T> = T extends (infer U)[] ? U : T; type Deep<T> = { [P in keyof T]: T[P] extends object ? Deep<T[P]> : T[P]; };

// Basic generic function function identity<T>(arg: T): T { return arg; } // Multiple type parameters function pair<T, U>(first: T, second: U): [T, U] { return [first, second]; } // Constrained generics interface Lengthwise { length: number; } function logLength<T extends Lengthwise>(arg: T): T { console.log(arg.length); return arg; } // Usage logLength('hello'); // ✅ Works logLength([1, 2, 3]); // ✅ Works logLength({ length: 10, value: 3 }); // ✅ Works // logLength(3); // ❌ Error: number doesn't have length

class Repository<T extends BaseEntity> { private items: T[] = []; add(item: T): void { this.items.push(item); } findById(id: string): T | undefined { return this.items.find(item => item.id === id); } update(id: string, updates: Partial<T>): T | undefined { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.id === id); if (index !== -1) { this.items[index] = { ...this.items[index], ...updates }; return this.items[index]; } return undefined; } delete(id: string): boolean { const index = this.items.findIndex(item => item.id === id); if (index !== -1) { this.items.splice(index, 1); return true; } return false; } } // Usage const userRepository = new Repository<User>(); const taskRepository = new Repository<Task>();

function getProperty<T, K extends keyof T>(obj: T, key: K): T[K] { return obj[key]; } function setProperty<T, K extends keyof T>( obj: T, key: K, value: T[K] ): void { obj[key] = value; } // Usage const user: User = { id: '1', name: 'John', email: 'john@example.com' }; const name = getProperty(user, 'name'); // Type is string const id = getProperty(user, 'id'); // Type is string // const invalid = getProperty(user, 'invalid'); // ❌ Error

type Result<T, E = Error> = | { success: true; data: T } | { success: false; error: E }; async function safeApiCall<T>( apiCall: () => Promise<T> ): Promise<Result<T>> { try { const data = await apiCall(); return { success: true, data }; } catch (error) { return { success: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)) }; } } // Usage async function fetchUser(id: string): Promise<Result<User>> { return safeApiCall(() => api.get<User>(`/users/${id}`)); } const result = await fetchUser('123'); if (result.success) { console.log(result.data.name); // Type-safe access } else { console.error(result.error.message); }

abstract class AppError extends Error { abstract readonly statusCode: number; abstract readonly type: string; constructor(message: string, public readonly context?: Record<string, any>) { super(message); this.name = this.constructor.name; } } class ValidationError extends AppError { readonly statusCode = 400; readonly type = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'; constructor( message: string, public readonly field: string, context?: Record<string, any> ) { super(message, context); } } class NotFoundError extends AppError { readonly statusCode = 404; readonly type = 'NOT_FOUND'; } class UnauthorizedError extends AppError { readonly statusCode = 401; readonly type = 'UNAUTHORIZED'; } // Error handling function function handleError(error: AppError): Response { switch (error.type) { case 'VALIDATION_ERROR': return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message, field: (error as ValidationError).field }), { status: error.statusCode }); case 'NOT_FOUND': return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: error.message }), { status: error.statusCode }); default: return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Internal server error' }), { status: 500 }); } }

// ❌ Bad - Imports both type and value import { User, createUser } from './user.service'; // ✅ Good - Separate type and value imports import type { User } from './user.types'; import { createUser } from './user.service'; // ✅ Mixed imports import { createUser, type User, type UserPreferences } from './user.service';

// ❌ Bad - Recreating interface interface UserResponse { id: string; name: string; email: string; // ... duplicate all User properties } // ✅ Good - Reuse existing types type UserResponse = User & { lastLoginAt: Date; preferences: UserPreferences; }; // ✅ Good - Transform existing types type UserSummary = Pick<User, 'id' | 'name' | 'email'>; type CreateUserRequest = Omit<User, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>;

// For large applications, use dynamic imports for types type LazyUserModule = typeof import('./user.module'); async function loadUserModule(): Promise<LazyUserModule> { return import('./user.module'); } // Conditional type loading type ConditionalUser<T extends boolean> = T extends true ? import('./full-user').User : import('./basic-user').User;

src/ ├── types/ │ ├── api.types.ts # API response types │ ├── user.types.ts # User-related types │ └── common.types.ts # Shared types ├── services/ │ ├── user.service.ts │ └── api.service.ts ├── utils/ │ ├── type-guards.ts # Type guard functions │ └── type-utils.ts # Type utility functions └── index.ts

// Type guard functions function isString(value: unknown): value is string { return typeof value === 'string'; } function isUser(value: unknown): value is User { return ( typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'id' in value && 'name' in value && 'email' in value && isString((value as any).id) && isString((value as any).name) && isString((value as any).email) ); } function isArrayOf<T>( value: unknown, guard: (item: unknown) => item is T ): value is T[] { return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(guard); } // Usage function processUserData(data: unknown) { if (isUser(data)) { // data is now typed as User console.log(data.name); } if (isArrayOf(data, isUser)) { // data is now typed as User[] data.forEach(user => console.log(user.name)); } }

// Extending existing interfaces declare global { interface Window { customProperty: string; } } // Module augmentation declare module 'express' { interface Request { user?: User; } } // Namespace merging namespace MyLibrary { export interface Config { apiUrl: string; } } namespace MyLibrary { export interface Config { timeout: number; } } // Config now has both apiUrl and timeout

Enable strict mode for maximum type safety Use explicit type annotations for function parameters and return types Avoid any type - use unknown or proper types instead Design clear interfaces with meaningful property names Leverage advanced types for better code reuse and safety Use generics for flexible, reusable components Implement proper error handling with custom error types Optimize performance with type-only imports and efficient type definitions Write type guards for runtime type checking Keep types close to their usage for better maintainability

This guide covers various deployment strategies and configurations for the Next.js for Production application.

Vercel provides the easiest deployment experience for Next.js applications. Quick Deployment​ Connect Repository: Go to Vercel Dashboard Click "Import Project" Connect your GitHub repository Configure Environment Variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-app.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=your_supabase_url NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your_supabase_anon_key SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your_service_role_key Deploy: Click "Deploy" Vercel automatically builds and deploys your app Vercel Configuration​ // vercel.json { "version": 2, "builds": [ { "src": "package.json", "use": "@vercel/next" } ], "routes": [ { "src": "/api/(.*)", "dest": "/api/$1" } ], "env": { "NODE_ENV": "production" }, "functions": { "app/**/*.ts": { "memory": 1024 } } }

Production Dockerfile​ # Multi-stage build for production FROM node:18-alpine AS base # Install dependencies only when needed FROM base AS deps RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat WORKDIR /app # Install dependencies based on the preferred package manager COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml* ./ RUN npm install -g pnpm && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile # Rebuild the source code only when needed FROM base AS builder WORKDIR /app COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules COPY . . # Build the application RUN npm install -g pnpm && pnpm build # Production image, copy all the files and run next FROM base AS runner WORKDIR /app ENV NODE_ENV production RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs RUN adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public # Set the correct permission for prerender cache RUN mkdir .next RUN chown nextjs:nodejs .next # Automatically leverage output traces to reduce image size COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone ./ COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static USER nextjs EXPOSE 3000 ENV PORT 3000 ENV HOSTNAME "0.0.0.0" CMD ["node", "server.js"] Docker Compose​ # docker-compose.yml version: '3.8' services: app: build: context: . dockerfile: Dockerfile target: production ports: - "3000:3000" environment: - NODE_ENV=production - DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL} - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=${NEXTAUTH_SECRET} depends_on: - postgres - redis postgres: image: postgres:15-alpine environment: POSTGRES_DB: nextjs_prod POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER} POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD} volumes: - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data ports: - "5432:5432" redis: image: redis:7-alpine ports: - "6379:6379" volumes: - redis_data:/data elasticsearch: image: elasticsearch:8.8.0 environment: - discovery.type=single-node - xpack.security.enabled=false ports: - "9200:9200" volumes: - elasticsearch_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data volumes: postgres_data: redis_data: elasticsearch_data:

AWS ECS with Fargate​ # aws-task-definition.json { "family": "fullstack-dev", "networkMode": "awsvpc", "requiresCompatibilities": ["FARGATE"], "cpu": "256", "memory": "512", "executionRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::account:role/ecsTaskExecutionRole", "containerDefinitions": [ { "name": "nextjs-app", "image": "your-account.dkr.ecr.region.amazonaws.com/fullstack-dev:latest", "portMappings": [ { "containerPort": 3000, "protocol": "tcp" } ], "environment": [ { "name": "NODE_ENV", "value": "production" } ], "secrets": [ { "name": "DATABASE_URL", "valueFrom": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:region:account:secret:database-url" } ], "logConfiguration": { "logDriver": "awslogs", "options": { "awslogs-group": "/ecs/fullstack-dev", "awslogs-region": "us-east-1", "awslogs-stream-prefix": "ecs" } } } ] } Deploy Script​ #!/bin/bash # deploy-aws.sh # Build and push Docker image docker build -t fullstack-dev . docker tag fullstack-dev:latest $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/fullstack-dev:latest docker push $AWS_ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/fullstack-dev:latest # Update ECS service aws ecs update-service \ --cluster nextjs-cluster \ --service nextjs-service \ --force-new-deployment

OWASP Dependency Check (Free Alternative)​ <!-- dependency-check-maven.xml --> <plugin> <groupId>org.owasp</groupId> <artifactId>dependency-check-maven</artifactId> <version>8.4.2</version> <configuration> <suppressionFiles> <suppressionFile>dependency-check-suppressions.xml</suppressionFile> </suppressionFiles> <failBuildOnCVSS>7</failBuildOnCVSS> <formats> <format>HTML</format> <format>JSON</format> <format>SARIF</format> </formats> </configuration> </plugin> Node.js implementation: // dependency-check-runner.js const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); function runDependencyCheck() { try { // Download dependency-check CLI execSync( 'wget https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/releases/download/v8.4.2/dependency-check-8.4.2-release.zip', ); execSync('unzip -q dependency-check-8.4.2-release.zip'); // Run dependency check execSync( './dependency-check/bin/dependency-check.sh --project "ecommerce-app" --scan . --format JSON --format HTML --failOnCVSS 7', ); // Parse results const results = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dependency-check-report.json', 'utf8')); console.log(`Found ${results.dependencies.length} dependencies`); // Check for vulnerabilities const vulnerabilities = results.dependencies.filter((dep) => dep.vulnerabilities && dep.vulnerabilities.length > 0); if (vulnerabilities.length > 0) { console.error(`Found ${vulnerabilities.length} dependencies with vulnerabilities`); process.exit(1); } } catch (error) { console.error('Dependency check failed:', error.message); process.exit(1); } } runDependencyCheck(); 5. # Use specific version tags for security FROM node:18.18.0-alpine3.18 AS base # Create non-root user RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs RUN adduser -S nextjs -u 1001 # Security: Install security updates RUN apk upgrade --no-cache # Set working directory WORKDIR /app # Copy package files COPY package*.json ./ # Install dependencies with security flags RUN npm ci --only=production --no-optional --audit-level moderate # Multi-stage build for production FROM base AS production # Copy application code COPY --chown=nextjs:nodejs . . # Build application RUN npm run build # Remove development dependencies and clean npm cache RUN npm prune --production && npm cache clean --force # Security: Remove unnecessary packages RUN apk del --purge # Switch to non-root user USER nextjs # Expose port EXPOSE 3000 # Health check HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \ CMD curl -f http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1 # Start application CMD ["npm", "start"]

// src/compliance/gdpr-compliance.service.ts import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'; import { trace } from '@opentelemetry/api'; @Injectable() export class GDPRComplianceService { private readonly tracer = trace.getTracer('gdpr-compliance'); async processDataRequest(requestType: 'access' | 'deletion' | 'portability', userId: string) { return this.tracer.startActiveSpan(`gdpr.${requestType}_request`, async (span) => { span.setAttributes({ 'gdpr.request_type': requestType, 'gdpr.user_id': userId, 'gdpr.timestamp': new Date().toISOString(), }); try { switch (requestType) { case 'access': return await this.generateDataExport(userId); case 'deletion': return await this.deleteUserData(userId); case 'portability': return await this.exportPortableData(userId); } } catch (error) { span.recordException(error); throw error; } finally { span.end(); } }); } private async generateDataExport(userId: string) { // Implementation for data export const userData = await this.collectUserData(userId); // Audit trail await this.auditService.log({ action: 'gdpr_data_access', userId, timestamp: new Date(), details: { dataTypes: Object.keys(userData) }, }); return userData; } private async deleteUserData(userId: string) { // Implementation for data deletion with audit trail const deletedData = await this.performDataDeletion(userId); // Audit trail await this.auditService.log({ action: 'gdpr_data_deletion', userId, timestamp: new Date(), details: { deletedRecords: deletedData.length }, }); return { deleted: true, recordCount: deletedData.length }; } }

// src/shared/backup/ecommerce-database-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; import { DataClassification, ECOMMERCE_BACKUP_POLICIES } from './backup-policies'; interface DatabaseBackupConfig { serviceName: string; database: string; classification: DataClassification; tables: string[]; customBackupScript?: string; } @Injectable() export class EcommerceDatabaseBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(EcommerceDatabaseBackupService.name); private readonly serviceConfigs: DatabaseBackupConfig[] = [ { serviceName: 'user-service', database: 'users_db', classification: DataClassification.SENSITIVE, tables: ['users', 'user_profiles', 'user_preferences', 'user_sessions'], }, { serviceName: 'product-service', database: 'products_db', classification: DataClassification.INTERNAL, tables: ['products', 'categories', 'product_variants', 'product_reviews'], }, { serviceName: 'order-service', database: 'orders_db', classification: DataClassification.CRITICAL, tables: ['orders', 'order_items', 'order_status_history', 'order_payments'], }, { serviceName: 'payment-service', database: 'payments_db', classification: DataClassification.CRITICAL, tables: ['payment_methods', 'transactions', 'payment_logs'], }, { serviceName: 'inventory-service', database: 'inventory_db', classification: DataClassification.INTERNAL, tables: ['inventory', 'stock_movements', 'reservations'], }, ]; constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {} // Critical data backup every 5 minutes @Cron('*/5 * * * *') async backupCriticalData(): Promise<void> { const criticalServices = this.serviceConfigs.filter( (config) => config.classification === DataClassification.CRITICAL, ); for (const config of criticalServices) { await this.createIncrementalBackup(config); } } // Sensitive data backup every 15 minutes @Cron('*/15 * * * *') async backupSensitiveData(): Promise<void> { const sensitiveServices = this.serviceConfigs.filter( (config) => config.classification === DataClassification.SENSITIVE, ); for (const config of sensitiveServices) { await this.createIncrementalBackup(config); } } // Full backup daily at 2 AM @Cron('0 2 * * *') async createFullBackups(): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Starting full ecommerce database backups'); for (const config of this.serviceConfigs) { await this.createFullBackup(config); } } private async createFullBackup(config: DatabaseBackupConfig): Promise<void> { const startTime = Date.now(); const backupId = `${config.serviceName}_full_${Date.now()}`; try { this.logger.log(`Creating full backup for ${config.serviceName}`); // Use Cloud SQL backup for production await this.triggerCloudSQLBackup(config.database, backupId); // Create application-level backup for specific tables await this.createApplicationBackup(config, backupId, 'full'); // Validate backup integrity await this.validateBackup(backupId); const duration = Date.now() - startTime; this.logger.log(`Full backup completed for ${config.serviceName} in ${duration}ms`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Full backup failed for ${config.serviceName}: ${error.message}`); await this.sendBackupAlert(config.serviceName, 'full_backup_failed', error.message); throw error; } } private async createIncrementalBackup(config: DatabaseBackupConfig): Promise<void> { const startTime = Date.now(); const backupId = `${config.serviceName}_incremental_${Date.now()}`; try { // Get changes since last backup const lastBackupTime = await this.getLastBackupTimestamp(config.serviceName); // Create incremental backup with WAL files await this.createWALBackup(config, backupId, lastBackupTime); // For critical data, also create a point-in-time snapshot if (config.classification === DataClassification.CRITICAL) { await this.createPointInTimeSnapshot(config, backupId); } const duration = Date.now() - startTime; this.logger.log(`Incremental backup completed for ${config.serviceName} in ${duration}ms`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Incremental backup failed for ${config.serviceName}: ${error.message}`); await this.sendBackupAlert(config.serviceName, 'incremental_backup_failed', error.message); throw error; } } private async triggerCloudSQLBackup(database: string, backupId: string): Promise<void> { // Use Google Cloud SQL Admin API to trigger backup const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const command = `gcloud sql backups create --instance=${database} --description="${backupId}"`; execSync(command); } private async createApplicationBackup( config: DatabaseBackupConfig, backupId: string, type: 'full' | 'incremental', ): Promise<void> { const policy = ECOMMERCE_BACKUP_POLICIES[config.classification]; // Create encrypted backup with compression const backupCommand = this.buildBackupCommand(config, backupId, type, policy); // Execute backup const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync(backupCommand); // Upload to multiple regions for critical data if (config.classification === DataClassification.CRITICAL) { await this.replicateToMultipleRegions(backupId, policy.replicationRegions); } } private buildBackupCommand(config: DatabaseBackupConfig, backupId: string, type: string, policy: any): string { const host = this.configService.get('DB_HOST'); const port = this.configService.get('DB_PORT'); const username = this.configService.get('DB_USERNAME'); let command = `pg_dump -h ${host} -p ${port} -U ${username} -d ${config.database}`; // Add table-specific options if (config.tables.length > 0) { const tableArgs = config.tables.map((table) => `-t ${table}`).join(' '); command += ` ${tableArgs}`; } // Add compression based on classification command += ` --compress=${policy.compressionLevel}`; // Encryption for sensitive data if (policy.encryptionRequired) { command += ` | gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256`; } return command; } private async validateBackup(backupId: string): Promise<void> { // Implement backup validation logic // 1. Verify file integrity // 2. Test restore to staging environment // 3. Validate data consistency } private async sendBackupAlert(serviceName: string, alertType: string, message: string): Promise<void> { // Send alert to monitoring system (Datadog, Slack, etc.) this.logger.error(`BACKUP ALERT [${serviceName}] ${alertType}: ${message}`); } }

// src/shared/backup/redis-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import Redis from 'ioredis'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; @Injectable() export class RedisBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RedisBackupService.name); private readonly redis: Redis; constructor() { this.redis = new Redis({ host: process.env.REDIS_HOST, port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379'), password: process.env.REDIS_PASSWORD, }); } // Backup user sessions every 30 minutes @Cron('*/30 * * * *') async backupUserSessions(): Promise<void> { await this.backupRedisPattern('session:*', 'user-sessions'); } // Backup shopping carts every 15 minutes @Cron('*/15 * * * *') async backupShoppingCarts(): Promise<void> { await this.backupRedisPattern('cart:*', 'shopping-carts'); } // Backup product cache every hour @Cron('0 * * * *') async backupProductCache(): Promise<void> { await this.backupRedisPattern('product:*', 'product-cache'); } private async backupRedisPattern(pattern: string, backupType: string): Promise<void> { try { const keys = await this.redis.keys(pattern); const backupData: Record<string, any> = {}; // Batch process keys to avoid memory issues const batchSize = 1000; for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i += batchSize) { const batch = keys.slice(i, i + batchSize); const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline(); batch.forEach((key) => pipeline.get(key)); const results = await pipeline.exec(); batch.forEach((key, index) => { if (results && results[index] && results[index][1]) { backupData[key] = results[index][1]; } }); } // Upload to Cloud Storage await this.uploadRedisBackup(backupData, backupType); this.logger.log(`Redis backup completed for ${backupType}: ${keys.length} keys`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Redis backup failed for ${backupType}: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } private async uploadRedisBackup(data: Record<string, any>, backupType: string): Promise<void> { const { Storage } = require('@google-cloud/storage'); const storage = new Storage(); const bucketName = process.env.BACKUP_BUCKET; const fileName = `redis-backups/${backupType}/${Date.now()}.json`; const file = storage.bucket(bucketName).file(fileName); await file.save(JSON.stringify(data), { metadata: { contentType: 'application/json', }, }); } async restoreRedisData(backupFile: string): Promise<void> { // Implementation for Redis data restoration try { const { Storage } = require('@google-cloud/storage'); const storage = new Storage(); const bucketName = process.env.BACKUP_BUCKET; const file = storage.bucket(bucketName).file(backupFile); const [contents] = await file.download(); const backupData = JSON.parse(contents.toString()); // Restore data in batches const pipeline = this.redis.pipeline(); Object.entries(backupData).forEach(([key, value]) => { pipeline.set(key, value); }); await pipeline.exec(); this.logger.log(`Redis data restored from ${backupFile}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Redis restore failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } }

# k8s/backup/velero-backup-config.yaml apiVersion: v1 kind: ConfigMap metadata: name: velero-backup-config namespace: velero data: backup-locations.yaml: | apiVersion: velero.io/v1 kind: BackupStorageLocation metadata: name: gcp-backup-location namespace: velero spec: provider: gcp objectStorage: bucket: ecommerce-k8s-backups prefix: velero config: serviceAccount: velero-backup-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --- apiVersion: velero.io/v1 kind: Schedule metadata: name: ecommerce-daily-backup namespace: velero spec: schedule: '0 3 * * *' # Daily at 3 AM template: includeClusterResources: true includedNamespaces: - ecommerce-prod - ecommerce-staging - monitoring - ingress-nginx excludedResources: - pods - replicasets - secrets storageLocation: gcp-backup-location ttl: 720h # 30 days retention --- apiVersion: velero.io/v1 kind: Schedule metadata: name: ecommerce-critical-backup namespace: velero spec: schedule: '*/15 * * * *' # Every 15 minutes template: includeClusterResources: false includedNamespaces: - ecommerce-prod includedResources: - persistentvolumes - persistentvolumeclaims - configmaps - services storageLocation: gcp-backup-location ttl: 168h # 7 days retention --- # Backup script for manual triggers apiVersion: v1 kind: ConfigMap metadata: name: backup-scripts namespace: ecommerce-prod data: manual-backup.sh: | #!/bin/bash # Manual backup script for emergency situations BACKUP_NAME="manual-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" echo "Creating manual backup: $BACKUP_NAME" # Create immediate backup velero backup create $BACKUP_NAME \ --include-namespaces ecommerce-prod \ --include-cluster-resources=true \ --wait # Check backup status velero backup describe $BACKUP_NAME # Export backup logs velero backup logs $BACKUP_NAME > /tmp/${BACKUP_NAME}.log echo "Manual backup completed: $BACKUP_NAME" restore-from-backup.sh: | #!/bin/bash BACKUP_NAME=$1 if [ -z "$BACKUP_NAME" ]; then echo "Usage: $0 <backup-name>" exit 1 fi echo "Restoring from backup: $BACKUP_NAME" # Create restore RESTORE_NAME="restore-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" velero restore create $RESTORE_NAME \ --from-backup $BACKUP_NAME \ --wait # Check restore status velero restore describe $RESTORE_NAME echo "Restore completed: $RESTORE_NAME"

// src/shared/backup/file-storage-backup.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Storage } from '@google-cloud/storage'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; @Injectable() export class FileStorageBackupService { private readonly logger = new Logger(FileStorageBackupService.name); private readonly storage = new Storage(); // Daily backup of product images @Cron('0 4 * * *') async backupProductImages(): Promise<void> { await this.syncBucketToBackup('ecommerce-product-images', 'ecommerce-backups-product-images', 'product-images'); } // Daily backup of static assets @Cron('0 5 * * *') async backupStaticAssets(): Promise<void> { await this.syncBucketToBackup('ecommerce-static-assets', 'ecommerce-backups-static-assets', 'static-assets'); } // Weekly backup of user uploaded content @Cron('0 6 * * 0') async backupUserContent(): Promise<void> { await this.syncBucketToBackup('ecommerce-user-content', 'ecommerce-backups-user-content', 'user-content'); } private async syncBucketToBackup(sourceBucket: string, backupBucket: string, contentType: string): Promise<void> { try { this.logger.log(`Starting backup sync for ${contentType}`); const [sourceFiles] = await this.storage.bucket(sourceBucket).getFiles(); const backupBucketRef = this.storage.bucket(backupBucket); let copiedFiles = 0; let skippedFiles = 0; for (const file of sourceFiles) { try { const backupFileName = `${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}/${file.name}`; const backupFile = backupBucketRef.file(backupFileName); // Check if file already exists in backup const [exists] = await backupFile.exists(); if (!exists) { await file.copy(backupFile); copiedFiles++; } else { skippedFiles++; } } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to backup file ${file.name}: ${error.message}`); } } this.logger.log(`Backup sync completed for ${contentType}: ${copiedFiles} copied, ${skippedFiles} skipped`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Backup sync failed for ${contentType}: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } async restoreFilesFromBackup(backupBucket: string, targetBucket: string, backupDate: string): Promise<void> { try { this.logger.log(`Starting file restore from ${backupDate}`); const [backupFiles] = await this.storage.bucket(backupBucket).getFiles({ prefix: backupDate }); const targetBucketRef = this.storage.bucket(targetBucket); let restoredFiles = 0; for (const file of backupFiles) { try { const originalFileName = file.name.replace(`${backupDate}/`, ''); const targetFile = targetBucketRef.file(originalFileName); await file.copy(targetFile); restoredFiles++; } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Failed to restore file ${file.name}: ${error.message}`); } } this.logger.log(`File restore completed: ${restoredFiles} files restored`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`File restore failed: ${error.message}`); throw error; } } }

#!/bin/bash # scripts/backup-k8s-configs.sh # Backup Kubernetes configurations and secrets BACKUP_DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/k8s-config-backup-$BACKUP_DATE" BUCKET_NAME="ecommerce-config-backups" mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR" echo "Starting Kubernetes configuration backup..." # Export namespaces kubectl get namespaces -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/namespaces.yaml" # Export secrets (base64 encoded, will be encrypted before storage) for namespace in ecommerce-prod ecommerce-staging monitoring; do mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR/secrets/$namespace" kubectl get secrets -n "$namespace" -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/secrets/$namespace/secrets.yaml" done # Export configmaps for namespace in ecommerce-prod ecommerce-staging monitoring; do mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR/configmaps/$namespace" kubectl get configmaps -n "$namespace" -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/configmaps/$namespace/configmaps.yaml" done # Export custom resources kubectl get crd -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/crds.yaml" # Export ingress configurations kubectl get ingress --all-namespaces -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/ingress.yaml" # Export service accounts kubectl get serviceaccounts --all-namespaces -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/serviceaccounts.yaml" # Export RBAC kubectl get clusterroles -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/clusterroles.yaml" kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/clusterrolebindings.yaml" kubectl get roles --all-namespaces -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/roles.yaml" kubectl get rolebindings --all-namespaces -o yaml > "$BACKUP_DIR/rolebindings.yaml" # Encrypt the backup tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz" -C "/tmp" "k8s-config-backup-$BACKUP_DATE" gpg --symmetric --cipher-algo AES256 --output "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz.gpg" "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz" # Upload to Google Cloud Storage gsutil cp "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz.gpg" "gs://$BUCKET_NAME/k8s-configs/$BACKUP_DATE.tar.gz.gpg" # Cleanup local files rm -rf "$BACKUP_DIR" "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz" "$BACKUP_DIR.tar.gz.gpg" echo "Kubernetes configuration backup completed: $BACKUP_DATE"

// src/shared/disaster-recovery/dr-orchestrator.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; export interface DRScenario { name: string; triggerConditions: string[]; recoverySteps: DRStep[]; estimatedRTO: number; // minutes estimatedRPO: number; // minutes } export interface DRStep { name: string; action: string; timeout: number; rollbackAction?: string; dependencies?: string[]; } @Injectable() export class DisasterRecoveryOrchestrator { private readonly logger = new Logger(DisasterRecoveryOrchestrator.name); private readonly drScenarios: DRScenario[] = [ { name: 'database_failure', triggerConditions: ['db_connection_lost', 'db_corruption_detected'], estimatedRTO: 15, estimatedRPO: 5, recoverySteps: [ { name: 'switch_to_replica', action: 'promote_read_replica', timeout: 300000, // 5 minutes rollbackAction: 'demote_replica', }, { name: 'update_connection_strings', action: 'update_k8s_secrets', timeout: 120000, // 2 minutes dependencies: ['switch_to_replica'], }, { name: 'restart_services', action: 'rolling_restart_pods', timeout: 600000, // 10 minutes dependencies: ['update_connection_strings'], }, ], }, { name: 'region_failure', triggerConditions: ['region_unavailable', 'multi_service_failure'], estimatedRTO: 60, estimatedRPO: 15, recoverySteps: [ { name: 'activate_dr_cluster', action: 'scale_dr_k8s_cluster', timeout: 900000, // 15 minutes }, { name: 'restore_from_backup', action: 'restore_latest_backup', timeout: 1800000, // 30 minutes dependencies: ['activate_dr_cluster'], }, { name: 'switch_dns', action: 'update_dns_records', timeout: 300000, // 5 minutes dependencies: ['restore_from_backup'], }, { name: 'validate_services', action: 'run_health_checks', timeout: 600000, // 10 minutes dependencies: ['switch_dns'], }, ], }, ]; async executeDisasterRecovery(scenarioName: string): Promise<void> { const scenario = this.drScenarios.find((s) => s.name === scenarioName); if (!scenario) { throw new Error(`Unknown DR scenario: ${scenarioName}`); } this.logger.log(`Starting disaster recovery for scenario: ${scenarioName}`); try { await this.notifyStakeholders('dr_started', scenario); for (const step of scenario.recoverySteps) { await this.executeRecoveryStep(step, scenario); } await this.validateRecovery(scenario); await this.notifyStakeholders('dr_completed', scenario); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`DR execution failed: ${error.message}`); await this.notifyStakeholders('dr_failed', scenario, error); throw error; } } private async executeRecoveryStep(step: DRStep, scenario: DRScenario): Promise<void> { this.logger.log(`Executing recovery step: ${step.name}`); try { switch (step.action) { case 'promote_read_replica': await this.promoteReadReplica(); break; case 'update_k8s_secrets': await this.updateKubernetesSecrets(); break; case 'rolling_restart_pods': await this.rollingRestartPods(); break; case 'scale_dr_k8s_cluster': await this.scaleDRCluster(); break; case 'restore_latest_backup': await this.restoreLatestBackup(); break; case 'update_dns_records': await this.updateDNSRecords(); break; case 'run_health_checks': await this.runHealthChecks(); break; default: throw new Error(`Unknown recovery action: ${step.action}`); } this.logger.log(`Recovery step completed: ${step.name}`); } catch (error) { this.logger.error(`Recovery step failed: ${step.name} - ${error.message}`); if (step.rollbackAction) { await this.executeRollback(step); } throw error; } } private async promoteReadReplica(): Promise<void> { // Promote read replica to master const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('gcloud sql instances promote-replica ecommerce-replica'); } private async updateKubernetesSecrets(): Promise<void> { // Update database connection secrets in Kubernetes execSync( `kubectl patch secret db-credentials -p '{"data":{"host":"${Buffer.from('new-db-host').toString('base64')}"}}'`, ); } private async rollingRestartPods(): Promise<void> { // Restart all application pods to pick up new configuration const deployments = ['user-service', 'product-service', 'order-service', 'payment-service']; for (const deployment of deployments) { execSync(`kubectl rollout restart deployment/${deployment} -n ecommerce-prod`); execSync(`kubectl rollout status deployment/${deployment} -n ecommerce-prod --timeout=300s`); } } private async notifyStakeholders(event: string, scenario: DRScenario, error?: Error): Promise<void> { // Send notifications via Slack, email, SMS const message = `DR Event: ${event} - Scenario: ${scenario.name}${error ? ` - Error: ${error.message}` : ''}`; this.logger.log(`Notification: ${message}`); } }

// src/shared/monitoring/backup-monitoring.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; @Injectable() export class BackupMonitoringService { private readonly logger = new Logger(BackupMonitoringService.name); // Monitor backup health every 30 minutes @Cron('*/30 * * * *') async monitorBackupHealth(): Promise<void> { await Promise.all([ this.checkDatabaseBackups(), this.checkFileBackups(), this.checkRedisBackups(), this.checkKubernetesBackups(), ]); } private async checkDatabaseBackups(): Promise<void> { const services = ['user-service', 'product-service', 'order-service', 'payment-service']; for (const service of services) { const lastBackup = await this.getLastBackupTime(service); const timeSinceBackup = Date.now() - lastBackup.getTime(); // Alert if backup is older than expected interval if (timeSinceBackup > this.getExpectedInterval(service)) { await this.sendAlert('backup_overdue', service, { lastBackup: lastBackup.toISOString(), timeSinceBackup: Math.round(timeSinceBackup / 1000 / 60), // minutes }); } } } private async sendAlert(type: string, service: string, data: any): Promise<void> { // Integration with monitoring systems this.logger.error(`BACKUP ALERT [${type}] ${service}: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`); } private getExpectedInterval(service: string): number { const intervals = { 'user-service': 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes 'product-service': 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 hour 'order-service': 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes 'payment-service': 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes }; return intervals[service] || 60 * 60 * 1000; // Default 1 hour } }

#!/bin/bash # scripts/recovery-playbooks/order-service-recovery.sh # Order Service Recovery Playbook # This script handles recovery of the critical order service set -e ORDER_SERVICE_RECOVERY_PLAYBOOK() { local BACKUP_ID=$1 local TARGET_ENV=$2 echo "=== ORDER SERVICE RECOVERY PLAYBOOK ===" echo "Backup ID: $BACKUP_ID" echo "Target Environment: $TARGET_ENV" echo "Started at: $(date)" # Step 1: Validate backup echo "Step 1: Validating backup..." if ! validate_backup "$BACKUP_ID"; then echo "ERROR: Backup validation failed" exit 1 fi # Step 2: Stop order service echo "Step 2: Stopping order service..." kubectl scale deployment order-service --replicas=0 -n "$TARGET_ENV" # Step 3: Restore database echo "Step 3: Restoring order database..." restore_database "orders_db" "$BACKUP_ID" # Step 4: Restore Redis cache echo "Step 4: Restoring order cache..." restore_redis_pattern "order:*" "$BACKUP_ID" # Step 5: Start order service echo "Step 5: Starting order service..." kubectl scale deployment order-service --replicas=3 -n "$TARGET_ENV" # Step 6: Wait for service to be ready echo "Step 6: Waiting for service readiness..." kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/order-service -n "$TARGET_ENV" --timeout=300s # Step 7: Validate service health echo "Step 7: Validating service health..." if ! validate_service_health "order-service" "$TARGET_ENV"; then echo "ERROR: Service health validation failed" exit 1 fi echo "=== ORDER SERVICE RECOVERY COMPLETED ===" echo "Completed at: $(date)" } validate_backup() { local backup_id=$1 # Implementation for backup validation return 0 } restore_database() { local database=$1 local backup_id=$2 # Implementation for database restoration echo "Restoring database $database from backup $backup_id" } restore_redis_pattern() { local pattern=$1 local backup_id=$2 # Implementation for Redis restoration echo "Restoring Redis pattern $pattern from backup $backup_id" } validate_service_health() { local service=$1 local namespace=$2 # Implementation for service health validation local health_check_url="http://$service.$namespace.svc.cluster.local:3000/health" curl -f "$health_check_url" > /dev/null 2>&1 } # Execute the playbook if called directly if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then ORDER_SERVICE_RECOVERY_PLAYBOOK "$1" "$2" fi

// src/shared/testing/backup-testing.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule'; interface BackupTestResult { testName: string; success: boolean; duration: number; errors: string[]; metrics: Record<string, any>; } @Injectable() export class BackupTestingService { private readonly logger = new Logger(BackupTestingService.name); // Run backup tests weekly @Cron('0 6 * * 0') async runWeeklyBackupTests(): Promise<void> { const testResults: BackupTestResult[] = []; testResults.push(await this.testDatabaseRestore()); testResults.push(await this.testRedisRestore()); testResults.push(await this.testFileRestore()); testResults.push(await this.testKubernetesRestore()); testResults.push(await this.testDisasterRecovery()); await this.generateTestReport(testResults); } private async testDatabaseRestore(): Promise<BackupTestResult> { const startTime = Date.now(); const testName = 'database_restore_test'; const errors: string[] = []; try { // Create test database const testDbName = `test_restore_${Date.now()}`; // Get latest backup const latestBackup = await this.getLatestBackup('orders_db'); // Restore to test database await this.restoreToTestDatabase(latestBackup, testDbName); // Validate data integrity const integrityCheck = await this.validateDataIntegrity(testDbName); if (!integrityCheck.valid) { errors.push(...integrityCheck.errors); } // Cleanup test database await this.cleanupTestDatabase(testDbName); return { testName, success: errors.length === 0, duration: Date.now() - startTime, errors, metrics: { backupSize: latestBackup.size, restoreTime: Date.now() - startTime, recordCount: integrityCheck.recordCount, }, }; } catch (error) { return { testName, success: false, duration: Date.now() - startTime, errors: [error.message], metrics: {}, }; } } private async testDisasterRecovery(): Promise<BackupTestResult> { const startTime = Date.now(); const testName = 'disaster_recovery_test'; const errors: string[] = []; try { // Simulate a disaster scenario in test environment await this.simulateDisaster('test-environment'); // Execute DR procedures await this.executeDRProcedures('test-environment'); // Validate recovery const recoveryValidation = await this.validateRecovery('test-environment'); if (!recoveryValidation.valid) { errors.push(...recoveryValidation.errors); } return { testName, success: errors.length === 0, duration: Date.now() - startTime, errors, metrics: { rto: recoveryValidation.rto, rpo: recoveryValidation.rpo, servicesRecovered: recoveryValidation.servicesRecovered, }, }; } catch (error) { return { testName, success: false, duration: Date.now() - startTime, errors: [error.message], metrics: {}, }; } } private async generateTestReport(results: BackupTestResult[]): Promise<void> { const report = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), summary: { totalTests: results.length, passedTests: results.filter((r) => r.success).length, failedTests: results.filter((r) => !r.success).length, totalDuration: results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.duration, 0), }, results, }; // Save report and send notifications await this.saveTestReport(report); await this.notifyTestResults(report); } }

Resource Limits: Always set appropriate resource limits and requests RBAC: Follow principle of least privilege for service accounts Secrets Rotation: Implement regular secret rotation policies Monitoring: Set up monitoring and alerting for External Secrets components Backup: Regularly backup configurations and critical secrets Testing: Test secret synchronization in staging before production
