# Authenticate with Google Cloud gcloud auth login gcloud auth application-default login # Set project export PROJECT_ID="your-microservices-project" gcloud config set project $PROJECT_ID # Enable required APIs gcloud services enable \ container.googleapis.com \ compute.googleapis.com \ cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com \ monitoring.googleapis.com \ logging.googleapis.com \ storage.googleapis.com \ sql-component.googleapis.com \ redis.googleapis.com \ pubsub.googleapis.com \ file.googleapis.com \ run.googleapis.com \ secretmanager.googleapis.com \ artifactregistry.googleapis.com \ cloudkms.googleapis.com \ certificatemanager.googleapis.com \ dns.googleapis.com

# Create Terraform service account gcloud iam service-accounts create terraform-microservices \ --description="Terraform service account for microservices infrastructure" \ --display-name="Terraform Microservices" # Grant necessary roles ROLES=( "roles/editor" "roles/container.admin" "roles/compute.admin" "roles/storage.admin" "roles/sql.admin" "roles/redis.admin" "roles/pubsub.admin" "roles/file.admin" "roles/run.admin" "roles/secretmanager.admin" "roles/artifactregistry.admin" "roles/cloudkms.admin" "roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin" "roles/resourcemanager.projectIamAdmin" "roles/dns.admin" ) for role in "${ROLES[@]}"; do gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \ --member="serviceAccount:terraform-microservices@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \ --role="$role" done # Download service account key gcloud iam service-accounts keys create terraform-key.json \ --iam-account=terraform-microservices@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com # Set environment variable export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="$(pwd)/terraform-key.json"

# Create project structure mkdir -p microservices-terraform/{modules,environments,scripts,k8s-manifests} cd microservices-terraform # Directory structure mkdir -p modules/{networking,gke,storage,databases,messaging,security,monitoring,cloudrun} mkdir -p environments/{dev,staging,prod} mkdir -p scripts/{deploy,backup,monitoring} mkdir -p k8s-manifests/{base,overlays} tree # microservices-terraform/ # ├── main.tf # ├── variables.tf # ├── outputs.tf # ├── terraform.tfvars # ├── versions.tf # ├── modules/ # │ ├── networking/ # VPC, subnets, firewall rules # │ ├── gke/ # GKE cluster and node pools # │ ├── storage/ # Cloud Storage, Filestore # │ ├── databases/ # Cloud SQL, Memorystore # │ ├── messaging/ # Pub/Sub topics and subscriptions # │ ├── security/ # Secret Manager, IAM, KMS # │ ├── monitoring/ # Cloud Monitoring, Logging # │ └── cloudrun/ # Cloud Run services # ├── environments/ # │ ├── dev/ # Development environment # │ ├── staging/ # Staging environment # │ └── prod/ # Production environment # ├── scripts/ # │ ├── deploy/ # Deployment scripts # │ ├── backup/ # Backup scripts # │ └── monitoring/ # Monitoring scripts # └── k8s-manifests/ # ├── base/ # Base Kubernetes manifests # └── overlays/ # Environment-specific overlays

# versions.tf terraform { required_version = ">= 1.6" required_providers { google = { source = "hashicorp/google" version = "~> 5.0" } google-beta = { source = "hashicorp/google-beta" version = "~> 5.0" } kubernetes = { source = "hashicorp/kubernetes" version = "~> 2.23" } helm = { source = "hashicorp/helm" version = "~> 2.11" } } backend "gcs" { bucket = "your-terraform-state-bucket" prefix = "microservices" } } provider "google" { project = var.project_id region = var.region } provider "google-beta" { project = var.project_id region = var.region } data "google_client_config" "default" {} provider "kubernetes" { host = "https://${module.gke.cluster_endpoint}" token = data.google_client_config.default.access_token cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.gke.cluster_ca_certificate) } provider "helm" { kubernetes { host = "https://${module.gke.cluster_endpoint}" token = data.google_client_config.default.access_token cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.gke.cluster_ca_certificate) } }

# variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string default = "us-central1" } variable "zones" { description = "The GCP zones" type = list(string) default = ["us-central1-a", "us-central1-b", "us-central1-c"] } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name (dev, staging, prod)" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string default = "microservices-app" } # Networking variables variable "network_name" { description = "VPC network name" type = string default = "microservices-network" } variable "subnet_ranges" { description = "Subnet CIDR ranges" type = object({ public_subnet = string private_subnet = string database_subnet = string gke_pods_range = string gke_services_range = string }) default = { public_subnet = "10.1.0.0/24" private_subnet = "10.1.1.0/24" database_subnet = "10.1.2.0/24" gke_pods_range = "10.2.0.0/16" gke_services_range = "10.3.0.0/16" } } # GKE variables variable "gke_config" { description = "GKE cluster configuration" type = object({ cluster_name = string kubernetes_version = string enable_private_nodes = bool enable_private_endpoint = bool master_ipv4_cidr_block = string enable_network_policy = bool enable_workload_identity = bool }) default = { cluster_name = "microservices-cluster" kubernetes_version = "1.28" enable_private_nodes = true enable_private_endpoint = false master_ipv4_cidr_block = "172.16.0.0/28" enable_network_policy = true enable_workload_identity = true } } variable "node_pools" { description = "GKE node pool configurations" type = map(object({ machine_type = string disk_size_gb = number disk_type = string image_type = string auto_repair = bool auto_upgrade = bool preemptible = bool min_count = number max_count = number initial_node_count = number node_labels = map(string) node_taints = list(object({ key = string value = string effect = string })) })) default = { system = { machine_type = "e2-medium" disk_size_gb = 50 disk_type = "pd-ssd" image_type = "COS_CONTAINERD" auto_repair = true auto_upgrade = true preemptible = false min_count = 1 max_count = 3 initial_node_count = 2 node_labels = { workload-type = "system" } node_taints = [] } applications = { machine_type = "e2-standard-4" disk_size_gb = 100 disk_type = "pd-ssd" image_type = "COS_CONTAINERD" auto_repair = true auto_upgrade = true preemptible = false min_count = 2 max_count = 20 initial_node_count = 3 node_labels = { workload-type = "applications" } node_taints = [] } spot = { machine_type = "e2-standard-2" disk_size_gb = 50 disk_type = "pd-standard" image_type = "COS_CONTAINERD" auto_repair = true auto_upgrade = true preemptible = true min_count = 0 max_count = 50 initial_node_count = 0 node_labels = { workload-type = "spot" } node_taints = [{ key = "spot" value = "true" effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }] } } } # Database variables variable "database_config" { description = "Database configuration" type = object({ postgres_version = string postgres_tier = string postgres_disk_size = number postgres_disk_type = string redis_memory_size_gb = number redis_tier = string redis_version = string }) default = { postgres_version = "15" postgres_tier = "db-custom-2-4096" postgres_disk_size = 100 postgres_disk_type = "PD_SSD" redis_memory_size_gb = 1 redis_tier = "STANDARD_HA" redis_version = "REDIS_7_0" } } # Storage variables variable "storage_config" { description = "Storage configuration" type = object({ filestore_tier = string filestore_capacity_gb = number bucket_force_destroy = bool bucket_versioning = bool }) default = { filestore_tier = "STANDARD" filestore_capacity_gb = 1024 bucket_force_destroy = true bucket_versioning = true } } # Cloud Run variables variable "cloud_run_services" { description = "Cloud Run service configurations" type = map(object({ image = string port = number cpu = string memory = string min_instances = number max_instances = number concurrency = number timeout_seconds = number env_vars = map(string) })) default = { gateway = { image = "gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/gateway:latest" port = 8080 cpu = "1" memory = "512Mi" min_instances = 1 max_instances = 10 concurrency = 100 timeout_seconds = 300 env_vars = { PORT = "8080" ENV = "production" } } auth = { image = "gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/auth:latest" port = 8080 cpu = "0.5" memory = "256Mi" min_instances = 0 max_instances = 5 concurrency = 50 timeout_seconds = 60 env_vars = { PORT = "8080" ENV = "production" } } } }

# main.tf # Enable required APIs resource "google_project_service" "required_apis" { for_each = toset([ "container.googleapis.com", "compute.googleapis.com", "cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com", "monitoring.googleapis.com", "logging.googleapis.com", "storage.googleapis.com", "sqladmin.googleapis.com", "redis.googleapis.com", "pubsub.googleapis.com", "file.googleapis.com", "run.googleapis.com", "secretmanager.googleapis.com", "artifactregistry.googleapis.com", "cloudkms.googleapis.com", "certificatemanager.googleapis.com", "dns.googleapis.com" ]) project = var.project_id service = each.value disable_dependent_services = false disable_on_destroy = false } # Networking module "networking" { source = "./modules/networking" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region network_name = var.network_name subnet_ranges = var.subnet_ranges environment = var.environment depends_on = [google_project_service.required_apis] } # Security (KMS, Secret Manager, IAM) module "security" { source = "./modules/security" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name depends_on = [google_project_service.required_apis] } # Artifact Registry module "artifact_registry" { source = "./modules/artifact_registry" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name depends_on = [google_project_service.required_apis] } # GKE Cluster module "gke" { source = "./modules/gke" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region zones = var.zones network_id = module.networking.network_id subnet_id = module.networking.private_subnet_id gke_config = var.gke_config node_pools = var.node_pools environment = var.environment kms_key_ring_id = module.security.kms_key_ring_id kms_crypto_key_id = module.security.kms_crypto_key_id depends_on = [module.networking, module.security] } # Databases (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Memorystore Redis) module "databases" { source = "./modules/databases" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region network_id = module.networking.network_id database_subnet_id = module.networking.database_subnet_id database_config = var.database_config environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name kms_crypto_key_id = module.security.kms_crypto_key_id depends_on = [module.networking, module.security] } # Storage (Cloud Storage and Filestore) module "storage" { source = "./modules/storage" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region network_id = module.networking.network_id storage_config = var.storage_config environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name kms_crypto_key_id = module.security.kms_crypto_key_id depends_on = [module.networking, module.security] } # Messaging (Pub/Sub) module "messaging" { source = "./modules/messaging" project_id = var.project_id environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name kms_crypto_key_id = module.security.kms_crypto_key_id depends_on = [module.security] } # Cloud Run Services module "cloudrun" { source = "./modules/cloudrun" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region cloud_run_services = var.cloud_run_services environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name artifact_registry_url = module.artifact_registry.repository_url depends_on = [module.artifact_registry, module.security] } # Monitoring and Logging module "monitoring" { source = "./modules/monitoring" project_id = var.project_id region = var.region environment = var.environment application_name = var.application_name gke_cluster_name = module.gke.cluster_name depends_on = [module.gke] }

# modules/networking/main.tf # VPC Network resource "google_compute_network" "vpc" { name = "${var.network_name}-${var.environment}" auto_create_subnetworks = false description = "VPC network for ${var.environment} microservices" } # Public Subnet (for load balancers, NAT gateways) resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "public_subnet" { name = "${var.network_name}-public-${var.environment}" ip_cidr_range = var.subnet_ranges.public_subnet region = var.region network = google_compute_network.vpc.id description = "Public subnet for ${var.environment}" log_config { aggregation_interval = "INTERVAL_10_MIN" flow_sampling = 0.5 metadata = "INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA" } } # Private Subnet (for GKE nodes, Cloud Run, VMs) resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "private_subnet" { name = "${var.network_name}-private-${var.environment}" ip_cidr_range = var.subnet_ranges.private_subnet region = var.region network = google_compute_network.vpc.id description = "Private subnet for ${var.environment} microservices" # Secondary ranges for GKE secondary_ip_range { range_name = "gke-pods-${var.environment}" ip_cidr_range = var.subnet_ranges.gke_pods_range } secondary_ip_range { range_name = "gke-services-${var.environment}" ip_cidr_range = var.subnet_ranges.gke_services_range } private_ip_google_access = true log_config { aggregation_interval = "INTERVAL_10_MIN" flow_sampling = 0.5 metadata = "INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA" } } # Database Subnet (for Cloud SQL, Memorystore) resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "database_subnet" { name = "${var.network_name}-database-${var.environment}" ip_cidr_range = var.subnet_ranges.database_subnet region = var.region network = google_compute_network.vpc.id description = "Database subnet for ${var.environment}" private_ip_google_access = true log_config { aggregation_interval = "INTERVAL_10_MIN" flow_sampling = 0.5 metadata = "INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA" } } # Cloud Router for NAT resource "google_compute_router" "router" { name = "${var.network_name}-router-${var.environment}" region = var.region network = google_compute_network.vpc.id bgp { asn = 64514 } } # Cloud NAT for private subnet internet access resource "google_compute_router_nat" "nat" { name = "${var.network_name}-nat-${var.environment}" router = google_compute_router.router.name region = var.region nat_ip_allocate_option = "AUTO_ONLY" source_subnetwork_ip_ranges_to_nat = "ALL_SUBNETWORKS_ALL_IP_RANGES" log_config { enable = true filter = "ERRORS_ONLY" } } # Global IP for load balancer resource "google_compute_global_address" "lb_ip" { name = "${var.network_name}-lb-ip-${var.environment}" description = "Global IP for load balancer in ${var.environment}" ip_version = "IPV4" address_type = "EXTERNAL" } # Firewall Rules resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_internal" { name = "${var.network_name}-allow-internal-${var.environment}" network = google_compute_network.vpc.name allow { protocol = "icmp" } allow { protocol = "tcp" ports = ["0-65535"] } allow { protocol = "udp" ports = ["0-65535"] } source_ranges = [ var.subnet_ranges.public_subnet, var.subnet_ranges.private_subnet, var.subnet_ranges.database_subnet, var.subnet_ranges.gke_pods_range, var.subnet_ranges.gke_services_range ] target_tags = ["internal"] description = "Allow internal communication within VPC" } resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_ssh" { name = "${var.network_name}-allow-ssh-${var.environment}" network = google_compute_network.vpc.name allow { protocol = "tcp" ports = ["22"] } source_ranges = ["0.0.0.0/0"] target_tags = ["ssh-allowed"] description = "Allow SSH access" } resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_http_https" { name = "${var.network_name}-allow-http-https-${var.environment}" network = google_compute_network.vpc.name allow { protocol = "tcp" ports = ["80", "443"] } source_ranges = ["0.0.0.0/0"] target_tags = ["http-server", "https-server"] description = "Allow HTTP and HTTPS traffic" } resource "google_compute_firewall" "allow_gke_webhook" { name = "${var.network_name}-allow-gke-webhook-${var.environment}" network = google_compute_network.vpc.name allow { protocol = "tcp" ports = ["443", "8443", "9443", "15017"] } source_ranges = ["172.16.0.0/28"] # Master CIDR target_tags = ["gke-node"] description = "Allow GKE master to communicate with nodes" } # Private Service Connection for Cloud SQL resource "google_compute_global_address" "private_service_connection" { name = "${var.network_name}-private-service-${var.environment}" purpose = "VPC_PEERING" address_type = "INTERNAL" prefix_length = 16 network = google_compute_network.vpc.id description = "Private service connection for ${var.environment}" } resource "google_service_networking_connection" "private_vpc_connection" { network = google_compute_network.vpc.id service = "servicenetworking.googleapis.com" reserved_peering_ranges = [google_compute_global_address.private_service_connection.name] } # modules/networking/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string } variable "network_name" { description = "Name of the VPC network" type = string } variable "subnet_ranges" { description = "Subnet CIDR ranges" type = object({ public_subnet = string private_subnet = string database_subnet = string gke_pods_range = string gke_services_range = string }) } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } # modules/networking/outputs.tf output "network_id" { description = "The ID of the VPC network" value = google_compute_network.vpc.id } output "network_name" { description = "The name of the VPC network" value = google_compute_network.vpc.name } output "public_subnet_id" { description = "The ID of the public subnet" value = google_compute_subnetwork.public_subnet.id } output "private_subnet_id" { description = "The ID of the private subnet" value = google_compute_subnetwork.private_subnet.id } output "database_subnet_id" { description = "The ID of the database subnet" value = google_compute_subnetwork.database_subnet.id } output "gke_pods_range_name" { description = "Name of the GKE pods secondary range" value = "gke-pods-${var.environment}" } output "gke_services_range_name" { description = "Name of the GKE services secondary range" value = "gke-services-${var.environment}" } output "global_lb_ip" { description = "Global load balancer IP" value = google_compute_global_address.lb_ip.address } output "private_service_connection" { description = "Private service connection" value = google_service_networking_connection.private_vpc_connection }

# modules/artifact_registry/main.tf # Docker repository for container images resource "google_artifact_registry_repository" "docker_repo" { location = var.region repository_id = "${var.application_name}-docker-${var.environment}" description = "Docker repository for ${var.application_name} in ${var.environment}" format = "DOCKER" labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name managed_by = "terraform" } } # Helm repository for Helm charts resource "google_artifact_registry_repository" "helm_repo" { location = var.region repository_id = "${var.application_name}-helm-${var.environment}" description = "Helm repository for ${var.application_name} in ${var.environment}" format = "DOCKER" # Helm charts are stored as OCI artifacts labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name managed_by = "terraform" type = "helm-charts" } } # IAM bindings for Artifact Registry resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "docker_reader" { project = var.project_id location = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.location repository = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.name role = "roles/artifactregistry.reader" member = "serviceAccount:${var.project_id}-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com" } resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "docker_writer" { project = var.project_id location = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.location repository = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.name role = "roles/artifactregistry.writer" member = "serviceAccount:${var.project_id}-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com" } # Service account for CI/CD pipeline resource "google_service_account" "artifact_registry_sa" { account_id = "${var.application_name}-ar-${var.environment}" display_name = "Artifact Registry Service Account for ${var.environment}" description = "Service account for pushing to Artifact Registry in ${var.environment}" } resource "google_service_account_key" "artifact_registry_key" { service_account_id = google_service_account.artifact_registry_sa.name } resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "ci_writer" { project = var.project_id location = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.location repository = google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.name role = "roles/artifactregistry.writer" member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.artifact_registry_sa.email}" } resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "helm_ci_writer" { project = var.project_id location = google_artifact_registry_repository.helm_repo.location repository = google_artifact_registry_repository.helm_repo.name role = "roles/artifactregistry.writer" member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.artifact_registry_sa.email}" } # modules/artifact_registry/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string } # modules/artifact_registry/outputs.tf output "docker_repository_url" { description = "Docker repository URL" value = "${google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.location}-docker.pkg.dev/${var.project_id}/${google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.repository_id}" } output "helm_repository_url" { description = "Helm repository URL" value = "${google_artifact_registry_repository.helm_repo.location}-docker.pkg.dev/${var.project_id}/${google_artifact_registry_repository.helm_repo.repository_id}" } output "repository_url" { description = "Main repository URL (alias for docker_repository_url)" value = "${google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.location}-docker.pkg.dev/${var.project_id}/${google_artifact_registry_repository.docker_repo.repository_id}" } output "service_account_email" { description = "Service account email for CI/CD" value = google_service_account.artifact_registry_sa.email } output "service_account_key" { description = "Service account key for CI/CD" value = google_service_account_key.artifact_registry_key.private_key sensitive = true }

# modules/security/main.tf # KMS Key Ring resource "google_kms_key_ring" "key_ring" { name = "${var.application_name}-keyring-${var.environment}" location = var.region lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } } # KMS Crypto Key for database encryption resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "database_key" { name = "${var.application_name}-database-key-${var.environment}" key_ring = google_kms_key_ring.key_ring.id purpose = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT" version_template { algorithm = "GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION" } lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } } # KMS Crypto Key for application secrets resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "secrets_key" { name = "${var.application_name}-secrets-key-${var.environment}" key_ring = google_kms_key_ring.key_ring.id purpose = "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT" version_template { algorithm = "GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION" } lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } } # Secret Manager secrets resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "database_password" { secret_id = "${var.application_name}-db-password-${var.environment}" labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name type = "database" } replication { auto {} } } resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "database_password_version" { secret = google_secret_manager_secret.database_password.id secret_data = random_password.database_password.result } resource "random_password" "database_password" { length = 32 special = true } # JWT secret for authentication resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "jwt_secret" { secret_id = "${var.application_name}-jwt-secret-${var.environment}" labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name type = "authentication" } replication { auto {} } } resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "jwt_secret_version" { secret = google_secret_manager_secret.jwt_secret.id secret_data = random_password.jwt_secret.result } resource "random_password" "jwt_secret" { length = 64 special = true } # API keys for external services resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "external_api_keys" { for_each = toset([ "stripe-api-key", "sendgrid-api-key", "oauth-google-secret", "oauth-github-secret" ]) secret_id = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-${var.environment}" labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name type = "api-key" } replication { auto {} } } # Service accounts for microservices resource "google_service_account" "microservice_accounts" { for_each = toset([ "user-service", "order-service", "payment-service", "notification-service", "gateway-service" ]) account_id = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-${var.environment}" display_name = "Service Account for ${each.key} in ${var.environment}" description = "Service account for ${each.key} microservice" } # IAM roles for microservices resource "google_project_iam_member" "microservice_permissions" { for_each = { for pair in setproduct( keys(google_service_account.microservice_accounts), ["roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor", "roles/cloudsql.client", "roles/pubsub.publisher", "roles/pubsub.subscriber"] ) : "${pair[0]}-${pair[1]}" => { service_account = pair[0] role = pair[1] } } project = var.project_id role = each.value.role member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.microservice_accounts[each.value.service_account].email}" } # Workload Identity bindings resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "workload_identity_bindings" { for_each = google_service_account.microservice_accounts service_account_id = each.value.name role = "roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser" member = "serviceAccount:${var.project_id}.svc.id.goog[${var.environment}/${each.key}]" } # modules/security/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string } # modules/security/outputs.tf output "kms_key_ring_id" { description = "KMS key ring ID" value = google_kms_key_ring.key_ring.id } output "kms_crypto_key_id" { description = "KMS crypto key ID for database" value = google_kms_crypto_key.database_key.id } output "secrets_kms_key_id" { description = "KMS crypto key ID for secrets" value = google_kms_crypto_key.secrets_key.id } output "database_password_secret_id" { description = "Database password secret ID" value = google_secret_manager_secret.database_password.id } output "jwt_secret_id" { description = "JWT secret ID" value = google_secret_manager_secret.jwt_secret.id } output "microservice_service_accounts" { description = "Microservice service accounts" value = { for name, sa in google_service_account.microservice_accounts : name => { email = sa.email id = sa.id } } } output "external_api_secrets" { description = "External API secrets" value = { for name, secret in google_secret_manager_secret.external_api_keys : name => secret.id } }
documents.s: KMS, Secret Manager, and IAM Configuration

documents.t: # modules/databases/main.tf # Cloud SQL PostgreSQL instance resource "google_sql_database_instance" "postgres" { name = "${var.application_name}-postgres-${var.environment}" database_version = "POSTGRES_${var.database_config.postgres_version}" region = var.region deletion_protection = var.environment == "prod" ? true : false settings { tier = var.database_config.postgres_tier availability_type = var.environment == "prod" ? "REGIONAL" : "ZONAL" disk_type = var.database_config.postgres_disk_type disk_size = var.database_config.postgres_disk_size disk_autoresize = true # IP configuration ip_configuration { ipv4_enabled = false private_network = var.network_id enable_private_path_for_google_cloud_services = true } # Backup configuration backup_configuration { enabled = true start_time = "02:00" point_in_time_recovery_enabled = true transaction_log_retention_days = 7 backup_retention_settings { retained_backups = 30 retention_unit = "COUNT" } } # Maintenance window maintenance_window { day = 7 # Sunday hour = 3 update_track = "stable" } # Database flags for performance tuning database_flags { name = "shared_preload_libraries" value = "pg_stat_statements,pg_hint_plan" } database_flags { name = "log_statement" value = "all" } database_flags { name = "log_min_duration_statement" value = "1000" } # Insights configuration insights_config { query_insights_enabled = true record_application_tags = true record_client_address = true } # User labels user_labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name managed_by = "terraform" } } # Encryption encryption_key_name = var.kms_crypto_key_id depends_on = [var.private_service_connection] } # Databases for microservices resource "google_sql_database" "microservice_databases" { for_each = toset([ "users", "orders", "payments", "notifications", "audit" ]) name = "${each.key}_${var.environment}" instance = google_sql_database_instance.postgres.name } # Database users for microservices resource "google_sql_user" "microservice_users" { for_each = toset([ "user_service", "order_service", "payment_service", "notification_service" ]) name = "${each.key}_${var.environment}" instance = google_sql_database_instance.postgres.name password = random_password.db_passwords[each.key].result } resource "random_password" "db_passwords" { for_each = toset([ "user_service", "order_service", "payment_service", "notification_service" ]) length = 32 special = true } # Store database passwords in Secret Manager resource "google_secret_manager_secret" "db_passwords" { for_each = random_password.db_passwords secret_id = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-db-password-${var.environment}" labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name service = each.key type = "database-password" } replication { auto {} } } resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "db_password_versions" { for_each = google_secret_manager_secret.db_passwords secret = each.value.id secret_data = random_password.db_passwords[each.key].result } # Redis Memorystore instance resource "google_redis_instance" "cache" { name = "${var.application_name}-redis-${var.environment}" memory_size_gb = var.database_config.redis_memory_size_gb tier = var.database_config.redis_tier redis_version = var.database_config.redis_version region = var.region # Network configuration authorized_network = var.network_id connect_mode = "PRIVATE_SERVICE_ACCESS" redis_configs = { maxmemory-policy = "allkeys-lru" notify-keyspace-events = "Ex" } # Maintenance policy maintenance_policy { weekly_maintenance_window { day = "SUNDAY" start_time { hours = 3 minutes = 0 seconds = 0 nanos = 0 } } } # High availability for production replica_count = var.environment == "prod" ? 1 : 0 read_replicas_mode = var.environment == "prod" ? [1] : [] content { origin = ["*"] method = ["GET", "HEAD"] response_header = ["*"] max_age_seconds = 3600 } } # Labels labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name purpose = each.key managed_by = "terraform" } } # Public access for static assets bucket resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "static_assets_public_read" { bucket = google_storage_bucket.app_buckets["static-assets"].name role = "roles/storage.objectViewer" member = "allUsers" } # Filestore instance for shared storage resource "google_filestore_instance" "shared_storage" { name = "${var.application_name}-filestore-${var.environment}" location = var.region tier = var.storage_config.filestore_tier file_shares { capacity_gb = var.storage_config.filestore_capacity_gb name = "shared" } networks { network = var.network_id modes = ["MODE_IPV4"] } # Labels labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name managed_by = "terraform" } } # Service accounts for storage access resource "google_service_account" "storage_service_accounts" { for_each = toset([ "static-assets", "user-uploads", "backups", "logs" ]) account_id = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-sa-${var.environment}" display_name = "Service Account for ${each.key} storage" description = "Service account for accessing ${each.key} bucket" } # IAM bindings for storage service accounts resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "storage_access" { for_each = google_service_account.storage_service_accounts bucket = google_storage_bucket.app_buckets[each.key].name role = "roles/storage.objectAdmin" member = "serviceAccount:${each.value.email}" } # # modules/messaging/main.tf # Pub/Sub topics for microservices communication resource "google_pubsub_topic" "topics" { for_each = { "user-events" = { description = "User lifecycle events (created, updated, deleted)" retention = "604800s" # 7 days } "order-events" = { description = "Order lifecycle events (created, updated, cancelled, completed)" retention = "2592000s" # 30 days } "payment-events" = { description = "Payment events (initiated, completed, failed, refunded)" retention = "2592000s" # 30 days } "notification-events" = { description = "Notification events (email, sms, push)" retention = "259200s" # 3 days } "audit-events" = { description = "Audit trail events for compliance" retention = "7776000s" # 90 days } "analytics-events" = { description = "Analytics and tracking events" retention = "1209600s" # 14 days } "dead-letter" = { description = "Dead letter queue for failed message processing" retention = "2592000s" # 30 days } } name = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-${var.environment}" # Message retention duration message_retention_duration = each.value.retention # Encryption kms_key_name = var.kms_crypto_key_id # Labels labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name purpose = each.key managed_by = "terraform" } } # Pub/Sub subscriptions for microservices resource "google_pubsub_subscription" "subscriptions" { for_each = { # User service subscriptions "user-service-user-events" = { topic = "user-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 20 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "" } # Order service subscriptions "order-service-user-events" = { topic = "user-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 30 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "attributes.event_type = \"created\" OR attributes.event_type = \"updated\"" } "order-service-payment-events" = { topic = "payment-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 30 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "attributes.event_type = \"completed\" OR attributes.event_type = \"failed\"" } # Payment service subscriptions "payment-service-order-events" = { topic = "order-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 60 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "attributes.event_type = \"created\"" } # Notification service subscriptions "notification-service-user-events" = { topic = "user-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 20 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "" } "notification-service-order-events" = { topic = "order-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 20 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "" } "notification-service-payment-events" = { topic = "payment-events" ack_deadline_seconds = 20 dead_letter_topic = "dead-letter" filter = "" } } name = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-${var.environment}" topic = google_pubsub_topic.topics[each.value.topic].name # Acknowledgment deadline ack_deadline_seconds = each.value.ack_deadline_seconds # Message filtering filter = each.value.filter != "" ? each.value.filter : null # Dead letter policy dead_letter_policy { dead_letter_topic = google_pubsub_topic.topics[each.value.dead_letter_topic].id max_delivery_attempts = 5 } # Retry policy retry_policy { minimum_backoff = "10s" maximum_backoff = "600s" } # Enable message ordering for critical subscriptions enable_message_ordering = contains([ "order-service-payment-events", "payment-service-order-events" ], each.key) # Labels labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name service = split("-", each.key)[0] managed_by = "terraform" } } # IAM bindings for Pub/Sub access resource "google_pubsub_topic_iam_member" "publishers" { for_each = { for pair in setproduct( keys(google_pubsub_topic.topics), ["user-service", "order-service", "payment-service", "notification-service"] ) : "${pair[1]}-${pair[0]}" => { topic = pair[0] service = pair[1] } } topic = google_pubsub_topic.topics[each.value.topic].name role = "roles/pubsub.publisher" member = "serviceAccount:${var.application_name}-${each.value.service}-${var.environment}@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" } resource "google_pubsub_subscription_iam_member" "subscribers" { for_each = google_pubsub_subscription.subscriptions subscription = each.value.name role = "roles/pubsub.subscriber" member = "serviceAccount:${var.application_name}-${split("-", each.key)[0]}-service-${var.environment}@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" } # modules/messaging/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string } variable "kms_crypto_key_id" { description = "KMS crypto key ID" type = string } # modules/messaging/outputs.tf output "topic_names" { description = "Pub/Sub topic names" value = { for name, topic in google_pubsub_topic.topics : name => topic.name } } output "subscription_names" { description = "Pub/Sub subscription names" value = { for name, subscription in google_pubsub_subscription.subscriptions : name => subscription.name } }

# modules/cloudrun/main.tf # Cloud Run services for serverless microservices resource "google_cloud_run_v2_service" "services" { for_each = var.cloud_run_services name = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-${var.environment}" location = var.region ingress = "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALL" template { # Service account service_account = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-service-${var.environment}@${var.project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" # Scaling configuration scaling { min_instance_count = each.value.min_instances max_instance_count = each.value.max_instances } # Container configuration containers { image = "${var.artifact_registry_url}/${each.key}:latest" # Resource allocation resources { limits = { cpu = each.value.cpu memory = each.value.memory } cpu_idle = true startup_cpu_boost = true } # Port configuration ports { container_port = each.value.port name = "http1" } # Environment variables dynamic "env" { for_each = each.value.env_vars content { name = env.key value = env.value } } # Environment variables from secrets env { name = "DATABASE_URL" value_source { secret_key_ref { secret = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-db-password-${var.environment}" version = "latest" } } } env { name = "REDIS_URL" value_source { secret_key_ref { secret = "${var.application_name}-redis-config-${var.environment}" version = "latest" } } } # Health check configuration startup_probe { http_get { path = "/health" port = each.value.port } initial_delay_seconds = 10 timeout_seconds = 1 period_seconds = 3 failure_threshold = 5 } liveness_probe { http_get { path = "/health" port = each.value.port } initial_delay_seconds = 30 timeout_seconds = 1 period_seconds = 10 failure_threshold = 3 } } # Request timeout timeout = "${each.value.timeout_seconds}s" # Maximum requests per container max_instance_request_concurrency = each.value.concurrency # Execution environment execution_environment = "EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT_GEN2" } # Traffic configuration traffic { type = "TRAFFIC_TARGET_ALLOCATION_TYPE_LATEST" percent = 100 } # Labels labels = { environment = var.environment application = var.application_name service = each.key managed_by = "terraform" } # Lifecycle lifecycle { ignore_changes = [ template[0].containers[0].image ] } } # IAM policy for Cloud Run services resource "google_cloud_run_service_iam_member" "public_access" { for_each = var.cloud_run_services service = google_cloud_run_v2_service.services[each.key].name location = google_cloud_run_v2_service.services[each.key].location role = "roles/run.invoker" member = "allUsers" } # Load balancer backend for Cloud Run services resource "google_compute_region_network_endpoint_group" "cloud_run_neg" { for_each = var.cloud_run_services name = "${var.application_name}-${each.key}-neg-${var.environment}" network_endpoint_type = "SERVERLESS" region = var.region cloud_run { service = google_cloud_run_v2_service.services[each.key].name } } # modules/cloudrun/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string } variable "cloud_run_services" { description = "Cloud Run service configurations" type = map(object({ image = string port = number cpu = string memory = string min_instances = number max_instances = number concurrency = number timeout_seconds = number env_vars = map(string) })) } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string } variable "artifact_registry_url" { description = "Artifact Registry URL" type = string } # modules/cloudrun/outputs.tf output "service_urls" { description = "Cloud Run service URLs" value = { for name, service in google_cloud_run_v2_service.services : name => service.uri } } output "service_names" { description = "Cloud Run service names" value = { for name, service in google_cloud_run_v2_service.services : name => service.name } }

# modules/monitoring/main.tf # Notification channels resource "google_monitoring_notification_channel" "email" { for_each = toset([ "devops-team@company.com", "sre-team@company.com" ]) display_name = "Email - ${each.key}" type = "email" labels = { email_address = each.key } } # Alert policies for infrastructure resource "google_monitoring_alert_policy" "high_cpu" { display_name = "${var.application_name} - High CPU Usage - ${var.environment}" combiner = "OR" conditions { display_name = "CPU usage is above 80%" condition_threshold { filter = "metric.type=\"compute.googleapis.com/instance/cpu/utilization\" resource.type=\"gce_instance\"" duration = "300s" comparison = "COMPARISON_GREATER_THAN" threshold_value = 0.8 aggregations { alignment_period = "60s" per_series_aligner = "ALIGN_RATE" } } } notification_channels = [ for channel in google_monitoring_notification_channel.email : channel.id ] } # GKE cluster monitoring resource "google_monitoring_alert_policy" "gke_node_not_ready" { display_name = "${var.application_name} - GKE Node Not Ready - ${var.environment}" combiner = "OR" conditions { display_name = "GKE node is not ready" condition_threshold { filter = "metric.type=\"kubernetes.io/node/ready\" resource.type=\"k8s_node\" resource.label.cluster_name=\"${var.gke_cluster_name}\"" duration = "300s" comparison = "COMPARISON_LESS_THAN" threshold_value = 1 aggregations { alignment_period = "60s" per_series_aligner = "ALIGN_MEAN" } } } notification_channels = [ for channel in google_monitoring_notification_channel.email : channel.id ] } # Application-level monitoring dashboard resource "google_monitoring_dashboard" "microservices_dashboard" { dashboard_json = jsonencode({ displayName = "${var.application_name} Microservices Dashboard - ${var.environment}" mosaicLayout = { tiles = [ { width = 6 height = 4 widget = { title = "GKE Cluster CPU Usage" xyChart = { dataSets = [{ timeSeriesQuery = { timeSeriesFilter = { filter = "metric.type=\"kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time\" resource.type=\"k8s_container\"" aggregation = { alignmentPeriod = "60s" perSeriesAligner = "ALIGN_RATE" } } } }] } } }, { width = 6 height = 4 widget = { title = "GKE Cluster Memory Usage" xyChart = { dataSets = [{ timeSeriesQuery = { timeSeriesFilter = { filter = "metric.type=\"kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes\" resource.type=\"k8s_container\"" aggregation = { alignmentPeriod = "60s" perSeriesAligner = "ALIGN_MEAN" } } } }] } } } ] } }) } # modules/monitoring/variables.tf variable "project_id" { description = "The GCP project ID" type = string } variable "region" { description = "The GCP region" type = string } variable "environment" { description = "Environment name" type = string } variable "application_name" { description = "Application name" type = string } variable "gke_cluster_name" { description = "GKE cluster name" type = string } # modules/monitoring/outputs.tf output "notification_channels" { description = "Monitoring notification channels" value = { email = { for email, channel in google_monitoring_notification_channel.email : email => channel.id } } } output "dashboard_url" { description = "Monitoring dashboard URL" value = "https://console.cloud.google.com/monitoring/dashboards/custom/${google_monitoring_dashboard.microservices_dashboard.id}?project=${var.project_id}" }

# Clone your Terraform configuration git clone https://github.com/your-org/microservices-terraform.git cd microservices-terraform # Initialize Terraform terraform init # Create terraform.tfvars for your environment cp environments/dev/terraform.tfvars.example terraform.tfvars # Edit terraform.tfvars with your specific values

# Validate configuration terraform validate # Plan the deployment terraform plan -var-file="terraform.tfvars" -out=tfplan # Review the plan carefully terraform show tfplan # Apply the infrastructure terraform apply tfplan

# Get cluster credentials gcloud container clusters get-credentials microservices-cluster-dev \ --region us-central1 \ --project your-microservices-dev-project # Verify cluster access kubectl get nodes kubectl get namespaces # Create application namespace kubectl create namespace dev # Set up Workload Identity kubectl annotate serviceaccount default \ --namespace dev \ iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account=microservices-app-gateway-service-dev@your-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com

# Build and push container images docker build -t us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/microservices-app-docker-dev/gateway:latest gateway/ docker push us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/microservices-app-docker-dev/gateway:latest docker build -t us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/microservices-app-docker-dev/auth:latest auth/ docker push us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/microservices-app-docker-dev/auth:latest # Deploy to Cloud Run (if using Cloud Run) gcloud run deploy gateway \ --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/microservices-app-docker-dev/gateway:latest \ --region us-central1 \ --platform managed \ --allow-unauthenticated # Or deploy to GKE using kubectl kubectl apply -f k8s-manifests/

# Check Cloud Run services gcloud run services list --region us-central1 # Check GKE deployments kubectl get pods -n dev kubectl get services -n dev # Check database connectivity kubectl run test-pod --image=postgres:15 --rm -it --restart=Never -- \ psql -h <POSTGRES_IP> -U user_service_dev -d users_dev # Check Redis connectivity kubectl run test-pod --image=redis:7 --rm -it --restart=Never -- \ redis-cli -h <REDIS_HOST> ping

Least Privilege Access Use separate service accounts for each microservice Grant minimal required permissions Enable Workload Identity for GKE pods Encryption at Rest and in Transit Use Cloud KMS for database encryption Enable TLS for all communications Encrypt secrets in Secret Manager Network Security Use private GKE clusters Implement network policies Use authorized networks for database access Secret Management Store all sensitive data in Secret Manager Use IAM to control secret access Rotate secrets regularly

Resource Management Set appropriate CPU and memory limits Use horizontal pod autoscaling Configure cluster autoscaling Database Optimization Use read replicas for analytics workloads Configure connection pooling Monitor query performance Caching Strategy Use Redis for session and application caching Implement CDN for static assets Cache frequently accessed data

Right-sizing Resources Use preemptible instances for non-critical workloads Scale down development environments Monitor resource utilization Storage Optimization Use lifecycle policies for Cloud Storage Choose appropriate storage classes Clean up unused resources Monitoring and Alerting Set up budget alerts Monitor resource usage trends Use committed use discounts for stable workloads

Infrastructure as Code Version control all Terraform configurations Use environment-specific configurations Implement automated testing CI/CD Pipeline Automate infrastructure deployments Use GitOps for application deployments Implement automated testing Monitoring and Observability Set up comprehensive monitoring Implement distributed tracing Use structured logging Disaster Recovery Implement backup strategies Test recovery procedures Use multi-region deployments for critical systems

Terraform Issues​ Issue: Provider authentication errors # Solution: Set up authentication export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="path/to/service-account-key.json" gcloud auth application-default login Issue: Resource quota exceeded # Solution: Check and increase quotas gcloud compute project-info describe --project=PROJECT_ID gcloud compute quotas list --project=PROJECT_ID GKE Issues​ Issue: Pods stuck in pending state # Check node resources kubectl describe nodes kubectl top nodes # Check pod events kubectl describe pod POD_NAME -n NAMESPACE Issue: LoadBalancer service stuck in pending # Check quota for load balancers gcloud compute addresses list gcloud compute forwarding-rules list # Check firewall rules gcloud compute firewall-rules list Database Issues​ Issue: Connection timeout to Cloud SQL # Check authorized networks gcloud sql instances describe INSTANCE_NAME # Check private service connection gcloud services vpc-peerings list --service=servicenetworking.googleapis.com Application Issues​ Issue: Cloud Run service not accessible # Check IAM permissions gcloud run services get-iam-policy SERVICE_NAME --region=REGION # Check service configuration gcloud run services describe SERVICE_NAME --region=REGION

Health Checks​ # GKE cluster health kubectl get nodes kubectl get pods --all-namespaces kubectl cluster-info # Database health gcloud sql instances list gcloud redis instances list --region=REGION # Cloud Run health gcloud run services list --region=REGION Log Analysis​ # View GKE logs kubectl logs -f deployment/DEPLOYMENT_NAME -n NAMESPACE # View Cloud Run logs gcloud logs read "resource.type=cloud_run_revision" --limit=50 # View database logs gcloud logs read "resource.type=cloudsql_database" --limit=50 This comprehensive guide provides everything needed to deploy production-ready microservices on Google Cloud Platform using Terraform, including all the infrastructure components, security configurations, monitoring, and operational best practices. Our GitOps implementation follows a multi-repository pattern: Application Repositories: Source code for each microservice Infrastructure Repository: Terraform configurations for GCP resources GitOps Repository: Kubernetes manifests and Kustomize configurations Shared Libraries Repository: Common configurations and utilities

# Install required CLI tools # Google Cloud SDK curl https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash exec -l $SHELL gcloud init # kubectl gcloud components install kubectl # kustomize curl -s "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/master/hack/install_kustomize.sh" | bash # ArgoCD CLI curl -sSL -o argocd-linux-amd64 https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/releases/latest/download/argocd-linux-amd64 sudo install -m 555 argocd-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/argocd # Terraform wget https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.5.0/terraform_1.5.0_linux_amd64.zip unzip terraform_1.5.0_linux_amd64.zip sudo mv terraform /usr/local/bin/

# Set up GCP project export PROJECT_ID="your-microservices-project" export REGION="us-central1" export CLUSTER_NAME="microservices-cluster" gcloud config set project $PROJECT_ID gcloud services enable container.googleapis.com gcloud services enable cloudsql.googleapis.com gcloud services enable secretmanager.googleapis.com

Create the infrastructure repository with the following structure: infrastructure/ ├── terraform/ │ ├── environments/ │ │ ├── dev/ │ │ ├── staging/ │ │ └── production/ │ ├── modules/ │ │ ├── gke/ │ │ ├── cloudsql/ │ │ └── networking/ │ └── shared/ └── scripts/ GKE Cluster Module​ # terraform/modules/gke/main.tf resource "google_container_cluster" "primary" { name = var.cluster_name location = var.region # Remove default node pool remove_default_node_pool = true initial_node_count = 1 # Network configuration network = var.vpc_name subnetwork = var.subnet_name # Enable workload identity workload_identity_config { workload_pool = "${var.project_id}.svc.id.goog" } # Enable network policy network_policy { enabled = true } # Private cluster configuration private_cluster_config { enable_private_nodes = true enable_private_endpoint = false master_ipv4_cidr_block = "172.16.0.0/28" } # Master authorized networks master_authorized_networks_config { cidr_blocks { cidr_block = "10.0.0.0/8" display_name = "internal" } } # Enable logging and monitoring logging_service = "logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes" monitoring_service = "monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes" # Addons addons_config { horizontal_pod_autoscaling { disabled = false } network_policy_config { disabled = false } istio_config { disabled = false auth = "AUTH_MUTUAL_TLS" } } } resource "google_container_node_pool" "primary_nodes" { name = "${var.cluster_name}-node-pool" location = var.region cluster = google_container_cluster.primary.name node_count = var.node_count node_config { preemptible = var.preemptible machine_type = var.machine_type disk_size_gb = var.disk_size_gb disk_type = "pd-ssd" # Google service account service_account = google_service_account.gke_nodes.email oauth_scopes = [ "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write", "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring", "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.read_only" ] # Workload Identity workload_metadata_config { mode = "GKE_METADATA" } labels = var.node_labels tags = var.node_tags } autoscaling { min_node_count = var.min_node_count max_node_count = var.max_node_count } management { auto_repair = true auto_upgrade = true } } resource "google_service_account" "gke_nodes" { account_id = "${var.cluster_name}-nodes" display_name = "GKE Nodes Service Account" } Environment-Specific Configuration​ # terraform/environments/production/main.tf module "gke_cluster" { source = "../../modules/gke" project_id = var.project_id cluster_name = "microservices-prod" region = "us-central1" vpc_name = "microservices-vpc" subnet_name = "microservices-subnet" machine_type = "e2-standard-4" node_count = 3 min_node_count = 3 max_node_count = 10 disk_size_gb = 100 preemptible = false node_labels = { environment = "production" team = "platform" } node_tags = ["microservices", "production"] }

Create a dedicated GitOps repository with the following structure: gitops-microservices/ ├── applications/ │ ├── api-gateway/ │ ├── user-service/ │ ├── order-service/ │ ├── payment-service/ │ └── notification-service/ ├── infrastructure/ │ ├── argocd/ │ ├── ingress-nginx/ │ ├── cert-manager/ │ ├── prometheus/ │ └── grafana/ ├── environments/ │ ├── base/ │ ├── development/ │ ├── staging/ │ └── production/ └── scripts/ ├── bootstrap.sh └── sync-all.sh

name: user-service image: gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/user-service:latest ports: - containerPort: 3000 name: http env: - name: NODE_ENV value: production - name: DATABASE_URL valueFrom: secretKeyRef: name: user-service-secrets key: database-url - name: JWT_SECRET valueFrom: secretKeyRef: name: user-service-secrets key: jwt-secret resources: requests: memory: '256Mi' cpu: '250m' limits: memory: '512Mi' cpu: '500m' livenessProbe: httpGet: path: /health port: 3000 initialDelaySeconds: 30 periodSeconds: 10 readinessProbe: httpGet: path: /ready port: 3000 initialDelaySeconds: 5 periodSeconds: 5 securityContext: allowPrivilegeEscalation: false runAsNonRoot: true runAsUser: 1000 readOnlyRootFilesystem: true capabilities: drop: - ALL --- apiVersion: v1 kind: Service metadata: name: user-service labels: app: user-service spec: ports: - port: 80 targetPort: 3000 protocol: TCP name: http selector: app: user-service type: ClusterIP --- apiVersion: v1 kind: ServiceAccount metadata: name: user-service annotations: iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account: user-service@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com Base Kustomization​ # applications/user-service/base/kustomization.yaml apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 kind: Kustomization metadata: name: user-service-base resources: - deployment.yaml - service.yaml - serviceaccount.yaml - networkpolicy.yaml commonLabels: app: user-service component: backend part-of: microservices images: - name: gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/user-service newTag: latest configMapGenerator: - name: user-service-config literals: - PORT=3000 - LOG_LEVEL=info - METRICS_ENABLED=true secretGenerator: - name: user-service-secrets literals: - database-url=placeholder - jwt-secret=placeholder type: Opaque

Production Overlay​ # applications/user-service/overlays/production/kustomization.yaml apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 kind: Kustomization namespace: microservices-prod resources: - ../../base - hpa.yaml - pdb.yaml - monitoring.yaml patchesStrategicMerge: - deployment-patch.yaml - service-patch.yaml replicas: - name: user-service count: 3 images: - name: gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/user-service newTag: v1.2.3 configMapGenerator: - name: user-service-config behavior: merge literals: - LOG_LEVEL=warn - METRICS_ENABLED=true - CACHE_TTL=3600 secretGenerator: - name: user-service-secrets behavior: replace files: - database-url=secrets/database-url - jwt-secret=secrets/jwt-secret Production Patches​ # applications/user-service/overlays/production/deployment-patch.yaml apiVersion: apps/v1 kind: Deployment metadata: name: user-service spec: template: spec: containers: - name: user-service resources: requests: memory: '512Mi' cpu: '500m' limits: memory: '1Gi' cpu: '1000m' env: - name: NODE_ENV value: production - name: LOG_LEVEL value: warn Horizontal Pod Autoscaler​ # applications/user-service/overlays/production/hpa.yaml apiVersion: autoscaling/v2 kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler metadata: name: user-service-hpa spec: scaleTargetRef: apiVersion: apps/v1 kind: Deployment name: user-service minReplicas: 3 maxReplicas: 10 metrics: - type: Resource resource: name: cpu target: type: Utilization averageUtilization: 70 - type: Resource resource: name: memory target: type: Utilization averageUtilization: 80 behavior: scaleDown: stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 policies: - type: Percent value: 10 periodSeconds: 60 scaleUp: stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0 policies: - type: Percent value: 100 periodSeconds: 15 - type: Pods value: 4 periodSeconds: 15 selectPolicy: Max Pod Disruption Budget​ Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) ensure high availability during voluntary disruptions like node maintenance, cluster upgrades, or deployments. # applications/user-service/overlays/production/pdb.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb labels: app: user-service component: backend spec: # Ensure at least 2 pods are always running minAvailable: 2 # Alternative: Allow maximum 1 pod to be disrupted at a time # maxUnavailable: 1 selector: matchLabels: app: user-service PDB Configuration Examples​ Option 1: Minimum Available Pods # Best for critical services - guarantees minimum capacity apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-min-available spec: minAvailable: 2 # Always keep at least 2 pods running selector: matchLabels: app: user-service Option 2: Maximum Unavailable Pods # More flexible - allows percentage-based disruptions apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-max-unavailable spec: maxUnavailable: 1 # Allow maximum 1 pod disruption selector: matchLabels: app: user-service Option 3: Percentage-Based PDB # Scales with deployment size apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-percentage spec: minAvailable: 75% # Keep 75% of pods available # Alternative: maxUnavailable: 25% selector: matchLabels: app: user-service Option 4: Environment-Specific PDB # Different strategies per environment # Production - Conservative approach apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-prod namespace: microservices-prod spec: minAvailable: 80% # Keep 80% available in production selector: matchLabels: app: user-service environment: production --- # Staging - More aggressive updates allowed apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-staging namespace: microservices-staging spec: maxUnavailable: 50% # Allow 50% disruption in staging selector: matchLabels: app: user-service environment: staging Advanced PDB with Multiple Selectors​ # applications/user-service/overlays/production/pdb-advanced.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb-advanced labels: app: user-service component: backend managed-by: argocd spec: # Use percentage for better scaling minAvailable: 66% # At least 2/3 of pods must remain available selector: matchLabels: app: user-service tier: backend matchExpressions: - key: version operator: In values: ['v1', 'v2'] # Apply to specific versions only PDB Best Practices Configuration​ # applications/user-service/base/pdb-template.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb labels: app: user-service component: backend annotations: # Document the rationale description: 'Ensures high availability during cluster maintenance' contact: 'platform-team@company.com' runbook: 'https://runbooks.company.com/pdb-user-service' spec: # Start conservative, tune based on SLO requirements minAvailable: 2 selector: matchLabels: app: user-service # Note: PDB only protects against voluntary disruptions # - Node maintenance # - Cluster upgrades # - kubectl drain # - Deployment updates with rolling strategy # # Does NOT protect against: # - Node failures # - Pod crashes # - Resource exhaustion Integration with Kustomize​ Update your production overlay to include PDB: # applications/user-service/overlays/production/kustomization.yaml apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 kind: Kustomization namespace: microservices-prod resources: - ../../base - hpa.yaml - pdb.yaml # Add PDB resource - monitoring.yaml patchesStrategicMerge: - deployment-patch.yaml - service-patch.yaml - pdb-patch.yaml # Optional: environment-specific PDB patches replicas: - name: user-service count: 3 images: - name: gcr.io/PROJECT_ID/user-service newTag: v1.2.3 Environment-Specific PDB Patches​ # applications/user-service/overlays/production/pdb-patch.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb spec: # Production: Very conservative minAvailable: 3 # Override base minAvailable # applications/user-service/overlays/staging/pdb-patch.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb spec: # Staging: Allow more disruption for faster updates maxUnavailable: 50% # applications/user-service/overlays/development/pdb-patch.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: user-service-pdb spec: # Development: Minimal protection, fast updates maxUnavailable: 2 PDB Monitoring and Alerting​ # monitoring/pdb-alerts.yaml apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1 kind: PrometheusRule metadata: name: pdb-alerts namespace: microservices-prod spec: groups: - name: pdb.rules rules: - alert: PodDisruptionBudgetViolation expr: | kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy < kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_desired_healthy for: 5m labels: severity: warning component: pdb annotations: summary: 'Pod Disruption Budget violated for {{ $labels.poddisruptionbudget }}' description: 'PDB {{ $labels.poddisruptionbudget }} in namespace {{ $labels.namespace }} has {{ $value }} healthy pods, but requires {{ $labels.desired_healthy }}' - alert: PodDisruptionBudgetAtLimit expr: | kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy == kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_desired_healthy for: 2m labels: severity: info component: pdb annotations: summary: 'Pod Disruption Budget at minimum for {{ $labels.poddisruptionbudget }}' description: 'PDB {{ $labels.poddisruptionbudget }} is at its minimum healthy pod count. Any disruption will violate the budget.' Validation and Testing​ # Check PDB status kubectl get pdb -n microservices-prod kubectl describe pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod # Test PDB during deployment kubectl rollout status deployment/user-service -n microservices-prod # Simulate disruption (be careful in production!) kubectl drain NODE_NAME --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data # Check if PDB prevents disruption kubectl get pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod -o yaml # Validate PDB covers your pods kubectl get pods -n microservices-prod -l app=user-service kubectl get pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod -o jsonpath='{.status}' Troubleshooting PDB Issues​ # Common PDB problems and solutions # 1. PDB preventing all disruptions kubectl get pdb -n microservices-prod # Solution: Increase replica count or adjust minAvailable # 2. Pods not matching PDB selector kubectl get pods -n microservices-prod --show-labels kubectl get pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod -o yaml # Solution: Fix label selectors # 3. PDB with zero disruptions allowed kubectl describe pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod # Solution: Adjust minAvailable or maxUnavailable values # 4. Check PDB events kubectl get events -n microservices-prod --field-selector involvedObject.kind=PodDisruptionBudget # 5. Force bypass PDB (emergency only!) kubectl delete pdb user-service-pdb -n microservices-prod # Remember to recreate after emergency maintenance

StatefulSets require special consideration for PDB configuration due to their stateful nature and ordered deployment/scaling requirements. This is particularly important for distributed systems like Kafka, Elasticsearch, or databases. Kafka StatefulSet PDB Configuration​ # infrastructure/kafka/base/kafka-statefulset.yaml apiVersion: apps/v1 kind: StatefulSet metadata: name: kafka labels: app: kafka component: broker spec: serviceName: kafka-headless replicas: 3 podManagementPolicy: Parallel # Important for Kafka selector: matchLabels: app: kafka template: metadata: labels: app: kafka component: broker spec: containers: - name: kafka image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.4.0 ports: - containerPort: 9092 name: kafka - containerPort: 9093 name: kafka-internal env: - name: KAFKA_BROKER_ID valueFrom: fieldRef: fieldPath: metadata.annotations['kafka.apache.org/broker-id'] - name: KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT value: 'zookeeper:2181' - name: KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS value: 'PLAINTEXT://$(POD_NAME).kafka-headless:9092' volumeMounts: - name: kafka-data mountPath: /var/lib/kafka/data resources: requests: memory: '1Gi' cpu: '500m' limits: memory: '2Gi' cpu: '1000m' readinessProbe: tcpSocket: port: 9092 initialDelaySeconds: 30 periodSeconds: 10 livenessProbe: tcpSocket: port: 9092 initialDelaySeconds: 60 periodSeconds: 30 volumeClaimTemplates: - metadata: name: kafka-data spec: accessModes: ['ReadWriteOnce'] resources: requests: storage: 100Gi storageClassName: fast-ssd Kafka PDB - Conservative Approach​ # infrastructure/kafka/base/kafka-pdb.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-pdb labels: app: kafka component: broker annotations: description: 'Ensures Kafka cluster maintains quorum during maintenance' contact: 'platform-team@company.com' runbook: 'https://runbooks.company.com/kafka-maintenance' spec: # For 3-node Kafka cluster: Allow maximum 1 broker disruption # Maintains 2/3 quorum for partition leadership maxUnavailable: 1 selector: matchLabels: app: kafka component: broker Advanced Kafka PDB with Replica Considerations​ # infrastructure/kafka/overlays/production/kafka-pdb-advanced.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-pdb-production labels: app: kafka component: broker environment: production annotations: description: 'Production Kafka PDB - Conservative disruption policy' kafka.replicas: '5' min.insync.replicas: '2' replication.factor: '3' spec: # For 5-node production cluster # Keep at least 4 brokers available (80% availability) minAvailable: 4 selector: matchLabels: app: kafka component: broker environment: production Environment-Specific Kafka PDB​ # infrastructure/kafka/overlays/staging/kafka-pdb-staging.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-pdb-staging namespace: kafka-staging spec: # Staging: More aggressive updates allowed # 3-node cluster, allow 2 disruptions for faster testing maxUnavailable: 2 selector: matchLabels: app: kafka environment: staging --- # infrastructure/kafka/overlays/development/kafka-pdb-dev.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-pdb-dev namespace: kafka-dev spec: # Development: Allow all disruptions for rapid iteration maxUnavailable: 100% selector: matchLabels: app: kafka environment: development Multi-Component StatefulSet PDB (Kafka + Zookeeper)​ # infrastructure/kafka/base/zookeeper-pdb.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: zookeeper-pdb labels: app: zookeeper component: ensemble spec: # Zookeeper ensemble: maintain quorum # For 3-node ensemble, allow max 1 disruption maxUnavailable: 1 selector: matchLabels: app: zookeeper component: ensemble --- # Separate PDB for Kafka brokers apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-brokers-pdb labels: app: kafka component: broker spec: # Kafka brokers: allow 1 disruption to maintain service maxUnavailable: 1 selector: matchLabels: app: kafka component: broker StatefulSet PDB Best Practices​ # infrastructure/kafka/base/kafka-pdb-best-practices.yaml apiVersion: policy/v1 kind: PodDisruptionBudget metadata: name: kafka-pdb-best-practices labels: app: kafka managed-by: kustomize annotations: # Document the reasoning description: | Kafka PDB ensuring cluster stability during voluntary disruptions. Configuration rationale: - Kafka replicas: 3 - Replication factor: 3 - Min in-sync replicas: 2 - Allow 1 broker disruption to maintain quorum This configuration ensures: - Partition leadership can be maintained - No data loss during rolling updates - ISR (In-Sync Replica) requirements are met contact: 'platform-team@company.com' runbook: 'https://runbooks.company.com/kafka/maintenance' slo.availability: '99.9%' disaster.recovery.plan: 'https://docs.company.com/kafka-dr' spec: # Conservative approach: Allow only 1 disruption maxUnavailable: 1 selector: matchLabels: app: kafka # Use matchExpressions for more complex selection matchExpressions: - key: component operator: In values: ['broker', 'kafka-broker'] - key: version operator: Exists # Any version Kustomize Integration for Kafka​ # infrastructure/kafka/base/kustomization.yaml apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 kind: Kustomization metadata: name: kafka-base resources: - kafka-statefulset.yaml - kafka-service.yaml - kafka-headless-service.yaml - kafka-pdb.yaml - zookeeper-statefulset.yaml - zookeeper-service.yaml - zookeeper-pdb.yaml - kafka-configmap.yaml commonLabels: app.kubernetes.io/name: kafka app.kubernetes.io/component: messaging app.kubernetes.io/part-of: data-platform configMapGenerator: - name: kafka-config literals: - KAFKA_NUM_PARTITIONS=3 - KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR=3 - KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS=2 - KAFKA_LOG_RETENTION_HOURS=168 # infrastructure/kafka/overlays/production/kustomization.yaml apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1 kind: Kustomization namespace: kafka-prod resources: - ../../base - kafka-pdb-production.yaml - kafka-monitoring.yaml patchesStrategicMerge: - kafka-statefulset-patch.yaml - kafka-pdb-patch.yaml replicas: - name: kafka count: 5 # Production cluster size configMapGenerator: - name: kafka-config behavior: merge literals: - KAFKA_DEFAULT_REPLICATION_FACTOR=3 - KAFKA_MIN_INSYNC_REPLICAS=2 - KAFKA_NUM_NETWORK_THREADS=8 - KAFKA_NUM_IO_THREADS=16 StatefulSet PDB Monitoring​ # monitoring/kafka-pdb-alerts.yaml apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1 kind: PrometheusRule metadata: name: kafka-pdb-alerts namespace: kafka-prod spec: groups: - name: kafka-pdb.rules rules: - alert: KafkaPDBViolation expr: | kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="kafka-pdb"} < kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_desired_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="kafka-pdb"} for: 2m labels: severity: critical component: kafka service: messaging annotations: summary: 'Kafka Pod Disruption Budget violated' description: | Kafka cluster PDB violation detected: - Current healthy pods: {{ $value }} - Required healthy pods: {{ $labels.desired_healthy }} - This may impact Kafka availability and partition leadership runbook_url: 'https://runbooks.company.com/kafka/pdb-violation' - alert: KafkaPDBAtLimit expr: | kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="kafka-pdb"} == kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_desired_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="kafka-pdb"} for: 5m labels: severity: warning component: kafka annotations: summary: 'Kafka PDB at minimum healthy pods' description: | Kafka cluster is at minimum healthy pod count. Any additional disruption will violate the PDB. Consider delaying maintenance operations. - alert: ZookeeperPDBViolation expr: | kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_current_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="zookeeper-pdb"} < kube_poddisruptionbudget_status_desired_healthy{poddisruptionbudget="zookeeper-pdb"} for: 1m labels: severity: critical component: zookeeper annotations: summary: 'Zookeeper ensemble PDB violated' description: | Zookeeper ensemble quorum at risk: - Current healthy nodes: {{ $value }} - Required nodes: {{ $labels.desired_healthy }} - This will impact Kafka cluster coordination Validation Scripts for StatefulSet PDB​ #!/bin/bash # scripts/validate-kafka-pdb.sh set -euo pipefail NAMESPACE=${1:-kafka-prod} KAFKA_CLUSTER=${2:-kafka} echo "=== Validating Kafka PDB Configuration ===" # Check if PDB exists echo "1. Checking PDB existence..." kubectl get pdb ${KAFKA_CLUSTER}-pdb -n $NAMESPACE # Check PDB status echo "2. Checking PDB status..." PDB_STATUS=$(kubectl get pdb ${KAFKA_CLUSTER}-pdb -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status}') echo "PDB Status: $PDB_STATUS" # Check current healthy pods CURRENT_HEALTHY=$(kubectl get pdb ${KAFKA_CLUSTER}-pdb -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status.currentHealthy}') DESIRED_HEALTHY=$(kubectl get pdb ${KAFKA_CLUSTER}-pdb -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status.desiredHealthy}') echo "3. PDB Health Status:" echo " Current Healthy: $CURRENT_HEALTHY" echo " Desired Healthy: $DESIRED_HEALTHY" # Validate pod labels match PDB selector echo "4. Validating pod selector matching..." kubectl get pods -n $NAMESPACE -l app=$KAFKA_CLUSTER --show-labels # Check StatefulSet ready replicas READY_REPLICAS=$(kubectl get statefulset $KAFKA_CLUSTER -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.status.readyReplicas}') TOTAL_REPLICAS=$(kubectl get statefulset $KAFKA_CLUSTER -n $NAMESPACE -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}') echo "5. StatefulSet Status:" echo " Ready Replicas: $READY_REPLICAS" echo " Total Replicas: $TOTAL_REPLICAS" # Test disruption simulation (dry-run) echo "6. Testing disruption simulation (dry-run)..." kubectl drain $(kubectl get nodes -o name | head -1) --dry-run=client --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data echo "=== Validation Complete ===" Emergency PDB Procedures for StatefulSets​ # Emergency procedures for Kafka cluster # 1. Check cluster health before PDB operations echo "=== Pre-maintenance Kafka Health Check ===" kubectl exec -n kafka-prod kafka-0 -- kafka-topics.sh \ --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 \ --list # Check topic health and ISR status kubectl exec -n kafka-prod kafka-0 -- kafka-topics.sh \ --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 \ --describe \ --under-replicated-partitions # 2. Temporarily relax PDB for emergency maintenance kubectl patch pdb kafka-pdb -n kafka-prod -p '{"spec":{"maxUnavailable":"100%"}}' # 3. Perform maintenance operations # ... your maintenance tasks ... # 4. Restore original PDB configuration kubectl patch pdb kafka-pdb -n kafka-prod -p '{"spec":{"maxUnavailable":1}}' # 5. Verify cluster health post-maintenance kubectl exec -n kafka-prod kafka-0 -- kafka-broker-api-versions.sh \ --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 # 6. Check topic partition leadership distribution kubectl exec -n kafka-prod kafka-0 -- kafka-topics.sh \ --bootstrap-server localhost:9092 \ --describe StatefulSet PDB Troubleshooting​ # Common StatefulSet PDB issues and solutions # 1. PDB blocking StatefulSet updates echo "=== Troubleshooting StatefulSet Update Issues ===" kubectl describe pdb kafka-pdb -n kafka-prod kubectl get statefulset kafka -n kafka-prod -o yaml | grep -A 10 updateStrategy # Check rolling update status kubectl rollout status statefulset/kafka -n kafka-prod # 2. Pods not matching PDB selector echo "=== Checking Pod Label Matching ===" kubectl get pods -n kafka-prod -l app=kafka --show-labels kubectl get pdb kafka-pdb -n kafka-prod -o yaml | grep -A 5 selector # 3. Check for conflicting PDBs kubectl get pdb -n kafka-prod -o wide # 4. Validate StatefulSet pod management policy kubectl get statefulset kafka -n kafka-prod -o jsonpath='{.spec.podManagementPolicy}' # 5. Check persistent volume status kubectl get pvc -n kafka-prod kubectl get pv | grep kafka # 6. Force StatefulSet pod recreation (emergency) kubectl delete pod kafka-0 -n kafka-prod # Wait for pod to be recreated and ready before proceeding to next This StatefulSet PDB configuration ensures your Kafka cluster (and other stateful services) maintain high availability during maintenance operations while respecting the stateful nature and ordering requirements of these systems.
