This comprehensive guide covers implementing Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) in your CI/CD pipeline using OWASP ZAP and GitHub Actions to automatically detect security vulnerabilities in running applications.
documents.s: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) with OWASP ZAP and GitHub Actions

documents.t: Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) is a security testing approach that analyzes running applications to identify vulnerabilities that could be exploited by attackers. Unlike Static Application Security Testing (SAST), DAST tests applications from the outside, simulating real-world attack scenarios.

Runtime Vulnerability Detection: Identifies issues only visible when the application is running Real-world Testing: Tests the application as an attacker would see it Technology Agnostic: Works with any web application regardless of programming language Configuration Issues: Detects server misconfigurations and deployment issues Authentication Testing: Can test authenticated areas of applications
OWASP ZAP is a free, open-source web application security scanner maintained by the OWASP Foundation. It's designed to be used by both beginners and security professionals.

Automated Scanning: Passive and active security scanning Manual Testing: Interactive proxy for manual security testing API Support: REST API and command-line interface Extensible: Plugin architecture with marketplace CI/CD Integration: Docker images and automation scripts
graph TD A[Development] --> B[Pull Request] B --> C[DAST Baseline Scan] C --> D[Merge to Main] D --> E[Full DAST Scan] E --> F[Security Report] F --> G[Deployment Gate]

Baseline Scan: Quick scan for common vulnerabilities Full Scan: Comprehensive security assessment API Scan: Specialized scanning for REST/GraphQL APIs Authenticated Scan: Testing with user credentials

Create .github/workflows/dast-scan.yml: name: DAST Security Scan on: push: branches: [ main, develop ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] schedule: # Run daily at 2 AM UTC - cron: '0 2 * * *' env: TARGET_URL: ${{ secrets.TARGET_URL || 'http://localhost:3000' }} jobs: dast-scan: runs-on: ubuntu-latest name: DAST Security Scan steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup application run: | # Start your application (example with Docker) docker-compose up -d # Wait for application to be ready timeout 300 bash -c 'until curl -f ${{ env.TARGET_URL }}/health; do sleep 5; done' - name: Run OWASP ZAP Baseline Scan uses: zaproxy/action-baseline@v0.10.0 with: target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/baseline.tsv' cmd_options: '-a' - name: Upload ZAP results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: zap-baseline-report path: report_html.html - name: Create security issue if: failure() uses: actions/github-script@v7 with: script: | const fs = require('fs'); const report = fs.readFileSync('report_html.html', 'utf8'); github.rest.issues.create({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, title: 'DAST Security Vulnerabilities Detected', body: `## Security Scan Results DAST scan has detected security vulnerabilities in the application. **Scan Details:** - Target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} - Commit: ${{ github.sha }} - Branch: ${{ github.ref_name }} Please review the detailed report in the artifacts.`, labels: ['security', 'vulnerability', 'dast'] });

Create .github/workflows/advanced-dast.yml: name: Advanced DAST Pipeline on: push: branches: [ main ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] env: REGISTRY: ghcr.io IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }} jobs: build-and-deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest outputs: app-url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.app-url }} steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Build application run: | docker build -t test-app . - name: Deploy to test environment id: deploy run: | # Deploy to staging/test environment docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name test-app test-app echo "app-url=http://localhost:3000" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT # Health check timeout 120 bash -c 'until curl -f http://localhost:3000/health; do sleep 2; done' baseline-scan: needs: build-and-deploy runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: ZAP Baseline Scan uses: zaproxy/action-baseline@v0.10.0 with: target: ${{ needs.build-and-deploy.outputs.app-url }} rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/baseline.tsv' cmd_options: '-a -j -m 2 -T 5' - name: Upload baseline results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: zap-baseline-results path: | report_html.html report_json.json full-scan: needs: build-and-deploy runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: ZAP Full Scan uses: zaproxy/action-full-scan@v0.8.0 with: target: ${{ needs.build-and-deploy.outputs.app-url }} rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/full-scan.tsv' cmd_options: '-a -j -m 10 -T 60' - name: Upload full scan results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: zap-full-scan-results path: | report_html.html report_json.json - name: Process results run: | # Parse JSON report for metrics python3 .github/scripts/process-zap-results.py report_json.json api-scan: needs: build-and-deploy runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Generate OpenAPI spec run: | # Generate or copy OpenAPI specification curl ${{ needs.build-and-deploy.outputs.app-url }}/api/docs/json > openapi.json - name: ZAP API Scan uses: zaproxy/action-api-scan@v0.6.0 with: target: ${{ needs.build-and-deploy.outputs.app-url }} format: openapi api_file: openapi.json cmd_options: '-a -j' - name: Upload API scan results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: zap-api-scan-results path: | report_html.html report_json.json security-gate: needs: [baseline-scan, full-scan, api-scan] runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: always() steps: - name: Download all artifacts uses: actions/download-artifact@v4 - name: Security gate check run: | # Process all scan results python3 .github/scripts/security-gate.py \ --baseline zap-baseline-results/report_json.json \ --full zap-full-scan-results/report_json.json \ --api zap-api-scan-results/report_json.json \ --threshold-high 0 \ --threshold-medium 5

Create .github/workflows/auth-dast.yml: name: Authenticated DAST Scan on: schedule: - cron: '0 6 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday workflow_dispatch: jobs: authenticated-scan: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup test environment run: | docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d sleep 30 - name: Create test user run: | # Create test user account curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/users \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"username":"testuser","password":"TestPass123!","email":"test@example.com"}' - name: Run authenticated ZAP scan run: | docker run --rm \ --network host \ -v $(pwd)/.zap/auth:/zap/auth \ -v $(pwd)/.zap/context:/zap/context \ -v $(pwd)/reports:/zap/reports \ owasp/zap2docker-stable \ zap-full-scan.py \ -t http://localhost:3000 \ -n /zap/context/default.context \ -U testuser \ -z "-config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true" \ -J zap-auth-report.json \ -H zap-auth-report.html - name: Upload authenticated scan results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: authenticated-scan-results path: reports/

The zaproxy/action-af@v0.2.0 action provides advanced automation and filtering capabilities for ZAP scans, including intelligent vulnerability filtering, custom rules, and enhanced reporting features. Key Features of Action-AF​ Intelligent Filtering: Automatically filters false positives and duplicates Custom Rule Engine: Define custom security rules and policies Advanced Reporting: Enhanced HTML/JSON reports with filtering details Baseline Comparison: Compare scan results against previous baselines Risk Assessment: Automated risk scoring and prioritization CI/CD Integration: Seamless integration with deployment pipelines Basic Action-AF Implementation​ Create .github/workflows/zap-action-af.yml: name: ZAP Advanced Filtering Scan on: push: branches: [ main, develop ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] workflow_dispatch: inputs: target_url: description: 'Target URL to scan' required: true default: 'https://example.com' scan_type: description: 'Type of scan to perform' required: true default: 'baseline' type: choice options: - baseline - full - api env: TARGET_URL: ${{ github.event.inputs.target_url || 'http://localhost:3000' }} SCAN_TYPE: ${{ github.event.inputs.scan_type || 'baseline' }} jobs: zap-af-scan: runs-on: ubuntu-latest name: ZAP Advanced Filtering Scan steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Setup application environment if: env.TARGET_URL == 'http://localhost:3000' run: | # Start application for testing docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d # Wait for application to be ready timeout 120 bash -c 'until curl -f ${{ env.TARGET_URL }}/health; do sleep 5; done' # Seed test data if needed curl -X POST ${{ env.TARGET_URL }}/api/test/seed - name: ZAP Action-AF Baseline Scan if: env.SCAN_TYPE == 'baseline' uses: zaproxy/action-af@v0.2.0 with: target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} scan_type: 'baseline' rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/baseline-af.json' filter_file_name: '.zap/filters/baseline-filters.json' cmd_options: >- -a -j -m 2 -T 5 -z "-config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true" fail_action: 'warn' allow_issue_writing: true - name: ZAP Action-AF Full Scan if: env.SCAN_TYPE == 'full' uses: zaproxy/action-af@v0.2.0 with: target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} scan_type: 'full' rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/full-scan-af.json' filter_file_name: '.zap/filters/full-scan-filters.json' cmd_options: >- -a -j -m 10 -T 60 -z "-config spider.maxDuration=30 -config scanner.maxScanDurationInMins=60" fail_action: 'error' allow_issue_writing: true issue_title: 'ZAP Full Scan Security Issues Detected' - name: ZAP Action-AF API Scan if: env.SCAN_TYPE == 'api' uses: zaproxy/action-af@v0.2.0 with: target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} scan_type: 'api' api_spec: '.zap/specs/openapi.yaml' rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/api-scan-af.json' filter_file_name: '.zap/filters/api-filters.json' cmd_options: >- -a -j -z "-config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true" fail_action: 'warn' allow_issue_writing: false - name: Upload ZAP Action-AF Results uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: zap-af-scan-results-${{ env.SCAN_TYPE }} path: | report_html.html report_json.json report_md.md zap_af_summary.json - name: Comment PR with Results if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' uses: actions/github-script@v7 with: script: | const fs = require('fs'); try { const summary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('zap_af_summary.json', 'utf8')); const markdownReport = fs.readFileSync('report_md.md', 'utf8'); const comment = `## 🔒 ZAP Action-AF Security Scan Results **Scan Type:** \`${{ env.SCAN_TYPE }}\` **Target:** \`${{ env.TARGET_URL }}\` **Commit:** \`${{ github.sha }}\` ### Summary - **Total Alerts:** ${summary.total_alerts} - **High Risk:** ${summary.high_risk} - **Medium Risk:** ${summary.medium_risk} - **Low Risk:** ${summary.low_risk} - **Informational:** ${summary.informational} - **Filtered Alerts:** ${summary.filtered_alerts} ### Filter Statistics - **False Positives Filtered:** ${summary.false_positives_filtered} - **Duplicates Removed:** ${summary.duplicates_removed} - **Risk Level Adjustments:** ${summary.risk_adjustments} <details> <summary>📋 Detailed Report</summary> ${markdownReport} </details> For complete results, check the [workflow artifacts](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}). `; github.rest.issues.createComment({ issue_number: context.issue.number, owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, body: comment }); } catch (error) { console.log('Could not post comment:', error.message); } Production-Ready Action-AF Configuration​ Create .github/workflows/production-zap-af.yml: name: Production ZAP Action-AF Pipeline on: schedule: - cron: '0 2 * * 1,3,5' # Monday, Wednesday, Friday at 2 AM workflow_dispatch: inputs: environment: description: 'Environment to scan' required: true default: 'staging' type: choice options: - staging - production scan_depth: description: 'Scan depth level' required: true default: 'standard' type: choice options: - quick - standard - deep jobs: matrix-scan: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: scan_type: [baseline, full, api] environment: [staging, production] fail-fast: false name: ZAP AF ${{ matrix.scan_type }} - ${{ matrix.environment }} steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v4 - name: Set environment variables run: | case "${{ matrix.environment }}" in staging) echo "TARGET_URL=${{ secrets.STAGING_URL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.STAGING_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV ;; production) echo "TARGET_URL=${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_URL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV ;; esac case "${{ github.event.inputs.scan_depth || 'standard' }}" in quick) echo "SCAN_TIMEOUT=5" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "MAX_DURATION=10" >> $GITHUB_ENV ;; standard) echo "SCAN_TIMEOUT=15" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "MAX_DURATION=30" >> $GITHUB_ENV ;; deep) echo "SCAN_TIMEOUT=30" >> $GITHUB_ENV echo "MAX_DURATION=120" >> $GITHUB_ENV ;; esac - name: Download baseline data run: | # Download previous scan results for comparison gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts \ --jq '.artifacts[] | select(.name | contains("baseline-${{ matrix.environment }}")) | .archive_download_url' \ | head -1 \ | xargs -I {} gh api {} > previous-baseline.zip || true if [ -f previous-baseline.zip ]; then unzip -q previous-baseline.zip -d previous-results/ || true fi env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} - name: ZAP Action-AF Production Scan uses: zaproxy/action-af@v0.2.0 with: target: ${{ env.TARGET_URL }} scan_type: ${{ matrix.scan_type }} rules_file_name: '.zap/rules/${{ matrix.environment }}-${{ matrix.scan_type }}-af.json' filter_file_name: '.zap/filters/${{ matrix.environment }}-filters.json' baseline_file_name: 'previous-results/report_json.json' cmd_options: >- -a -j -T ${{ env.SCAN_TIMEOUT }} -z "-config spider.maxDuration=${{ env.MAX_DURATION }} -config scanner.maxScanDurationInMins=${{ env.MAX_DURATION }} -config api.addrs.addr.name=.* -config api.addrs.addr.regex=true" auth_header_name: 'Authorization' auth_header_value: 'Bearer ${{ env.AUTH_TOKEN }}' fail_action: ${{ matrix.environment == 'production' && 'error' || 'warn' }} allow_issue_writing: true issue_title: 'ZAP ${{ matrix.scan_type }} Security Issues - ${{ matrix.environment }}' issue_labels: 'security,zap,${{ matrix.scan_type }},${{ matrix.environment }}' - name: Process and enhance results run: | # Create enhanced summary with trend analysis python3 .github/scripts/enhance-zap-af-results.py \ --current report_json.json \ --baseline previous-results/report_json.json \ --environment ${{ matrix.environment }} \ --scan-type ${{ matrix.scan_type }} \ --output enhanced-summary.json - name: Upload results with retention uses: Create .github/scripts/security-gate.py: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Security gate for DAST scan results. Fails the build if vulnerability thresholds are exceeded. """ import json import sys import argparse def check_security_gate(reports, thresholds): """Check if security thresholds are met.""" total_high = 0 total_medium = 0 total_low = 0 for report_file in reports: if not report_file: continue try: with open(report_file, 'r') as f: data = json.load(f) except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e: print(f"Error reading {report_file}: {e}") continue # Count vulnerabilities site = data.get('site', [{}])[0] alerts = site.get('alerts', []) for alert in alerts: risk = alert.get('riskdesc', '').lower() if 'high' in risk: total_high += 1 elif 'medium' in risk: total_medium += 1 elif 'low' in risk: total_low += 1 print(f"Security Gate Results:") print(f"High Risk Vulnerabilities: {total_high} (threshold: {thresholds['high']})") print(f"Medium Risk Vulnerabilities: {total_medium} (threshold: {thresholds['medium']})") print(f"Low Risk Vulnerabilities: {total_low} (threshold: {thresholds['low']})") # Check thresholds gate_passed = True if total_high > thresholds['high']: print(f"❌ SECURITY GATE FAILED: High risk vulnerabilities ({total_high}) exceed threshold ({thresholds['high']})") gate_passed = False if total_medium > thresholds['medium']: print(f"❌ SECURITY GATE FAILED: Medium risk vulnerabilities ({total_medium}) exceed threshold ({thresholds['medium']})") gate_passed = False if total_low > thresholds['low']: print(f"⚠️ WARNING: Low risk vulnerabilities ({total_low}) exceed threshold ({thresholds['low']})") # Low risk doesn't fail the gate by default if gate_passed: print("✅ SECURITY GATE PASSED: All thresholds met") return True else: print("❌ SECURITY GATE FAILED: Security thresholds exceeded") return False def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Security gate for DAST results') parser.add_argument('--baseline', help='Baseline scan report') parser.add_argument('--full', help='Full scan report') parser.add_argument('--api', help='API scan report') parser.add_argument('--threshold-high', type=int, default=0, help='High risk threshold') parser.add_argument('--threshold-medium', type=int, default=5, help='Medium risk threshold') parser.add_argument('--threshold-low', type=int, default=20, help='Low risk threshold') args = parser.parse_args() reports = [args.baseline, args.full, args.api] thresholds = { 'high': args.threshold_high, 'medium': args.threshold_medium, 'low': args.threshold_low } success = check_security_gate(reports, thresholds) if not success: sys.exit(1) if __name__ == "__main__": main()

""" import json import sys import argparse from datetime import datetime, timedelta from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any class ZAPAFResultsProcessor: def __init__(self): self.current_results = None self.baseline_results = None self.enhanced_summary = {} def load_results(self, current_file: str, baseline_file: Optional[str] = None): """Load current and baseline ZAP results.""" try: with open(current_file, 'r') as f: self.current_results = json.load(f) except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e: print(f"Error loading current results: {e}") return False if baseline_file: try: with open(baseline_file, 'r') as f: self.baseline_results = json.load(f) except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError): print(f"Baseline file not found or invalid: {baseline_file}") self.baseline_results = None return True def extract_alerts(self, results: Dict) -> List[Dict]: """Extract alerts from ZAP results.""" if not results: return [] site = results.get('site', [{}])[0] return site.get('alerts', []) def categorize_alerts(self, alerts: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, List[Dict]]: """Categorize alerts by risk level.""" categories = { 'High': [], 'Medium': [], 'Low': [], 'Informational': [] } for alert in alerts: risk_desc = alert.get('riskdesc', 'Unknown') risk_level = risk_desc.split(' ')[0] if ' ' in risk_desc else 'Informational' if risk_level in categories: categories[risk_level].append(alert) else: categories['Informational'].append(alert) return categories def analyze_trends(self) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Analyze trends between current and baseline results.""" trend_analysis = { 'new_issues': [], 'resolved_issues': [], 'recurring_issues': [], 'risk_changes': [] } if not self.baseline_results: return trend_analysis current_alerts = self.extract_alerts(self.current_results) baseline_alerts = self.extract_alerts(self.baseline_results) # Create alert signatures for comparison current_signatures = {self._create_alert_signature(alert): alert for alert in current_alerts} baseline_signatures = {self._create_alert_signature(alert): alert for alert in baseline_alerts} # Find new issues for sig, alert in current_signatures.items(): if sig not in baseline_signatures: trend_analysis['new_issues'].append(alert) else: # Check for risk level changes baseline_risk = baseline_signatures[sig].get('riskdesc', '') current_risk = alert.get('riskdesc', '') if baseline_risk != current_risk: trend_analysis['risk_changes'].append({ 'alert': alert, 'previous_risk': baseline_risk, 'current_risk': current_risk }) else: trend_analysis['recurring_issues'].append(alert) # Find resolved issues for sig, alert in baseline_signatures.items(): if sig not in current_signatures: trend_analysis['resolved_issues'].append(alert) return trend_analysis def _create_alert_signature(self, alert: Dict) -> str: """Create a unique signature for an alert based on key attributes.""" name = alert.get('name', '') plugin_id = alert.get('pluginid', '') url = alert.get('instances', [{}])[0].get('uri', '') if alert.get('instances') else '' return f"{plugin_id}:{name}:{url}" def calculate_confidence_metrics(self, alerts: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, int]: """Calculate confidence-based metrics for alerts.""" confidence_counts = { 'High': 0, 'Medium': 0, 'Low': 0 } for alert in alerts: confidence = alert.get('confidence', 'Medium') if confidence in confidence_counts: confidence_counts[confidence] += 1 return confidence_counts def analyze_coverage(self) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Analyze scan coverage and completeness.""" if not self.current_results: return {} site = self.current_results.get('site', [{}])[0] coverage = { 'total_urls_scanned': len(site.get('urls', [])), 'scan_duration': self._extract_scan_duration(), 'technologies_detected': self._extract_technologies(), 'authentication_status': self._check_authentication_coverage() } return coverage def _extract_scan_duration(self) -> str: """Extract scan duration from results.""" # This would depend on the specific structure of Action-AF results return "Unknown" def _extract_technologies(self) -> List[str]: """Extract detected technologies.""" technologies = [] current_alerts = self.extract_alerts(self.current_results) for alert in current_alerts: if 'technology' in alert.get('name', '').lower(): tech_info = alert.get('desc', '') technologies.append(tech_info) return list(set(technologies)) def _check_authentication_coverage(self) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Check authentication coverage in scan.""" auth_coverage = { 'authenticated_urls': 0, 'unauthenticated_urls': 0, 'auth_bypass_attempts': 0 } # This would be enhanced based on Action-AF specific features return auth_coverage def generate_enhanced_summary(self, environment: str, scan_type: str) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Generate comprehensive enhanced summary.""" current_alerts = self.extract_alerts(self.current_results) categorized = self.categorize_alerts(current_alerts) trends = self.analyze_trends() confidence_metrics = self.calculate_confidence_metrics(current_alerts) coverage = self.analyze_coverage() self.enhanced_summary = { 'metadata': { 'scan_timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'environment': environment, 'scan_type': scan_type, 'zap_version': self.current_results.get('@version', 'Unknown'), 'action_af_version': 'v0.2.0' }, 'summary': { 'total_alerts': len(current_alerts), 'high_risk': len(categorized['High']), 'medium_risk': len(categorized['Medium']), 'low_risk': len(categorized['Low']), 'informational': len(categorized['Informational']) }, 'confidence_metrics': confidence_metrics, 'trend_analysis': { 'new_issues_count': len(trends['new_issues']), 'resolved_issues_count': len(trends['resolved_issues']), 'recurring_issues_count': len(trends['recurring_issues']), 'risk_changes_count': len(trends['risk_changes']), 'new_issues': trends['new_issues'][:5], # Top 5 for summary 'resolved_issues': trends['resolved_issues'][:5], 'risk_changes': trends['risk_changes'] }, 'coverage_analysis': coverage, 'recommendations': self._generate_recommendations(categorized, trends), 'compliance_status': self._assess_compliance(categorized), 'action_items': self._generate_action_items(categorized, trends) } return self.enhanced_summary def _generate_recommendations(self, categorized: Dict, trends: Dict) -> List[str]: """Generate actionable recommendations.""" recommendations = [] if categorized['High']: recommendations.append(f"Address {len(categorized['High'])} high-risk vulnerabilities immediately") if len(trends['new_issues']) > 5: recommendations.append("Investigate cause of multiple new security issues") if trends['risk_changes']: recommendations.append("Review risk level changes for potential false positives") if categorized['Medium'] and len(categorized['Medium']) > 10: recommendations.append("Consider batch remediation for medium-risk issues") return recommendations def _assess_compliance(self, categorized: Dict) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Assess compliance with security standards.""" compliance = { 'owasp_top_10': self._check_owasp_compliance(categorized), 'pci_dss': self._check_pci_compliance(categorized), 'overall_score': 0 } # Calculate overall score (0-100) high_penalty = len(categorized['High']) * 20 medium_penalty = len(categorized['Medium']) * 5 low_penalty = len(categorized['Low']) * 1 total_penalty = min(100, high_penalty + medium_penalty + low_penalty) compliance['overall_score'] = max(0, 100 - total_penalty) return compliance def _check_owasp_compliance(self, categorized: Dict) -> Dict[str, bool]: """Check OWASP Top 10 compliance.""" # Simplified compliance check return { 'injection': len([a for a in categorized['High'] if 'injection' in a.get('name', '').lower()]) == 0, 'xss': len([a for a in categorized['High'] if 'xss' in a.get('name', '').lower()]) == 0, 'security_misconfiguration': len([a for a in categorized['High'] if 'configuration' in a.get('name', '').lower()]) == 0 } def _check_pci_compliance(self, categorized: Dict) -> bool: """Check basic PCI DSS compliance.""" # Simplified PCI check return len(categorized['High']) == 0 and len(categorized['Medium']) < 5 def _generate_action_items(self, categorized: Dict, trends: Dict) -> List[Dict]: """Generate prioritized action items.""" action_items = [] # High priority items for alert in categorized['High'][:3]: # Top 3 high-risk action_items.append({ 'priority': 'CRITICAL', 'title': f"Fix: {alert.get('name', 'Unknown vulnerability')}", 'description': alert.get('desc', '')[:200] + '...', 'affected_urls': len(alert.get('instances', [])), 'estimated_effort': 'High' }) # New issues from trend analysis for alert in trends['new_issues'][:2]: # Top 2 new issues action_items.append({ 'priority': 'HIGH', 'title': f"Investigate new issue: {alert.get('name', 'Unknown')}", 'description': 'New security issue detected in latest scan', 'affected_urls': len(alert.get('instances', [])), 'estimated_effort': 'Medium' }) return action_items def save_results(self, output_file: str): """Save enhanced results to file.""" try: with open(output_file, 'w') as f: json.dump(self.enhanced_summary, f, indent=2, default=str) print(f"Enhanced results saved to: {output_file}") return True except Exception as e: print(f"Error saving results: {e}") return False def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Enhance ZAP Action-AF results with trend analysis') parser.add_argument('--current', required=True, help='Current scan results JSON file') parser.add_argument('--baseline', help='Baseline scan results JSON file') parser.add_argument('--environment', required=True, help='Environment name') parser.add_argument('--scan-type', required=True, help='Type of scan performed') parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, help='Output file for enhanced results') args = parser.parse_args() processor = ZAPAFResultsProcessor() if not processor.load_results(args.current, args.baseline): sys.exit(1) enhanced_results = processor.generate_enhanced_summary(args.environment, args.scan_type) if not processor.save_results(args.output): sys.exit(1) # Print summary to stdout for GitHub Actions print("\n=== Enhanced ZAP Action-AF Results Summary ===") print(f"Environment: {enhanced_results['metadata']['environment']}") print(f"Scan Type: {enhanced_results['metadata']['scan_type']}") print(f"Total Alerts: {enhanced_results['summary']['total_alerts']}") print(f"High Risk: {enhanced_results['summary']['high_risk']}") print(f"Medium Risk: {enhanced_results['summary']['medium_risk']}") print(f"New Issues: {enhanced_results['trend_analysis']['new_issues_count']}") print(f"Resolved Issues: {enhanced_results['trend_analysis']['resolved_issues_count']}") print(f"Compliance Score: {enhanced_results['compliance_status']['overall_score']}/100") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

{len(self.consolidated_data.get('recommendations', []))} immediate recommendations for security improvement. Create docker/zap/scripts/configure-zap.py: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Configure ZAP for automated scanning. """ import requests import time import sys import json class ZAPConfigurer: def __init__(self, zap_url='http://localhost:8080'): self.zap_url = zap_url self.api_key = None def wait_for_zap(self, timeout=60): """Wait for ZAP to start up.""" start_time = time.time() while time.time() - start_time < timeout: try: response = requests.get(f'{self.zap_url}/JSON/core/view/version/') if response.status_code == 200: print("ZAP is ready") return True except requests.ConnectionError: print("Waiting for ZAP to start...") time.sleep(2) print("Timeout waiting for ZAP to start") return False def configure_api_key(self): """Configure API key for ZAP.""" try: # Generate API key response = requests.get(f'{self.zap_url}/JSON/core/action/generateApiKey/') if response.status_code == 200: self.api_key = response.json()['Result'] print(f"API key configured: {self.api_key}") return True except Exception as e: print(f"Error configuring API key: {e}") return False def configure_scanner_settings(self): """Configure scanner settings.""" settings = { 'scanner.maxResultsToList': '100', 'scanner.maxRuleDurationInMins': '5', 'scanner.maxScanDurationInMins': '60', 'scanner.threadPerHost': '2' } for key, value in settings.items(): try: params = { 'apikey': self.api_key, 'key': key, 'value': value } response = requests.get(f'{self.zap_url}/JSON/core/action/setOptionValue/', params=params) if response.status_code == 200: print(f"Set {key} = {value}") except Exception as e: print(f"Error setting {key}: {e}") def configure_passive_rules(self): """Enable/disable passive scan rules.""" # Enable important passive rules important_rules = [ '10015', # Incomplete or No Cache-control and Pragma HTTP Header Set '10020', # X-Frame-Options Header Not Set '10021', # X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing '10035', # Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set '10038', # Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set ] for rule_id in important_rules: try: params = { 'apikey': self.api_key, 'ids': rule_id } response = requests.get(f'{self.zap_url}/JSON/pscan/action/enableScanners/', params=params) if response.status_code == 200: print(f"Enabled passive rule: {rule_id}") except Exception as e: print(f"Error enabling rule {rule_id}: {e}") def main(): configurator = ZAPConfigurer() if not configurator.wait_for_zap(): sys.exit(1) if not configurator.configure_api_key(): sys.exit(1) configurator.configure_scanner_settings() configurator.configure_passive_rules() print("ZAP configuration completed successfully") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

Example of extending Action-AF functionality: # .github/scripts/action-af-extension.py """ Custom extension for ZAP Action-AF with organization-specific features. """ import json import requests from typing import Dict, List, Any class ActionAFExtension: def __init__(self, config_file: str): with open(config_file, 'r') as f: self.config = json.load(f) def custom_vulnerability_scoring(self, alert: Dict) -> Dict: """Apply custom vulnerability scoring logic.""" base_score = self._get_base_score(alert) # Apply business context business_impact = self._assess_business_impact(alert) # Apply environmental factors env_factor = self._get_environmental_factor(alert) # Calculate custom score custom_score = base_score * business_impact * env_factor alert['custom_scoring'] = { 'base_score': base_score, 'business_impact': business_impact, 'environmental_factor': env_factor, 'final_score': custom_score, 'risk_classification': self._classify_risk(custom_score) } return alert def intelligent_false_positive_detection(self, alerts: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]: """Use ML model to detect false positives.""" processed_alerts = [] for alert in alerts: # Feature extraction features = self._extract_features(alert) # ML prediction fp_probability = self._predict_false_positive(features) # Apply confidence threshold if fp_probability < self.config['fp_threshold']: alert['false_positive_probability'] = fp_probability alert['recommendation'] = 'investigate' processed_alerts.append(alert) else: alert['false_positive_probability'] = fp_probability alert['recommendation'] = 'likely_false_positive' # Optional: still include but mark as low priority if self.config['include_likely_fps']: processed_alerts.append(alert) return processed_alerts def compliance_mapping(self, alerts: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Any]: """Map vulnerabilities to compliance frameworks.""" compliance_mapping = {} frameworks = self.config['compliance_frameworks'] for framework in frameworks: compliance_mapping[framework] = self._map_to_framework(alerts, framework) return compliance_mapping def generate_remediation_guidance(self, alert: Dict) -> Dict[str, str]: """Generate specific remediation guidance.""" guidance = { 'immediate_actions': [], 'code_changes': [], 'configuration_updates': [], 'monitoring_recommendations': [] } # Use knowledge base to generate guidance kb_guidance = self._query_knowledge_base(alert) if kb_guidance: guidance.update(kb_guidance) # Add organization-specific guidance org_guidance = self._get_organizational_guidance(alert) if org_guidance: guidance['organizational_requirements'] = org_guidance return guidance

Level 1 - Initial: Basic security controls in place Level 2 - Developing: Systematic security processes established Level 3 - Defined: Comprehensive security framework implemented Level 4 - Managed: Advanced security monitoring and response capabilities Level 5 - Optimizing: Continuous security improvement and innovation

Secure development practices Code review processes Security testing Vulnerability management

// src/asset-management/asset-inventory.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; interface Asset { id: string; name: string; type: 'INFRASTRUCTURE' | 'APPLICATION' | 'DATA' | 'NETWORK' | 'SECURITY_CONTROL'; category: string; classification: 'PUBLIC' | 'INTERNAL' | 'CONFIDENTIAL' | 'RESTRICTED'; criticality: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL'; owner: string; custodian: string; location: string; environment: 'DEVELOPMENT' | 'STAGING' | 'PRODUCTION'; dependencies: string[]; businessValue: number; // 1-10 scale technicalValue: number; // 1-10 scale riskScore: number; lastAssessed: Date; metadata: Record<string, any>; } interface AssetDependency { assetId: string; dependsOn: string; dependencyType: 'TECHNICAL' | 'BUSINESS' | 'DATA_FLOW' | 'SECURITY'; criticality: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL'; description: string; } interface AssetRisk { assetId: string; riskId: string; riskType: 'CONFIDENTIALITY' | 'INTEGRITY' | 'AVAILABILITY' | 'COMPLIANCE'; threat: string; vulnerability: string; impact: number; // 1-10 scale likelihood: number; // 1-10 scale riskScore: number; // impact * likelihood mitigations: string[]; residualRisk: number; status: 'IDENTIFIED' | 'ASSESSED' | 'MITIGATED' | 'ACCEPTED' | 'TRANSFERRED'; } @Injectable() export class AssetInventoryService { private readonly logger = new Logger(AssetInventoryService.name); private readonly assets = new Map<string, Asset>(); private readonly dependencies = new Map<string, AssetDependency[]>(); private readonly risks = new Map<string, AssetRisk[]>(); constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {} async discoverAssets(): Promise<void> { this.logger.log('Starting asset discovery process'); // Discover infrastructure assets await this.discoverInfrastructureAssets(); // Discover application assets await this.discoverApplicationAssets(); // Discover data assets await this.discoverDataAssets(); // Discover network assets await this.discoverNetworkAssets(); // Discover security controls await this.discoverSecurityControls(); this.logger.log(`Asset discovery completed. Found ${this.assets.size} assets`); } async registerAsset(asset: Omit<Asset, 'id' | 'lastAssessed' | 'riskScore'>): Promise<string> { const assetId = this.generateAssetId(asset.type, asset.name); const newAsset: Asset = { ...asset, id: assetId, lastAssessed: new Date(), riskScore: 0, // Will be calculated during risk assessment }; this.assets.set(assetId, newAsset); // Perform initial risk assessment await this.assessAssetRisk(assetId); this.logger.log(`Asset registered: ${assetId}`); return assetId; } async updateAsset(assetId: string, updates: Partial<Asset>): Promise<void> { const asset = this.assets.get(assetId); if (!asset) { throw new Error(`Asset not found: ${assetId}`); } const updatedAsset = { ...asset, ...updates, lastAssessed: new Date() }; this.assets.set(assetId, updatedAsset); // Re-assess risk if critical properties changed if (this.shouldReassessRisk(updates)) { await this.assessAssetRisk(assetId); } this.logger.log(`Asset updated: ${assetId}`); } async getAsset(assetId: string): Promise<Asset | undefined> { return this.assets.get(assetId); } async getAssetsByType(type: string): Promise<Asset[]> { return Array.from(this.assets.values()).filter(asset => asset.type === type); } async getAssetsByClassification(classification: string): Promise<Asset[]> { return Array.from(this.assets.values()).filter(asset => asset.classification === classification); } async getAssetsByCriticality(criticality: string): Promise<Asset[]> { return Array.from(this.assets.values()).filter(asset => asset.criticality === criticality); } async getCriticalAssets(): Promise<Asset[]> { return Array.from(this.assets.values()).filter(asset => asset.criticality === 'CRITICAL' || asset.businessValue >= 8 || asset.riskScore >= 7 ); } async addDependency(dependency: AssetDependency): Promise<void> { const assetDependencies = this.dependencies.get(dependency.assetId) || []; assetDependencies.push(dependency); this.dependencies.set(dependency.assetId, assetDependencies); this.logger.log(`Dependency added: ${dependency.assetId} depends on ${dependency.dependsOn}`); } async getAssetDependencies(assetId: string): Promise<AssetDependency[]> { return this.dependencies.get(assetId) || []; } async getAssetDependents(assetId: string): Promise<AssetDependency[]> { const dependents: AssetDependency[] = []; for (const [_, deps] of this.dependencies) { dependents.push(...deps.filter(dep => dep.dependsOn === assetId)); } return dependents; } async assessAssetRisk(assetId: string): Promise<void> { const asset = this.assets.get(assetId); if (!asset) { throw new Error(`Asset not found: ${assetId}`); } // Identify risks for the asset const risks = await this.identifyAssetRisks(asset); this.risks.set(assetId, risks); // Calculate overall risk score const riskScore = this.calculateOverallRiskScore(risks); asset.riskScore = riskScore; this.assets.set(assetId, asset); this.logger.log(`Risk assessment completed for asset: ${assetId}, risk score: ${riskScore}`); } async getAssetRisks(assetId: string): Promise<AssetRisk[]> { return this.risks.get(assetId) || []; } async generateAssetReport(): Promise<any> { const allAssets = Array.from(this.assets.values()); const report = { timestamp: new Date(), summary: { totalAssets: allAssets.length, byType: this.groupAssetsByProperty(allAssets, 'type'), byClassification: this.groupAssetsByProperty(allAssets, 'classification'), byCriticality: this.groupAssetsByProperty(allAssets, 'criticality'), byEnvironment: this.groupAssetsByProperty(allAssets, 'environment'), }, criticalAssets: await this.getCriticalAssets(), highRiskAssets: allAssets.filter(asset => asset.riskScore >= 7), complianceStatus: await this.generateComplianceStatus(), recommendations: await this.generateRecommendations(), }; return report; } private async discoverInfrastructureAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover GCP infrastructure assets await this.discoverGCPAssets(); // Discover Kubernetes assets await this.discoverKubernetesAssets(); // Discover container assets await this.discoverContainerAssets(); } private async discoverGCPAssets(): Promise<void> { // Use Google Cloud Asset Inventory API const gcpAssets = [ { name: 'Production GKE Cluster', type: 'INFRASTRUCTURE' as const, category: 'Container Orchestration', classification: 'CONFIDENTIAL' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'platform-team', custodian: 'devops-team', location: 'us-central1', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['production-vpc', 'cloud-sql'], businessValue: 10, technicalValue: 10, metadata: { nodeCount: 5, version: '1.27', zones: ['us-central1-a', 'us-central1-b', 'us-central1-c'], }, }, { name: 'Production Cloud SQL', type: 'INFRASTRUCTURE' as const, category: 'Database', classification: 'RESTRICTED' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'data-team', custodian: 'dba-team', location: 'us-central1', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['production-vpc'], businessValue: 10, technicalValue: 9, metadata: { engine: 'PostgreSQL', version: '14', highAvailability: true, backupEnabled: true, }, }, // Add more GCP assets ]; for (const asset of gcpAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverKubernetesAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover Kubernetes resources const k8sAssets = [ { name: 'API Gateway Service', type: 'APPLICATION' as const, category: 'API Gateway', classification: 'CONFIDENTIAL' as const, criticality: 'HIGH' as const, owner: 'api-team', custodian: 'devops-team', location: 'production-cluster', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['backend-services', 'authentication-service'], businessValue: 9, technicalValue: 8, metadata: { namespace: 'production', replicas: 3, image: 'gcr.io/project/api-gateway:v1.2.3', }, }, // Add more Kubernetes assets ]; for (const asset of k8sAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverApplicationAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover application components const applicationAssets = [ { name: 'User Authentication Service', type: 'APPLICATION' as const, category: 'Authentication', classification: 'RESTRICTED' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'security-team', custodian: 'backend-team', location: 'production-cluster', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['user-database', 'oauth-provider'], businessValue: 10, technicalValue: 9, metadata: { technology: 'NestJS', version: '2.1.0', features: ['JWT', 'OAuth', 'MFA'], }, }, { name: 'E-commerce Frontend', type: 'APPLICATION' as const, category: 'Web Application', classification: 'INTERNAL' as const, criticality: 'HIGH' as const, owner: 'frontend-team', custodian: 'frontend-team', location: 'production-cluster', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['api-gateway', 'cdn'], businessValue: 9, technicalValue: 7, metadata: { technology: 'Next.js', version: '3.0.1', features: ['SSR', 'PWA', 'SEO'], }, }, // Add more application assets ]; for (const asset of applicationAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverDataAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover data assets const dataAssets = [ { name: 'Customer PII Database', type: 'DATA' as const, category: 'Personal Data', classification: 'RESTRICTED' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'privacy-officer', custodian: 'data-team', location: 'cloud-sql-instance', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['cloud-sql'], businessValue: 10, technicalValue: 8, metadata: { recordCount: 1000000, retentionPeriod: '7 years', complianceRequirements: ['GDPR', 'CCPA'], }, }, { name: 'Payment Transaction Logs', type: 'DATA' as const, category: 'Financial Data', classification: 'RESTRICTED' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'finance-team', custodian: 'security-team', location: 'cloud-logging', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['logging-service'], businessValue: 9, technicalValue: 7, metadata: { retentionPeriod: '10 years', complianceRequirements: ['PCI-DSS', 'SOX'], }, }, // Add more data assets ]; for (const asset of dataAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverNetworkAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover network assets const networkAssets = [ { name: 'Production VPC', type: 'NETWORK' as const, category: 'Virtual Network', classification: 'CONFIDENTIAL' as const, criticality: 'CRITICAL' as const, owner: 'network-team', custodian: 'devops-team', location: 'us-central1', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: [], businessValue: 9, technicalValue: 10, metadata: { cidrRange: '10.0.0.0/16', subnets: 5, firewallRules: 25, }, }, // Add more network assets ]; for (const asset of networkAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverSecurityControls(): Promise<void> { // Discover security control assets const securityAssets = [ { name: 'Google Cloud Armor', type: 'SECURITY_CONTROL' as const, category: 'WAF', classification: 'INTERNAL' as const, criticality: 'HIGH' as const, owner: 'security-team', custodian: 'security-team', location: 'global', environment: 'PRODUCTION' as const, dependencies: ['load-balancer'], businessValue: 8, technicalValue: 8, metadata: { policies: 15, rules: 50, protection: ['DDoS', 'SQLi', 'XSS'], }, }, // Add more security controls ]; for (const asset of securityAssets) { await this.registerAsset(asset); } } private async discoverContainerAssets(): Promise<void> { // Discover container images and their vulnerabilities this.logger.log('Discovering container assets'); } private async identifyAssetRisks(asset: Asset): Promise<AssetRisk[]> { const risks: AssetRisk[] = []; // Common risks based on asset type switch (asset.type) { case 'APPLICATION': risks.push(...this.getApplicationRisks(asset)); break; case 'DATA': risks.push(...this.getDataRisks(asset)); break; case 'INFRASTRUCTURE': risks.push(...this.getInfrastructureRisks(asset)); break; case 'NETWORK': risks.push(...this.getNetworkRisks(asset)); break; } // Classification-based risks if (asset.classification === 'RESTRICTED' || asset.classification === 'CONFIDENTIAL') { risks.push(...this.getSensitiveDataRisks(asset)); } // Environment-based risks if (asset.environment === 'PRODUCTION') { risks.push(...this.getProductionRisks(asset)); } return risks; } private getApplicationRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-app-001`, riskType: 'CONFIDENTIALITY', threat: 'Data breach through application vulnerability', vulnerability: 'Unpatched security vulnerabilities', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 5, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 5, mitigations: ['Security scanning', 'Regular updates', 'Penetration testing'], residualRisk: 3, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-app-002`, riskType: 'AVAILABILITY', threat: 'Service disruption', vulnerability: 'Single point of failure', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 3, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 3, mitigations: ['High availability', 'Load balancing', 'Auto-scaling'], residualRisk: 2, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private getDataRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-data-001`, riskType: 'CONFIDENTIALITY', threat: 'Unauthorized data access', vulnerability: 'Insufficient access controls', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 4, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 4, mitigations: ['Encryption', 'Access controls', 'Audit logging'], residualRisk: 2, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private getInfrastructureRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-infra-001`, riskType: 'AVAILABILITY', threat: 'Infrastructure failure', vulnerability: 'Hardware/software failure', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 3, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 3, mitigations: ['Redundancy', 'Monitoring', 'Backup systems'], residualRisk: 2, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private getNetworkRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-network-001`, riskType: 'CONFIDENTIALITY', threat: 'Network intrusion', vulnerability: 'Misconfigured firewall rules', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 4, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 4, mitigations: ['Firewall configuration', 'Network monitoring', 'IDS/IPS'], residualRisk: 2, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private getSensitiveDataRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-sensitive-001`, riskType: 'COMPLIANCE', threat: 'Regulatory violation', vulnerability: 'Non-compliance with data protection regulations', impact: 9, likelihood: 3, riskScore: 27, mitigations: ['Compliance monitoring', 'Data governance', 'Regular audits'], residualRisk: 2, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private getProductionRisks(asset: Asset): AssetRisk[] { return [ { assetId: asset.id, riskId: `${asset.id}-prod-001`, riskType: 'AVAILABILITY', threat: 'Business disruption', vulnerability: 'Production system failure', impact: asset.businessValue, likelihood: 2, riskScore: asset.businessValue * 2, mitigations: ['DR planning', 'Monitoring', 'Incident response'], residualRisk: 1, status: 'IDENTIFIED', }, ]; } private calculateOverallRiskScore(risks: AssetRisk[]): number { if (risks.length === 0) return 0; const totalRisk = risks.reduce((sum, risk) => sum + risk.riskScore, 0); return Math.round(totalRisk / risks.length); } private shouldReassessRisk(updates: Partial<Asset>): boolean { const criticalProperties = ['classification', 'criticality', 'environment', 'dependencies']; return criticalProperties.some(prop => prop in updates); } private generateAssetId(type: string, name: string): string { const timestamp = Date.now(); const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8); return `${type.toLowerCase()}-${name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-${timestamp}-${random}`; } private groupAssetsByProperty(assets: Asset[], property: keyof Asset): Record<string, number> { const grouped: Record<string, number> = {}; for (const asset of assets) { const value = String(asset[property]); grouped[value] = (grouped[value] || 0) + 1; } return grouped; } private async generateComplianceStatus(): Promise<any> { // Generate compliance status based on assets return { gdpr: { compliant: true, issues: 0 }, pciDss: { compliant: false, issues: 2 }, sox: { compliant: true, issues: 0 }, }; } private async generateRecommendations(): Promise<string[]> { const recommendations: string[] = []; const highRiskAssets = Array.from(this.assets.values()).filter(asset => asset.riskScore >= 7); if (highRiskAssets.length > 0) { recommendations.push(`Review and mitigate risks for ${highRiskAssets.length} high-risk assets`); } const criticalAssets = await this.getCriticalAssets(); if (criticalAssets.length > 10) { recommendations.push('Consider reducing the number of critical assets through consolidation'); } return recommendations; } }

// src/asset-management/asset-classification.service.ts import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common'; interface ClassificationCriteria { confidentiality: 'PUBLIC' | 'INTERNAL' | 'CONFIDENTIAL' | 'RESTRICTED'; integrity: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL'; availability: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL'; businessImpact: number; // 1-10 scale regulatoryRequirements: string[]; retentionPeriod: number; // days } interface ValuationCriteria { replacementCost: number; businessValue: number; // 1-10 scale revenueImpact: number; // annual revenue impact customerImpact: number; // number of customers affected reputationImpact: number; // 1-10 scale complianceImpact: number; // 1-10 scale } @Injectable() export class AssetClassificationService { private readonly logger = new Logger(AssetClassificationService.name); async classifyAsset(asset: any): Promise<ClassificationCriteria> { const classification: ClassificationCriteria = { confidentiality: this.assessConfidentiality(asset), integrity: this.assessIntegrity(asset), availability: this.assessAvailability(asset), businessImpact: this.assessBusinessImpact(asset), regulatoryRequirements: this.identifyRegulatoryRequirements(asset), retentionPeriod: this.determineRetentionPeriod(asset), }; this.logger.log(`Asset classified: ${asset.id} - ${JSON.stringify(classification)}`); return classification; } async valuateAsset(asset: any): Promise<ValuationCriteria> { const valuation: ValuationCriteria = { replacementCost: this.calculateReplacementCost(asset), businessValue: this.calculateBusinessValue(asset), revenueImpact: this.calculateRevenueImpact(asset), customerImpact: this.calculateCustomerImpact(asset), reputationImpact: this.calculateReputationImpact(asset), complianceImpact: this.calculateComplianceImpact(asset), }; this.logger.log(`Asset valuated: ${asset.id} - Total value: ${valuation.businessValue}`); return valuation; } private assessConfidentiality(asset: any): 'PUBLIC' | 'INTERNAL' | 'CONFIDENTIAL' | 'RESTRICTED' { // Assess confidentiality based on data sensitivity if (asset.type === 'DATA') { if (asset.category.includes('PII') || asset.category.includes('Personal')) { return 'RESTRICTED'; } if (asset.category.includes('Financial') || asset.category.includes('Payment')) { return 'RESTRICTED'; } if (asset.category.includes('Customer') || asset.category.includes('Business')) { return 'CONFIDENTIAL'; } if (asset.category.includes('Internal') || asset.category.includes('Operational')) { return 'INTERNAL'; } } // Assess application confidentiality if (asset.type === 'APPLICATION') { if (asset.category.includes('Authentication') || asset.category.includes('Security')) { return 'RESTRICTED'; } if (asset.category.includes('Core') || asset.category.includes('Business')) { return 'CONFIDENTIAL'; } } // Default assessment return asset.environment === 'PRODUCTION' ? 'CONFIDENTIAL' : 'INTERNAL'; } private assessIntegrity(asset: any): 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' { if (asset.type === 'DATA') { if (asset.category.includes('Financial') || asset.category.includes('Legal')) { return 'CRITICAL'; } if (asset.category.includes('Customer') || asset.category.includes('Business')) { return 'HIGH'; } } if (asset.type === 'APPLICATION' && asset.criticality === 'CRITICAL') { return 'CRITICAL'; } return asset.businessValue >= 8 ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM'; } private assessAvailability(asset: any): 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' { if (asset.environment === 'PRODUCTION') { if (asset.criticality === 'CRITICAL' || asset.businessValue >= 9) { return 'CRITICAL'; } if (asset.businessValue >= 7) { return 'HIGH'; } return 'MEDIUM'; } return 'LOW'; } private assessBusinessImpact(asset: any): number { let impact = asset.businessValue || 5; // Adjust based on asset type if (asset.type === 'DATA' && asset.classification === 'RESTRICTED') { impact = Math.min(10, impact + 2); } if (asset.type === 'APPLICATION' && asset.environment === 'PRODUCTION') { impact = Math.min(10, impact + 1); } return impact; } private identifyRegulatoryRequirements(asset: any): string[] { const requirements: string[] = []; // Data-specific requirements if (asset.type === 'DATA') { if (asset.category.includes('Personal') || asset.category.includes('PII')) { requirements.push('GDPR', 'CCPA'); } if (asset.category.includes('Financial') || asset.category.includes('Payment')) { requirements.push('PCI-DSS', 'SOX'); } if (asset.category.includes('Health')) { requirements.push('HIPAA'); } } // Industry-specific requirements if (asset.metadata?.industry === 'healthcare') { requirements.push('HIPAA', 'HITECH'); } if (asset.metadata?.industry === 'financial') { requirements.push('SOX', 'GLBA', 'PCI-DSS'); } return requirements; } private determineRetentionPeriod(asset: any): number { // Default retention periods in days const defaultRetention = { 'Personal Data': 2555, // 7 years 'Financial Data': 3650, // 10 years 'Legal Data': 3650, // 10 years 'Operational Data': 1095, // 3 years 'Log Data': 365, // 1 year }; for (const [category, days] of Object.entries(defaultRetention)) { if (asset.category.includes(category.split(' ')[0])) { return days; } } // Regulatory requirements if (asset.metadata?.complianceRequirements?.includes('SOX')) { return 3650; // 10 years } if (asset.metadata?.complianceRequirements?.includes('GDPR')) { return 2555; // 7 years } return 1095; // Default 3 years } private calculateReplacementCost(asset: any): number { // Estimate replacement cost based on asset type and complexity const baseCosts = { 'APPLICATION': 100000, // $100k base for application development 'DATA': 50000, // $50k base for data recreation 'INFRASTRUCTURE': 200000, // $200k base for infrastructure 'NETWORK': 150000, // $150k base for network setup 'SECURITY_CONTROL': 75000, // $75k base for security controls }; let cost = baseCosts[asset.type] || 50000; // Adjust based on complexity and business value cost = cost * (asset.businessValue / 5); // Scale by business value cost = cost * (asset.technicalValue / 5); // Scale by technical complexity return Math.round(cost); } private calculateBusinessValue(asset: any): number { let value = asset.businessValue || 5; // Adjust based on dependencies if (asset.dependencies?.length > 5) { value = Math.min(10, value + 1); } // Adjust based on environment if (asset.environment === 'PRODUCTION') { value = Math.min(10, value + 1); } return value; } private calculateRevenueImpact(asset: any): number { // Estimate annual revenue impact if asset is unavailable const baseImpact = { 'CRITICAL': 10000000, // $10M 'HIGH': 5000000, // $5M 'MEDIUM': 1000000, // $1M 'LOW': 100000, // $100k }; return baseImpact[asset.criticality] || 100000; } private calculateCustomerImpact(asset: any): number { // Estimate number of customers affected const baseImpact = { 'CRITICAL': 1000000, // 1M customers 'HIGH': 500000, // 500k customers 'MEDIUM': 100000, // 100k customers 'LOW': 10000, // 10k customers }; return baseImpact[asset.criticality] || 10000; } private calculateReputationImpact(asset: any): number { // Reputation impact on 1-10 scale if (asset.classification === 'RESTRICTED' && asset.type === 'DATA') { return 9; // High reputation risk for sensitive data } if (asset.criticality === 'CRITICAL') { return 7; } return asset.businessValue >= 8 ? 6 : 3; } private calculateComplianceImpact(asset: any): number { // Compliance impact on 1-10 scale const regulatoryRequirements = this.identifyRegulatoryRequirements(asset); if (regulatoryRequirements.length === 0) { return 1; } // Higher impact for more regulatory requirements return Math.min(10, regulatoryRequirements.length * 2); } }

methodology: string; assessor: string; overallRiskScore: number; riskDistribution: Record<string, number>; topRisks: AssetRisk[]; recommendations: string[]; nextAssessmentDate: Date; } @Injectable() export class RiskAssessmentService { private readonly logger = new Logger(RiskAssessmentService.name); const assessmentId = await this.createRiskAssessment('Monthly Assessment', 'COMPREHENSIVE'); this.logger.log(`Monthly risk assessment completed: ${assessmentId}`); } async createRiskAssessment(name: string, scope: 'COMPREHENSIVE' | 'TARGETED' | 'QUICK'): Promise<string> { const assessmentId = this.generateAssessmentId(); // Perform the assessment await this.executeRiskAssessment(assessment); this.riskAssessments.set(assessmentId, assessment); this.logger.log(`Risk assessment created: ${assessmentId}`); return assessmentId; } async assessThreatScenario(scenarioId: string, assetId: string): Promise<RiskMatrix> { const scenario = this.threatScenarios.get(scenarioId); if (!scenario) { throw new Error(`Threat scenario not found: ${scenarioId}`); } // Calculate risk matrix for the specific asset and threat scenario const riskMatrix = this.calculateRiskMatrix(scenario, assetId); this.logger.log(`Threat scenario assessed: ${scenarioId} for asset ${assetId}, risk level: ${riskMatrix.riskLevel}`); return riskMatrix; } async calculateResidualRisk(assetId: string, mitigations: string[]): Promise<number> { // Get current risk score const currentRisk = await this.getCurrentRiskScore(assetId); // Calculate mitigation effectiveness const mitigationEffectiveness = this.calculateMitigationEffectiveness(mitigations); // Calculate residual risk const residualRisk = Math.max(1, currentRisk * (1 - mitigationEffectiveness)); this.logger.log(`Residual risk calculated for ${assetId}: ${residualRisk}`); return residualRisk; } async generateRiskHeatmap(): Promise<any> { // Generate risk heatmap data const heatmapData = []; for (let impact = 1; impact <= 5; impact++) { for (let likelihood = 1; likelihood <= 5; likelihood++) { const riskScore = impact * likelihood; const riskLevel = this.getRiskLevel(riskScore); heatmapData.push({ impact, likelihood, riskScore, riskLevel, assetCount: await this.getAssetCountForRisk(riskScore), }); } } return heatmapData; } async getRiskTrends(timeframe: 'WEEK' | 'MONTH' | 'QUARTER'): Promise<any[]> { // Get risk trends over time const trends = []; const assessments = Array.from(this.riskAssessments.values()) .filter(assessment => this.isWithinTimeframe(assessment.timestamp, timeframe)) .sort((a, b) => a.timestamp.getTime() - b.timestamp.getTime()); for (const assessment of assessments) { trends.push({ date: assessment.timestamp, overallRisk: assessment.overallRiskScore, highRiskAssets: assessment.topRisks.filter(risk => risk.riskScore >= 15).length, criticalRiskAssets: assessment.topRisks.filter(risk => risk.riskScore >= 20).length, }); } return trends; } private async executeRiskAssessment(assessment: RiskAssessmentReport): Promise<void> { // Collect all asset risks const allRisks: AssetRisk[] = []; // Calculate overall risk metrics assessment.overallRiskScore = this.calculateOverallRiskScore(allRisks); assessment.riskDistribution = this.calculateRiskDistribution(allRisks); assessment.topRisks = this.getTopRisks(allRisks); assessment.recommendations = await this.generateRiskRecommendations(allRisks); } private calculateRiskMatrix(scenario: ThreatScenario, assetId: string): RiskMatrix { // Get asset-specific factors const assetMultiplier = this.getAssetRiskMultiplier(assetId); // Calculate adjusted impact and likelihood const adjustedImpact = Math.min(5, Math.round(scenario.impact * assetMultiplier)); const adjustedLikelihood = Math.min(5, scenario.likelihood); const riskScore = adjustedImpact * adjustedLikelihood; const riskLevel = this.getRiskLevel(riskScore); return { impact: adjustedImpact, likelihood: adjustedLikelihood, riskScore, riskLevel, }; } private getRiskLevel(riskScore: number): 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' { if (riskScore >= 20) return 'CRITICAL'; if (riskScore >= 15) return 'HIGH'; if (riskScore >= 8) return 'MEDIUM'; return 'LOW'; } private getAssetRiskMultiplier(assetId: string): number { // This would integrate with AssetInventoryService // For now, return default multiplier return 1.0; } private async getCurrentRiskScore(assetId: string): Promise<number> { // This would integrate with AssetInventoryService // For now, return default risk score return 10; } private calculateMitigationEffectiveness(mitigations: string[]): number { // Calculate overall effectiveness of mitigations (0-1 scale) const mitigationValues = { 'Encryption': 0.7, 'Access Controls': 0.6, 'Monitoring': 0.4, 'Backup': 0.5, 'Redundancy': 0.8, 'Patching': 0.6, 'Training': 0.3, 'Incident Response': 0.4, }; let totalEffectiveness = 0; let count = 0; for (const mitigation of mitigations) { for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(mitigationValues)) { if (mitigation.includes(key)) { totalEffectiveness += value; count++; break; } } } return count > 0 ? Math.min(0.9, totalEffectiveness / count) : 0; } private calculateOverallRiskScore(risks: AssetRisk[]): number { if (risks.length === 0) return 0; const totalRisk = risks.reduce((sum, risk) => sum + risk.riskScore, 0); return Math.round(totalRisk / risks.length); } private calculateRiskDistribution(risks: AssetRisk[]): Record<string, number> { const distribution = { LOW: 0, MEDIUM: 0, HIGH: 0, CRITICAL: 0 }; for (const risk of risks) { const level = this.getRiskLevel(risk.riskScore); distribution[level]++; } return distribution; } private getTopRisks(risks: AssetRisk[]): AssetRisk[] { return risks .sort((a, b) => b.riskScore - a.riskScore) .slice(0, 10); } private async generateRiskRecommendations(risks: AssetRisk[]): Promise<string[]> { const recommendations: string[] = []; const criticalRisks = risks.filter(risk => this.getRiskLevel(risk.riskScore) === 'CRITICAL'); if (criticalRisks.length > 0) { recommendations.push(`Address ${criticalRisks.length} critical risks immediately`); } const highRisks = risks.filter(risk => this.getRiskLevel(risk.riskScore) === 'HIGH'); if (highRisks.length > 5) { recommendations.push(`Prioritize mitigation of ${highRisks.length} high risks`); } return recommendations; } private getMethodologyForScope(scope: string): string { const methodologies = { 'COMPREHENSIVE': 'ISO 27005 Risk Management', 'TARGETED': 'NIST SP 800-30 Risk Assessment', 'QUICK': 'Simplified Risk Assessment', }; return methodologies[scope] || 'Standard Risk Assessment'; } private calculateNextAssessmentDate(scope: string): Date { const intervals = { 'COMPREHENSIVE': 365, // Annual 'TARGETED': 180, // Semi-annual 'QUICK': 90, // Quarterly }; const days = intervals[scope] || 365; const nextDate = new Date(); nextDate.setDate(nextDate.getDate() + days); return nextDate; } private async getAssetCountForRisk(riskScore: number): Promise<number> { // This would query the asset inventory // For now, return mock data return Math.floor(Math.random() * 20); return diffDays <= (limits[timeframe] || 365); } private generateAssessmentId(): string { const timestamp = Date.now(); const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8); return `RISK-${timestamp}-${random}`.toUpperCase(); } private initializeThreatScenarios(): void { const scenarios: ThreatScenario[] = [ { id: 'T001', name: 'Data Breach via Application Vulnerability', description: 'Attacker exploits application vulnerability to access sensitive data', threatActor: 'External Hacker', attackVector: 'Web Application', assetTypes: ['APPLICATION', 'DATA'], impact: 5, likelihood: 3, mitigations: ['Security scanning', 'Input validation', 'Access controls'], }, { id: 'T002', name: 'Insider Threat - Data Exfiltration', description: 'Malicious insider accesses and exfiltrates sensitive data', threatActor: 'Malicious Insider', attackVector: 'Privileged Access', assetTypes: ['DATA', 'APPLICATION'], impact: 4, likelihood: 2, mitigations: ['Access monitoring', 'Data loss prevention', 'Background checks'], }, { id: 'T003', name: 'Infrastructure Failure', description: 'Critical infrastructure component fails causing service disruption', threatActor: 'Natural Disaster/Technical Failure', attackVector: 'Physical/Technical', assetTypes: ['INFRASTRUCTURE', 'NETWORK'], impact: 4, likelihood: 3, mitigations: ['Redundancy', 'Backup systems', 'Disaster recovery'], }, { id: 'T004', name: 'Supply Chain Attack', description: 'Attacker compromises software supply chain to inject malicious code', threatActor: 'Nation State/APT', attackVector: 'Software Supply Chain', assetTypes: ['APPLICATION', 'INFRASTRUCTURE'], impact: 5, likelihood: 2, mitigations: ['Code signing', 'Dependency scanning', 'Vendor assessment'], }, { id: 'T005', name: 'DDoS Attack', description: 'Distributed denial of service attack overwhelms infrastructure', threatActor: 'Cybercriminals', attackVector: 'Network', assetTypes: ['INFRASTRUCTURE', 'NETWORK', 'APPLICATION'], impact: 3, likelihood: 4, mitigations: ['DDoS protection', 'Rate limiting', 'Load balancing'], }, ]; scenarios.forEach(scenario => { this.threatScenarios.set(scenario.id, scenario); }); } } This comprehensive Asset Management & Risk Assessment implementation provides: Asset Discovery & Inventory with automated discovery of infrastructure, applications, data, network, and security control assets Asset Classification & Valuation with confidentiality, integrity, availability assessment and business value calculation Risk Assessment Framework with threat scenario modeling, risk matrix calculation, and residual risk assessment Threat Modeling with STRIDE methodology and attack vector analysis Risk Monitoring & Reporting with automated assessments, risk heatmaps, and trend analysis Compliance & Governance with regulatory requirement mapping and compliance status tracking The implementation ensures comprehensive visibility and risk management for all organizational assets in the NestJS/Next.js application ecosystem.

// src/auth/jwt.service.ts import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common'; import { JwtService as NestJwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { Repository } from 'typeorm'; import { RefreshToken } from './entities/refresh-token.entity'; import { User } from '../users/entities/user.entity'; import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'; @Injectable() export class JwtService { constructor( private jwtService: NestJwtService, private configService: ConfigService, @InjectRepository(RefreshToken) private refreshTokenRepository: Repository<RefreshToken>, ) {} async generateTokens(user: User): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string }> { const payload = { sub: user.id, email: user.email, roles: user.roles, permissions: user.permissions, }; const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, { expiresIn: this.configService.get('JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN', '15m'), }); const refreshToken = await this.generateRefreshToken(user.id); return { accessToken, refreshToken }; } async generateRefreshToken(userId: string): Promise<string> { // Invalidate existing refresh tokens await this.refreshTokenRepository.update( { userId, isActive: true }, { isActive: false } ); const token = randomBytes(64).toString('hex'); const expiresAt = new Date(); expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 30); // 30 days await this.refreshTokenRepository.save({ token, userId, expiresAt, isActive: true, }); return token; } async refreshAccessToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string }> { const storedToken = await this.refreshTokenRepository.findOne({ where: { token: refreshToken, isActive: true }, relations: ['user'], }); if (!storedToken || storedToken.expiresAt < new Date()) { throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid refresh token'); } return this.generateTokens(storedToken.user); } async revokeRefreshToken(token: string): Promise<void> { await this.refreshTokenRepository.update( { token }, { isActive: false } ); } }

// src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common'; import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport'; import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt'; import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config'; import { UsersService } from '../../users/users.service'; @Injectable() export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) { constructor( private configService: ConfigService, private usersService: UsersService, ) { super({ jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(), ignoreExpiration: false, secretOrKey: configService.get('JWT_SECRET'), }); } async validate(payload: any) { const user = await this.usersService.findById(payload.sub); if (!user || !user.isActive) { throw new UnauthorizedException('User not found or inactive'); } // Check if user's roles/permissions have changed if (this.hasPermissionsChanged(user, payload)) { throw new UnauthorizedException('User permissions have changed'); } return { id: user.id, email: user.email, roles: user.roles, permissions: user.permissions, }; } private hasPermissionsChanged(user: any, payload: any): boolean { // Compare current user roles/permissions with token payload return JSON.stringify(user.roles) !== JSON.stringify(payload.roles); } } // src/auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts import { Injectable, ExecutionContext, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common'; import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport'; import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core'; @Injectable() export class JwtAuthGuard extends AuthGuard('jwt') { constructor(private reflector: Reflector) { super(); } canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) { const isPublic = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<boolean>('isPublic', [ context.getHandler(), context.getClass(), ]); if (isPublic) { return true; } return super.canActivate(context); } handleRequest(err: any, user: any, info: any) { if (err || !user) { throw err || new UnauthorizedException('Invalid token'); } return user; } }

// src/auth/guards/roles.guard.ts import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core'; @Injectable() export class RolesGuard implements CanActivate { constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {} canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean { const requiredRoles = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>('roles', [ context.getHandler(), context.getClass(), ]); const requiredPermissions = this.reflector.getAllAndOverride<string[]>('permissions', [ context.getHandler(), context.getClass(), ]); if (!requiredRoles && !requiredPermissions) { return true; } const { user } = context.switchToHttp().getRequest(); if (requiredRoles && !this.hasRequiredRoles(user.roles, requiredRoles)) { return false; } if (requiredPermissions && !this.hasRequiredPermissions(user.permissions, requiredPermissions)) { return false; } return true; } private hasRequiredRoles(userRoles: string[], requiredRoles: string[]): boolean { return requiredRoles.some(role => userRoles.includes(role)); } private hasRequiredPermissions(userPermissions: string[], requiredPermissions: string[]): boolean { return requiredPermissions.every(permission => userPermissions.includes(permission)); } } // Decorators import { SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common'; export const Roles = (...roles: string[]) => SetMetadata('roles', roles); export const Permissions = (...permissions: string[]) => SetMetadata('permissions', permissions); export const Public = () => SetMetadata('isPublic', true);

// src/auth/guards/resource-owner.guard.ts import { Injectable, CanActivate, ExecutionContext, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common'; import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core'; @Injectable() export class ResourceOwnerGuard implements CanActivate { constructor(private reflector: Reflector) {} async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> { const resourceParam = this.reflector.get<string>('resourceParam', context.getHandler()); if (!resourceParam) return true; const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest(); const user = request.user; const resourceId = request.params[resourceParam]; // Check if user owns the resource or has admin role if (user.roles.includes('admin') || user.roles.includes('super-admin')) { return true; } // Custom resource ownership logic const isOwner = await this.checkResourceOwnership(user.id, resourceId, context); if (!isOwner) { throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have access to this resource'); } return true; } private async checkResourceOwnership(userId: string, resourceId: string, context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> { // Implement resource-specific ownership checks const resourceType = this.getResourceType(context); switch (resourceType) { case 'user': return userId === resourceId; case 'order': return await this.checkOrderOwnership(userId, resourceId); default: return false; } } private getResourceType(context: ExecutionContext): string { const className = context.getClass().name.toLowerCase(); return className.replace('controller', ''); } private async checkOrderOwnership(userId: string, orderId: string): Promise<boolean> { // Implementation to check if user owns the order return true; // Simplified } } export const ResourceOwner = (param: string) => SetMetadata('resourceParam', param);
